Name: Textbook Finish
Description: A finishing blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Master's Demonstration
Description: A model strike that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Drilled Repetition
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Rehearsed Motions

Name: Drawn Venom

Name: Purging Thrust

Name: Measured Purge
Description: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Tolerance Drill
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Knuckle Lesson
Description: A two-fisted blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Hurled Rubble
Description: Throws a chunk of rock that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

Name: Brachiate
Description: Swings you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Returned in Kind

Name: Seam Finder
Description: A weapon strike driven between the plates that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Angled Plates
Description: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds.

Name: Felling Stroke

Name: Woodsman's Arc

Name: Edge Discipline

Name: Splitting Habit

Name: Erratic Flight

Name: Skipped Stone
Description: Skips a flat stone into the target for 10 damage and stuns it for 0.8 seconds; it then leaps to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that.

Name: Rolls Right Off
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.

Name: Unruffled
Description: Once your health falls below 50%, every heal reaching you is worth 30% more for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Uprooted Boulder
Description: Tears up a boulder and hurls it at a target up to 7 tiles away for 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. It ignores the target's armour and has a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Gravel Wallow

Name: Pinpoint Pitch
Description: Throws a stone for 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Threat Stare
Description: Stares down everything in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage, stunning it for 1 second, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Weakened] for 8 seconds.

Name: Weak Spot Found
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Sized Up
Description: Each time you afflict something, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Gnawed-Bone Toss
Description: Throws a gnawed bone for 7 damage. It holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Elbows at the Table
Description: Shoves every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage, knocking them back 3 tiles, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Shared Haunch
Description: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Second Helping

Name: Flung Brand

Name: Smouldering Pelt
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Singed Temper
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Troop Tide
Description: Slams the ground in a wave that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

Name: Long-Arm Flick
Description: Flicks a bolt of water into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Its reach is 40% longer.

Name: Wriggle Free
Description: Frees you and every ally within 5 tiles from up to 2 control conditions each.

Name: Shoal Closes Ranks
Description: When your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds and a shoal escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Treetop Drop
Description: You leap up to 6 tiles onto the target and pound it for 15 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. For 4 seconds after, you move 20% faster.

Name: Picked Nits
Description: Flicks 4 fleas in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 2 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Rampart Bound
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Spring-Loaded
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Trampling Heel
Description: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Column Tread
Description: Stamps the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Forced March
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds. A troop escort marches beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Road-Hardened Knuckles
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Split Bough
Description: Hurls a split bough that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, the hit dealing 100% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Crossed Purposes
Description: Seizes up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, deals 10 damage to each and stuns them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

Name: Two-Pronged Guard
Description: Returns 50% of the damage you take to whoever dealt it for 9 seconds, and each such blow has a 30% chance to turn the attacker against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Either Hand
Description: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Mocking Fling
Description: Flings a clod that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Its reach is 40% longer.

Name: Pilfered Finish
Description: A finishing blow that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Troop Bluff
Description: Veils you and your allies within 5 tiles for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Feint and Wallop
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Throat-Sac Howl

Name: Puff-Chest Spring
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 11 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Snap Reflex
Description: Each time anything but fire hurts you, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 6% more dodge chance.

Name: Rotten Fruit Lob
Description: Lobs a rotten fruit into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Mycelial Rally
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles.

Name: Slow Overgrowth
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Ledge Shove
Description: A two-handed shove that deals 15 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Cliff Hold
Description: Your armour rises by 12%. You have 6% physical resistance.

Name: Flung Sod

Name: Leaning Crush
Description: A slow, leaning blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

Name: Barn Warmth
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 5 tiles, for 10 seconds.

Name: Huddle In

Name: Thumbs on Every Limb
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Sure Clasp
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your armour also rises by 6%.

Name: Drumming Knuckles

Name: Gallop Rhythm

Name: Ring the Prey
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds. A troop escort hunts beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Anvil Throw
Description: Hurls an iron weight up to 7 tiles for 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Cold Knuckle

Name: Silverback Wall

Name: Cold-Forged Hide

Name: Sloughed Hide

Name: Basking Hide

Name: Fistful Feast

Name: Cloud Burst

Name: Stripped Field
Description: Releases a swarm that stays for 14 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Gorge on the Fallen
Description: Each time you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Bare-Knuckle Cast

Name: Unbound Pound
Description: Slams a wave of raw arcana that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores their resistances.

Name: Arcane Arm-Span
Description: Your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 20 seconds.

Name: Charged Fist
Description: Each time you spend stamina, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Gagging Grip

Name: Taught Gesture

Name: Slow Bulwark

Name: Unhurried Mass

Name: Two-Fisted Quake

Name: Snatched Grip
Description: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to an enemy and snatches at its hands, dealing 10 damage and silencing it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

Name: Up the Sleeve
Description: Pulls out a trick you already used: clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Fiddled Odds

Name: From the Floorboards

Name: Underfoot Scramble
Description: Rushes you up to 5 tiles and scurries between the legs of up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and turning them against each other for 4 seconds.

Name: Troop Goes Quiet

Name: Flicked Splinter

Name: Finds the Gap

Name: Pressed Advantage

Name: Bundled and Wrung

Name: Spare Arm

Name: Rolled Tackle

Name: Bristling Curl

Name: Layered Brawn

Name: Practised Signs

Name: Thorny Switch

Name: Nesting Bower

Name: Leaf-Fed Bulk

Name: Running Start

Name: Hunched Out the Storm

Name: Sodden Coat
Description: Your armour rises by 8%. You also carry 10% water resistance.

Name: Gathers the Stragglers

Name: Mobbing Swipe

Name: Scrabbling Mischief

Name: Not Going Down

Name: Next to the Block
Description: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Belfry Shriek
Description: Shrieks in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving everything caught [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Night Tether
Description: A dart of darkness deals 4 damage and heals you for 25% of it, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Mobbing Colony
Description: Looses a colony of bats for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Feeding on the Held
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Crushing Embrace
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and crush it in a weapon strike for 12 damage. It is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 35% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Pinned Beneath
Description: Mauls everything in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaving each enemy caught [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Winter Den Stance
Description: Your armour rises by 30% and your physical resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

Name: Goaded Temper
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Stinging Cells
Description: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 3 seconds.

Name: Swarming Hold
Description: A weapon strike that deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and 30% slower for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Woven Skep
Description: Sets down a hive for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Sealing the Comb
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Stooping Talons
Description: You dive up to 7 tiles onto the target and strike for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Hooded Quarry
Description: Throws a hood that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Blunted] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Loosed Falcon
Description: Looses a falcon for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Pit Canary
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Fish in a Barrel
Description: Looses an arrow that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target, up to 40%.

Name: Staking Shot
Description: A full-draw shot deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 8 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Cinch Line
Description: Strings a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Nocked and Waiting
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Turnkey Throw
Description: Throws an iron key-bar for 12 damage, up to 1.4 times that at 6 tiles. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

Name: Iron Door
Description: Slams an iron door into the target for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 10% easier to wound and [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Lockdown
Description: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: No Exemptions
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Batted About
Description: A quick weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 20% slower for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Cornered Mouse
Description: Pounces on a target at or below 25% health for 26 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.2 times the damage they had left, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Toying Feint
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Playing With It
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Into the Pen
Description: Drives forward through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, knocking everything caught back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Yoked Blow
Description: Throws a yoke for 28 damage, up to 1.4 times that at 6 tiles, leaving the target [Leaden] for 6 seconds. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Close Corral
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 9 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Stall-Fed
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Shackle Toss
Description: Throws a shackle for 4 damage that then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Links Pulled Taut
Description: Yanks the chain taut around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 25% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Hauled In
Description: Reels up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Short Leash
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Smothering Wrap
Description: Flings a wrap that deals 11 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Flung Netting
Description: Flings a net through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave each enemy caught [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Covered Over
Description: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Padded Cell
Description: When anything but fire hurts you, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Cut Both Ways
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Reef Closes In
Description: Reef grows up around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Caged] for 2 seconds.

Name: Tide Pool Shelter
Description: Raises a pool where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Accretion Wall
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Death Roll
Description: Rolls a target at or below 30% health for 28 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.4 times the damage they had left, and leaves it [Inescapable] for 4 seconds.

Name: Vise Grip
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike deals 9 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 50% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Waiting Jaws
Description: Conjures a pair of jaws onto the nearest enemy that arm after 1 second and wait up to 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 3 tiles springs them, which deals 24 damage to everything within 2 tiles of them and leaves it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Mudbank Watcher
Description: Calls a bonded crocodile that fights beside you. Every 2 seconds it bites an enemy within 4.5 tiles and deals 6 damage, and anything it bites moves 50% slower for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Shed Antler
Description: Throws a shed antler that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 6 tiles, with a 15% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Startled Kick
Description: Kicks out through a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 7 damage with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Caught in Lamplight
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Second Flinch
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge roll that failed is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Latching Bite
Description: A bite for 5 damage that leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: deals 24 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 7 tiles, and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

Name: Kennel Call
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A pack of hounds fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Gatehound
Description: Calls a bonded hound that fights beside you. Every 1.2 seconds it bites an enemy within 4.5 tiles and deals 4 damage, and anything it bites moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Decoy Spread
Description: Skims 3 decoys out at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Becalmed
Description: Drops a weight of still water on the target that deals 26 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Unruffled
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Rolls Off the Back
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Ring of Pillars
Description: Stone pillars burst up around you, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Capstone
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Drops a block of stone on it that deals 30 damage and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

Name: Standing Stones
Description: Raises a line of standing stones 6 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Inner Keep
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Your gaze deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 7 tiles, and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Petrifying Stare
Description: Stares down a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, stunning everything caught for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Meeting the Gaze
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Panopticon
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for your next strike, for up to 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Devour the Penned
Description: Uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 16 damage, 60% more for each one eaten. It is left 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Dinner Bell

Name: Brazen Bull

Name: Burning Bars
Description: Raises a line of burning bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Ember Lattice
Description: Conjures a lattice of embers around you: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 6%, 15% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your fire resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Silver Cast
Description: Throws a darting shot that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the original damage each. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Drawn Net
Description: Draws a net of bars tight around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. You slip free, moving 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Bait Shoal
Description: Casts a lure that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A shoal of silver fish fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Glancing Bars
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pounce Lock
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Falling Gate
Description: Brings a barred gate down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Landing Brace
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Hopping Ward
Description: Each time you cover a stretch of ground, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.

Name: Stamp Order

Name: Column Halt

Name: Garrison Step
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sentry Stride
Description: You move 10% faster and have 8% physical resistance.

Name: Prong Split
Description: Throws a two-pronged shot that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of the damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Twin Tines
Description: Looses 2 prongs in a wide fork, each dealing 9 damage, knocking its target back 3 tiles and leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Crossroads Fence
Description: Strings a barred fence 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Branching Reprisal
Description: Each time you strike with your weapon, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Your armour rises by 6%. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Sprung Latch
Description: Flicks a bolt that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Switcheroo
Description: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Feigned Surrender
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds and raises your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds.

Name: Loaded Dice
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would hit you is rolled a second time against your dodge chance, and the second roll stands.

Name: Sticky Reach
Description: Lashes out a sticky tongue that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Marsh Chorus
Description: Booms a narrow croak 5 tiles ahead that deals 12 damage to everything in it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Lily Snare
Description: Takes 1 second to set a snapping trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Last Hop
Description: Once your health falls below 50%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. You also have 8% more dodge chance. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Bind
Description: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Caged] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Puffball Burst
Description: Bursts a cloud that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 15% chance to leave the target [Caged] for 2 seconds.

Name: Brittle Husk
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each such blow leaves the attacker [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Colony
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second and your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Ram Break
Description: A headbutt that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Hardhead Jab
Description: A short thrust that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at its full reach of 2 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your own health already lost (max 40%).

Name: Cliffside Stance
Description: Your armour rises by 25% and your physical resistance by 12% for 10 seconds.

Name: Stand Fast
Description: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Herd Nip
Description: A snapping strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

Name: Steam Gust
Description: Breathes a wide cone 4 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Barn Warmth
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles, plus 1% more for every 1% of your cast speed.

Name: Calf at Heel
Description: Calls a grazen calf familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill you make restores 3 health.

Name: Barred Muzzle
Description: Fires a slug that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignores its armour and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Suppressing Fire
Description: Looses 3 shots in a spread, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Loophole Post
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a gun post beside you for 20 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 7 tiles for 6 damage.

Name: Return Fire
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shot strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 8 damage. Your armour rises by 5%. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Snarl Lash
Description: A lashing strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Thousand Threads
Description: Looses 4 strands in a fan, each dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Woven Ward
Description: Weaves a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 6 blows, and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

Name: Strand Ledger
Description: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 27% of your weapon damage per strand (163% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Leveller
Description: A flattening blow that deals 40 damage, ignores armour, leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Anvil Toll
Description: Slams the ground, dealing 18 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Smith's Summons
Description: Increases your blunt damage by 25% for 10 seconds and pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Finishing Weight
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Wringing Grip
Description: A crushing grip on a target up to 2 tiles away that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Seize and Turn
Description: Seizes up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 4 seconds. Each takes 10 damage and is stunned for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Firm Hold
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Sure Fingers
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Trampling Rush
Description: Rushes you up to 7 tiles to the target, then a weapon strike deals 16 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 35% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Hoofbeat Drum
Description: Stamps in a tight circle, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves you moving 20% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Relief Post
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. A mount escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Long Haul
Description: Each time you cover a stretch of ground, you recover 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Barbed Haul
Description: Throws a barbed hook that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Grapple Lines
Description: Looses 2 hooked lines, each dealing 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Snagline
Description: Drags every enemy near a baited line ahead of you inward for 6 seconds. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 2 seconds. The wall is 6 tiles long.

Name: Catch and Hold
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Wedge Charge
Description: Drives forward through a wide cone 5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Each target has a 40% chance to be left [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Couched Lance
Description: A lance thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 34 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Corral Run
Description: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A warhorse fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Mounting Pace
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Run Down
Description: A closing blow that deals 24 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It leaves the target [Inescapable] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Quarry Ring
Description: Draws a ring 5 tiles wide around you that deals 14 damage to every enemy in it and leaves each [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Baying Pack
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further. A pack of hounds fights beside you for 25 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Scent Bound
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Frostbound Blow
Description: A weapon strike that deals 18 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds, leaves it [Frostbite] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Damped] for 5 seconds.

Name: Unmoving Toll
Description: Strikes every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 34 damage that ignores resistances, and leaves each [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Deep Freeze
Description: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Rime Bulwark
Description: Your armour rises by 14%, and you have 8% frost resistance.

Name: Between the Bars
Description: A thrust at a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

Name: Nail Down
Description: Throws a hidden blade that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet, and a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Muffled Step

Name: Jailhouse Shiv
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Torpid Spit

Name: Winter Torpor
Description: Breathes a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Shed Skin
Description: Removes 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health. A shed tail fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Basking Rampart
Description: During the day, your armour rises by 12% and your dodge chance by 5%.

Name: Gnaw Through

Name: Devouring Cloud

Name: Living Palisade

Name: Plague Hatch
Description: Calls a locust cloud familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving its target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Spellbound Cell

Name: Latticed Volley
Description: Looses 4 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Mirror Gate
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it. You have 12% more arcane resistance while it holds.

Name: Quickened Ward
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and your arcane resistance rises by 12%.

Name: Binding Word
Description: Speaks a word that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Suppressed] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Closing Sentence

Name: Standing Cast
Description: Increases your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds. A guardian fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Spoken Shield
Description: Each time you spend mana, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Tidal Nudge
Description: Pushes a swell that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Swell

Name: Weight of Numbers
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Cornered Fury
Description: When your health falls below 35%, your damage rises 50% for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Flung Muck
Description: Flings muck that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance of [Hindered] slowing the target's attacks for 4 seconds.

Name: Scatter Kick
Description: Kicks out in a wide cone 6 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Decoy Trot
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. While it lasts, a troop of monkeys fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Spare Hands
Description: Calls a bonded macaque that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds against enemies within 5 tiles.

Name: Quick Trample
Description: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its maximum range of 5 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Startling Stamp
Description: A thunderous stamp that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Rind Lure
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. While it lasts, a pack of mice fights beside you for 5 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Scurry Clear
Description: When you are hurt, you gain a ward that soaks 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Pinpoint Prod
Description: Sends a narrow bolt that deals 9 damage. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Seam Strike
Description: A charging thrust that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its maximum range of 6 tiles, and deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health on top.

Name: Locked On
Description: Increases your critical chance by 20% for 12 seconds. Pulls up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Gap Found
Description: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Hobbling Throw
Description: A lashing throw that deals 5 damage, with a 35% chance of [Slowed] reducing the target's movement for 4 seconds.

Name: Corral
Description: Closes in on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Paddock
Description: Raises a line of force 6.5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything struck moves 16% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Tightening Mesh
Description: When you inflict a condition, your damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Many Hooves
Description: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Eightfold Thrash
Description: Looses 8 flailing strikes in a spread, each dealing 3 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

Name: Wrapped Up
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises 8% while it holds.

Name: Reaching Limb
Description: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds against enemies within 5 tiles.

Name: Rolling Bash
Description: You roll into the target, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You rush up to 6 tiles to reach it.

Name: Barbed Trample
Description: Tramples through every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 4 damage to each.

Name: Bristling Hide
Description: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

Name: Overlap
Description: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Clean Slash
Description: Sends a thin bolt that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Loose Leaves
Description: Looses 5 bolts in a spread, each dealing 6 damage and ignoring resistances.

Name: Struck Out
Description: Removes up to 12 conditions from you.

Name: Margin Notes
Description: Your other abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter. Your armour rises 10%.

Name: Rootbind
Description: Sends a seed bolt that deals 10 damage with a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

Name: Pollen Burst
Description: Looses a cone of pollen 5 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it and making them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Grazing Ground
Description: Raises a patch of grass where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Deep Roots
Description: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.

Name: Quick Jab
Description: A snap blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: Spooked Stampede
Description: Bolts through enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 13 damage and knocking them back 3 tiles.

Name: Burst Start
Description: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Building Speed
Description: When you have run a good distance, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Drizzle Lob
Description: Lobs a drop that deals 5 damage with a 40% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Cloudburst
Description: The sky opens, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a splash of 80% of that to enemies within 3.5 tiles of each.

Name: Falling Grey
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Steady Downpour
Description: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Gathered Charge
Description: Sends a bolt that deals 7 damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Clean Sweep
Description: Sweeps a cone 7 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. The sweep ignores armour.

Name: Gleaned Wind
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

Description: When you run out of stamina, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Not Going Down
Description: When your health runs out, you regain 8 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 120 seconds.

Name: Sovereign Charge
Description: A charge through every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Your party's damage rises 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Command Presence
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 6 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 10 seconds, drawing 1.5 times the usual threat.

Name: Presiding Calm
Description: When your health is full, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Scent Trail
Description: Sends a bolt that deals 9 damage and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 40%). It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Circling Rush
Description: You rush to the target and strike every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 13 damage and making them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Blood in the Water
Description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Lurking Strike
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 40% more critical chance.

Description: A heavy shove that deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its maximum range of 4 tiles, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Bulwark Crush
Description: Brings the full weight down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage and ignoring resistances.

Name: Hold the Line
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises 10% while it holds.

Name: Held Ground
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (64% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.

Name: Broadside
Description: A heavy swing that deals 18 damage, up to 2 times as much at its maximum range of 6 tiles, and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Salvo
Description: Looses 3 bolts in a spread, each dealing 8 damage and ignoring armour.

Name: Fair Wind
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Swell Step
Description: When you have run a good distance, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Dig In
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Furrow Drive
Description: When you kill an enemy, your damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Reaping Stroke
Description: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 0.5 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The blow deals 20 damage.

Name: Wide Swath
Description: Cuts a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it.

Name: Chewed Over
Description: Restores 14 health to you, with a 10% chance of a critical heal. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

Name: Harvest Home
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Fair Warning
Description: Sends a bolt that deals 6 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Foul Cone
Description: Looses a reeking cone 5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and with a 40% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Description: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source, for 8 seconds.

Name: Nobody Twice
Description: When you are hurt, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Description: A heavy, unhurried blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Inevitable
Description: A crushing blow on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Slow Mend
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Recovery
Description: When you are hurt, healing you receives is 30% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Waiting Strike
Description: A coiled strike that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Venom Spread
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 8 damage and is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4.5 tiles.

Name: Coiled Tension

Description: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Web Snare
Description: Conjures a snare onto the nearest enemy. It waits 20 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 14 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Plucked Strand
Description: When a condition you inflicted expires, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Gap-Finding Lash
Description: Lashes an enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunned for 1 second.

Name: Thrice-Drilled Cast
Description: Casts 3 hooked chains in a fan out to 8 tiles, each dealing 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Link by Link
Description: Each hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Bitter Draw
Description: Casts a hooked link at the first enemy it meets for 8 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Wormwood Drag
Description: Stretches a 6-tile chain ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Shared Purge
Description: Draws up to 3 poison conditions out of you and out of each of your allies.

Name: Back Along the Link
Description: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Long Arm
Description: Swings a chain at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach.

Name: Wrecking Swing
Description: Swings a heavy chain in a full circle that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each one back 3 tiles.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: Hooks a chain ahead of you and swings you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Grips Back
Description: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds and the enemy you hit moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Ring-Splitter
Description: Jabs a chain spike into the target for 5 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Shed Mail
Description: Bursts your conjured mail outward, which deals 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Riveted Layer
Description: Closes a coat of links around you that absorbs the next 20 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

Name: Conjured Hauberk
Description: Conjures a coat of chain mail: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 10.

Name: Headsman's Tether
Description: Drops a chained blade on an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Whirling Bit
Description: Whirls an axe-head on a chain around you, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Pendulum Blade
Description: Hangs an axe-head on a chain where you stand for 12 seconds. It swings at an enemy within 3 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Carry Through
Description: When you kill an enemy, your chain whips on to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Belfry Rattle
Description: Rattles your chains, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each with [Vibrant Echo] for 5 seconds.

Name: Drained on the Hook
Description: Hooks an enemy at or below 30% health for 24 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Dark Rafters
Description: Hauls you up into the dark and veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 17% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

Name: Night Roost
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 15%.

Name: Crushing Embrace
Description: Wraps chains around an enemy and crushes it for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Into the Den
Description: Collapses a 5-tile line of chain ahead of you for 3 seconds that drags enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Baiting Roar
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

Name: Goaded in the Pit
Description: Each time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% in all, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Lodged Barb
Description: A weapon strike that deals 6 damage and leaves a barbed link in the target: it is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 15% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Swarm Relay
Description: The swarm deals 25 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles for 50% of the damage.

Name: Of One Hive
Description: For 10 seconds, every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power.

Name: Stinger Handoff
Description: When you inflict a condition, a barbed link flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Grapple Swoop
Description: Hooks an enemy up to 7 tiles away and swoops you to it along the chain, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: Flight of Hooks
Description: Flicks 2 light hooks out to 9 tiles, each dealing 3 damage, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: To the High Perch
Description: Hooks a point up to 7 tiles away and pulls you to it at once. You also gain 10% dodge chance.

Name: Swung Momentum
Description: Every few paces you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Whaler's Shot
Description: Fires a chained harpoon at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 2 times that at full range, and the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Staked Lines
Description: Looses 3 chain-bolts in a spread out to 9 tiles, each dealing 26 damage that ignores armour, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Strung Across

Name: Held at Full Draw
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Slammed Shut

Name: Warden's Lock
Description: Casts a shackle at the first enemy it meets that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Behind Bars
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Cell of Last Resort
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Toyed-With Prey

Name: Nine-Tailed Scourge

Name: Padded Tread
Description: Muffles your chains and veils you for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking breaks the veil.

Name: Caught on the Tether
Description: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.

Name: Ploughed Furrow
Description: Drags a heavy yoke of chain through a cone ahead of you, which deals 13 damage to everything within 4 tiles and knocks it back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Team Haul
Description: Hauls a weighted chain into an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach; its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 30%. On a hit, every ally gains 20% damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Steady Yoke
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Belled Collar
Description: Conjures a collar of links: your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 10% more damage, each kill restores 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 15.

Name: Paid Out in Lengths
Description: Casts a link at the first enemy it meets for 6 damage, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of that. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Fan of Fetters
Description: Lashes a fan of chains ahead of you, which deals 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles, stuns it for 1 second and has a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Bound Fast
Description: Binds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

Name: No Slipping Free
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.

Name: Cast Net
Description: Casts a woven net of fine chain in a cone ahead of you, which deals 4 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Winding Sheet
Description: Casts a sheet of woven links at an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Field Dressing
Description: Binds your wounds in woven links: you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Woven Ward
Description: 15% of the elemental damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Spreading Reef
Description: Casts a coral-crusted link at the first enemy it meets for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Barnacle Rasp
Description: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Living Moorings
Description: Grows a reef of living links around you for 8 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Slow Accretion
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Out of Still Water
Description: Lunges a hooked chain at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 30 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit, and its damage rises 5% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 50%.

Name: Rolling Grip
Description: A weapon strike that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Waiting Jaws
Description: Conjures a set of chained iron jaws at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 1 minute; the first enemy to come within 2 tiles springs them, which deals 20 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

Name: Drowning Hold
Description: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health.

Name: Weighted Kick
Description: A quick kick weighted with a loop of chain that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: Fleeing Whipcrack
Description: A long lash at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach, and knocks the target back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

Name: Slipped Halter
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and springs you 2 tiles from where you stood. You also have 10% more dodge chance.

Name: Yanked Aside
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled again.

Name: Worry the Wound
Description: Worries a hooked link into the target for 8 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Run It Down
Description: Casts a leash at the first enemy it meets, up to 7 tiles away, and runs you down it to the target for 14 damage.

Name: Lifeline
Description: Throws a lifeline to the ally who needs it most: they regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Hound at Heel
Description: A leashed hound fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: One Good Skip
Description: Skims a link at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage; it skips on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

Name: Shaken Spray
Description: Shakes water off your chains in a cone, which deals 26 damage that ignores resistances to everything within 4 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Shrugged Off
Description: Removes up to 5 conditions from you, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Rolls Right Off
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Ball and Shackle

Name: Anchor Drop

Name: Bolted Down
Description: Locks plates of stone along your chains, raising your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Rock Flail
Description: Conjures a flail of chain with a rock head: your weapon damage rises 14%, every strike leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage every 0.8 seconds, 3 times over, and your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Picked Out From Afar
Description: Hooks an enemy at or below 30% health up to 9 tiles away for 26 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range.

Name: Lidless Shackle
Description: Casts a shackle at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Far as It Sees
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

Name: Never Out of View
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Carver's Portion
Description: A hooked blow that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 9 damage, leaving the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

Name: Laid Table
Description: A sweep of chain that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt, and every ally gains 15% damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Bones for Broth
Description: Hooks every body within 9 tiles, up to 5, and drains it. Each one restores 7% of your health.

Name: Course After Course
Description: Each enemy you kill builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack, 25% in all at 5 stacks. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Running Flame

Name: White-Hot Brand
Description: Presses a heated link into the target for 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Searing Coil
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Kindling Leap
Description: When you land a critical hit, a heated link flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, then leaps to 3 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Silver Skein
Description: Casts a weighted net at the first enemy it meets that deals 28 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every other enemy within 3 tiles of it takes 80% of that damage.

Name: Darting Links
Description: Whirls a ring of links around you that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and each hit darts on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Wriggle Free
