Description: Pecks all around you in a ring, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Pick Clean
Description: Strips one of your afflictions off the target with a peck that deals 8 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Crop Full
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Scavenger Frenzy
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Raw Spark
Description: Fires a bolt of raw arcana that deals 9 damage to the first enemy in its path. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

Name: Wild Burst
Description: A burst of raw arcana that deals 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Hen's Charm
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 11 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Quickened Mind
Description: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 22% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Muted Cluck
Description: Clucks a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy in its path, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds, its abilities out of reach.

Name: Hen-Scrawl Rune
Description: Scratches a rune into the target with a blow that deals 28 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

Name: Long Reach
Description: For 22 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

Name: Rote Repetition
Description: Your abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Tidal Heave
Description: Heaves a wave through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each has a 60% chance to be [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Rolling Swell
Description: Rolls a swell that deals 28 damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Buoyant Calm
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

Name: Slow Tide
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Brood Mother's Shove
Description: Rushes the target and deals 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

Name: Thunder Flurry
Description: Beats down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage, plus 5% of the maximum health of any boss or elite it hits. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Puffed Up
Description: Increases your damage by 35% for 15 seconds. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 20 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Cornered Mettle
Description: When your health falls below 40%, you deal 50% more damage for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your armour is also 8% higher at all times.

Name: Decoy Scuffle
Description: Kicks up a flapping commotion that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to confuse the target for 4 seconds, turning it on its allies.

Name: Pocketed Scrap
Description: Flings a pilfered scrap that deals 8 damage. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Feint and Flap
Description: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds. You jink 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Nimble Pilferer
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds. Your dodge chance is also 5% higher at all times.

Name: Skitter Nip
Description: A quick peck that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after each peck.

Name: Underfoot Mob
Description: Swarms every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour.

Name: Hush in the Straw
Description: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You move 10% faster while veiled.

Name: Bolt Hole
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a ward that absorbs 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. Your dodge chance is also 6% higher at all times.

Name: Seam Finder
Description: A precise peck that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 25% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Stitching Volley
Description: Looses 4 darts at once, each dealing 5 damage. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Pinprick Bulwark
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Sharp Eye
Description: When you land a critical hit, a darting strike hits the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Coop Wire Toss
Description: Hurls a snarl of twine that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Hemmed In
Description: Cinches a mesh of cord around every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 22 damage that ignores resistances. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Rally the Pen
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds.

Name: Twine-Tied Chick
Description: Calls a bonded chick familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Inkblot Jab
Description: Lashes out with ink that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 30% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds, lowering its critical hit chance. Each hit also has a 20% chance to confuse the target for 3 seconds.

Name: Eightfold Lash
Description: Lashes in every direction, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Shed the Snare
Description: Removes two conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Reserve Arms
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your dodge chance is also 5% higher at all times.

Name: Rolling Rebuff
Description: Rolls into the target from afar, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Barrel About
Description: Barrels around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 25%.

Name: Huddle Under
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and hardens your armour by 10%. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Seams Closing
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Writ of Summons
Description: Serves a writ that deals 30 damage and curses the target, plus 5% of the maximum health of a boss or elite it hits.

Name: Sheaf Flutter
Description: Flutters 3 pages at once, each dealing 5 damage, knocking its target back 2 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Fine Print
Description: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

Name: Standing Orders
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Spilled Seed
Description: Spits a seed that deals 8 damage and roots the target, leaving it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Pod Burst
Description: Bursts seed pods in a ring, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target, up to 30%.

Name: Henhouse Garden
Description: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, up to 4 allies.

Name: Deep Roots
Description: When you gain health, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Bolt from the Warren
Description: Bolts at the target and deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. You rush to the target first, and your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds.

Name: Startle Burst
Description: Bursts out in every direction, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Flushed Dash
Description: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 30% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Ground Covered
Description: When you cover a stretch of ground, you deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Falling Grey
Description: A drop from above that deals 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Storm Front
Description: Beats a gale of rain ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in the cone. Every hit is a critical hit, and the target has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Shelter from Storm
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Damp Feathers
Description: When you are hurt by something other than fire, you gain a ward that absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Flung Dirt
Description: Scratches up a clod and flings it, dealing 4 damage and leaving the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Clear the Yard
Description: Rakes a wide arc ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

Name: Tidy Furrows
Description: Rakes up to 2 conditions off you and every ally.

Name: Gleaned Grain
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Gnaw and Scatter
Description: Bites for 6 damage, leaving the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Seething Mob
Description: A swarm boils out, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Barn Overrun
Description: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

Name: Scrap Survivor
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Royal Decree
Description: Hands down a verdict that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds, plus 5% of the maximum health of a boss or elite it hits.

Name: Sovereign Squawk
Description: Cries out, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

Name: Roll Call
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 25% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Deference
Description: Against enemies below half health, your damage rises 15%. Your dodge chance is also 5% higher at all times.

Name: Smelled Out
Description: Lunges at the target and deals 15 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles. The target is left 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Scent Chase
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds.

Name: Draw First Blood
Description: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% chance to critically heal. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Frenzied Pack
Description: When you strike, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Brace and Bash
Description: Slams forward and deals 32 damage, leaving the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Last Stand Flail
Description: Flails at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Hold the Line
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Guard Up
Description: Against a target afflicted with a condition, your armour rises 12%.

Name: Gale Heave
Description: Heaves a gust that deals 14 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Tailwind Flap
Description: Beats a gust ahead of you, dealing 24 damage to everything in the cone. Allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds after it hits.

Name: Make Sail
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance while it holds.

Name: Sea Legs
Description: When you cover a stretch of ground, you gain a ward that absorbs 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Spade Bash
Description: Brings the flat down and deals 15 damage, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunned for 1 second.

Name: Heaped Load
Description: Heaves a shovelful of earth at the first enemy in line for 28 damage. It bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Raised Berm
Description: Heaps a bank of earth 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Dug In
Description: When your health is full, you gain a ward that absorbs 15% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Gleaning Reap
Description: A strike that deals 20 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

Name: Crescent Sweep
Description: Cuts a wide arc ahead of you, dealing 9 damage to everything in it. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Winter Larder
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Harvest Fervour
Description: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Warning Spray

Name: Lingering Spit
Description: Spits a stinking glob that deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds, slowing the target's attacks.

Name: Left Alone
Description: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Stink of Warning
Description: When your health falls below 50%, a stinking bolt hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Heavy Settling
Description: A weighty peck that deals 9 damage, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Inevitable End
Description: A strike that deals 24 damage to a target at or below 30% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Settle In
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Calm
Description: When your stamina is full, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Coiled Lunge
Description: Strikes from a coil, dealing 7 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and making the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Hissing Cloud
Description: Hisses a cloud ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in the cone that ignores resistances.

Name: Venomed Patience
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Slow Burn
Description: When a condition you inflicted runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Skewer from Afar
Description: A thrown point that deals 36 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Skewering Toss
Description: Throws a point that deals 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Stretch the Line
Description: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Door-Facing Instinct
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. It also regenerates 0.3 health a second, permanently.

Name: Silk Snare
Description: Spits a strand of silk that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Spun Round
Description: Spins a web out around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Hidden Tripline
Description: Spins a trap that waits 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Strand by Strand

Name: Tacking Needle
Description: Flicks a threaded needle that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Measure Twice, Cut Once
Description: A shear cut that deals 28 damage and is always a critical hit, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Tailored Gambeson
Description: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

Name: Running Stitch
Description: Every hit you land adds a stitch on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stitch (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stitch fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Wrung Poultice
Description: Wrings a venom-soaked rag out in a cone up to 5 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage and leaving everything caught [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Drawn Sting
Description: Flings a wet poultice pad that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and draws one of your afflictions out of it, healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. It needs an affliction of yours on the target and uses it up.

Name: Fresh Dressings
Description: Changes the dressings on you and every ally, removing up to 2 poison conditions from each.

Name: Soaked Through
Description: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Drape Swing
Description: Swings on a flung length of cloth to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and kicks it for 13 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at full reach.

Name: Sack and Pound
Description: Throws a sack over the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage and turning it against its allies for 4 seconds. If it hits, every ally deals 15% more damage for 10 seconds.

Name: Troop Colours
Description: Waves a flag and bellows, drawing up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Knuckle Bindings
Description: Conjures cloth bindings around your fists: you attack 6% faster, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 20% more damage, and each kill returns 2 health.

Name: Through the Gaps
Description: Drives a needle through the gaps in the target's armour, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Scale-Sewn Hem
Description: Whirls a hem sewn with steel scales, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Layered Quilting
Description: Raises a quilted barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and raises your armour by 10% for 8 seconds.

Name: Arming Doublet
Description: Every time you take damage, a layer builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per layer (42% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Cut the Lacings
Description: A quick chop at the target's straps and lacings for 5 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Streamered Throw
Description: Hurls the axe, trailing a cloth streamer, at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that is at or below 25% health for 26 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. The streamer slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

Name: Grip Wrapping
Description: Binds the haft tight with cloth, raising your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Measured for a Shroud
Description: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health.

Name: Roost Break
Description: Snaps your cloak wide, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 0.8 seconds. Each has a 30% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Bloodied Tatter
Description: Spends 5% of your maximum health to fling a blood-soaked tatter of your cloak that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Folded in Night
Description: Folds your cloak around you and veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Dusk Mantle
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Smothering Embrace
Description: Wraps the target in a heavy blanket and crushes it for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Midwinter Weight
Description: Drops a heavy quilt on every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

Name: Den Bedding
Description: Burrows into heavy bedding, restoring 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: Quilted Hide
Description: Conjures a thick quilted coat: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12% and your maximum health by 10.

Name: Darning Swarm
Description: Looses 3 darning needles at once, each dealing 3 damage, with a 15% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Flower to Flower
Description: Throws a bobbin that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on that enemy spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Hive of Needles
Description: Sets down a hive sewn from cloth for 12 seconds. It looses a needle at an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.2 seconds for 4 damage.

Name: Stinging Seam
Description: Every hit you land sews a stitch into that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all pull at once: a blow strikes it for 34% of your weapon damage per stitch (170% at full). Unfed, a stitch fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Trailing Pennant
Description: Sweeps the pennant trailing behind you through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Kite Stoop
Description: Drops on an enemy up to 8 tiles away from a cloth kite for 26 damage, up to 2 times as much at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Billowing Glide
Description: Glides you 2 tiles on your cloak, then raises your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

Name: Wind-Filled Cloak
Description: Every few paces you cover, your cloak fills and you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Bobbin Quiver
Description: Looses 3 shafts of stiffened thread at once, each dealing 4 damage. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Taut Line
Description: Fires a bolt trailing a taut line at an enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Restrung
Description: Restrings your weapon with longer thread: for 20 seconds, your attack and spell range is multiplied by 1.4.

Name: Silk-Wound String
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Weighted Net
Description: Casts a weighted net that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Drawstring Snare
Description: Pulls a hidden net shut around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Closing Drapes
Description: Drops a 5-tile curtain ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Trapper's Mesh
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Unravel
Description: Bats a ball of yarn at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Velvet Ambush
Description: A muffled weapon strike that deals 28 damage and is always a critical hit. It makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it [Suppressed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Muffled Tread
Description: Binds your feet in cloth and veils you for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Stitch in Time
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.

Name: In the Traces
Description: Throws your harnessed weight into the target, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

Name: Herd Banner
Description: Plants a banner with a stamp that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Draught Harness
Description: Buckles on a draught harness, raising your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds.

Name: Rested Caparison
Description: The moment your stamina is full, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.

Name: Leaping Loop
Description: Throws a looping stitch that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage each.

Name: Knotwork Cordon
Description: Throws loops of knotted thread around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Laced Ranks
Description: Laces every ally within 5 tiles together for 10 seconds: each strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power.

Name: Unbreakable Knot
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them.

Name: Unspooling Lash
Description: Lashes out with an unspooling length of cloth that deals 5 damage to an enemy up to 5 tiles away, up to 1.5 times as much at full reach.

Name: Flying Shuttle
Description: Throws a loom shuttle that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Silk Cocoon
Description: Wraps you in a cocoon of thread for 4 seconds: blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Invisible Mending
Description: Every ability you use weaves a thread onto you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per thread (25% at full). Unfed, a thread fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Polyp Lace
Description: Flicks out a lace fringe of feeding polyps, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Shipwreck Trawl
Description: Casts a coral-crusted trawl at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Reef-Crusted Mantle
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Living Weave
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Rolling Wrap
Description: Seizes an enemy at or below 30% health, rolls it up in wet cloth for 30 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Drowning Sheet
Description: Throws a sodden sheet over a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to everything under it and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Sunken Seine
Description: Sinks a weighted net beside the nearest enemy, where it waits up to 20 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 16 damage in a blast and is [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Wound Tighter
Description: As one of your afflictions lifts from an enemy, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Ribbon Whirl
Description: Whirls weighted ribbons around you, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, then you move 20% faster for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Flashing Scarf

Name: Last Resort Lining
Description: When you land a weapon strike, you gain a ward that soaks 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. Your armour is 8% higher.

Name: Rising Swell
Description: Casts a weighted line that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you run since you last used it (max +50%).

Name: Broadside
Description: Looses 3 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage and knocking the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Fair Wind
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You gain +10% dodge chance for it.

Name: Steady Keel
Description: After you have moved far enough, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Buried Thread
Description: A heavy overhead blow that deals 30 damage, also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Spoil Heap
Description: Heaves a cone of soil heaped on a cloth that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Packed Earth
Description: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Spadework
Description: When you spend stamina, you deal 25% more physical damage for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher.

Name: Reaping Arc
Description: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health. Deals 20 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Swath
Description: Holds 4 charges, one spent on each cut and one returned by each kill. Cuts a cone that deals 8 damage to everything caught in it.

Name: Gleaner's Edge
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Late Harvest
Description: When you go too long without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Foul Spool
Description: Flicks a spool that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Lingering Cloud
Description: Looses a cone that deals 11 damage to everything in it and pushes it back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

Name: Warning Cloak
Description: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 40% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

Name: Parting Spray
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Slow Cinch
Description: A slow heavy blow that deals 40 damage as a guaranteed critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Dragging Weight
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 10 damage, with a 50% chance each of being [Stalled] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Settled Mend
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

Name: Rested Limbs
Description: When your stamina is full, you deal 30% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Patient Fang
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Coiled Strike
Description: Consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.4 times their remaining damage to a strike that deals 18 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

Name: Held Breath
Description: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Venom Memory
Description: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the next nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 lightning damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Heaved Lance
Description: A thrown spear that deals 30 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Pinning Throw
Description: Hurls a spear that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Extended Shaft
Description: For 10 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Follow-Through
Description: When you kill an enemy, a spear flies to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Spun Snare
Description: Casts a strand that deals 4 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, and slows what it hits by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Web Burst
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 10 damage, is stunned for 1.2 seconds and is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Dropline
Description: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises by 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Respun Strand
Description: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds within 4.5 tiles. Its hits apply poison, dealing 2 damage per tick for 4 ticks, and critically hit anything already afflicted.

Name: Rote Incision
Description: A practised cut that deals 7 damage and lodges coral grit in the wound: the target is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, and each tick has a 30% chance to crit. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Textbook Spurs
Description: Raises a ring of coral spurs that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Studied Stillness
Description: After 2 seconds of holding still, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 30 seconds.

Name: Laid Down by Practice
Description: Every ability you use lays a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Drawn Barb
Description: A barbed thrust that deals 18 poison damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, then leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Bitter Bloom
Description: Stinging polyps burst out around you, dealing 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. The venom they draw heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Filtered Shallows
Description: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and your allies and restores 8 health.

Name: Lapsed Venom
Description: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Wrenched Outcrop
Description: Tears a chunk of reef loose and hurls it at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Picked-Up Hammer
Description: Brings a coral head down on the target two-handed for 30 damage. The blow is always a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Heaped Rubble
Description: Rips up the reef and heaps it into a wall 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches its jagged face moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Hold What You Hit
Description: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Seam Growth
Description: Drives coral into the seams of the target's armour, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 10 seconds.

Name: Bristling Plates
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Stinging spines grow out through your plating and stab every enemy within 2 tiles for 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Cement
Description: After 2 seconds of growth, raises your armour by 25% for 30 seconds.

Name: Hammered Thicker
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.

Name: Splitting the Rot
Description: A falling chop that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Flying Chips
Description: Hacks a spray of coral splinters 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in the cone, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Pruned Clean
Description: Cuts the festering coral out of your own wounds, removing up to 2 conditions from you and restoring 10 health.

Name: Where It Festers
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Night-Feeding Sting
Description: Flits a sting at the first enemy in front of you for 4 poison damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Echoing Grotto
Description: Shrieks into a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 11 resonating damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds. The echo carries your afflictions on each target to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Roost in the Dark
Description: Draws you back into the reef: you restore 10 health and are veiled for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Lapping the Wound
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Crusted Haymaker
Description: A swipe that deals 14 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles. The crust it leaves weighs the target down: it is 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

Name: Overgrown Maul
Description: A two-pawed maul that deals 30 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Long Torpor
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds, and raises your physical resistance by 10%.

Name: Thickening Hide
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your armour by 6%.

Name: Nematocyst Volley
Description: Looses 3 stinging cells at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 poison damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Colony Seed
Description: Fires a seeded sting that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Spawned Hive
Description: Grows a humming colony that stands for 15 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Tireless Polyps
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 2% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Skimmed Spicule
Description: Skims a coral spicule at the first enemy in front of you for 4 damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have flown or run since you last used it, up to 50%.

Name: Gull's Drop
Description: Carries a coral head aloft and drops it on an enemy up to 7 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores armour.

Name: Lifted Carapace
Description: Grows a light shell over you that absorbs the next 16 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 5% while it holds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds.

Name: Wavetop Glide
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your health recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Shattering Shaft
Description: Looses a coral-tipped arrow that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, then shatters, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Broken-Off Tip
Description: Looses an arrow at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The coral tip snaps off in the wound, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Rooted Marksman
Description: Grows a coral marksman that stands for 18 seconds and shoots an enemy within 7 tiles for 6 damage every 2 seconds.

Name: Living Stave
Description: Conjures a bow of living coral. It increases your weapon damage by 10%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Closing Lattice
Description: Grows a 6-tile lattice of stinging coral ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Shooting the Bolt
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You drive a spicule into an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: The Door Still Shuts
Description: Grows a ring of coral bars at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 18 damage and is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: No Gap Between Bars
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Last Rake
Description: A raking pounce that deals 22 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Hooked Cuff
Description: A swat with claws that hook in: it deals 4 damage, slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Crevice Squeeze
Description: Springs you 2 tiles into cover and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Sure-Footed Crust
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Shoulder to Shoulder
Description: A horned shove that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

Name: Unhurried Stamp
Description: After 1.5 seconds of gathering, stamps down for 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Lagoon Pasture
Description: Raises a shallow reef where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4.

Name: Chewing It Over
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Link by Link
Description: Fires a string of linked polyps that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 0.8 seconds. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Reeled Under
Description: Lashes a coral-weighted line at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Drag-Line
Description: Grows a 6-tile line of linked coral for 5 seconds that drags enemies toward it, and slows each one it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Ring-Mail Reef
Description: Conjures a mail of linked coral rings: every hit you take is 3 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Fan Lash
Description: Lashes a woven sea fan at an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Cast Mesh
Description: Casts a mesh of woven coral 3.5 tiles ahead of you that deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Lacework Mantle
Description: Drapes a woven coral lattice over you that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

Name: Folded Light
Description: 20% of the elemental damage you take is folded back onto whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Rising Atoll
Description: Raises a jagged reef 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Seeding Cut
Description: A cut that deals 12 damage and seeds the wound with polyps, [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Lodger in the Reef
Description: Calls a moray out of the reef for 20 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage.

Name: Ever-Growing
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.

Name: Waiting Jaws
Description: Snaps shut on a weakened enemy for 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the bite, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Death Roll
Description: Clamps on and rolls the target across stinging coral: the roll deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Sink Below
Description: Sinks you among the coral heads: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you restore 10 health.

Name: Motionless Hours
Description: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Staghorn Splinters
Description: Flings 3 branching splinters of staghorn coral at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Bounding Gore
Description: Bounds up to 6 tiles to an enemy and gores it with branching coral for 12 damage, up to 1.5 times as much from the full 6 tiles, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Startled Into Cover
Description: Veils you and your allies for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Flinch and Harden
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: Rallying Bay
Description: Bays a call 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 4 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Standing Guard
Description: Barks a challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Reefhound
Description: A bonded hound crusted with stinging coral runs with you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Flicked Brine
Description: Flicks a bead of brine at the first enemy in front of you for 7 water damage and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Breakwater
Description: Raises a low reef 5 tiles long for 5 seconds. It deals 11 water damage to each enemy that crosses it and knocks it back 2 tiles.

Name: Rolls Right Off
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to roll off and back onto whoever inflicted it, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Calm Waters
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.

Name: Upthrust Shelf
Description: Thrusts a shelf of old reef limestone up through the ground 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 28 rock damage that ignores armour to everything in it and leaving them [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Set in Stone
Description: A blow with fossil reef that deals 16 rock damage and turns your afflictions on the target to stone: it uses up every one and deals 70% more damage for each. The target is 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Limestone Rind
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds, and your rock resistance by 10%.

Name: Bedrock Reply
Description: When you take damage that is not fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 6% rock resistance.

Name: Noticed Flaw
Description: Fires a spicule into the flaw you noticed: it deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Lidless Thousand
Description: Stings everything in a cone 4 tiles long for 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

Name: Gorgon's Regard
Description: Your stare stiffens flesh into coral, holding every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Watched Wounds
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Open Mouths
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and eats it. The strike deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Scattered Spawn
Description: Looses 5 clouds of spawn in a wide spread, each dealing 10 water damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

Name: Shared Catch
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and 1% more for every 1% of cast speed you have.

Name: Preserved Surplus
Description: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Embers on the Current
Description: Looses 3 burning polyps at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 fire damage, setting the target [Burning] for 5 seconds and bursting for 80% of that on every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Stinging Brush
Description: A brushing touch that deals 4 fire damage and leaves the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Scalding Skin
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Kiln-Hardened
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% fire resistance.

Name: Skipping Fry
Description: Flicks a stinging fry that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Shoal Burst
Description: Looses 4 fry in a wide spread, each dealing 6 damage and leaving the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Hide in the Branches
Description: Tucks you into the branches of the reef: a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Cleaner Station
Description: A bonded cleaner wrasse fights beside you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each kill it makes returns 3 health to you.

Name: Settling Leap
Description: Leaps you up to 6 tiles to a target, then deals 14 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Larval Drift
Description: Looses a cone of drifting larvae that deals 7 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Hard Landing
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Spat Over Stone
Description: You move 10% faster and have 6% physical resistance.

Name: Heel Grind
Description: A grinding blow that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Crushing Tread
Description: Stamps down, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Marching Hide
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after you use it.

Name: Layered Stride
Description: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Pronged Pin
Description: Throws a two-pronged shard at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Branch Point
Description: Sends a branching spine into the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage. It then splits to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Turned Aside
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 40% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Spreading Growth
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Lifted Purse
Description: A quick tendril strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: False Shoreline
Description: Raises a false reef around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 35% chance to turn the target against its allies for 4 seconds.

Name: Mottled Shallows
Description: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Sly Nettle
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Sprung Barb
Description: Springs a barbed polyp at a wounded target up to 6 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Bursting Pool
Description: Spits a pool of reef water that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. Each target is left [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Out of the Pool
Description: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, 1% more for every 1% cast speed you have. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Held Breath
Description: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Sporing Puff
Description: Puffs a spore that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 50%).

Name: Fruiting Body
Description: A swelling burst that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Symbiosis
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds, and 8 health at once.

Name: Mycelial Mat
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (15% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Ledge Ram
Description: A ramming blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Dislodged Boulder
Description: Heaves a chunk of reef at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It ignores resistances.

Name: Gathered Onto the Ledge
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. A ring of polyps fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Shrugged Off
Description: Each time anything but fire hurts you, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. You have 10% rock resistance.

Name: Cropped Close
Description: Crops the reef floor around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Lowered Horns
Description: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Winter Barn
Description: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

Name: Contented Hours
Description: While you are at full health, 3 stamina a second comes back to you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Sudden Crack
Description: Fires a hardened shard of reef that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, always strikes critically, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Scattergrit

Description: A stone-weighted blow aimed at the joins of the target's armour, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Rampart Shove
Description: You thrust a wall-shield of stone out ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead and knocking it 3 tiles back.

Name: Strata Guard
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds, and you carry 10% physical resistance.

Name: Grown Plating
Description: Conjures plate grown from jagged stone: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Notch by Notch
Description: A short chop with a flint edge that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Shattering Hatchet
Description: Hurls a hatchet of knapped flint that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts into shards that hit every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% as much.

Name: Whetstone Stroke
Description: You hone the edge on stone for 1 second, then deal 30% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Knapped Edge
Description: Conjures an axe-head of knapped flint. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Cave Shriek
Description: You shriek into the rock ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Stalactite Drop
Description: Brings a spike of cave stone down on an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage.

Name: Roost Overhead
Description: You flit up onto the rock overhead, landing 2 tiles away; for 3 seconds blows deal no damage to you and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Sunless Hide
Description: At night, your armour rises by 12%. You gain +4% dodge chance at all times.

Name: Mountain's Weight
Description: You rear up and drop your full weight onto the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Wounded Bulk
Description: A swipe of your full, rock-weighted bulk that deals 13 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It deals 6% more for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 30%.

Name: Denning Down
Description: You hunker down into the ground, regaining 4 health a second for 8 seconds, and you carry 10% physical resistance.

Name: Hill-Shouldered
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you carry 6% physical resistance.

Name: Mason Swarm
Description: Flings 3 barbs of grit at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Flint Stinger
Description: Darts a flint stinger into an enemy for 7 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You hold 4; each kill gives one back.

Name: Mud Hive
Description: You raise a hive of packed mud for 15 seconds. Its bees sting the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Daubed Layers
Description: Every hit you land packs on a layer of mud, building a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Stooping Landfall
Description: You stoop onto a target up to 7 tiles away and land with the weight of stone, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Geode Clutch
Description: Throws a stone egg that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts over every enemy within 2 tiles for 50% as much. You hold 3; each kill gives one back.

Name: Crag Perch
Description: You hop 2 tiles onto a perch of stone, and your armour rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Ballast
Description: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield of packed grit worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Split-Shale Shaft
Description: Looses a shale-headed arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. The head splits and leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the damage. You hold 4 arrows; each kill gives one back.

Name: Weighted Flight
Description: Looses 3 heavy stone-headed arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage and stunning what it hits for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Braced Stance
Description: You brace your feet for 1.5 seconds, then for 20 seconds your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

Name: Flint Bodkins
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.

Name: Closing Spires
Description: Spires of stone burst up around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Bars Slam Shut
Description: Bars of stone close on an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Stone Pen
Description: Raises a pen of stone 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Sealed Gaol
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% earth resistance.

Name: Scratched Dirt
Description: You scratch a spray of grit 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in the cone, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 4 seconds.

Name: Ledge Pounce
Description: You pounce on a target up to 6 tiles away and land with stone-hard claws, dealing 28 damage that is always a critical hit and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Righting Twist
Description: You twist back onto your feet, removing up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

Name: Upright Landing
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a stone shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. You gain +5% dodge chance.

Name: Stampede Ram
Description: You charge up to 7 tiles into the target, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It deals 5% more for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

Name: Herd Quake
Description: You stamp the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles; if it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

Name: Ploughed Berm
Description: You plough a furrow and throw up a berm of earth 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Slow Temper
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Anchor Line
Description: Casts a stone anchor on a chain into an enemy for 13 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds, and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it.

Name: Linked Tremor
Description: A rattling shock through the ground deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: You drop anchor and haul on your chains, pulling up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Fettered Footing
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Woven Sling

Name: Sandbag Brace
Description: You stack earth-filled sacks around you: a barrier absorbs the next 22 damage and your armour rises by 8% for 8 seconds.

Name: Grave Linen
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.

Description: A jab with a spur of reef-stone that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You hold 4 spurs; each kill grows one back.

Name: Tidepool Growth

Name: Accreting Shell
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Wallow Lash

Name: Lying in the Silt
Description: You sink into the ground and are veiled for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Held Breath

Name: Kicked Scree
Description: Kicks a loose stone into an enemy for 4 damage. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Frozen Stillness

Name: Run to Ground

Name: Water Off Stone

Name: Stepping Stones
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.

Name: Fault Line

Name: Spalled Fist
Description: You break stone from your own skin at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Granite Mantle
Description: A mantle of granite absorbs the next 28 damage and raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds.

Name: Petrifying Stare

Name: Seen Seams
Description: Your earth damage cannot be resisted.

Name: Gulp of Soil
Description: Sends a ripple through the ground into an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 9 damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: The Swallowing Pit
Description: The ground gapes open around you, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles, and you restore 10 health.

Name: Gorged on Minerals
Description: You gorge on salts drawn from the ground, restoring 10 health, and your maximum health rises by 20% for 15 seconds.

Name: Second Helpings
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You carry 6% physical resistance.

Name: Volcanic Spatter

Name: Obsidian Haft

Name: Silt Spray

Name: Mud Glaze
Description: Coats you in slick mud, raising your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 10% for 12 seconds.

Name: Slick Shingle

Name: Bounding Slam
Description: Springs you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you.

Name: Pestering Chips

Name: Hard Landings
Description: Each time you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Forced March

Name: Halting Order
Description: Brings the ground down on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 30 damage to each. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Hobnail Stride
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Pilgrim's Plating
Description: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.

Name: Split Shard
Description: Hurls a two-pronged shard that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the damage.

Name: Crossing Cracks

Name: Parting Wall
Description: Raises a wall of stone 4 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Tines Converge
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (82% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Sleight of Gravel
Description: Flicks out 3 pebbles at once, spread apart. Each pebble deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn its target against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Pulled Rug
Description: Opens the ground under one enemy, dealing 32 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Bolt-Hole
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later and you move 11% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Played Dead
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Bog Boom
Description: A deep croak sends a shockwave 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns them for 1 second.

Name: Mire Snare
Description: Flicks a glob of mud that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Dry-Season Sleep
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Squat and Spring
Description: When your stamina is full, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds. Your armour rises by 6% at all times.

Name: Spore Drift
Description: Sheds a ring of spores, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Root Rot
Description: A rotting blow that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Mulch Bed
Description: Raises a bed of loam where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Spreading Mat
Description: A bonded mat of mycelium keeps pace with you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds, slowing each one by 20% for 2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Headlong Shove
Description: A headlong blow that deals 15 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Loosened Scree
Description: Dislodges a boulder that deals 36 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Dug-In Hooves
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Won't Budge
Description: When your health falls below 40%, your physical damage rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your armour rises by 6% at all times.

Name: Herd Press
Description: Shoulders outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally nearby (max 24%).

Name: Millstone Chew
Description: A grinding blow that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Warm Hollow
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Fleece Fold
Description: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Grit Scatter
Description: Looses 4 shards of gravel at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and knocking its target back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Dense Slug
Description: Fires a dense stone slug that deals 40 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 11 tiles. It ignores armour.

Name: Firing Pit
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a stone emplacement that lasts 12 seconds and fires on an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Rifled Bore
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Strand Barrage
Description: Looses 5 barbed rootlets at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Matted Snarl
Description: Flings a mat of woven roots that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Caught in the Tangle
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Root-Woven Mail
Description: Conjures a coat of root-woven stone: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.

Name: Anvil Beat
Description: A heavy, even blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Levelling Stroke
Description: Brings the hammer down on the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their armour, and leaves each [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Ringing Rebound
Description: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Compounding Blows

Name: Wringing Clasp
Description: A crushing grip that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Grasping Loam
Description: Hands of earth rise around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Steadying Hold
Description: Sets a firm barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Signet of Granite
Description: Conjures a granite signet: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill returns 2 health, and your armour rises by 4%.

Name: Hoof-Flung Clod
Description: Kicks a clod of turf that deals 3 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

Name: Trampling Drive
Description: Drives forward through a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

Name: Even Canter
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 9 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Second Furlong
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% at all times.

Name: Barbed Cast
Description: Casts a stone-weighted barb that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Gaff Strike
Description: A hooked blow that deals 24 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Hauled Close
Description: Collapses a point of earth ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

Name: Burr Coat
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Clattering Stamp
Description: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Rolling Thunder
