Name: Charging Lunge
Description: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you leap 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Hardpan Gait
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 15%.

Name: Quarry Mark
Description: A swift blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance of [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Final Stretch
Description: Hurls a boulder that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Narrowing Gap
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

Name: Cornered Prey
Description: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Heavy Ore

Name: Cold Rebuff

Name: Obsidian Nick

Name: Hidden Seam

Name: Flint Underfoot

Name: Clean Cut
Description: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Sand Kick
Description: Kicks up hot sand around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Venomed Bite

Name: Dropped Tail
Description: Drops a stone tail that fights for 14 seconds, striking an enemy within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.6 seconds.

Name: Daylight Hardening
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Gnawing Flurry

Name: Cloud Stripping

Name: Dust Plague

Name: Fed by the Fallen

Name: Rehearsed Cadence

Name: Lobbed Clay

Description: When your stamina runs out, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Leaf Flight
Description: Flicks a bolt at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 20%).

Name: Hard Crease
Description: A blow that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Fine Print
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 20 seconds.

Name: Quick Draft
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.

Name: Tangleroot
Description: Sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Seedfall Ring
Description: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, stunning it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Growing Gait
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

Name: Deep Roots
Description: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.

Name: Hind Kick
Description: A quick kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2s after you use it.

Name: Bolt and Strike
Description: A thrown blow that deals 12 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Warren Sprint
Description: Increases your movement speed by 50% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

Name: Hare's Heels
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 14%.

Name: Downpour Run
Description: Lets loose 5 spread-out streaks, each dealing 3 damage and leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds, cold and lightning biting deeper and fire less. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Slick Heel
Description: A blow that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Wet Pavement
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Puddle Stride
Description: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Sweeping Tines
Description: Rakes a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Long Reach
Description: A thrown blow that deals 9 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Leave It Tidy
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

Name: Clear the Ground
Description: When a condition on you runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Gutter Bite
Description: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance of leaving the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds, healing it less.

Name: Swarm Rush
Description: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Scrounged Strength
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Last Off the Ship
Description: When your health runs out, you regain 8 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 120 seconds.

Name: Royal Decree
Description: Sends a bolt of edict into the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage. If it lands, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Heralded Arrival
Description: Hits every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 11 damage to each and stunning it for 0.8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

Name: Long Arm of Law
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Standing Order
Description: While you are at full health, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Scent Lunge
Description: You surge up to 6 tiles onto the target and bite for 14 damage, 10% more for each affliction on it (up to 30%), healing for 15% of the damage dealt and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Circling Wake
Description: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 8 damage to each and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Feeding Pass
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Taste of Blood
Description: When you strike an enemy, 10% of the damage you deal heals you for the next 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Rampart Rush
Description: You slam the target for 14 damage and stun it for 1 second, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Bearing Down
Description: Hits every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 8 damage to each. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Guarded Stride
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, hardening your armour by 10%.

Name: Taken in Stride
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (48% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10s.

Name: Broadside
Description: A thrown blow that deals 16 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Swell and Break
Description: Hits every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each and ignoring their armour. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

Name: Fair Wind
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 12% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Sea Legs
Description: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Spade Work
Description: A heavy blow that deals 15 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Loose Dirt
Description: A thrown blow that deals 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

Name: Trench Line
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Packed Road
Description: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 10%.

Name: Reaping Arc
Description: Cuts a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Last Furrow
Description: A strike that deals 10 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Reaper's Lunge
Description: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 12% for 4s after you use it.

Name: Swath Cleared
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Warning Spray
Description: Sprays a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Rotten Parting
Description: Hurls a foul glob that hits the first enemy in its path for 26 damage and splashes everything within 3 tiles for 80% of that, leaving the target [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

Name: Turned Back
Description: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 55% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 7 seconds.

Name: Notice Taken
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Blow
Description: A slow, heavy blow that deals 20 damage and stuns the target for 1.6 seconds, leaving it 14% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow Reckoning
Description: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 7 damage to each, with a 40% chance each of [Stalled] for 6 seconds, its abilities coming back slower. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Settled Weight
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Arrives Eventually
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Venom Flick
Description: Flicks a bolt at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Patient Fang

Name: Shed Skin
Description: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Venom Wake
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.

Name: Line Thrown
Description: A thrown blow that deals 8 damage, up to 2.4 times that at maximum range. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Reach of Iron
Description: Thrusts along a narrow cone 7 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

Name: Lance Rush
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Aimed at the Door
Description: Your damage rises by 15% against targets at low health.

Name: Silk Ledger
Description: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 4. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for part of your weapon damage per strand. Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Textbook Opening
Description: You step in on a target up to 3 tiles away and thrust, which deals 30 piercing damage and always lands as a critical hit. The target is 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Drilled Pair
Description: Thrusts both tines out together, each dealing 6 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets within 4 tiles. Your critical chance is 40% higher against a target that has not yet been wounded. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Run the Form Again
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and steps you 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Second Tine
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Draw It Out
Description: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 15 piercing damage and uses up every one of your afflictions on it. It adds their remaining damage to the blow and deals 60% more for each one used up.

Name: Kept at Arm's Length

Name: Lance the Wound
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and from each of your allies.

Name: Bitter Return
Description: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Hook and Heave
Description: Hooks the target between the tines for 12 damage and heaves it 3 tiles away, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Overarm Hurl
Description: Hurls the whole polearm overarm into the first enemy it meets within 10 tiles for 30 piercing damage, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health. It has a 50% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

Description: Increases your piercing damage by 30% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Prised Open

Name: Seam Finder

Description: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Point, Then Edge

Name: Come at the Spear
Description: Plants the butt of the haft and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Gathering Heft

Name: Barb Left Behind

Name: Soaring Cast

Name: Vault Aloft
Description: Vaults off the haft and glides 5 tiles forward, then moves 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: On the Wing

Name: Split Broadhead

Name: Reach of the String

Name: Breath Before Release

Name: Man-Catcher

Name: Portcullis Drop

Name: Palisade
Description: Plants a row of tines 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that enemies cannot pass.

Name: Nowhere Left to Run
Description: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health.

Name: Paw on the Tail
Description: A weapon strike for 5 slashing damage that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Toyed With

Name: Pounce Step
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 4 tiles away, and gives you 10% more dodge chance.

Name: Haunches Wound Tight
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike has 20% more critical chance. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Hay Toss
Description: Scoops up everything within 2 tiles ahead on the tines, dealing 10 damage and tossing each target 3 tiles back.

Name: Oxgoad

Name: Goaded Herd
Description: Goads your allies on: every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Slow to Stampede

Name: Grapnel Haul

Name: Rattling Links

Name: Anchor Line
Description: Anchors a line of links 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Whipping Slack
Description: Each time you strike with your weapon, a link lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Thrown Net

Name: Wrapped Haft

Name: Footwork on the Sand
Description: Your dodge chance rises by 10% against enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Branching Reef

Name: Polyp Garden

Name: Growth on the Wreck
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Sunken Jaws

Name: Basking Hour

Name: Flag-Tail Jab

Name: Royal Rack
Description: Lowers the branching tines and sweeps everything within 3 tiles ahead for 26 piercing damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Bound Clear
Description: Springs 2 tiles clear of where you stood, then moves 35% faster with 10% more dodge chance for 6 seconds.

Name: First to Notice

Name: Heel Nip
Description: A quick weapon strike for 4 piercing damage that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Rallying Sweep

Name: Slipped Leash
Description: Calls a hound to your side for 15 seconds; it bites enemies within 2 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Held for the Thrust
Description: Your damage rises by 10% against enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Dabbling Rake

Name: Gig the Soaked

Name: Turned Aside
Description: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Rolls Off the Back

Name: Upthrust

Name: Fault Line

Name: Standing Stone

Name: Bedrock Stance
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% rock resistance.

Name: Twin Gouge

Name: Unblinking Aim
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Nothing Turns the Point
Description: Your piercing damage cannot be resisted.

Name: Clean the Plate
Description: Spears the first enemy within 4 tiles and deals 18 piercing damage. 30% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over the following 6 seconds. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health.

Name: Carving Round
Description: Carves around you, dealing 6 slashing damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Marrow and Gristle
Description: Picks over every body within 6 tiles, up to 5; each restores 7% of your maximum health.

Name: Second Helping
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Hand in the Coals

Name: Spitting Tongues

Name: Brazier Guard
Description: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Toasting Tines
Description: Conjures red-hot tines on your weapon: your weapon damage rises by 10%, every strike sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you have 8% fire resistance.

Name: Shoal Skip
Description: Hurls the fork, which deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Spear the Shallows
Description: A thrust at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full range. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Channel Stakes
Description: Drives forked stakes into the ground for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds they spear an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Silver Scatter

Name: Over the Table

Name: Carried Plague

Name: Pole Hop

Name: Bite After the Leap

Name: Stride Into It

Name: Road Pole

Name: Road Cadence
Description: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Both Ways

Name: Splayed Tines

Name: Other Branch
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

Name: Either Point Will Do
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to land a critical hit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Feint Jab
Description: Flicks the fork at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Its reach is 40% longer.

Name: Slipped Between

Name: Straw Man
Description: Props up a pitchfork-wielding scarecrow for 12 seconds that jabs an enemy within 5 tiles every 2 seconds for 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Light Fingers
Description: Each time you afflict something, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Lily Flick
Description: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range. It slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Sprung Trap

Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Fan of Edges
Description: Fires 5 bladed rounds in a fan, each dealing 6 damage and ignoring armour.

Name: Quick Draw
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Underbarrel Blade
Description: Conjures a blade fixed beneath your barrel: your weapon damage rises by 10% and you attack 5% faster, and every strike leaves [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.

Name: Numbing Pellet
Description: Fires a chilled pellet that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Long Bask
Description: Fires a single shot that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Cold Blood
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Daylight Marksman
Description: In daylight, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Plague Pellets
Description: Fires 5 small pellets in a wide spread, each dealing 2 damage.

Name: Stripping Cloud
Description: Fires a round that bursts into a devouring cloud, dealing 28 damage to the target and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Darkened Sky
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

Name: Picked Clean
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Arcane Discharge
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: fires a raw arcane charge that deals 9 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding half their remaining damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Unbound Detonation
Description: Fires every charged chamber at once in a ring, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

Name: Mana Primer
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Stray Arcana
Description: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Final Clause
Description: Fires an inscribed round at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage.

Name: Recited Volley
Description: Fires 3 inscribed rounds in a spread, each dealing 5 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

Name: Warding Script
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Practiced Litany
Description: Each time you spend mana, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Slow Pressure
Description: Fires a heavy, slow round that deals 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Slack Water
Description: Fires a dull report into the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 2 tiles, leaving it 30% slower for 4 seconds and [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Drifting Rest
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Calm Before
Description: When your health is full, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Brute Load
Description: Fires a slug that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Siege Round
Description: Fires a shell that deals 40 damage and bursts for 80% of it on every enemy within 3.5 tiles of the target.

Name: Heavy Charge
Description: Increases your damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

Name: Recoil Dividend
Description: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Fingerwork
Description: Flicks a round that deals 4 damage, then bounces to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

Name: Fruit-Pelt Trio
Description: Throws 3 rounds in a spread; each round deals 5 damage and the last to land leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Sleeve Trick
Description: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source, which suffers 25% of its strength.

Name: Palmed Round
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Skirting Pop
Description: A quick shot that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

Name: Startling Crack
Description: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Behind the Baseboard
Description: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you at 30% of the usual rate and you move 15% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Dark Corner
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Eye of the Gap
Description: Fires a round that deals 32 damage and ignores armour.

Name: Seam Shot
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage with a 50% chance of [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Fine Bore
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Wound Opens
Description: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Cross-Stitch Salvo
Description: Fires 3 rounds that each deal 6 damage, each with a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Weighted Lead
Description: Deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and adds 60% more damage for each.

Name: Haul Line
Description: Pulls a line of snare 6 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

Name: Trailing Weights
Description: Each time you afflict something, a bolt leaps to the nearest other enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Ink Spray
Description: Sprays a wide cone that deals 7 damage to everything in it, leaves it [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds, and has a 60% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow Squeeze
Description: Fires a round that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit.

Name: Arms Wide
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. A second pair of arms fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Many Hands
Description: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Shingle Shot
Description: Fires a round that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Overlap Storm
Description: Fires 4 rounds in a tight pattern; each round deals 4 damage and knocks the target back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Rolled Tight
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Lapped Seams
Description: Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner. Your armour rises by 15%.
