Name: Standing Order
Description: Fires 5 rounds that each deal 7 damage and ignore resistances.

Name: Wiped Slate
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you.

Name: Overdue Notice
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 40% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Seed Pellet
Description: Fires a seed that deals 4 damage, with a 15% chance of leaving the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Rooting Salvo
Description: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 12 damage and has a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Sprouting Emplacement
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds. A turret of vines fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Steady Growth
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.

Name: Scamper Strike
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target, then it takes 13 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

Name: Thumper Ring
Description: Every enemy within 2 tiles takes 4 damage.

Name: Bolt Hole
Description: Carries you 4 tiles forward in a burst, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Running Lead
Description: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Plunging Drizzle
Description: Drops a shot from above that deals 11 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, with a 60% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Cloudburst Mortar
Description: Lobs 6 shells that each deal 8 damage; every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Grey Curtain
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

Name: Slicker Reload
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Raking Sweep
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 10 damage and is knocked back 3 tiles.

Name: Gleaning Shot
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 8 damage, plus 8% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

Name: Gathered Powder
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 7 seconds.

Name: Stray Leavings
Description: When you strike an enemy, a bolt hits the nearest other enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Swarm Fire
Description: Fires 3 rounds; each round deals 2 damage.

Name: Carrier's Slug
Description: Fires a slug that deals 14 damage and has a 60% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Gnaw Through
Description: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% chance to crit. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Still Breathing
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Decree Shot
Description: Fires a shot that deals 30 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range; allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

Name: Parade Pair
Description: Fires 2 rounds side by side; each round deals 3 damage.

Name: Raise the Standard
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Executive Order
Description: Against enemies at low health, you deal 15% more damage.

Name: Feeding Shot
Description: Strikes a target at or below 30% health for 18 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which are used up.

Name: Taste of Blood
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health and deals 9 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Closing Circle
Description: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Fresh Wake
Description: When you kill something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Slammed Barricade
Description: Fires a slug that deals 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Covering Fire
Description: Sweeps a cone that deals 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 25% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Draw Fire
Description: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds, with 1.5 times the usual threat.

Name: Bulwark Closes
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Broadside
Description: Fires 5 rounds in a wide spread; each round deals 6 damage and knocks the target back 2 tiles.

Name: Hull Piercer
Description: Fires a heavy ball that deals 40 damage and ignores armour.

Name: Fair Wind
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

Name: Steady Keel
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.

Name: Buried Charge
Description: Primes up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds; each bursts for 30 damage the moment an enemy comes near, hitting enemies within 3.5 tiles for 80% of it.

Name: Spoil Throw
Description: Fires a round that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Gone Underground
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Dug Foothold
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Last Cut
Description: Fires at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 22 damage; you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Wide Swath
Description: Every enemy within 4 tiles takes 9 damage, is knocked back 3 tiles and is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Reap the Chamber
Description: Restores 25 mana to you at once.

Name: Harvest Home
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Warning Cloud
Description: Releases a cone that deals 6 damage, leaves everything in it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, and has a 50% chance of [Damped] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Reek Settles
Description: Deals 16 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage each.

Name: Reeking Hide
Description: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Parting Gift
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Inevitable Round
Description: Fires a round that deals 36 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, plus 6% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

Name: Idle Shot
Description: Fires a round that deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance of [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hung Rest
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

Name: Unbothered Aim
Description: While you are at full health, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Fang Round
Description: Fires a round that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow Lethal
Description: Fires a round that deals 28 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, ignores resistances and sets the target [Poisoned] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Coiled Wait
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 35% for 10 seconds.

Name: Holster Adder
Description: Calls a bonded adder that fights beside you within 4.5 tiles, striking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds and setting what it strikes [Poisoned] for 2 damage a tick for 4 ticks.

Name: Skewering Shot
Description: Fires a round that deals 16 damage and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Impaling Line
Description: Fires 3 rounds in a line; each deals 14 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

Name: Pointed Landing
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away.

Name: Second Throw
Description: Each time you kill something, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Pounce on the Line
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target, which takes 15 damage and is left 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Web Spray
Description: Sprays a cone of strands that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hide the Party
Description: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you at 40% of the usual rate and you move 10% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Taut Strands
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Threaded Needle
Description: Drives one stiffened strand into a target up to 6 tiles away for 4 piercing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the strand tied on, [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Running Stitch
Description: Sends a strand through the first enemy it meets for 26 piercing damage, then on through 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Nimble Plaiting
Description: Your strands take over the drilled motions of your hands, increasing your attack speed by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Rote Knotwork
Description: Every ability you use ties another knot in your hair: a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Wicking Strand
Description: A strand fastens on a target up to 7 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, draws that affliction out and uses it up, and deals 8 poison damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Shed Venom
Description: Flicks the poison your strands have drawn out across a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 poison damage and leaving each enemy [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Drawn Through the Roots
Description: Your hair draws up to 3 poison conditions out of you through its roots and restores 8 health.

Name: Bitter Run-Off
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to run down a strand to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Liana Swing
Description: Catches a target up to 7 tiles away with a rope of hair and swings you to it, landing a blow for 14 blunt damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach.

Name: Grip and Pummel
Description: Seizes the target in a fist of hair and pounds it for 5 blunt damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 20% chance to hold it [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Picked Clean
Description: Strands comb through you and your allies, picking up to 2 conditions off each of you.

Name: Bristling Display
Description: When your health falls below 30%, every hair on you stands on end and you deal 25% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Pried Plates
Description: Strands work into the joints of the target's armour and wrench it open, dealing 28 piercing damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Scouring Wool
Description: Scrubs a mass of wire-stiff strands across every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 4 slashing damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Plaited Mail
Description: Plaits your hair into a coat of mail that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Lacquered Lamellae
Description: Conjures armour of lacquered plaits laid in overlapping rows: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Split Ends
Description: Swings an axe-head on a rope of hair at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 22 slashing damage that rises to 1.6 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Roped Hatchet Whirl
Description: Whirls an axe-head around you on its rope of hair, dealing 8 slashing damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Razor Mane
Description: Your hair stands out in honed edges for 9 seconds, and 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Trophy Lock
Description: When you kill an enemy, you cut a lock from it and your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Pitch Too High
Description: Your hair thrums at a pitch too high to hear, dealing 4 resonating damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Tethered Bite
Description: Sends a bat out on a strand to fasten on a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 28 dark damage that ignores resistance. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Rafter Line
Description: Throws a strand to a point up to 6 tiles away and snaps you there. You have 8% more dodge chance.

Name: Felt Before Seen
Description: At night, the fine hairs on your skin sense a blow coming: your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Shaggy Clinch
Description: Wraps the target in coils of hair and crushes it against you for 15 blunt damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Matted Maul
Description: Brings down two great paws of matted hair, dealing 32 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Winter Coat
Description: Your hair thickens into a heavy pelt, raising your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and your frost resistance rises by 15%.

Name: Felted by Blows
Description: Every time you take damage, your hair mats thicker: a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Barbed Parting
Description: Tears 4 barbed hairs from your scalp at a cost of 4% of your maximum health and looses them spread apart, each dealing 6 poison damage. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Alarm Scent
Description: Flicks a scent-tipped strand at a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you (max 32%).

Name: Beard of Stingers
Description: A swarm settles in your hair as a living beard and fights from it for 15 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

Name: Combed Nectar
Description: Every hit you land dusts your hair with pollen: a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Quill Flick
Description: Flicks a hair stiffened into a quill at a target up to 8 tiles away for 4 piercing damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave a strand trailing from the target, [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Buffeting Fan
Description: Spreads your hair into a wing and beats it once, dealing 11 wind damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you and knocking it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Jessed Hawk
Description: Looses a hawk on a jess of plaited hair for 12 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every second.

Name: Hollow Shafts
Description: Your hairs grow hollow shafts: you move 8% faster and your wind resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Strung With Tresses
Description: Shoots an arrow from a string plaited of your own hair at a target up to 10 tiles away, dealing 8 piercing damage that rises to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 5 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Loosed Sheaf
Description: Draws every strand back to full tension and looses 4 hair-thin shafts at once, spread apart, each dealing 13 piercing damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Longer Draw
Description: Lengthens the string with more of your hair: for 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

Name: Filament Points
Description: Your arrowheads are drawn out to the width of one strand: your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Closing Lattice
Description: Bars of plaited hair rise in a ring and close, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and holding them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: No Way Out
Description: Bars of plaited hair shut around a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 28 damage and leaving it [Inescapable] for 10 seconds. Bosses and elites take a further 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Woven Palisade
Description: Raises a wall of plaited hair 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Bars That Grab
Description: When you are hurt by anything but fire, a strand lashes out at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds. Anything you strike moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Hacked-Up Wad
Description: Hacks up a wad of swallowed fur and spits it at a target up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: End of the String
Description: Rakes a target up to 5 tiles away with a clawed strand, dealing 16 slashing damage that rises to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each.

Name: Tufted Pads
Description: Wraps your feet in fur and veils you for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Whisker Warning
Description: Your whiskers give a second warning: once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Heel Loop
Description: Throws a loop of plaited hair around the legs of a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drover's Crack
Description: Cracks a long whip of plaited hair in a full circle, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Round-Up
Description: Throws loops of hair over up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles, pulling them onto you and holding their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Yoked Team
Description: When your stamina fills, your strands haul in unison and you deal 20% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Coffle Braid
Description: Throws a braid that locks around a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 12 damage, then links on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Cinch
Description: Hauls tight every strand you have on the target, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

Name: Windlass Anchor
Description: Anchors a line of hair 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward, and anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Link by Link
Description: Every hit you land loops another strand around that enemy: a stack builds on it, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all pull tight at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Whipstitch
Description: Stitches a strand through a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 piercing damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

Name: Winding Sheet
Description: Throws a sheet of woven hair over everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you and draws it tight, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour and leaving each target [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Field Sutures
Description: Stitches wounds shut with your own hair. It restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Penitent's Shirt
Description: Every time you take damage, your haircloth shirt builds a stack on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Snapped Branch
Description: Snaps off a lock grown hard and jagged, at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, and throws it at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 9 slashing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Stinging Bloom
Description: Every strand opens into a stinging polyp and fires at once, dealing 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Polyp Garden
Description: Your hair roots where you stand and spreads into a bed of polyps reaching 3 tiles around you. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Accreted Shell
Description: When you are healed, the new growth along your hair hardens into a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Wrung Under
Description: Winds a rope of hair around the target and rolls, dealing 22 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

Name: Waterline Lunge
Description: Hauls you along a strand to a target up to 6 tiles away and clamps on, dealing 14 damage, holding it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Drowned Noose
Description: Lays a noose of hair on the ground at the nearest enemy, where it waits up to 30 seconds. When an enemy comes within 2 tiles it pulls shut and deals 22 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

Name: Still Holding
Description: Your strands clamp down on what they already hold: you deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Velvet Tines
Description: Gores the target with antlers of bound hair still in velvet, dealing 5 piercing damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Startle Flare
Description: Every hair on you flares out at once, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Flagged Tail
Description: Your hair flashes white and you bolt: you spring 2 tiles from where you stood, and for 6 seconds you move 35% faster with 8% more dodge chance.

Name: Prickling Nape
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, the hair on your neck rises: a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Slipped Leash
Description: Slips a hound of knotted hair off its leash at a target up to 8 tiles away. It bites for 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Worry the Wound
Description: Catches a target carrying one of your afflictions by the strand tied to it and shakes it, using that affliction up. It deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Cure From the Biter
Description: Presses a hair from what bit you into the wound. It restores 14 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Tether Hound
Description: Calls a bonded hound on a leash of your own hair. It fights beside you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, and anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Shaken Spray
Description: Shakes the water out of your hair in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 water damage and leaving each target [Soaked] for 3 seconds.

Name: Unruffling Stroke
Description: Draws an oiled braid down a target up to 4 tiles away for 13 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Damped] for 6 seconds.

Name: Oiled Down
Description: Works preen oil through every strand: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Strider's Tread
Description: Fine oiled hairs on your feet hold you up on the surface: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, from silver you have 8% more dodge chance on it, and from gold your health recovers 15% faster on it.

Name: Faultline Heave
Description: Sends strands through the ground to the first enemy in their path, where they erupt as jagged stone for 30 earth damage. Every enemy within 3 tiles of it takes 80% of that.

Name: Wedge and Widen
Description: Root hairs work into the target and split it for 8 earth damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Dug In
Description: Your hair drives into the ground as roots, reducing the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Taproot
Description: When your stamina runs out, root hairs draw from the ground beneath you, restoring 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Straight to the Pupil
Description: Drives one stiffened strand into the eye of a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 piercing damage that ignores armour and rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target is [Blunted] for 8 seconds.

Name: Blinding Fringe
Description: Whips a curtain of hair across the faces of everything in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 damage and stunning each target for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Swept Clear
Description: Sweeps the hair out of your eyes: your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Warding Knot
Description: Conjures a charm of knotted hair around a staring bead: your critical hit chance rises by 6%, your critical hit multiplier rises by 0.15, and each kill restores 3 health.

Name: Course After Course
Description: Sends a strand to tear a mouthful from a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 blood damage. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Passed Around
Description: Looses 3 feeding strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 blood damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Bound at One Table
Description: Ties a strand to every ally within 5 tiles: each strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds, and you regain 8 health.

Name: Ten Thousand Mouths
Description: When you kill an enemy, your strands feed on the remains: for 6 seconds you heal for 25% of the damage you deal. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Travelling Spark
Description: Lights a strand that reaches the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 fire damage. The spark then runs along your hair to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that.

Name: Singeing Corona
Description: Every strand catches at once and flares out in a ring, dealing 28 fire damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Lit Curtain
Description: Hangs a curtain of burning hair 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Burnt-Down Fuse
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, the spark at the end of that strand jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 8 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Drawn Seine
Description: Hauls a net of strands through a cone ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Landed Catch
Description: Casts a line of hair that deals 14 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles and stuns it for 1 second, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slipped Knot
Description: For 7 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Tangled Minnow
Description: A bonded fish woven from your strands swims beside you, striking an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Springboard Lash
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Leaping Nits
Description: Flicks a nit from your hair that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then jumps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that.

Name: Slack and Snap
Description: Snaps you along a strand 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Infestation
Description: Every hit you land drops a flea from your hair onto that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all bite at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per flea (136% at full). Unfed, a flea drops off every 4 seconds.

Name: Paced Lash
Description: Pays out a strand that deals 8 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Tripline
Description: Sweeps a cone of strands along the ground ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Snare Underfoot
Description: Takes 1 second to set a snare of strands at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 12 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles springs it, which deals 18 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Cordwain Soles
Description: Conjures soles of braided strands: your movement speed rises 8%, your stamina recovers 12% faster, your critical chance rises by 3% and your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 2 health.

Name: Split End
Description: Throws a strand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 100% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Crossroads Sweep
Description: Sweeps strands round you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on an enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Parting Ways
Description: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Second Prong
Description: Each time you kill something, a strand springs to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Misdirected Cast
Description: Throws a strand that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 35% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Crossed Loyalties
Description: Snarls strands round every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage and stunning each for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Slipped Shadow
Description: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, your movement speed rises 10%, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Loaded Dice
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Sudden Reel
Description: Snaps a strand out that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Leapfrog Snare
Description: Springs you up to 6 tiles toward a target, then deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Pond Hop
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 3s.

Name: Pad Mooring
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Rooted Spore
Description: Throws a strand that deals 10 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Puffball Fringe
Description: Puffs a cone of spores ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Weave
Description: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Spreading Rot
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.

Name: Butting Haul
Description: A butting blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Through the Mail
Description: Swings a ring of strands, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

Name: Rooted Footing
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Dug-In Heels
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Herd Lash
Description: Casts a strand that deals 4 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 32%). Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Rallying Sweep
Description: Sweeps strands round you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Warm Bed-Down
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Banked Warmth
Description: Your armour rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Quick Report
Description: Fires a slug on a strand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Dead Reckoning
Description: Lines up a strand-guided shot that deals 36 damage to one enemy within 10 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Steadied Aim
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Twitch Reflex
Description: When you are hurt, you fire back at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Doubled Braid
Description: Throws a strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then plaits on to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

Name: Pull Tight
Description: Deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

Name: Tangle Field
Description: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Thousand-Strand Whip
Description: Conjures a whip of braided strands. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 6%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Levelling Drop
Description: A crushing blow that deals 40 damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Flattening Sweep
Description: Whips strands round you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Hammered Felt
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Driven Points
Description: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.

Name: Wringing Grasp
Description: Flicks a strand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and holds it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Gathering Grip
Description: Strings a 5-tile line of strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 10 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Self-Sutured
Description: Restores 18 health to you. Each heal has a 10% chance to be a critical heal, restoring more.

Name: Firm Hold
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Hoofbeat Lash
Description: A quick lash that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: Tireless Circuit
Description: Whips strands round you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Unflagging Tow
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3s after you use it.

Name: Tethered Mount
Description: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. You can ride it.

Name: Barbed Snag
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away along a barbed strand, then deals 11 damage and holds it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Gaffed Haul
Description: Casts a barbed strand that deals 20 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. It can only strike a target at or below 25% health. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Long Line
Description: Your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far for 20 seconds.

Name: Caught Fast
Description: Each time you afflict something, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Ridden Down
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 8 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Thrown Lariat
Description: Throws a lariat that deals 30 damage to one enemy within 8 tiles, always as a critical hit, and holds it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Deals up to 1.3 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Gallop Rope
Description: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds.

Name: Stride Beat
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Rushes you along a strand to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Quarry's Tag
Description: Throws a strand that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 12 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Pack Cry
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

Name: Run Down
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.

Name: Wire Whip
Description: Cracks a stiff strand that deals 5 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Bar Sweep
Description: Swings stiff strands round you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Drawn Shield
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and raises your armour by 8%, both for 8 seconds.

Name: Woven Mail
Description: Conjures armour of drawn strands: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12% plus a further 4%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Tethered Blade
Description: Flicks a strand-bound blade that deals 5 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles, and up to 2 times that at maximum range.

Name: Fan of Cuts
Description: Looses 4 strands at once, spread apart; each deals 5 damage. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Razor Tresses
Description: For 7 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Waiting Cut
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Chilled Thread
Description: Casts a cold strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Sprung Stillness
Description: A sudden lash that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Dropped Tail
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A shed strand fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Sun-Warmed
Description: During the day, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Swarm Hop
Description: Casts a strand that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 4 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

Name: Stripped Field
Description: Sweeps strands round you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

Name: Chewing Mat
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a mat of gnawing strands for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

Name: Leave Nothing
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Charged Strand
Description: Casts a charged strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Severed Thread
Description: Cuts through one enemy within 7 tiles for 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one drawn. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

Name: Spell-Snaring Weave
Description: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is turned aside and sent back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Stored Charge
Description: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Spoken Loop
Description: Throws a strand that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Spell Impetus] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Recited Knotwork
Description: Weaves strands round you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Muddled] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on an enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Second Telling
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Rote Recital
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.

Name: Slow Cast
Description: Drifts a strand that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 35% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Rolling Tide
Description: Pushes a cone of strands ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Lulling Cord
Description: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

Name: Easy Current
Description: When you gain health, you receive 30% more healing for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Hawser Lash
Description: Lashes a rope of braided strands at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 16 blunt damage that rises to 2 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Cinching Snap
Description: Every strand snaps tight around you at once, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

Name: Braided Sinew
Description: Plaits your strands into cables across your back, raising your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Dead Weight
Description: When you land a critical hit, you deal 40% more physical damage for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Pilfering Strand
Description: A strand picks at a target up to 7 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, uses it up and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

Name: Swinging Snatch
Description: Hooks a target up to 7 tiles away and swings you to it, landing a blow for 13 damage that leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Branch Hop
Description: Throws a strand to a branch and lets you step to a point up to 7 tiles away at once.

Name: Idle Fingers
Description: When you inflict a condition, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Skitter Spray
Description: Scatters 3 loose strands spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Baseboard Run
Description: Rushes you up to 5 tiles to a target and drives a strand through it for 14 damage.

Name: Behind the Wainscot
Description: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Small Hours
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Gap Finder
Description: Threads one stiffened strand through a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 36 piercing damage that ignores armour.

Name: Quick Darn
Description: A fast jab that deals 4 piercing damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Honed Ends
Description: Splits every strand to a point, increasing your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Weak Seam
Description: Against an enemy carrying a condition, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Drawstring Throw
Description: Casts a mesh of strands over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Hauled Weft
Description: Casts a strand at the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Picket Weave
Description: Raises a wall of woven strands 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Snagging Loops
Description: Every time you hit an enemy, a stack builds on it, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Eightfold Reach
Description: Looses 4 strands spread apart, each dealing 9 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Final Coil
Description: Winds a strand around a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 24 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Many Hands
Description: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of strands fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Boneless Give
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (48% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Rattling Plates
Description: Rattles a ring of stiffened strands around you, dealing 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Rolled Barb
Description: Rolls your strands into a ball and slams it into a target, dealing 14 blunt damage, leaving it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3 tiles.

Name: Overlap Shell
Description: Layers your strands into a shell that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Lapped Tiers
Description: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Stiff Edge
Description: Flicks a stiffened strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 slashing damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Unfolded Sheet
Description: Fans your strands out into a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Longhand
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

Name: Small Print
Description: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Creeping Runners
Description: Sends runners of hair along the ground to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 12 nature damage and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Pinning Tendril
Description: A tendril of hair drives into a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 nature damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Greening Patch
Description: Roots your strands into the ground where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Sap Rise
Description: Your armour rises by 6%. It also regenerates 0.8 health a second, permanently.

Name: Thump and Go
Description: A quick lash at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: Flushed Out
Description: Fires a strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Flat Out
Description: Increases your movement speed by 45% for 8 seconds.

Name: Springing Gait
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.

Name: Spatter
Description: Shakes 3 beads of water off your strands, spread apart, each dealing 3 water damage.

Name: Cloudburst
Description: Sends a heavy wave of water down a strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 water damage and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Dripping Eaves
Description: Lets water run down every strand to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, restoring 14 health to each.

Name: Wet Slate
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 2 mana a second for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Comb Through
Description: Drags a comb of strands across the target at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, dealing 9 slashing damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Windrow
Description: Sweeps a strand across the ground into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Gather In
Description: Drags up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Gleanings
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 6 stamina and 3 health. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Gnawing Pulse
Description: Sends a gnawing strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Cargo Plague
Description: Coughs a cloud of foul strands across a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 poison damage and leaving each enemy [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Bilge Recovery
Description: Restores 16 health to you, with a 10% chance to critically heal. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Tressrat Brood
Description: Calls a bonded rat of your own hair that fights beside you, gnawing enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Royal Decree
Description: Brings down a rod of strands on a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 radiant damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Imperial Toll
Description: Sends a strand at the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, at a cost of 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Standard Raised
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Chancery Bearing

Name: Circling Bite
