Name: Tow Line
Description: Fires a strand ahead and hauls you 5 tiles along it. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: Feeding Frenzy
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Rim Smash
Description: Slams a ring of packed strands around you, dealing 14 blunt damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Brace and Bash
Description: Drives a fist of packed strands into a target for 28 blunt damage that ignores armour, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Spiked Guard
Description: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Last Brace
Description: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a ward that absorbs 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Beating Wind
Description: Spreads your strands into a sail and beats it once, dealing 14 wind damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you and knocking it back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Ballast Throw
Description: Hurls a weighted knot down a strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 blunt damage. Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it takes 80% of that.

Name: Running Rigging
Description: Trims your strands to the wind, increasing your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Sea Legs
Description: Your maximum health rises by 6%.

Name: Landslide
Description: Drops a mass of packed strands on the target, dealing 30 earth damage that ignores resistance and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Clod Toss
Description: Lobs a knot of earth-caked strands at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 earth damage.

Name: Backfilled Wound
Description: Packs your strands over your wounds, restoring 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to critically heal.

Name: Turned Sod
Description: When you strike an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Reaping Arc
Description: Sweeps a curved blade of strands in a full circle, dealing 28 slashing damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Stooked Bundle
Description: Cuts a bundled strand loose at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 6 slashing damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Winnowing
Description: Combs 3 conditions out of you.

Name: Harvest Tally
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 8 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 12 seconds.

Name: Warning Musk
Description: Sprays a fine mist of strands in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 poison damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Lingering Reek
Description: Lashes a stinking strand at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 14 poison damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Turned Back
Description: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

Name: Stand Your Ground
Description: When your health falls below 50%, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 12 poison damage. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Grip
Description: A strand closes on the first enemy it meets, dealing 16 damage and stunning it for 1.4 seconds.

Name: Settled Account
Description: Draws a target up to 6 tiles away into a slow loop, dealing 18 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

Name: Slow Hang
Description: Lets your strands take the weight off you, cutting the damage you take by 20% for 15 seconds.

Name: Inevitable Growth
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.6 health a second, permanently.

Name: Fang Exchange
Description: Strikes with a strand that uses up one of your afflictions on the target, dealing 9 poison damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Coil and Wait
Description: Whips a venomed strand at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 poison damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and ignores resistance, and leaving it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Sloughed Skin
Description: Sheds a layer of strands that restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Venomed Blood
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.

Name: Long Throw
Description: Hurls a stiffened shaft of strands at a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 40 piercing damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and ignores armour.

Name: Three Casts
Description: Throws 3 shafts in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 8 piercing damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Point Set
Description: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Second Shaft
Description: When you strike an enemy, a shaft of strands lashes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 piercing damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Silk Line
Description: Spins a strand to a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Anchor Thread
Description: Fires strands at every enemy within 3.5 tiles at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, dealing 7 damage to each.

Name: Dew-Strung Trap
Description: Strings a web trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 2 minutes, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 24 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Loom Watch
Description: Calls a bonded spider of your own hair that fights beside you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Drilled Stroke
Description: A blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

Name: Object Lesson
Description: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to every enemy in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 20 seconds.

Name: While the Iron's Hot
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

Name: Measure Twice
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Pestle Draw
Description: A blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Mortar Grind
Description: Pounds the ground, dealing 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Bitter Rebound
Description: For 9 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Spent Dose
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Two-Fist Quake
Description: Brings both fists down on the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Whatever's to Hand
Description: Hurls a stone that deals 30 damage to the first enemy in its path. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Found a Bigger Rock
Description: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Roused Silverback
Description: When your health falls below 30%, your physical damage rises 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Rivet Popper
Description: A blow that deals 32 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Struck Breastplate
Description: Strikes your own plating, and the ring deals 7 resonating damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Also costs 3% of your maximum health.

Name: Dents Beaten Out
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Smithy-Made Harness
Description: Conjures hammered plate over you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your maximum health rises by 8, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Timber
Description: Brings the edge down along a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 28 slashing damage to every enemy in it. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Poll and Bit
Description: Strikes with the flat of the head, then the edge: deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Peened Edge
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Felling Notches
Description: Every time you land a hit, a notch builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per notch. Unfed, a notch fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Struck-Iron Ping
Description: Sends the ring of struck iron into the first enemy in its path for 4 resonating damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Belfry Toll
Description: Tolls a note that deals 14 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Bell's Answer
Description: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Carrying Echo
Description: When you land a critical hit, the echo strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 lightning damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Den-Breaker
Description: An overhead blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 25%).

Name: Cuffing Sweep
Description: Cuffs everything in a cone 3 tiles long for 12 damage and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Boilerplate Hide
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Gathering Weight
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Scatter of Brads
Description: Drives 3 barbed nails out in a spread, each dealing 5 damage with a 50% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Stinger Driven Home
Description: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Tinkers' Swarm
Description: After a 1-second cast, calls a swarm for 15 seconds that taps at an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each tap with a 30% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Cobbler's Tempo
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Downdraft Slam
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 12 wind damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Skyfall Weight
Description: Throws a weight that deals 30 damage to the first enemy in its path, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Hauled by the Haft
Description: The swung head carries you 5 tiles forward. For 3 seconds after you land, you move 20% faster.

Name: Running Wind-Up
Description: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Fowler's Blunt
Description: Looses a blunt-headed arrow that deals 5 damage to the first enemy in its path, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Loosed at Full Draw
Description: Draws the hammer back and throws it at a target up to 9 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Lengthened Haft
Description: After a 1-second cast, your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 15 seconds.

Name: String Pulled Taut
Description: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Coffle Rivet
Description: A blow that deals 13 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Portcullis Drop
Description: Strikes the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Driven Palings
Description: Hammers a row of bars 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Held for the Blow
Description: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Batted Aside
Description: Swats everything in a cone 2.5 tiles long for 11 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Quiet Coshing
Description: A blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It always lands as a critical hit. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

Name: Felted Mallet
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 11% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Lands Square
Description: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.

Name: Head-Down Charge
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 8 tiles away, then deals 15 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Tread of the Herd
Description: Stamps the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 30%).

Name: Lead-Cow's Clang
Description: Strikes a bell: up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

Name: Draught-Ox Shoulders
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises by 10, from silver your health recovers 15% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Meteor Orbit
Description: Swings the head round on its tether, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Skipping Links
Description: Casts the head out on its tether to strike the first enemy in its path for 7 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

Name: Stake and Tether
Description: Hammers a stake into the ground ahead of you. For 5 seconds its 5-tile tether drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Mail in the Making
Description: Every hit you land forges a link on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per link. Unfed, a link fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Thrashed Dust
Description: Beats out a cone of dust 2 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Fulling Stocks
Description: Pounds the target for 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Colours to the Mast
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Arming Doublet
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 10% blunt resistance.

Name: Staghorn Shatter
Description: Smashes a reef growth into a cone of shards 3 tiles long, dealing 7 piercing damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

Name: Shipwrecker
Description: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Razor Reef
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Storm-Beaten Crust
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Vice Shut
Description: Clamps down on the target for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Overhand
Description: After a 1.5-second wind-up, strikes everything in a cone 3 tiles long for 16 damage and stuns it for 1.6 seconds, with a 60% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

Name: Still as a Log
Description: After a 2-second cast, increases your damage by 40% for 10 seconds.

Name: Patience Rewarded
Description: When your stamina fills, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Rutting Clash
Description: Meets the target head-on for 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Warning Stamp
Description: Stamps once, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. For 2 seconds after using it, you move 10% faster.

Name: Recoil Bound
Description: Springs 2 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

Name: Slip, Then Swing
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Thrown and Retrieved
Description: Throws the hammer at a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It holds 3 charges, and each kill brings a charge back.

Name: Quarry at Bay
Description: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The blow deals 22 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times the damage they had left to deal. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

Name: Catch-Hound
Description: After a 1-second cast, whistles up a hound that fights beside you for 18 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each bite has a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Dropped at Your Feet
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Pond Ripple
Description: Strikes the ground and a ripple deals 3 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Seven Skips
Description: Skims the hammer at a target up to 8 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach. It ignores the target's resistances.

Name: Rain on the Anvil
Description: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Bobs Back Up
Description: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Epicentre
Description: Strikes the ground, dealing 30 earth damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring their armour, and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Spreading Fracture
Description: A blow that deals 14 rock damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Tremor Underfoot
Description: After a 1-second wind-up, the ground shakes and holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Quarryman's Read
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.

Name: Called Shot
Description: Sights along the haft and sends the head at a target up to 7 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: All Faults Found
Description: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in it and leaving each [Marked] for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Dead Centre
Description: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Nail's Head
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.

Name: Tenderiser
Description: Pounds the target for 4 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Dinner Gong
Description: Strikes a gong that deals 28 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 25% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Trestle Table
Description: Knocks together a laden table where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Cracked for Marrow
Description: When you kill an enemy, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Spark Shower
Description: Strikes hot iron and throws sparks through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 fire damage with a 70% chance to leave each enemy hit [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: The Quench
Description: Only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The blow deals 22 damage and puts out every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times the damage they had left to deal.

Name: Slag Runnel
Description: Pours a line of slag 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Forge-Hot Head
Description: Conjures a maul with a glowing head. Your weapon damage rises by 12% and your fire resistance by 10%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Priest's Knock
Description: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The knock deals 20 damage, uses up every affliction on the target for 1.4 times the damage they had left to deal, and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Thrashing Shallows
Description: Slams the ground and throws up water, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Bait and Brace
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 4 seconds.

Name: Silver Turnabout
Description: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all, and a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack.

Name: Hopping Rivet
Description: Flicks a rivet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hop dealing 50% of the original damage.

Name: Dropped Anvil
Description: Drops your full weight onto the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

Name: Landing Brace
Description: You hop 3 tiles forward and land braced, raising your armour by 25% for 8 seconds.

Name: Height Into Weight
Description: Each time you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Long Road's Reckoning
Description: A full-weight blow that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

Name: Cobble Setter
Description: Stamps the ground flat ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Hobnailed Boots
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

Name: Beaten Road
Description: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Branching Bruise
Description: A strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then branch out to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Splitting Crack
Description: Splits the ground ahead of you in a wide fork 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and ignoring armour.

Name: Back-and-Fore
Description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Other Tine
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Three-Shell Toss
Description: Throws 3 weights at once, spread apart, each dealing 9 damage and knocking what it hits back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Blindside
Description: A blow that deals 34 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Deadfall
Description: Sets a deadfall on the nearest enemy that waits 20 seconds; the first enemy to come within 3 tiles of it is crushed, and it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Opening Exploited
Description: When you inflict a condition, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Sodden Lob
Description: Lobs a sodden weight that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Marsh Slap
Description: Slaps the wet ground ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Sweating Venom
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Wound Tight
Description: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Puffball Burst
Description: Slams the ground and bursts a cloud of spores, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 60% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Soft Rot Smash
Description: A blow that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Hardened Bracket
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. You also carry 15% poison resistance.

Name: Into Every Crack
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Headlong Ram
Description: You rush an enemy up to 6 tiles away and ram it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Won't Be Moved
Description: Plants your feet and slams the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring armour. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Unmoved
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Dig In
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Drover's Blow
Description: A heavy blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. When it hits, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Herd Tramp
Description: Stamps the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

Name: Bellwether's Call
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Grazing Count
Description: Every blow you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6, they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack.

Name: Percussion Shot
Description: Strikes a cap and fires a ball that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour.

Name: Muzzle Clap
Description: Strikes a charge that bursts through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Half-Cock to Full
Description: Increases your damage by 35% for 10 seconds.

Name: Second Report
Description: When you land a critical hit, a shot cracks out at the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Braided Lash
Description: Swings a braided, weighted cord that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Pillars Pulled Down
Description: Brings down everything around you, dealing 36 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Matted Padding
Description: Beats loose strands into felt around you, which absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

Name: Uncut Locks
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.

Name: Anvil-Flat
Description: A two-handed blow that deals 40 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Ringing Floor
Description: Strikes the ground twice in one motion, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Pounding Rig
Description: Sets down a trip-forge that lasts 12 seconds and pounds the nearest enemy within 3 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 6 damage.

Name: Peened Over
Description: Each blow you land gives you a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Set and Drive
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. You drive a blow home that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at your full 4-tile reach.

Name: Steady Tapping
Description: A quick, measured tap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Eye on the Mark
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Smith's Mitts
Description: Conjures a pair of smith's mitts: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more, each kill returns 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.

Name: Shoe Pitch
Description: Pitches 3 horseshoes at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Farrier's Throw
Description: Hurls a horseshoe that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full 6-tile reach, and stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Breath Between Blows
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Unflagging Arm
Description: Each blow you land restores 3 stamina. Once every 2 seconds.

Description: A kick that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of health the target still has (max +30%). Holds 5 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Unflagging
Description: Your attack speed rises 25% for 15 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Last Reserves
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Snag and Tear
Description: A heel strike that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Thrashing Snag
Description: You thrash in place, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Dragged at the Tail
Description: Snags up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles and pulls them onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Snagged Can't Follow
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.

Name: Ridden Through
Description: A full-speed collision that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds after.

Name: Thrown-Up Turf
Description: Your hooves throw up 3 clods of turf at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Open Ground
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Heart Keeps the Beat
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: A running strike at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each, and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Trail Gone Red
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to a target and strike it for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Never Out of Reach
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Scent of the Flagging
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Cold-Shoe Strike
Description: A shod kick at a target at or below 20% health that deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Grey Wake
Description: You plough through a cone up to 5 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to everything in it.

Name: Cold-Forged Hide
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it.

Name: Unbowed Stance
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Slipped Blade
Description: A heel strike at a target at or below 25% health that deals 20 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Crescent Sweep
Description: A sweeping kick that deals 4 damage to everything in a cone up to 3 tiles ahead, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Edge Turned Out
Description: Your critical hits deal 30% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Unseen Approach
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Sun-Warmed Lunge
Description: A lunging kick at a target up to 5 tiles away that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range.

Name: Noon Heat Snort
Description: You snort stored sun-heat in a cone up to 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Sun on the Flanks
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Warmed by Noon
Description: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Chaff Cloud
Description: Your hooves kick up 3 bursts of chaff at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Strip to the Stalk
Description: Flings a biting knot of locusts from your hooves at the first enemy in line, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 20% of it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Following Swarm
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm that runs with you for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. It draws the attention of the last enemy you struck, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Eat and Move On
Description: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Loose Spark
Description: Kicks a spark of raw arcana at the first enemy in line, dealing 4 damage.

Name: Wild Current
Description: You stamp raw arcana into the ground, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Running Off the Surge
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sweat Into Spark
Description: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 4 mana. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Dressage Finish
Description: A measured strike at a target at or below 25% health that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Unravelling] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Pirouette on the Haunches
Description: You turn on your haunches, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stripping 10% armour for 4 seconds and slowing each by 20%. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Drilled Cadence
Description: Your casting speed rises 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Counted Paces
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Weight
Description: A slow, full-weight kick at a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full range. Bosses and elites also lose 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Wallowing Wake
Description: You wallow forward, dealing 3 damage to everything in a cone up to 3 tiles ahead, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Easy Pace
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

Name: Nothing Urgent
Description: The moment your health is full, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Textbook Gaff
Description: A rehearsed pull-cut that deals 28 damage and always lands as a critical hit. It drags the target's guard open, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Opening Cast
Description: Throws a barbed line that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Reset the Measure
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Set Then Pull
Description: Every time you land a hit, a barb builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per barb (163% at full). Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Draw the Venom
Description: A pulling cut that deals 18 damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Dosed Point
Description: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves a barb in the wound: the target is [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Bitter Extraction
Description: Pulls up to 2 poison conditions out of you and restores 10 health.

Name: Under Any Hide
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Wrench Loose
Description: Wrenches the target's guard open, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Uprooted Lob
Description: Gaffs a chunk out of the ground and hurls it overhand. It deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Bough Swing
Description: Catches a hold ahead and swings you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Peel the Plate
Description: Catches a plate and tears it away, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Lowered Shields
Description: Drags the barb across the guard of every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, with a 35% chance per hit to leave them [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Barbed Pauldrons
Description: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Gap Finder
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 4% sooner.

Name: Back-Spike Trip
Description: Catches the target's leg with the back-spike and brings the blade down. It deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Headsman's Reach
Description: Pulls the target's head down and drops the edge on it, dealing 24 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Timber Skid
Description: Pulls a felled trunk 5 tiles long across the ground for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Neck on the Block
Description: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 9 seconds.

Name: Thumb-Claw Latch
Description: Flings a clawed barb that deals 7 dark damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Roost Drop
Description: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and drags its guard open, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Rafter Line
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. You gain +10% dodge chance.

Name: Clinging Thirst
Description: Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. When you land a critical hit, your attacks heal you for 20% of their damage for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Land the Big One
Description: A raking maul that deals 32 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: River Gaff
Description: A long reach that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

Name: Crushing Embrace
Description: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Taste of the Catch
Description: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Torn Stinger
Description: Drives a barbed sting in and tears free of it, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Worker's Volley
Description: Looses 3 barbed stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage, with a 20% chance per hit to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Honey Snare
Description: Sets a baited snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 18 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Alarm Scent
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Talon Stoop
Description: A stooping snatch at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Mantling Sweep
Description: Sweeps the haft in a full circle, dealing 12 wind damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

Name: Off the Glove
Description: Looses a hawk for 10 seconds that strikes for 3 damage every second within 4 tiles. Each strike of its talons has a 35% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Circling Raptor
Description: Every few paces you cover, a talon strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Full-Draw Harpoon
Description: Looses a harpoon at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and always lands as a critical hit. Its barbed line slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Quiver of Barbs
Description: Shoots a barbed arrow that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Paid-Out Line
Description: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: Nock After the Set
Description: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 20% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Through the Bars
Description: A thrust that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Dropped Portcullis
Description: Drops a ring of bars on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Gibbet Lock
Description: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Kept at Arm's Length
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Toy With It
Description: Catches the target with a claw and bats it away, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Done Playing
Description: A killing strike with claws set, dealing 20 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Dangled Lure
Description: Dangles a baited line 3 tiles long for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it.

Name: Mouser on the Prowl
Description: A bonded mouser prowls with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Its curved claws leave them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Toss on the Horns
Description: Drives a low upward arc through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and tossing it back 3 tiles.

Name: Drover's Goad
Description: A prodding reach that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

Name: Round Up
Description: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Heels Dug In
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Thrown Grapnel
Description: Throws a grapnel on a length of links that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Yank It Taut
Description: A wrenching strike that deals 16 damage and tears out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one. The torn wound is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and the target moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Windlass
Description: Stakes a winched line 6 tiles long for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Trailing Links
Description: When you strike, a barbed link flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Pulled Thread
Description: Snags a thread of the target's guard and pulls, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Weighted Net
Description: Casts a barbed net over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds, with a 60% chance per hit to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Curved-Needle Suture
Description: Stitches your wounds shut and restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Row by Row
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 7. At 7 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (29% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Staghorn Cut
Description: A raking strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Run Aground
Description: Raises a barbed reef under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 water damage and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Snagging Shoal
Description: Sets down a branching growth for 12 seconds that cuts for 3 damage every second within 3 tiles, each cut with a 35% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Accretion
Description: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a growth on it, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per growth (218% at full). Unfed, a growth fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Roll It Under
Description: Sets the barb and rolls, dealing 16 damage and tearing out every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Snap From Stillness
Description: Lunges through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit and clamps the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Baited Waterline
Description: Sets a baited barb at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 40 seconds and deals 22 damage to each of the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles.

Name: Log in the Shallows
Description: Anything you strike moves 20% slower for 3 seconds. When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Running Tine
Description: A lunging tine that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and tosses the target back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Antler Flick
Description: Catches and tosses with your tines in a full circle, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Break Away
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance.

Name: Gored in Passing
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (109% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Hold for the Pack
Description: Catches the target and holds it open, dealing 28 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Lockjaw
Description: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Short Leash
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds. For 8 seconds an escort fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Lurcher at Heel
Description: A bonded hound runs with you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.1 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Dive and Surface
Description: Dives you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then gaffs it for 13 water damage, leaving it [Soaked] for 5 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Idle Dabble
Description: A reach that deals 4 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Unruffled
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you slip 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Slides Off, Snags Them
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Heaved Bedrock
Description: Catches the bedrock and hauls it up under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 earth damage that ignores armour.

Name: Driven Piton
Description: Throws a stone piton that deals 8 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Deadman Anchor
Description: Sets your barb into bedrock and braces on it, raising your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Purchase on Stone
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Caught Looking
Description: A snagging weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Picked Out
Description: Throws a barbed dart that deals 22 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 60% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Hold My Gaze
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Fastened Tight
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 7% more damage per stack (33% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Carve the Catch
Description: A carving cut that deals 9 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Passed Platter
Description: Gaffs and carves every enemy within 3 tiles for 28 damage, healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Hung to Share
Description: Hangs the day's catch where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Full Rail
Description: Every kill you make hangs a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pull Down the Thatch
Description: A hauling cut that deals 13 fire damage, sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Raked Coals
Description: Rakes live coals through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 fire damage to everything caught in it, with a 35% chance per hit to leave it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

Name: Ember Furrow
Description: Drags a line of live coals 5 tiles long across the ground for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hot Iron Answer
Description: When a non-fire blow hurts you, a red-hot barb flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Silver Scatter
Description: Casts 3 barbed lines at once in a spread, each dealing 3 water damage.

Name: Play the Line
Description: A reeling strike that deals 7 water damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and makes it move 30% slower for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Wriggle Off
Description: Slips you 4 tiles forward, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: First Nibble
Description: When you inflict a condition, a baited barb flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Leaping Latch
Description: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and latch on with a strike that deals 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Host to Host
Description: Flicks a barb that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then jumps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

Name: Bound Within Reach
Description: Springs you to a point up to 8 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance.

Name: Latched Feeder
Description: When you strike an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Ankle Snag
Description: A low hooking sweep at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Long Road Reaping
Description: Sweeps the haft around at knee height, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring armour. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Braced Stance
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Miles in the Arm
Description: After you cover a stretch of ground, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Branching Throw
Description: Throws a two-pronged barb that deals 7 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets and splits to 1 more within 3 tiles for the full amount. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Two-Tined Thrust
Description: Strikes 2 times, one with each prong, each strike dealing 10 piercing damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Pronged Palisade
Description: Plants a row of prongs 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 6 seconds. Anything that strikes it moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Second Roll
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Crossed Lines
Description: Snags up to 2 enemies within 4 tiles, deals 10 damage to each and turns them against each other for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Light Fingers
Description: Throws a snatching barb that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Lure in the Reeds
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Bait Taken
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.

Name: Tongue Lash
Description: Lashes out at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 6 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Sudden Splashdown
Description: You spring up to 6 tiles onto an enemy, then deal 12 water damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you.

Name: Snapped Fly
Description: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Squat Lookout
Description: A bonded bullfrog sits with you, lashing its tongue at enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Spore-Laced Jab
Description: A barbed jab that deals 4 poison damage and leaves spores in the wound: [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Uproot the Bloom
Description: Tears the growth out of the target, dealing 18 poison damage and using up every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage and 60% more damage for each one used up.

Name: Hyphal Mat
Description: Spreads a mat of threads 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and leaves those it catches [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Gets Into Everything
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Shove Off the Ledge
Description: A butting blow that deals 18 rock damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Ledge Jab
Description: A reaching jab from sure footing at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 7% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 35%).

Name: Unshiftable Footing
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Last Foothold
Description: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Crook the Stray
Description: A sweeping crook blow that deals 26 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. On a hit, every ally in your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Drive the Flock
Description: Drives the haft in a wide sweep ahead of you, dealing 10 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long and knocking it back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Into the Fold
