Description: A strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds, and has a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Rotting Lure
Description: Seeds up to 3 bodies in reach with spores for 30 seconds. Each bursts for 26 damage the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it.

Name: Spore Shroud
Description: Veils you in spores for 8 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10%. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Spores Move On
Description: When a condition you inflicted runs out, spores burst to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Headlong Butt
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and butt it for 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

Name: Off the Ledge
Description: Kicks out with both hooves, dealing 24 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to every enemy within 3 tiles, and knocks each back 3 tiles.

Name: Planted Hooves
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Hold the Ledge
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Scatter the Herd
Description: Charges into the pack, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Cull the Weakest
Description: A blow that deals 18 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Downwind Among Them
Description: Veils you and your nearby allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Graze Between Kills
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Clean Kill Shot
Description: A shot that deals 34 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 10 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Startling Report
Description: A deafening report that deals 10 damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you and stuns each for 1 second.

Name: Sighting In
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

Name: Held Breath
Description: When you go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Snare Lines
Description: Whips snaring strands at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage, stripping 10% armour for 6 seconds and slowing each by 20%, then stuns each for 1 second.

Name: Draw the Noose
Description: Tightens a strand on a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage and leave it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Every Strand Listening
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Braided Garrotte
Description: Conjures a braided garrotte. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Poleaxe
Description: A crushing blow that deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Beating the Brush
Description: Hammers the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour, and leaves each [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Measured Backswing
Description: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

Name: Follow-Through
Description: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Throat Grip
Description: Grabs one enemy within 2 tiles by the throat, dealing 9 damage, stunning it for 1 second and silencing it for 3 seconds.

Name: Wring the Neck
Description: A twisting grip that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to it. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

Name: Unshaking Aim
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to steady yourself, then increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Closing Grip
Description: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Saddle Javelin
Description: A javelin thrown from the saddle that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

Name: Loosed at the Gallop
Description: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Long Rein
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

Name: Fresh Legs
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Reel Yourself In
Description: Casts a barbed line at the target and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it. The barb deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Snagging Sweep
Description: A sweep of barbs that deals 4 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, with a 20% chance per hit to leave each [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Haul the Line
Description: Casts a barbed line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

Name: Snagged Prey
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Thundering Front
Description: Drives forward at a gallop, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Lance at Full Tilt
Description: A charging lance blow that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 48%.

Name: Full Gallop
Description: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Gathered Stride
Description: Every few paces you cover in pursuit, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Quarry Named
Description: A thrown spear that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: End of the Chase
Description: A finishing strike that deals 16 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Scent Taken
Description: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Run Down
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Unyielding Thrust
Description: A thrust that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Jaws Spring Shut
Description: Snaps shut around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Hidden Gin
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to set iron jaws by the nearest enemy. They stay armed for 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles and everything within 2 tiles of the jaws take 16 damage.

Name: Grim Persistence
Description: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Palmed Blade
Description: Flicks a palmed blade that deals 7 damage, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that is not yet wounded. It holds 3 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

Name: Skinning Cut
Description: A cut that deals 18 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Under the Guard
Description: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Seam Finder
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Strike From Stillness
Description: A strike that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Tail Lash
Description: A lash of the tail that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Sun-Warmed Muscle
Description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Daylight Stalker
Description: By day, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Swarm Upon It
Description: Sends a knot of locusts into the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Stripping Cloud
Description: Breathes out a cloud of locusts that deals 6 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you. It holds 4 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

Name: Chittering Tide
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Picked Clean
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Seeking Lance
Description: A lance of force that seeks the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage while ignoring resistances, and leaves the target [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

Name: Flushing Pulse
Description: A pulse that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Recast the Snare
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Wake of Spells
Description: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Spoken Mark
Description: Speaks a word at a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage.

Name: Litany of Pursuit
Description: Intones a litany that deals 25 damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Word of Stillness
Description: Takes 1 second to speak, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Practiced Cadence
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Drag of the Current
Description: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 8 damage, loses 8% armour for 6 seconds, is slowed by 30% and is pushed back 2 tiles.

Name: Unhurried Blow
Description: A heavy strike that costs 4% of your maximum health, deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Drifting Rest
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Following the Current
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank, you move 15% faster over it.

Name: Hundredth Hammerfall
Description: A practised hammer blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: The Rehearsed Turn
Description: Swings the hammer through a full turn, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy hit is left [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Mailed Footwork
Description: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds.

Name: Rote and Rivet
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Drawn to the Blade
Description: A thrust that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Skimmed Dross
Description: Flings off skimmed dross, dealing 10 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You regain 6 health. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Proof Against Taint
Description: For 3 seconds, no condition can take hold of you and blows that reach you deal no damage, and you regain 8 health at once. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Nothing to Corrode
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% poison resistance.

Name: Vice Grip
Description: Seizes the target and slams it down for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Hurled Ingot
Description: Throws an ingot that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Breastplate Drumming
Description: Beats your fists on your breastplate, pulling up to 6 enemies within 5 tiles onto you and holding their attention for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow to Anger
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pauldron Check
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away and drives a shoulder plate into it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Shed Scales
Description: Bursts your outer layer of plates outward, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Plate Over Plate
Description: Locks a second layer of plate over the first: it absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Proofed Brigandine
Description: Conjures a brigandine of riveted plates: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Helm Cleaver
Description: A full overhead chop that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Splitting Wedge
Description: Chops through a wide arc 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 30%).

Name: Headsman's Stance
Description: Increases your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Bearded Bit
Description: Conjures a heavy bearded axe head on your weapon. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your armour by 5%, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Belfry Stroke
Description: Strikes your own plate so it rings, dealing 12 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

Name: Latching Weight
Description: A hooked weapon strike that deals 8 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, slows it by 20% for 3 seconds, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Answering Peal
Description: For 7 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Dark-Hung Mail
Description: At night, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Crushing Hug
Description: Locks both arms round the target and squeezes for 30 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Baited Too Long
Description: Swipes through a wide arc 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

Name: Fat for the Winter
Description: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

Name: Shag Beneath Steel
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your physical resistance rises by 6%.

Name: Hive of Tacks
Description: Looses a swarm of barbed tacks across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 3 poison damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Barb Driven Home
Description: Hammers the barb in, dealing 18 damage and consuming every affliction on the target to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Riveting Swarm
Description: Calls up a swarm of rivet-wasps that fights for 12 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Forge-Hand Tempo
Description: Each time you strike with your weapon, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Deadweight Stoop
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and lands on it for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

Name: Pinion Scatter
Description: Looses 3 metal pinions at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Alight Braced
Description: Hops you 3 tiles from where you stood, and raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Hollow-Forged Bones
Description: You move 8% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 6%.

Name: Arbalest Bolt
Description: Looses a heavy bolt that deals 32 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 9 tiles. It ignores armour.

Name: Racked Quarrels
Description: Looses 3 quarrels at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Planted Pavise
Description: Plants a standing shield 4 tiles wide for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Bodkin Points
Description: Your piercing attacks ignore 18% of the target's armour.

Name: Portcullis Drop
Description: Drops a grate round you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Door Swung To
Description: A closing blow that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Turnkey's Hour
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Behind the Bars
Description: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Honed on the Doorpost
Description: A raking weapon strike that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Four-Point Landing
Description: Lands on all fours with your full weight, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles.

Name: Not a Scratch
Description: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Ninth Rivet
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Drove-Road Tread
Description: Stamps shod hooves down round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Lead Ox
Description: A horn-first blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Yoked Together
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Unhurried Mending
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.

Name: Fetter Lash
Description: A lashing weapon strike that deals 12 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Reeled Short
Description: Snaps a weighted line taut on a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Hauled Hand Over Hand
Description: Hauls on the links, pulling up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holding their attention for 7 seconds.

Name: Link Added
Description: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Running Stitch
Description: Throws a threaded needle that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

Name: Rally to the Colours
Description: Slams a shod banner pole down, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Wire-Thread Lining
Description: For 9 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Ring by Ring
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: What the Reef Takes
Description: A scraping blow that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Staghorn Burst
Description: Bursts rusted spines out round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. [Bleeding] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Outcrop of Wreckage
Description: Plants an encrusted spar that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Living Rust
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Clamp and Roll
Description: A clamping, rolling weapon strike that deals 24 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 30% for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Jaws From Below
Description: Snaps a hinged jaw shut across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Mantrap in the Shallows
Description: Sets a jaw trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

Name: Grip Never Slackens
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Tined Toss
Description: Hooks the target on a rack of tines and throws it: a weapon strike that deals 13 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Warning Stamp
Description: Stamps a shod hoof, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Bolt in Full Harness
Description: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for the first 4 seconds.

Name: Flinch Turned Plate
Description: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Brought to Bay
Description: A clamping bite of spiked metal that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 30%).

Name: Slipped Leash
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Collar of Spikes
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each attacker is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Junkyard Mastiff
Description: Calls a mastiff that fights beside you, biting an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing what it bites by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Skipped Sinker
Description: Skips a cast sinker that deals 7 water damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Unruffled Plunge
Description: Drops your full plated weight and throws up a wave, dealing 28 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

Name: Beads Off Oiled Steel
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Preening Between Blows
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Seam Collapse
Description: Hurls a slab of ore-bearing rock that deals 22 rock damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Hematite Teeth
Description: Drives spikes of raw ore up through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 rock damage to everything in it and stunning it for 1 second.

Name: Lodestone Draw
Description: Raises a lodestone seam 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Laid Down in Strata
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Cold Regard
Description: Sends a level stare into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 arcane damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Every Gap Counted
Description: Strikes at each gap you have picked out across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It ignores armour.

Name: Stare-Down
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Slit Visor
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Marrow Cracked
Description: A cracking weapon strike that deals 24 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Tipped Cauldron
Description: Tips a boiling cauldron across a wide cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 fire damage to everything in it and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: The Common Pot
Description: Sets a cookpot down where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

Name: Well-Fed Bulwark
Description: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Bare-Handed Brand
Description: A weapon strike with the metal gripped red-hot in your bare hand, dealing 9 fire damage and setting the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Crucible Overhand
Description: Hurls a crucible of molten slag that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Tempering Heat
Description: Raises your armour by 22% and your fire resistance by 15% for 10 seconds.

Name: Struck While Hot
Description: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Scattered Slivers
Description: Sprays a shoal of iron slivers in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to each enemy caught and leaving it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Sounding Line
Description: Casts a weighted iron line at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour.

Name: Slick Plate
Description: Raises your armour by 15% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

Name: Each Slip a Rivet
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Unexpected Arrival
Description: Leaps onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and comes down with your full weight, dealing 14 damage, biting it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Hop and Drop
Description: Hops in place and comes down hard, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spring to Cover
Description: Raises a shell of iron that absorbs the next 16 damage and holds for 5 seconds, and your armour rises by 5% while it holds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds after you use it. Enemies more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

Name: Heavy Landings
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your physical damage by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Hobnailed Kick
Description: Kicks an enemy with an iron-shod boot, dealing 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Road's Last Mile
Description: Brings the whole road behind you down in one stamp, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch you have travelled, up to 30%.

Name: Forced March
Description: For 12 seconds, you take 20% less damage, move 20% faster, and are freed of every root, freeze and slow.

Name: Mile-Hardened
Description: Your movement speed is permanently 8% higher, and you have 8% physical resistance.

Name: Split Spike
Description: Fires an iron spike that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 60% of that damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Two-Tine Rap
Description: Jabs with a two-pronged iron head, dealing 4 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Both Ways Braced
Description: 25% of the damage that reaches you is split off your plate and sent back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Glancing Branch
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, the blow forks off your iron plate as a spike and deals 6 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Coin Trick
Description: Flicks a cold iron coin that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second. It has a 40% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Dust in the Eyes
Description: Flings iron filings in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to each enemy caught, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Not What It Seemed
Description: For 8 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Cheat the Reckoning
Description: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Silt Spit
Description: Spits a gob of silty water that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Sudden Snap
Description: Springs at a wounded enemy and deals 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Leap Into Brace
Description: Springs you 3 tiles and raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. Enemies more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

Name: Held Breath
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Rust Seeding
Description: Fires a rusted spore-pellet that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Red Dust Bloom
Description: Releases a cloud of rust spores in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy caught.

Name: Toadstool Hedge
Description: Grows a 5-tile line of rusted iron fungus ahead of you for 8 seconds. Enemies that cross it are [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hyphal Reach
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 8% physical resistance.

Name: Off the Ledge
Description: Butts a wounded enemy for 22 damage and leaves it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Planted Stamp
Description: Stamps an iron-shod hoof, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Nothing Moves Me
Description: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Crag-Footed
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% rock resistance.

Name: Circle the Calves
Description: Shoulders outward from the middle of your allies, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each 2.5 tiles back.

Name: Bellwether Toll
Description: Rings an iron bell against an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage; when it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

Name: Stand Before the Herd
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A grazen bull fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Chewing It Over
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Roundshot
Description: Fires a cold iron ball that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour.

Name: Grapeshot
Description: Blasts a spray of iron shot in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to each enemy caught. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Behind the Mantlet
Description: Plants an iron mantlet that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, raising your armour by 6% while it holds. A gun crew fires from behind it for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Drilled Reloading
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and every ability you have comes round 6% sooner.

Name: Bristle Spray
Description: Looses 5 iron bristles at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Garrotte Wire
Description: Loops an iron wire around a wounded enemy's throat, dealing 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.2 times their remaining damage, and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Tangle Fence
Description: Strings a 5-tile tangle of iron wire ahead of you for 8 seconds. It blocks enemies, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Thousandfold Weave
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% slashing resistance.

Name: Dropped Anvil
Description: Heaves an anvil that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Forge Tap
Description: Taps an enemy with a forge-hot smith's stroke, dealing 5 damage, setting it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Work-Hardened
Description: Raises your armour by 25% and your blunt resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

Name: Blow Upon Blow
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Wrung Dry
Description: Seizes an enemy in a mailed grip and squeezes, dealing 16 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Knuckle Rap
Description: Raps an enemy with mailed knuckles, dealing 5 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and with a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Hold the Line
Description: For 12 seconds, you take 20% less damage.

Name: Gauntlet That Fits
Description: Conjures a fitted iron gauntlet: your armour rises by 8%, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.

Name: Trample Through
Description: Drives forward in iron-shod strides, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead and knocking each 3 tiles back.

Name: Shod Kick
Description: Lashes out with an iron-shod kick, dealing 7 damage and knocking the target 1.5 tiles back. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Outrider's Dash
Description: Raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed by 25% for 10 seconds. Enemies more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

Name: Tireless Companion
Description: A bonded heidel in iron barding fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds and slowing them by 15% for 2 seconds. You can ride it.

Name: Gutting Barb
Description: Drives an iron barb into a wounded enemy, dealing 20 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.3 times their remaining damage, and making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Barbed Sweep
Description: Sweeps a barbed iron hook through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to each enemy caught, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Reeled to Heel
Description: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles and drags them onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Snagged and Held
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Couched Lance
Description: Charges an iron-tipped lance into an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch you have galloped, up to 30%.

Name: Rearing Crash
Description: Rears and crashes down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Warhorse in Barding
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a barded warhorse that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds. It draws the attention of your last target.

Name: Road-Shod
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Quarry Marked
Description: Fires an iron dart that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Closing the Gap
Description: Runs down an enemy up to 8 tiles away and strikes it for 14 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Jaws Underfoot
Description: Sets iron jaws beneath the nearest enemy. They wait up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage and is [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It draws the attention of your last target.

Name: Never Lose the Scent
Description: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Unwarded Blow
Description: Strikes an enemy with cold iron, dealing 30 damage that ignores its resistances and making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Unbending Shove
Description: Thrusts forward with your whole cold weight, dealing 11 damage to every enemy in a cone 3 tiles ahead and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Spurn the Spell
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Cold to the Core
Description: Your armour rises by 12%, and you have 10% arcane resistance.

Name: Under the Gorget
Description: Slips a blade into the gap of a wounded enemy's guard, dealing 22 damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Flurry From Cover
Description: Lunges from behind your guard in a flurry of cuts, dealing 26 damage to every enemy in a cone 3 tiles ahead. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Hidden Spikes
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Opening Found
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Torpid Blow
Description: Strikes an enemy with chilled iron, dealing 12 damage, [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, [Stunned] for 1 second and [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Chilled Spittle
Description: Spits cold, metallic venom that deals 7 damage. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Shed and Regrow
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds, raises your physical resistance by 10%, and lifts 1 condition from you.

Name: Basking Hide
Description: By day, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Gnawing Filings
Description: Looses a swirl of iron filings that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Picked Clean
Description: Sends a knot of iron filings into an enemy, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Devouring Veil
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of iron filings for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each bite has a 25% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Leave Nothing
Description: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Ferrous Spark
Description: Fires a spark of magnetised iron that deals 8 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Grounding Pulse
Description: Earths the raw magic around you through cold iron, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Earth the Charge
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Grounded Casting
Description: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Word of Halting
Description: Speaks a word of iron at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Recited Bolts
Description: Looses 3 bolts of iron-grey force at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spoken Bulwark
Description: Speaks a ward of iron that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

Name: Unbroken Litany
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Ballast Blow
Description: Brings an iron ballast weight down on an enemy, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Wallowing Wash
Description: Rolls your weight through the water around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Becalmed
Description: Takes 1 second to still everything within 4 tiles, holding every creature there in place for 3 seconds and leaving them 30% slower for 3 seconds after.

Name: Outlast It
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Fanned Hand
Description: Throws 3 knives in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Closing Throw
Description: Throws a knife that deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Studied Anatomy
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Ten Thousand Cuts
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Lancet Draw
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Spent Venom
Description: Throws a knife that deals 12 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Bled Clean
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Counteragent
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Fistful of Collar
Description: Grabs the target and stabs it: deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Overarm Fling
Description: Hurls a knife overarm at a target up to 7 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Whittled Stakes
Description: Hides sharpened stakes at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage and is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Brute Leverage
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you attack 4% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 4%, and from gold you move 5% faster.

Name: Gap in the Plates
Description: Drives the blade through a join in the target's plate for 28 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Edged Lames
Description: Turns the sharpened edges of your plates through every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage and leaving each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Muffled Mail
Description: Absorbs 20 damage across up to 4 blows for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 8%. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Sharpened Rondels
Description: Conjures bladed plate: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 6%, and 12% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your dodge chance rises by 3%.

Name: Notch and Fell
Description: A falling chop on a target at or below 30% health that deals 22 damage, uses up every affliction on it and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage.

Name: Hatchet Chaser
Description: Throws a hatchet and a small blade together out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage and leaving its target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Weighted Edge
Description: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Scored for the Split
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Painless Incision
Description: A small cut that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Thrown by Ear
Description: Throws a knife up to 12 tiles that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit, and it leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Wingbeat Hush
Description: Veils you in darkness for 5 seconds. You move 33% faster, enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Banked Near Misses
Description: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Mauling Rake
Description: Rakes a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage, knocking each enemy 3 tiles back and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Driven to the Hilt
Description: Puts your full weight behind the blade for 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Bristling Embrace
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Blood on the Pelt
Description: When you land a critical hit, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Barb Left Behind
Description: A stab that deals 7 poison damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Stirred Hive
Description: Stabs at everything in reach, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Worker's Tempo
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds. A swarm escorts you for 8 seconds, stinging for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Tireless Round
Description: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, 6 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Shrike's Larder
Description: Impales the target for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Stoop From the Sun
Description: Dives you onto a target up to 8 tiles away and stabs for 14 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: High Perch
Description: Glides you 3 tiles from where you stood, and increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Gathered Speed
Description: After you cover enough ground, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Broadhead
Description: Looses a blade-headed arrow up to 12 tiles that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Make Room
Description: Slashes a cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage and knocking each enemy 3 tiles back. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: String-Flung Steel
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: At Full Draw
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Shot Bolt
Description: Throws a knife that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Razor Grille
Description: Raises a line of bladed bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to anything that crosses it, knocks it 2 tiles back and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Portcullis
Description: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leaves them [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Fish in a Barrel
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Mouser's Spring
Description: Springs you onto a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Worry the Wound
Description: Swipes a cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to each enemy in it. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

Name: Padding Close
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds. You move 22% faster, enemies notice you 75% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Second Swipe
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Upward Hook
Description: A hooking upward stab that deals 14 damage, throws the target 3 tiles back and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Skewering Charge
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and gores it for 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Behind the Cape
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds, and increases your piercing damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Worth the Wait
Description: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 35% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Tethered Cast
Description: Throws a tethered blade that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then swings on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

Name: Shared Shackle
Description: Lashes the tethered blade at a target up to 4 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Barbed Dragline
Description: Stretches a barbed line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. Each one it catches is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Link by Link
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Sleeve Dart
Description: Flicks a blade from your sleeve that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 40% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Cloak and Dagger
Description: Whips your cloak across a cone 3 tiles ahead with the blade behind it, dealing 12 damage, stunning each enemy for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Field Sutures
Description: Restores 16 health to you, 8% more for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Stitched-In Sheaths
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 6%, and your dodge chance by 4%.

Name: Branching Reach
Description: Grows a blade of coral out to a target up to 4 tiles away for 3 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

Name: Grown From Bone
Description: Grows a fan of razor branches from your arm through a cone 2.5 tiles ahead, dealing 8 damage and leaving each enemy [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Staghorn Outcrop
Description: Grows a razor-edged outcrop that stands for 12 seconds and cuts an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, each cut with a 30% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Accretion
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield worth 3% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Mudbank Lunge
Description: Lunges at a target up to 5 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit, and it leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Rolling Clamp
Description: Clamps onto the target and twists the blade: deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Still Water
Description: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 70% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Won't Let Go
Description: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Parting Flick
Description: Throws a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Break Cover
Description: Bursts out with the blade drawn, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Startle Reflex
Description: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Stung Into Motion
Description: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Hamstring Snap
Description: A low cut that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

Name: Trail's End
Description: Runs down a target up to 6 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Silent at Heel
Description: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 11%. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Other Set of Teeth
Description: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Skipped Blade
Description: Skims a knife low across the ground at a target up to 7 tiles away for 3 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Without a Ripple
Description: Throws a knife that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour and resistances, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Dive Under
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you surface 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Placid Until
Description: The moment you are back at full health, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Underfoot Edges
Description: Drives stone blades up through the ground around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each 2 tiles back and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Snapped Off Inside
Description: Stabs a target at or below 30% health for 20 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Sown Shards
Description: Hides knapped flints at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 20 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles take 14 damage and are left [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Palmed Flint
Description: Conjures a flint blade. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Line of Sight
Description: Throws a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 3 seconds.

Name: Where the Gaze Rests
Description: Stabs the target for 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Held by a Look
Description: Your stare holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leaves them [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Every Tell Noted
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a second blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Carving for the Table
Description: Carves through every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Clean the Bone
Description: Strips a target at or below 30% health for 20 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Pare the Spoiled
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Choice Cut
Description: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Too Hot to Hold
Description: A stab with a red-hot blade that deals 9 fire damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Buried Ember
Description: Throws a heated knife that deals 26 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Blade in the Coals
Description: Increases your fire damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Seared Shut
Description: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Silver Fry
Description: Flicks a shoal of 3 slim knives in a spread, each dealing 4 damage.

Name: Gill to Tail
Description: Fillets a target at or below 25% health, dealing 22 damage plus 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which this blow uses up.

Name: Gone Downstream
Description: Veils you for 5 seconds, during which you move 25% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Slips the Grip
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Across the Table
Description: Leaps up to 7 tiles onto the target and stabs it, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Pinhole Bites
Description: A quick nip with the knife-tip that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Hop and Nick
Description: You spring 3 tiles forward and gain 25% critical hit chance for 10 seconds.

Name: Restless Legs
Description: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Bladed Heel
Description: Kicks with a blade set in your heel, dealing 4 damage to everything in a short arc 2 tiles ahead. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Miles in the Arm
Description: Throws a knife up to 8 tiles that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and hits up to 1.5 times harder at maximum range. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Steady Tread
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Waylayer
Description: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Split Tine
Description: Throws a knife that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Both Ways at Once
Description: Looses 2 knives at once along diverging paths, each dealing 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Trident Parry
Description: Raises a parrying guard that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

Name: Offshoot
Description: Every time you land a critical hit, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 26% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Feinting Flick
Description: Flicks a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 15% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds.

Name: Behind the Smile
Description: A stab that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after.

Name: Stacked Deck
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Loaded Odds
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Slick Venom
Description: A quick stab with a venom-slicked knife that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Bank to Bank
Description: Springs up to 6 tiles onto the target and drives the knife in, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.3 times harder from the far end of that reach.

Name: Sudden Spring
Description: Springs 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after.

Name: Lie in Wait
Description: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Mouldering Cut
Description: A cut that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Cut Out the Rot

Name: Slow Colony

Name: Ram and Rip
Description: Butts the target and stabs it, dealing 12 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Description: Throws a knife up to 9 tiles that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.5 times harder at maximum range.

Name: Cornered Billy
Description: When your health falls low, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Description: Throws a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

Name: Rankling Wound

Name: Opening Form

Name: Motionless Focus

Name: Long Wait, Clean Cut

Name: Canopy Drop

Name: Spare-Limb Cudgel

Name: Frill and Chest

Name: Cornered Thrash

Description: A bite that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Thorned Hide

Name: Lopped and Regrown

Name: Stillness, Then the Fall

Name: Cut Loose

Name: Wall-Clinger's Dusk

Name: Torpid Maul

Name: Brumation

Name: Cold Blood, Busy Wings

Name: Branch to Branch

Name: Rising Warmth

Name: Held Draw

Name: Regrown Quiver

Name: The Door Swings Shut

Name: Belly-Low Pounce

Name: Toy with the Catch

Name: Twitching Lure

Name: Tail for a Life

Name: Bound Prey
