Description: Dives under the ground and surfaces 5 tiles ahead. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Sunned on Slate
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Blood from the Lid
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Squirts your own blood from under the lid at the first enemy within 6 tiles for 9 blood damage, with a 60% chance of [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Basilisk Regard
Description: Stares down a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 10 damage and stunning each enemy in it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Two Ways at Once
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Unblinking Second Look
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Morsel Snatch
Description: Snatches at the first enemy within 5 tiles with your tongue for 4 damage. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Swallowed Whole
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A gulp that deals 24 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding their remaining damage to the blow. You heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

Name: Burn the Tail Fat
Description: Restores 14 health to you, rising 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%. The heal has a 10% chance to crit.

Name: Fed and Warm
Description: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Spit Ember
Description: Spits an ember that deals 4 fire damage to the first enemy within 6 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 12% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: A Day's Sun Released
Description: Releases the heat stored in your scales, dealing 28 fire damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It ignores resistances.

Name: Warmed Blood
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

Name: Basking by the Blaze
Description: Each time you afflict something, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Scattered Shoal
Description: Flings 4 slick scales in a spread; each one deals 11 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Darting Silverside
Description: Spits a darting bead of water from hiding that deals 7 damage, with a 50% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds, and 40% more critical chance against a target nothing has wounded yet. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Wriggle Free
Description: Removes up to 3 control conditions on you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Through the Fingers
Description: Every time you slip a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You also regenerate 0.4 health a second.

Name: Plague Hop
Description: Leaps to a target up to 7 tiles away and bites it with venom for 13 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

Name: Nip and Spring
Description: Flicks a barbed nip that deals 4 damage and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds afterward.

Name: Ceiling Cling
Description: Springs you 3 tiles and you cling where you land: your dodge chance rises 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Hard to Squash
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times.

Name: Stalker's Mile
Description: Strikes a target you have followed, up to 7 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

Name: Pinning Heel
Description: Stamps a clawed foot down on the target and deals 5 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 20% chance to hold it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Slow-Burning Stride
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

Name: Every Step Mends
Description: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Forked Taste
Description: Flicks a forked lash of venom that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Venom Down Both Roads
Description: Sprays venom in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it, with a 60% chance of [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Taste and Return
Description: For 8 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: The Other Branch
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a dodge roll that failed is rolled again, and the second roll stands.

Name: Dazzling Frill
Description: Flares a sudden shift of colour that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. Each has a 35% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Turncoat Spit
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Spits venom that deals 9 damage, with a 40% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Colours of the Thicket
Description: You and your allies are veiled for 6 seconds, enemies notice you 60% later, and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Feigned Stillness
Description: Your dodge chance rises by 12% against enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Burst from the Reeds
Description: Springs to a target up to 6 tiles away and strikes it for 32 damage, always a critical hit, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Wet-Skin Splash
Description: Slaps the damp ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance of [Soaked] for 5 seconds. You regain 2 health.

Name: Knit on Landing
Description: Springs you 3 tiles and restores 20 stamina. Restores 6 health to whoever in your party is worst off.

Name: Coiled Haunches
Description: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Spore Puff
Description: Puffs spores from your skin, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles, and you regain 4 health.

Name: Rooting into the Weak
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Sends a thread of rot into it from up to 6 tiles away that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Moss Bed
Description: Grows a bed of moss where you lie still. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Grown Overnight
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Horned Brow
Description: Butts the target with a spiked brow that deals 14 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Ledge Collapse
Description: Kicks loose the ground you cling to; every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes a blow that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, with a 50% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Claws in the Rock
Description: Digs your claws into the ground: your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Stubborn Regrowth
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Sun-Stored Bellow
Description: Breathes fire in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Chew the Cud
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Spits a chewed wad that deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Huddle Warmth
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally in your party for 8 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Grazing
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Still-Held Shot
Description: After 1.5 seconds holding perfectly still, fires a shot that deals 38 damage and is always a critical hit.

Name: Startle Report
Description: Breaks cover with a crack of flame in a cone 3 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Hold Your Breath
Description: After 1 second of stillness, your critical hit chance rises 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Second Sighting
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Bristle Moult
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sheds a ring of bristles that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Strand-Bound Blow
Description: A strike with your weapon wound in shed strands that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Regrown Coat
Description: Absorbs the next 20 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 5%.

Name: Bristling Hide
Description: When anything but fire hurts you, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Tail Like a Maul
Description: Brings your tail down on the target with a blow that deals 34 damage, ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Ground Thump
Description: Slams the ground, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Flattened in Return
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it lasts restores 5 health.

Name: Settled Weight
Description: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and you regenerate 0.4 health a second.

Name: Gecko Clutch
Description: Clamps the target in clinging toes and strikes with your weapon in a blow that deals 12 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Never Let Go
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 20% health. Grabs it from up to 6 tiles away with a blow that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and it moves 40% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Fingers Grown Back
Description: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Clinging Hold
Description: When you strike an enemy, 10% of the damage you deal heals you for the next 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Mounted Rush
Description: Rides you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes it for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Hoof-Kicked Dust
Description: Kicks up a cone of dust 2.5 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Warm Flank
Description: Your health regeneration rises 60% for 20 seconds.

Name: Second Wind Under Sun
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Barbed Lash
Description: Lashes a barbed tongue at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Tear the Barb Free
Description: Strikes with your weapon in a blow that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each one. The torn wound leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Snag and Haul
Description: Hooks a point up to 6 tiles away and hauls you there, and you cling on with 15% more dodge chance.

Name: Lodged Barbs
Description: Every hit you land lodges a venomed barb in the target, up to 4. At 4 they all tear free at once, striking that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per barb. Unfed, a barb falls out every 4 seconds.

Name: Galloping Lash
Description: Lashes a target up to 5 tiles away with a blow that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 3% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

Name: Rearing Hooves
Description: Rears up and stamps down, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You regain 4 health.

Name: Upright Sprint
Description: Rises onto your hind legs and runs: your movement speed rises 35% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

Name: Running on the River
Description: You run across water and swamp as on solid ground.

Name: Closing Lunge
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Lunges you to it from up to 7 tiles away for a bite that deals 26 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Feeding Circle
Description: Strikes every enemy within 3.5 tiles for a blow that deals 26 damage and leaves them [Marked] for 10 seconds. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Watching from Afar
Description: After 1 second of stillness, your attacks and spells reach 30% further for 15 seconds.

Name: Waiting Out the Bite
Description: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health.

Name: Numbing Bite
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Strikes with your weapon for a chilling blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It also leaves the target [Frostbitten] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Chill Shove
Description: Shoves out with your cold bulk, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Torpor Shell
Description: You go still and cold: for 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Winter-Proof Hide
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% frost resistance.

Name: Quick Nick
Description: A quick strike with your weapon that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Thrown from Cover
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Throws a hidden blade that deals 24 damage, with 50% more critical chance against a target nothing has wounded yet.

Name: Blend In
Description: You are veiled for 8 seconds, enemies notice you 70% later, and you move 10% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Back to Stillness
Description: When you kill an enemy, your next strike has 20% more critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Blood from the Eyes
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Squirts blood from your eyes in a cone 3 tiles long that deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance of [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Venom Jaw
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Bites it for 25 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: New Tail by Dusk
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: High Noon Rock
Description: In daylight, your damage rises by 10%.

Name: Strip the Afflicted
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on a target and uses it up. Every enemy within 3 tiles takes a blow that deals 7 damage, and you regain 2 health.

Name: Swarm-Borne Venom
Description: Spits a glob of venom that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Called Cloud
Description: Calls a cloud of locusts for you to feed on for 12 seconds; it strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill you make restores 4 health.

Name: Gorged
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Prismatic Ray
Description: Fires a ray at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and ignores resistances.

Name: Shifting Mote
Description: A quick arcane strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance of [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Sun on the Mana
Description: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Leaking Sparks
Description: When you spend mana, a bolt of raw arcana strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 9 damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Long-Held Incantation
Description: After 2 seconds held motionless, looses a bolt that deals 30 damage and bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Correcting Word
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Speaks a word at it from up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance of [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Rehearse Again
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and your dodge chance rises 10%.

Name: Waited-For Word
Description: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Slow Tail Wash
Description: Sweeps your tail through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Lazy Nudge
Description: Sends a slow bubble that deals 4 damage, heals you for 15% of the damage dealt, and has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Drift and Mend
Description: Healing you receive rises 40% for 15 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Pulse
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1.

Name: Rehearsed Descent
Description: Sends a flight of locusts into the first enemy it meets for 6 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 100% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Flawless Stripping
Description: The swarm strips every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Schooled Cloud
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds. For 10 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Counted Bites
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Bitter Meal
Description: Sends locusts into the first enemy they meet for 9 poison damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions; the locusts eat one of them.

Name: Decanted Plague
Description: Pours a cone of locusts 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 poison damage to everything in it and leaving them [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Venom Gleaners
Description: The swarm eats up to 3 poison conditions off you, and you regain 12 health.

Name: Seasoned Carriers
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Chitin Haymaker
Description: A punch that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The locusts on your fist then leap to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

Name: Flung Handful
Description: Flings 3 fistfuls of locusts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Chest-Beating Drone
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every second.

Name: Provoked Troop
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.

Name: Rivet Gnaw
Description: A bite at the joints that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Under the Plates
Description: Sends locusts crawling through a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. It ignores armour.

Name: Interlocked Husks
Description: Locks shed husks into a shell that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. For 6 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 1.6 seconds.

Name: Salvaged Scale
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (17% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Cleaving Maw
Description: A chop that deals 18 damage and eats every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one eaten. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Windrow Sweep
Description: Sweeps edged wings in a full circle, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Hooked Wing-Edges
Description: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

Name: Mown Rows
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Stridulant Shriek
Description: A shriek through a cone 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Thirst at Dusk
Description: Sends part of the swarm into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Roosting Pall
Description: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Sated on the Wing
Description: Each time you kill something, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Maul of Many Mouths
Description: A wide maul that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Swarmweight Slam
Description: Drops the weight of the swarm on one target, dealing 15 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. 25% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Glutted Bulk
Description: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 20 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

Name: Autumn Gorge
Description: Whenever you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Barbed Sacrifice
Description: A weapon strike that deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Stinging Front
Description: Both swarms break outward, dealing 10 poison damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Second Swarm
Description: Calls a second swarm that fights for 15 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Nectar from the Fallen
Description: When you kill an enemy, you restore 12 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Long Migration
Description: Sends a flight of locusts at a target up to 8 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach.

Name: Thermal Stoop
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then the swarm lands with you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Scatter and Regather
Description: Steps you instantly to a spot up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Fed in Passing
Description: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Sky-Blotting Flight
Description: Looses 5 flights of locusts at once, spread apart, out to 8 tiles, each dealing 9 damage. They ignore armour, and 15% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

Name: Breeding Quiver
Description: Shoots a locust at a target up to 7 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Closer Horizon
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Splitting Shaft
Description: When you land a critical hit, a bolt flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 9 lightning damage, then leaps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Closing Swarm
Description: Sends a swarm that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Penned Pickings
Description: The swarm deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 12% for each affliction already on the target (max 48%).

Name: Living Bars
Description: Raises a line of locked locusts 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Feeding Time
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Hopper's Pounce
Description: Springs you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Nape Bite
Description: A killing bite on an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 18 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Springing Legs
Description: A leap that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: One Always Escapes
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Trampling Drove
Description: The drove deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 40%).

Name: Cud and Crop
Description: Sends grazing locusts into the first enemy they meet for 4 damage. 30% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Common Grazing
Description: Lays out a pasture within 4 tiles of where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Placid Appetite
Description: Your maximum health rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Unbroken Line
Description: Sends a string of locusts through the first enemy it meets for 28 damage, then on to 4 more enemies within 4 tiles for 80% of that each. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Shackle Nip
Description: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Knotted Tether
Description: Strings a line of linked locusts 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Next Link Feeds
Description: Each time you kill something, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Last Thread
Description: Strikes an enemy at or below 25% health from up to 6 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

Name: Fraying Strands
Description: Looses 4 strands of locusts at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Drapery of Wings
Description: For 9 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

Name: Moulted Lining
Description: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Encrusting Graft
Description: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Calved Colony
Description: Breaks off part of your own colony into a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 9 water damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave them [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Brood Reef
Description: Plants a reef that stands for 15 seconds and sends locusts at an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Slow Accretion

Description: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Weir Snap
Description: Shuts a weir on a target up to 5 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Shut Sluice
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: it deals 20 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up.

Name: Stillwater Pen
Description: Sets a pen of still water 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 25% for 3 seconds.

Name: Warden's Due
Description: Each time you afflict something, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Pounce From Below
Description: Surfaces under a target up to 6 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It always strikes critically and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Fathom Purr
Description: A deep purr deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. You regain 8 health.

Name: Afternoon Doze
Description: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds, and you regain 8 health at once.

Name: Eight Lives Left
Description: Once your health falls below 25%, you regain 5 health a second for 8 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Stampede
Description: Tramples forward in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage and leaving everything in it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Lowered Brow
Description: A headbutt that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

Name: Ruminant Hours
Description: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

Name: Grazer's Constitution
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health regenerates 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.

Name: Mooring Links
Description: Casts a length of links that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Anchor Cast
Description: Heaves an anchor at a target up to 7 tiles away for 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it moving 25% slower for 4 seconds.

Name: Tow Line
Description: Ties a line to the ally who needs it most, restoring 3 health a second to them for 8 seconds.

Name: Slack Taken Up
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Wringing Twist
Description: Wrings the target out for 9 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Sodden Shroud
Description: Throws a soaked sheet over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage, stunning everything under it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Wet Compress
Description: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Padded Swaddling
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Snapped Staghorn
Description: Breaks a branch of reef off your own back and hurls it at a target up to 5 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Breaker on the Reef
Description: Breaks a wave over the reef on your back, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It always strikes critically and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Sheltering Shoal
Description: Grows a reef where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Polyp by Polyp
Description: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Drowning Roll
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Clamps on and rolls it under for 24 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: The Wait Ends
Description: Lunges you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then bites for 13 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Floating Log
Description: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 65% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Basking Whole
Description: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Fording Bound
Description: Bounds you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then lands in a splash that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Shed and Regrown
Description: Sheds a tine and casts it for 9 damage. Also costs 4% of your maximum health. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Bolt to Cover
Description: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, and restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Winded, Then Still
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Fetched Driftwood
Description: Throws a length of driftwood at a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill fetches one back.

Name: Herding Circle
Description: Circles the enemies around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Guarded Flank
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. An escort of hounds fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Shore Hound
Description: A bonded hound keeps to your side, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds, and each kill it makes restores 3 health to you.

Name: Shaken Droplets
Description: Shakes the water off your back at a target for 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Upended Wash
Description: Tips your bulk forward and throws a wash over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, knocking everything in it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

Name: Off the Oiled Back
Description: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to its source instead, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Raft at Rest
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While on it, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 6%.

Name: Clouded Shallows
Description: Kicks up the bottom mud in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Silt Burial
Description: Drops a mass of riverbed silt on the first enemy it meets for 30 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Mud Wallow
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

Name: Riverbed Ballast
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Placid Regard
Description: A level look across a cone 4 tiles long deals 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

Name: Level Stare
Description: Fixes a target up to 8 tiles away for 26 damage that ignores armour, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and leaves it moving 30% slower for 5 seconds.

Name: Glassed Over
Description: After a 1.5-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Clear Water Sight
Description: Your water damage cannot be resisted, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Browsing Mouthfuls
Description: Tears 3 mouthfuls from the enemies ahead at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds.

Name: Last Course
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Swallows it for 22 damage and heals you for 40% of the damage dealt.

Name: Seagrass Banquet
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

Name: Fattened by Degrees
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Kettle Spout
Description: Spits boiling water that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Steam Vent
Description: Vents steam in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving everything in it [Burning] for 6 seconds.

Name: Warm Spring
Description: Opens a warm spring where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 4 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

Name: Banked Coals
Description: Each time you afflict something, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Silver Followers
Description: Looses 3 silver darts that drift slowly outward, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Shoal Wheels Round
Description: Sends a packed shoal into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage and leaving it [Slowed] for 6 seconds. On a hit, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Sheltering Belly
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. For 6 seconds, the shoal sheltering under you darts out beside you, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Slick Among Many
Description: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Leap and Settle
Description: You spring up to 7 tiles onto the target and settle on it, dealing 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Skipping Nips
Description: Flicks a biting speck that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Unlikely Bound
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and you regain 12 health as you land.

Name: Hop Between Rests
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Trudging Stamp
Description: A stamp that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Journey's Weight
Description: Brings the weight of the road down around you: every enemy within 3.5 tiles is dealt 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and is left [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

Name: Walking It Off
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds.

Name: Paced Miles
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Parting Current
Description: Looses 2 jets of water that split apart, each dealing 7 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Twin Tines
Description: Strikes twice with both points, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 10 seconds.

Name: Halved Burden
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

Name: The Other Path
Description: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Sailor's Mermaid
Description: Lures up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

Name: Lazy Ambush
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a strike from where you lay still that deals 20 damage plus 1.5 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up.

Name: Sunken Pretence
Description: Veils you for 8 seconds and you regain 10 health at once. You move 10% faster while veiled, enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Shrugged Back
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

Name: Long-Held Lunge
Description: A sudden lunge out of stillness that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 7 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target [Soaked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Sudden Surfacing
Description: Bursts up from the water, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. You regain 10 health.

Name: Sitting Damp
Description: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Coiled Calm
Description: When your stamina is full, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Shed Spores
Description: Breathes out spores grown from your own body at the cost of 4% of your maximum health, dealing 7 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long with a 40% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 10 seconds.

Name: Overnight Fruiting
Description: Lobs a slow, swollen cap that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 10 seconds.

Name: Mycelium Mat
Description: Spreads a mat of growth where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Larger Each Morning
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Ramming Nudge
Description: A head-down ram that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

Name: Stamping Ground
Description: Stamps in place, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Won't Budge
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Dug-In Heels
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.

Name: Shared Pasture
Description: Spits a mouthful of cud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

Name: Barn-Warm Lowing
Description: Lows a warm cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Damped] for 8 seconds. On a hit, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Huddle Close
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Long Winter Barn
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Slow-Loaded Report
Description: Takes 1.5 seconds to load, then fires a shot that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour.

Name: Scattered Pellets
Description: Fires a spray of waterlogged pellets in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Settled Aim
Description: Takes 1.5 seconds of stillness; then, for 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Long Between Shots
Description: After a long run without a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Snarl of Strands
Description: Lashes strands around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 10% armour for 6 seconds, slowing each by 25% and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Raking Comb
Description: A raking strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Whisker Sense
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Woven Mantle
Description: Conjures a mantle of fine strands: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.

Name: Flattened Swell
Description: Slaps the water flat around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Paddle Comes Down
Description: A crushing blow that deals 34 damage that ignores armour, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and leaves it [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Tempered Hide
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Anvil Calm
Description: When you land a critical hit, you gain a shield of 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Gentle Grip
Description: A grasping strike with your nails that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Firm Hold
Description: Seizes one enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 9 damage, stunning it for 1 second and taking its next action away for 3 seconds.

Name: Laid-On Palm
Description: Restores 4 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

Name: Mender's Ring
Description: Conjures a smooth ring: your maximum health rises by 10, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 4 health.

Name: Flung Clod
Description: Kicks back a clod that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Trampling Circuit
Description: Tramples a slow circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Long Ride Home
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 25 seconds.

Name: Hoofsore Rest
Description: When your stamina runs out, you gain a shield of 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Snagged Line
Description: Casts a snagging line to a point ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Each enemy it catches is dealt 10 damage and stunned for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Barbed Reel
Description: Casts a barbed hook that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, adding 50% more damage for each.

Name: Working the Barb Free
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you regain 10 health.

Name: Line Stays Taut
Description: When you inflict a condition, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Hoofbeat Surge
Description: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and strike it for 15 damage, up to 1.4 times as much from your full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

Name: Stampede of Spray
Description: Thunders a wave forward in a cone 6 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to everything in it and leaving each [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Steady Canter
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 6 seconds after you use it.

Name: Heart Keeps Time
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%. It also regenerates 0.4 health a second, permanently.

Name: Spotted Quarry
Description: A thrown strike that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Kill
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a strike that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Still in the Reeds
Description: Takes 1 second of stillness, then increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Trailing Scent
Description: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Cold Sounding Weight
Description: Drops a cold, sinking weight on the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1 second.

Name: Sinking Hull
Description: Drops your full weight, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

Name: Unbending Keel
Description: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Grey Hull
Description: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.3 health a second, permanently.

Name: Tucked Blade
Description: Flicks a hidden blade that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Propeller Scar
Description: A hidden cut that deals 28 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 12 seconds.

Name: Old Scars Close
Description: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Edge Under the Hide
Description: Conjures a hidden blade. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Sluggish Flick
Description: Flicks a slow globule that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Sun-Warmed Lash
Description: A tail lash that deals 14 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at its full reach of 5 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Basking Stone
Description: Increases the healing you receive by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Sunlit Shallows
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Stripping the Meadow
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health; every enemy within 2.5 tiles is dealt 6 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Swarming Graze
Description: Sends a buzzing cloud into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Endless Cloud
Description: Sends out a swarm for 20 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

Name: Gorging Season
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 15 seconds.

Name: Drifting Mote
Description: Releases a slow mote of arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Tide of Arcana
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles is dealt 28 damage that ignores resistances and left [Stalled] for 8 seconds.

Name: Slow-Spun Ward
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Pooled Arcana
Description: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Measured Litany
Description: Takes 1.5 seconds to recite, then looses 4 words of power at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage that ignores resistances.

Name: Spoken Correction
Description: Speaks a correcting word that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Recited Again
Description: Takes 1.5 seconds to recite, then clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Measured Breath
Description: When you spend mana, you regain 2 mana a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Rollover
Description: Rolls your whole body over, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Soaked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Long-Delayed Nudge
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: sends a slow, heavy swell that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets.

Name: Nothing Is Urgent
Description: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Mending Tide
Description: When you regain health, the healing you receive rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Drilled Sleight
Description: A rehearsed grab that deals 7 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Flawless Routine
Description: Tumbles you through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Seen Once
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Ten Thousand Repetitions
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Parasite Pluck
Description: Picks every one of your afflictions off the target at once, dealing 16 damage plus their remaining damage, with 60% more damage for each affliction picked off. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Bitter Smear
Description: A quick weapon strike smeared with drawn venom that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

Name: Nit-Picking
Description: Picks up to 3 conditions off you and off every ally near you, and you regain 10 health.

Name: Flicked Back
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be picked off and sent back to whoever inflicted it.

Name: Knuckle Vault
Description: Vaults you on your knuckles to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Drumming Fists
Description: Pounds the ground, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 40% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Showing Off
Description: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 10 seconds after using it.

Name: Backed Against the Trunk
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Unbuckle
Description: Undoes a strap on the target, dealing 8 damage and stripping 15% of its armour for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Seam Slip
Description: A weapon strike slipped between the target's plates for 30 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Borrowed Plates
Description: Straps on pilfered plates: a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. You move 12% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Layer by Layer
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Limb Drop
Description: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away with a weapon strike that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit. The target is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Juggled Hatchets
Description: Tosses 3 hatchets out of a juggle at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

Name: Hand-Over-Hand Chops
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Lucky Break
Description: Each time you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Howler's Pitch
Description: Looses a shriek 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Dusk Pilfer
Description: A quick rake in the dark that deals 4 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Flit to the Rafters
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Roost Instinct
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Clinging Maul
Description: Clamps onto a target's back and mauls it with a weapon strike for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Bough-Breaker
Description: Leaps and lands with your full weight, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Thick Pelt, Light Step
Description: Raises your armour by 18% for 12 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Prodded Too Often
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Raid the Comb
Description: Sends the swarm into the first enemy it meets for 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds.

Name: Shaken Hive
Description: Shakes a swarm loose in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Swarm in Tow
Description: Turns the swarm chasing you onto your enemies for 12 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill restores 4 health to you.

Name: Busy Fingers
Description: Each time you strike, you restore 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Swooping Snatch
Description: A snatch made on the wing that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Stoop from the Canopy
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. You dive up to 7 tiles onto it for 22 damage and leave it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Glide Hop
Description: A gliding hop that carries you 4 tiles forward. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

Name: Featherweight
Description: You move 12% faster at all times.

Name: Lifted Arrow
Description: Fires an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 25% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet. It holds 4 charges, and each kill hands one back.

Name: Branch Volley
Description: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: High Perch
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Snap Shot
Description: Every few paces you cover, your critical chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Reach Through
Description: Reaches between the bars to rake a target for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Slammed Gate
Description: Slams bars shut around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Picked Lock
Description: Frees you from up to 3 conditions that hold or stun you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Slips Any Latch
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You also have 6% more dodge chance.

Name: Rooftop Pounce
Description: Pounces on a target up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range. It is always a critical hit, and the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Batting Paws
Description: Bats at everything in reach with both hands, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Always Lands
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 6 seconds, and you finish 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Soft-Footed Luck
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that got past your dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Spooked Stampede
Description: Stampedes through everything around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. You ride it out, moving 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: Gathering Charge
Description: Gores a target for 30 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Rally the Troop
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Unhurried Grazer
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 4% faster, from silver your stamina comes back 12% faster, and from gold you have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Linked Arms
Description: Whips a length of links into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that each. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Swing In
Description: Swings you on the links to a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Hold Still
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, and you finish 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Short Leash
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.

Name: Pulled Thread
Description: A yank that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Exposed] and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and spreads your afflictions on it to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Over the Head
Description: Flings a cloth over a target up to 4 tiles away for 3 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drape and Vanish
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Deep Pockets
Description: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 mana. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Prised Open
Description: Pries a target open for 28 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Description: Scrambles over the cutting edge, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Lay No Hand
Description: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

Name: Gleaner's Edge
Description: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Dragged Under

Name: Springboard

Name: Lookout's Bark

Name: Gone at the Snap
Description: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

Name: Pricked Ears
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 6% more dodge chance.

Name: Groom and Lick

Name: Unruffled
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 12 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Ember Line

Name: Stolen Warmth
Description: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Pinball Bounce

Name: Across the Table
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Fresh Host
Description: Each time you cover enough ground, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Stride-End Swipe
Description: Grabs at an enemy with your foot at the end of a stride, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have travelled (max +25%).

Name: Run Them Ragged
Description: Covers up to 6 tiles to the target and lands 3 quick kicks, dealing 11 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Fatigued] for 6 seconds.

Name: Shorter Road
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 5 seconds after using it.

Name: Cobble Dancer

Name: Forked Feint

Name: Split Jab
Description: Flicks a jab at the first enemy in line up to 7 tiles away, dealing 4 damage. It then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Took the Other Path
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 8 seconds. While it lasts, a second you peels off the other way and fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 10 seconds.

Name: Second Roll
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Lifted Its Trick
Description: Darts to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, deals 10 damage and silences it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

Name: Flipped Coin

Name: Nobody Saw a Thing

Name: Skimmed Off the Top

Name: Belly-Flop Landing

Name: Lily Pad Hop
Description: Springs you 5 tiles forward, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Coiled Spring

Name: Shaken Spores
Description: Shakes spores from your fur over a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 25% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Smeared Palm
Description: Smears spores into the target with an open palm, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Lichen Grooming
Description: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

Name: Feeding Mycelium
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, your attacks heal you for 10% of the damage they deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Clamber and Stamp
Description: Clambers up the target and drives both heels down for 14 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Summit Drop
Description: Drops from above onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times that from full range.

Name: Footing Found
Description: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

Name: Butting Back
Description: Each time something other than fire hurts you, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Herd Pile-On
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: deals 22 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max +32%).

Name: Warmth Thief
Description: Swats every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Herd Grooming
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Fighting beside others pays: +10% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.

Name: Fed and Rested
Description: Each time you are healed, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 4 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Quick on the Draw
Description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Spare Pistol

Name: Snarled Strands

Name: Shed in Their Eyes

Name: Combed Out
Description: Combs up to 3 conditions off you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Tangled Marks
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Nutcracker Blow
Description: Cracks the target with a held stone for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

Name: Two-Fisted Pounding
Description: Pounds the ground with both fists, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Find the Soft Spot
Description: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

Name: Knows Where It Cracks

Name: Pried Loose

Name: Wring Out

Name: Slipped the Grip

Name: Never Winded
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds after using it.

Name: Faithful Mount
Description: Calls a bonded heidel that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. Each kill returns 3 health.

Name: Barbed Line

Name: Barbed Pickings
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: tears at it for 8 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Swing on the Line
Description: Swings you 6 tiles forward on a hooked line, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Pilfering Barbs
Description: Each time you strike, you snag back 3 mana. Once every 2 seconds.

Name: Gallop-By Grab

Name: Hoofbeat Heart

Name: Pounce Prepared
Description: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Scent of Weakness
Description: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Pick at the Rivets

Name: Flurry of Nicks

Name: Up the Sleeve
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Waits for an Opening
Description: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Still, Then Sudden
Description: Rakes the target for 30 damage that is always a critical hit and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Tail-Whip Spin
Description: Whips your tail round, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Dropped Tail
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 8 seconds, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Sun on the Scales
Description: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: deals 20 damage plus 1.8 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up.

Name: Stronger Than It Looks
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you have 5% more dodge chance, and from gold you attack 8% faster.

Name: Gap in the Plates
Description: A bite through a gap in the target's plates that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Hollow Suit

Name: Widening Kerf

Name: Winter Curl
Description: Veils you for 9 seconds and restores 14 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.
