Name: Gnawed Puncture
Description: Bores into an afflicted target, dealing 8 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Grain Thieves
Description: Releases a swarm that stays for 10 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. It draws the attention of the enemy you last struck.

Name: Picked to the Bone
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Arcane Sliver
Description: Fires a sliver of force that deals 4 damage, with a 15% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Hairline Breach
Description: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 30 damage that ignores resistance, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Thin Draught
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Stray Spark
Description: Each time you spend mana, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 lightning damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Final Syllable
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Inscribes the last mark on it, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Cursed] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Spelled in Threes
Description: Looses 3 inscribed points in a spread, each dealing 6 damage. Holds up to 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Called Cadence
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds.

Name: Rehearsed Phrase
Description: Every ability you cast builds a stack on you, up to 5. Your next ability spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 7 seconds.

Name: Slow Seep
Description: A slow prick that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Drifting Mine
Description: Sends a point drifting slowly forward that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Calming Points
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Slow Tide In
Description: When your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Rehearsed Throw
Description: Throws a conjured mesh that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Tangle Tally
Description: Hauls a conjured mesh through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave them [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

Name: Drilled Reach
Description: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

Name: Tied by Habit
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 4 mana. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Bitter Draw
Description: Throws a fine mesh that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Shaken Dregs
Description: Shakes the strained dregs out of the mesh across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 50% chance per hit to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Strain the Blood
Description: Draws a mesh through your blood that strains up to 3 poison conditions out of you and restores 10 health.

Name: Gift Returned
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be caught in the mesh and sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Rigging Swing
Description: Casts a line to a target up to 6 tiles away and swings you to it, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Gunnysack Slam
Description: Bags the target in a conjured mesh and swings it into the ground for 32 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Cargo Climb
Description: Throws a mesh onto a hold up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it hand over hand, instantly, with +10% dodge chance.

Name: Knuckled Down
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you pull a mesh tight around yourself: a ward soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Plate Snag
Description: Hooks a steel-ringed mesh into the target's guard and wrenches, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Pauldron Swing
Description: Swings a mesh of steel rings through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and throwing it back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave it [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Ring-Mail Drape
Description: Drapes a conjured mesh of steel rings over you that absorbs the next 22 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

Name: Hauberk of Knots
Description: Conjures a hauberk of knotted steel mesh: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Cut from the Mesh
Description: A falling chop on a held target that deals 18 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

Name: Bladed Hem
Description: Whirls a mesh hemmed with edges around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Coat of Edges
Description: Wraps you in a mesh sewn with edges. For 9 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Keen Moment
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Roost Drop
Description: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaving it [Pinned] under a mesh for 2 seconds.

Name: Echo off the Walls
Description: Sends a high pulse through a mesh that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance per hit to leave them [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Canopy of Dusk
Description: Draws a mesh of darkness over you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 10% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

Name: Flit and Fling
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a strand builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a weighted mesh strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per strand (109% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Cornered Rake
Description: Rakes a mesh through a cone 3 tiles long at the cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 8 damage to everything caught in it. Its damage rises 10% for every 10% of your health you are missing (max 50%).

Name: Ribcracker
Description: Wraps the target in a conjured mesh and squeezes, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Shoulder In
Description: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds, and draws up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Fat of the Run
Description: Every kill hangs a catch on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per catch (25% at full). Unfed, a catch fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Bagged Swarm
Description: Throws a mesh bag of stinging workers that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each one hit is [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Honeyed Cords
Description: A lash of honey-smeared cords that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. It leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Dripping Comb
Description: Hangs a lattice of honeycomb where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Tethered Hive
Description: A bonded swarm travels with you in a mesh skep, stinging enemies within 4 tiles for 2 damage every second. Each sting leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

Name: Fowler's Lob
Description: A gliding throw that deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Flush the Covey
Description: Snaps a mesh open around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing them back 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Updraft
Description: Throws a mesh up into the wind and rides it forward, carrying you 5 tiles at once.

Name: Momentum of the Glide
Description: Every few paces you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Full-Draw Bolas
Description: After a 1 second draw, looses a weighted mesh that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Three on a String
Description: Looses 3 shafts on cords at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and each kill hauls one back.

Name: Tripline Shot
Description: Strings a drawn shaft to a tripline where you stand for 12 seconds. It shoots an enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds, each shot with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Shooting the Snared
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Slammed Shut
Description: Slams a barred mesh shut on the target, dealing 14 damage, leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Bar by Bar
Description: Drops a barred mesh around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: The Door Drops
Description: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 3 seconds. When it lets go, they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Gapless Weave
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Velvet Flick
Description: Throws a mesh that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Toy with the Catch
Description: A raking swipe at a tangled target that deals 9 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Ropewalker
Description: Runs you along a conjured cord: you finish 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

Name: Caught Mid-Fall
Description: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is caught instead and leaves you at 1 health.

Name: Roped and Thrown
Description: Throws a loop of cord that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and throws it down, leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Ox-Drawn Trawl
Description: Drags a wide mesh forward through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything caught in it plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Herd Them In
Description: Ropes up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you, holding their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Taut Coils
Description: Every time you land a hit, a coil of rope winds onto that enemy, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: the rope snaps taut and strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per coil (163% at full). Unfed, a coil fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Link to Link
Description: Throws a mesh of links that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Shared Shackles
Description: Loops a linked mesh over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and leaving each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Purse Line
Description: Lays a drawstring loop 4 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it.

Name: Cracked Lash
Description: When you land a critical hit, a length of linked cord lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Winding Sheet
Description: Winds a close weave around a target at or below 30% health, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Smothering Fold
Description: Throws a drape of close weave across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Gauze Wrap
Description: Binds your wounds in an open-weave gauze: you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Warp and Weft
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a row of weave builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per row (35% at full). Unfed, a row fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Branching Snare
Description: Throws a mesh crusted with sharp growth that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Atoll Rising
Description: Your mesh hardens into a ring of branching reef around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Crusted Over
Description: Grows a crust of reef over the mesh you wear, raising your armour by 25% for 11 seconds.

Name: Living Lattice
Description: The mesh you wear grows into living reef: your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Clamp and Roll
Description: Clamps the target and rolls, winding a conjured mesh around it and dealing 30 damage, always as a critical hit. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Drag It Under
Description: Hauls in a target at or below 30% health from up to 5 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 40% for 3 seconds.

Name: The Waiting Jaw
Description: Sets a jawed snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 60 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 24 damage and is left [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Slack, Then Teeth
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Cast on the Run
Description: Throws a trailing snare that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Tine Toss
Description: Catches the target on a rack of tines strung with mesh and tosses it back 3 tiles, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Freeze and Bolt
Description: Startles every creature within 3 tiles into a snare that holds it in place for 2 seconds, while you bound 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Startled Spring
Description: When you are hurt by anything but fire, a snare springs on the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Run It Down
Description: Runs you to a target up to 7 tiles away and drags it down in a mesh, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Hold at Bay
Description: Locks onto a target at or below 30% health and holds it in the mesh, dealing 20 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Fetched Back
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: At Heel
Description: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second and slowing each one it bites by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Dunking Stool
Description: Dunks the target in a conjured mesh, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds, [Soaked] for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Skipping Sinkers
Description: Skips 3 mesh weights across the ground at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave its target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Runs Through the Mesh
Description: Lets up to 5 conditions run out of you through the mesh and restores 8 health.

Name: Buoyed Step
Description: A line of floats holds you up: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, and from silver your dodge chance on it rises by 8%.

Name: Rockfall Seine
Description: Drops a mesh weighted with jagged stone on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Slingstone
Description: Slings a jagged stone from a mesh pouch, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Gabion Wall
Description: Raises a wall of rubble packed in mesh, 5 tiles long, for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Heaped Cairn
Description: Every time you take damage, a stone drops into the mesh around you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stone (28% at full). Unfed, a stone fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.

Name: Threaded Glance
Description: A weighted cord threaded through a gap in the target's guard that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds, with a 45% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Seeker's Mesh
Description: Throws a mesh around you in which every knot finds a weak spot, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves its target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Watching Knot
Description: Sets down a knot of mesh with a lidless gaze for 12 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second, each strike with a 35% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Sharper Each Blink
Description: Every time you land a critical hit, a watching knot opens on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per knot (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a knot fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Full Creel
Description: Throws a hand mesh that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Crew's Share
Description: Hauls a full mesh in around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Haul to the Table
Description: Drags every body within 9 tiles to you in a mesh, up to 5. Each one heals you for 7% of your health.

Name: Larder at the Belt
Description: Conjures a mesh larder at your belt: each kill restores 5 health, your maximum health rises by 15, your critical chance rises by 4%, and your critical hits deal 10% more damage.

Name: Running Flame
Description: Throws a burning mesh that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. The flame runs along the cords: your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Held in the Blaze
Description: Drops a burning mesh on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 fire damage that ignores resistance, leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Burning Weir
Description: Stretches a burning mesh 5 tiles long across the ground for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Smouldering Bolas
Description: Conjures a weighted cord that smoulders in your hand: your weapon damage rises by 12%, your strikes land 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.

Name: Seine the Shallows
Description: Drags a conjured seine through a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Darting Mesh
Description: Flicks a small mesh that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then slips on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Haul the Shoal
Description: Hauls up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles onto you in one sweep of your mesh and holds their attention for 4 seconds.

Name: Wriggle Room
Description: Your dodge chance rises by 12% against enemies carrying one of your conditions.

Name: Pounce and Pin
Description: You spring up to 6 tiles onto the target and pin it under your mesh, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Snap and Hop
Description: Snaps a mesh shut around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Tangled Landing
Description: You leap 4 tiles and land with a mesh flung out around you: every creature within 3 tiles is held in place for 2 seconds.

Name: Next Host Over
Description: When you kill an enemy, your mesh leaps off the body to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Trailing Cast
Description: Casts the mesh you drag behind you, dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have walked, up to 30%.

Name: Stamp Out
Description: Stamps down on an enemy at or below 25% health and treads your mesh into it, dealing 22 damage and using up every affliction on it to add their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Ankle Loop
Description: Lays a loop of mesh at the nearest enemy's feet. It waits up to 45 seconds, and the first enemy to step within 2 tiles takes 16 damage and is [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Coiled on the March
Description: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you coil up the mesh you drag behind you and regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Parting Throw
Description: Throws your mesh so it splits in two, the halves flying apart; each deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Prong Through the Knot
Description: Drives a two-tined gaff through your mesh and into the target, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Back Along the Cords
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to branch back along your mesh to whoever laid it instead.

Name: Branching Strand
Description: When you inflict a condition, your mesh forks off a second strand that hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Tangle the Pack
Description: Flings a mesh around you that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to turn each against its own side for 3 seconds.

Name: Empty the Snare
Description: Flicks a light mesh that robs the first enemy it meets of everything you have caught on it, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction you have on that target for 60% more damage each.

Name: Hunter's Blind
Description: Throws a screen of mesh over you and your allies, veiling you all for 6 seconds and making you 10% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: No Clean Escape
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Sticky Lash
Description: Lashes out a sticky line of mesh up to 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and slowing the target by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Plunge from the Reeds
Description: You spring up and come down in a dripping mesh, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Lily-Pad Snarl
Description: Lays a sticky mesh 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward; anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Toad in the Rigging
Description: Calls a bonded toad that rides your mesh and lashes enemies within 5 tiles with its tongue, striking for 4 damage and slowing them by 15% for 2 seconds.

Name: Threaded Rot
Description: A weapon strike that threads spores into the wound, dealing 10 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread through your mesh to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Fruiting Body
Description: Spores burst along your mesh, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Diseased] for 10 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Mat
Description: Spreads a mat of living threads where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Seeded Threads
Description: Every hit you land plants a spore in your mesh on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all burst at once, striking that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per spore (170% at full). Unfed, a spore fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Staked and Butted
Description: Hooks the target on a mesh line staked at your feet and butts it, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Scree Drag
Description: Sweeps a weighted mesh along the ground in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Dig In
Description: You anchor yourself with your mesh: you take 20% less damage for 10 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn to attack you for 5 seconds.

Name: Knots Pulled Tight
Description: Every time you take damage, your mesh pulls a knot tighter around you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per knot (56% at full). Unfed, a knot loosens every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Corral the Stray
Description: Throws a heavy mesh over a straggler, dealing 30 damage to the first enemy it meets; when it lands, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Round Up
Description: Sweeps your mesh around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

Name: Under One Blanket
Description: Draws your allies in under a warm mesh: you and every ally within 4 tiles regain 14 health, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Woven Halter
Description: Conjures a woven halter of mesh: your critical chance rises by 3%, your critical hits deal 10% more, each kill returns 3 health and your maximum health rises by 12. Its effect increases by 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Bursting Charge
Description: Fires a packed charge that bursts open into a mesh on the first enemy it meets, dealing 34 damage and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Tethered Round
Description: Fires a round at a target already caught in one of your afflictions, using that affliction up, and deals 8 damage, up to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles.

Name: Launcher on a Tripod
Description: Sets up a conjured launcher for 15 seconds that fires mesh shot at enemies within 6 tiles, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Sighted on the Snared
Description: When you inflict a condition, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Loose Strands
Description: Flicks a mesh of hair apart into 4 strands in a spread, each dealing 3 damage, with a 15% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Garrotte of Tresses
Description: Whips a braided cord of hair from your mesh around an enemy at or below 25% health up to 4 tiles away, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach.

Name: Cocoon of Braids
Description: Wraps you in a cocoon of woven hair that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Strand by Strand
Description: Every hit you land weaves a strand of hair onto you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per strand (60% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a strand falls away every 6 seconds.

Name: Pound the Weights
Description: Slams the weighted edge of your mesh down all around you, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Flatten the Caught
Description: Hammers a target carrying one of your afflictions, using that affliction up, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Driven Stakes
Description: Hammers a row of stakes strung with mesh into the ground ahead of you, a wall 5 tiles long that blocks the way for 8 seconds.

Name: Struck While Held
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying one of your conditions.

Name: Closing Fist
Description: Throws a mesh at an enemy at or below 30% health that clenches shut on it, dealing 26 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Grasping Sweep
Description: Sweeps a grasping mesh through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

Name: Many Knotted Fingers
Description: Calls up a pair of hands knotted from your mesh for 12 seconds; they grab at enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Reeled Back In
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, you gather your mesh back in and regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Ride Them Down
Description: You charge up to 7 tiles to the target and trample it into your mesh, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Endless Circuit
Description: You ride a full circle trailing your mesh, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, always as a critical hit.

Name: Second Wind in Harness
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Hauled Onward
Description: When your stamina runs dry, you lean into the harness of your mesh and regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Barbed Weave
Description: A weapon strike that catches the target on barbs woven through your mesh, dealing 7 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Trotline
Description: Casts 3 barbed lines in a spread, each dealing 10 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Barbed Mantle
Description: Wraps you in a barbed mesh: for 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Set the Barb
Description: Every hit you land sets a barb of your mesh in that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all tear free at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per barb (25% at full). Unfed, a barb slips out every 4 seconds.

Name: Lasso at the Gallop
Description: Whirls a loop of mesh and hurls it up to 8 tiles, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Rearing Lash
Description: You rear and lash a weighted mesh through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy 3 tiles back.

Name: Run Out the Line
Description: Throws a line of mesh ahead and gallops 6 tiles along it; you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Colt on a Tether
Description: Calls a bonded colt that runs beside you dragging a trailing mesh through enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 5 damage and slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Marking Toss
Description: Tosses a scrap of mesh that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: End of the Chase
Description: A weapon strike against an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds; it is [Inescapable] for 4 seconds and cannot teleport away.

Name: Long Pursuit
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Quarry Tiring
Description: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health.

Name: Cold Links Fall
Description: Drops a heavy mesh of cold linked rings over a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage to everything in it plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Clinking Snag
Description: Snags the target in a short jab of ring-linked mesh, dealing 5 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Mail of Mesh
Description: Draws a mesh of linked rings over yourself, raising your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Unyielding Rings
Description: When anything but fire hurts you, your mesh of linked rings closes around you as a ward that absorbs 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Through the Gaps
Description: Slips a blade through the gaps in your mesh into an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Bladed Fling
Description: Throws a mesh strung with hidden blades that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Cut Yourself Loose
Description: Cuts through the mesh holding you, removing up to 3 conditions from you.

Name: Knotted Blade
Description: Conjures a blade knotted into a mesh cord: your weapon damage rises by 10%, your critical hits deal 12% more, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.

Name: Sluggish Throw
Description: Throws a cold, heavy mesh that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

Name: Tail-Whip Coil
Description: Whips your tail and the mesh coiled on it around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Drab Cover
Description: You lie still beneath a mesh and are veiled for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Shed What Was Caught
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you shed the part of you the enemy has caught and regrow it, regaining 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Swarm-Stuffed Sack
Description: Throws a mesh sack stuffed with conjured locusts that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage; 25% of the damage comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Swarm Closes In
Description: Your mesh fills with a devouring swarm around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Plague Let Out
Description: Opens your mesh and lets out a cloud of conjured locusts for 10 seconds; it swarms enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 3 damage every second.

Name: Gorging Season
Description: When you kill an enemy, the swarm caught in your mesh gorges on it: for 4 seconds you heal for 20% of the damage you deal. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Unravel the Catch
Description: Pulls a thread of raw arcana through your mesh on the target, dealing 18 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage each.

Name: Crackling Mesh
Description: A mesh of raw arcana snaps out around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Skim the Ether
Description: Trails your mesh through the stray arcana around you, restoring 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Spells Caught Mid-Air
Description: Your mesh catches elemental attacks aimed at you: 30% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.

Name: Spoken Knot
Description: Speaks a knot of mesh into being on the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction the target carries, up to 40%.

Name: Word of Closing
Description: You speak the closing word and a mesh snaps shut through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Binding Recital
Description: After a 1.5-second incantation, your mesh closes on every creature within 5 tiles and holds them in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Ward Between the Words
Description: When you spend mana, the practised words knot a ward of mesh around you that absorbs 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Slack Line
Description: Pays out a slack line of mesh up to 5 tiles that deals 7 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and slows the target by 30% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Slow Sinking
Description: Settles your full weight on an enemy at or below 30% health and lets your mesh sink it, dealing 22 damage and leaving it [Soaked] and 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Drift Together
Description: Draws the ally who needs it most into your drifting mesh, restoring 3 health a second to them for 8 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Return
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your mesh drifts slack back to you and you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Eight Rehearsed Strokes
Description: Lashes out with all 8 arms at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Lid Trick
Description: Works an arm tip into the guard of the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

Name: A Mind per Limb
Description: Clears the cooldown on 2 of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Second Stroke
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Cupping Glass
Description: Draws the poison out of the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage and healing you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Backwash
Description: Sprays a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage and leaving every enemy in it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Suckers on the Wound
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies and restores 8 health.

Name: Bitterness Turned Tonic
Description: When one of your afflictions on an enemy wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You carry 10% poison resistance.

Name: Overhand Hurl
Description: Reaches up to 5 tiles to seize an enemy and hurls it 3.5 tiles back, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach.

Name: Borrowed Cudgel
Description: Hurls a rock gripped in one arm at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Returned Grip
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.

Name: Between the Plates
Description: Slides an arm through the gaps in the target's guard, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Shield-Wall Shove
Description: Thrusts a plate outward on every arm, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each one back 3 tiles.

Name: Closing Bulwark
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Raised Bucklers
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Falling Fan
Description: Brings several arms down in a fan 2.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in the cone, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Headsman's Hold
Description: Holds a weakened enemy still with your arms and brings the edge down for 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, then leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Lopped and Still Gripping
Description: Cuts one of your own arms free. It stays where it falls for 12 seconds and strikes an enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Felling Count
Description: Every hit you land adds a stack to that enemy, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Clinging Sip
Description: Throws an arm over the first enemy it meets and bites, dealing 4 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Shriek in the Murk
Description: Vents a cloud of ink and shrieks through it, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Name: Cloak Turned Inside Out
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

Name: Dusk Skin
Description: At night your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Pressed Flat
Description: Charges up to 5 tiles at an enemy and lands on it with every arm, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Falling Bulk
Description: Drops your whole weight on the ground around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Curled for Winter
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Bulk That Regrows
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Stinger in Each Sucker
Description: Slaps an arm onto the target for 3 damage and every sucker stings it, leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Sting Follows Sting
Description: Lashes every arm outward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Dawn-to-Dusk Labour
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Alarm Scent
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, an arm darts at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Stooping Snatch
Description: Jets down on an enemy up to 8 tiles away and snatches it in your arms for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. The target moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Dropped on the Rocks
Description: Carries the target up and drops it on the rocks for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Siphon Glide
Description: Jets you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds.

Name: Skims the Surface
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Drawn Taut, Let Fly
Description: Looses an arm at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Harpoon at Full Stretch
Description: After a 1.2 second draw, shoots an arm tip that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and stays fastened to it, leaving it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

Name: Slack Paid Out
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: Cocked Arms
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Slammed Gate
Description: Swings your arms shut on everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage, stunning each enemy for 1 second and leaving it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Shrinking Cell
Description: Closes every arm around a weakened enemy and tightens for 22 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound and [Inescapable] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: No Way Past
Description: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds.

Name: No Slipping Free
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% physical resistance.

Name: Pounce From Nowhere
Description: Springs at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and lands on it with every arm for 10 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 25% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Play Is Over
Description: Hooks an enemy from up to 4 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Through the Keyhole
Description: Teleports you to a spot up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Lands on Its Arms
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Drive the Herd
Description: Spreads your arms wide and walks them forward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead and driving each one back 3 tiles.

Name: Ring Brand
Description: Presses a sucker hard onto the target for 5 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 35% chance that the ring it leaves keeps the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Bellwether Anchor
Description: Fastens your suckers to the ground and pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow Blood, Strong Pull
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 15% faster, from silver your health recovers 10% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 5% sooner.

Name: Linked Lash
Description: Lashes an arm into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, then passes arm to arm to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of the damage.

Name: The Cinch
Description: Cinches every coil on the target tight for 16 damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage each, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Arm in Arm
Description: Links an arm to every ally within 5 tiles: for 10 seconds each of them strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power.

Name: Down the Line
Description: When you land a critical hit, an arm lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage, then passes on to 2 more within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Flung Fold
Description: Throws a fold of your mantle that wraps the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and leaving it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Warp and Weft
Description: Weaves your arms over and under each other across a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Draped in Borrowed Colour
Description: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Wrapped as You Go
Description: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Staghorn Threshold
Description: Grows a reef 5 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves that enemy [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Reach From the Crevice
Description: Lashes an arm at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Garden at the Den
Description: Arranges a reef garden where you stand. For 9 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Overgrown at Rest
Description: The moment your health is full, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health covers you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Undertow
Description: Winds every arm around a weakened enemy, hauls it under and rolls with it for 20 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Sprung From Stillness
Description: Lunges from stillness with every arm, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead and seizing each one, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Settled in the Silt
Description: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Grip Past Struggling
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.

Name: Startled Burst
Description: Bursts a cloud of ink around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each one back 2.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Trailing Whip
Description: Trails an arm behind you and whips it at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Black Jet
Description: Jets you 6 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds afterward.

Name: Flinch Cloud
Description: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health covers you for 4 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Worrying Bite
Description: Clamps onto the target and wraps it in your arms, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Flushed for the Pack
Description: Rakes every arm through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Steadying Arm
Description: Wraps an arm around the ally who needs it most and restores 3 health a second to them for 6 seconds.

Name: Inkhound
Description: A bonded hound with suckered legs runs with you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. It holds on to what it bites: the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Shaken Dry
Description: Shakes the water off your skin, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each one [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Shooing Jet
Description: Squirts a jet of water from your siphon at the first enemy it meets, dealing 10 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

Name: Slip the Blow
Description: For 3 seconds you take no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Two Hearts to Spare
Description: Once every 5 minutes, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Armful of Scree
Description: Throws 3 stones at once from three arms, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Boulder Heave
Description: Heaves a boulder held in every arm at the first enemy it meets, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Cairn Wall
Description: Piles stones into a wall 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Rock Among Rocks
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% earth resistance.

Name: Seen Through
Description: Sends an arm up to 7 tiles to the target's weak place, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaving the target [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

Name: All-Round Watch
Description: Flicks an arm at each enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Skin That Sees
Description: Your dodge chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Clocked
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Shell Cracker
Description: Cracks the target open for 4 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: From Every Plate
Description: Takes a helping from every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage to each and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Passed Down the Table
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

Name: Midden Heap
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Searing Coil
Description: Wraps an arm around the target for 6 damage, setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slowing it by 25% for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Burning Ink Bank
Description: Vents a bank of ink 5 tiles long ahead of you and lights it for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and sets that enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Smoulder Screen
Description: Vents a cloud of smoke that veils you for 5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Flash-Boil Reflex
Description: When anything but fire hurts you, a jet of steam from your siphon scalds the nearest enemy within 3 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Darting Arm
Description: Whips an arm into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then darts to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Slipstream Shove
Description: Drives a surge of water outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Slip the Net
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 12% for 8 seconds.

Name: Wriggle Clear
Description: When your stamina runs out, you wriggle free and regain 15 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Pounce Across the Gap
Description: Looses an arm across the gap that deals 8 damage, rising to 2 times that at the full 7 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Landing Pin
Description: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to the first enemy in your path and slams an arm into it, dealing 14 damage.

Name: Sprung Elsewhere
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

Name: Coiled Arms
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.

Name: Road-Long Reach
Description: Throws an arm that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

Name: Heel-Down Stamp
Description: Stamps every arm down at once, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Road Unrolled
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

Name: Gait of Eight
Description: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Parted Lash
Description: Splits one arm in two, loosing 2 bolts spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Barbed Branch
Description: A forked arm tip stabs the target for 14 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Back the Other Way
Description: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

Name: Spare Prong
Description: When you kill an enemy, a spare arm lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Palmed Coin
Description: Reaches an arm out that deals 32 damage and is always a critical hit, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles.

Name: Wrong Arm
Description: Strikes with one arm while another flings ink, dealing 10 damage, knocking the target back 2 tiles and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Name: Shell and Switch
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 20% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Count Short
Description: When your strikes go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Snapped Tongue
Description: Snaps an arm out, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Spat Spray
Description: Spits a cone of water 6 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Rock Kick-Off
Description: Carries you 5 tiles forward in a sudden dash.

Name: Damp Hide
Description: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Spore Bloom
Description: Vents a cloud of ink and spores, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Rot Dart
Description: Flicks a spore-crusted arm tip that deals 3 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Mend
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Perched Sporeling
Description: A bonded sporeling grows on one of your arms and fights beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a tick for 4 ticks.

Name: Anchored Ram
Description: Drives an anchored arm in, dealing 16 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Planted Sweep
Description: Sweeps every arm around, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. It ignores armour.

Name: Footing Fast
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises 8% while it lasts.

Name: Held My Ground
Description: When your health falls below 30%, a ward worth 25% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Herdmaster's Lash
Description: Whips a warm arm into the target, dealing 30 damage. Allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

Name: Rumen Spurts
Description: Flicks 2 spurts spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds.

Name: Warm Den
Description: Gathers a warm den around you for 12 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside its 4 tiles.

Name: Rumination
Description: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Funnel Report
Description: Fires a pressurised jet from your funnel that deals 40 damage and ignores armour.

Name: Rapid Salvo
Description: Looses 3 spurts of ink in quick succession, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Recoil Jet
Description: A jet from your funnel that carries you 4 tiles forward.

Name: Hot Chamber
Description: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Garotte Thread
Description: Cinches fine filaments around a target at or below 25% health, dealing 16 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each.

Name: Binding Strand
Description: Wraps a sticky strand around the target, dealing 4 damage and slowing it by 25% for 3 seconds.

Name: Mantle of Strands
Description: Weaves your arms into a mantle that raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Strand upon Strand
Description: Every hit you land lays a strand on the target, up to 6. When it reaches 6 they all spend at once as a burst of damage. Unfed, a strand frays every 4 seconds.

Name: Pile Driver
Description: Anchors every other arm and slams one down, dealing 20 damage and stunning the target for 1.4 seconds.

Name: Anvil Drop

Name: Snarled Bristle
Description: Bristles every plate and strand, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and hindering their attacks for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Silk Snare
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Fine Filaments
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.4 health a second permanently.

Name: Flatten
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A crushing tail blow that deals 20 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Plate Slam
Description: Slams down on your plates, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Levelled Rampart
Description: Raises a wall 4 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

Name: Hammering Back
Description: When you are hurt by something other than fire, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Clamp Down
Description: Seizes a target up to 4 tiles away, dealing 8 damage with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Rallying Slam
Description: Brings your plates down hard, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Allies within 5 tiles strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

Name: Pick Out Burrs
Description: Dispels 2 hostile effects on you and your allies.

Name: Steady Hold
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your armour by 6%.

Name: Hoof Drum
Description: Drums your plates on the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Hauling Charge
Description: Rolls a curled ball of scales into the first enemy it meets, dealing 15 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Tireless Stand
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds. Enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you, up to 3, for 5 seconds.

Name: Plodding Pace
Description: You move 10% faster, and you have 8% physical resistance.

Name: Gaff Heave
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, up to 6 tiles away. Hooks it with a claw for 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

Name: Snag Quill
Description: Flings a barbed scale that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Drag Line
Description: Lays a barbed line 6 tiles long for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

Name: Caught Fast
Description: Whenever you inflict a condition on an enemy, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Trample Run
Description: You rush up to 7 tiles forward and trample, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Iron-Shod Shove
Description: Kicks the target with a hind-leg of scales, dealing 40 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. The blow ignores armour.

Name: Cantering Guard
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 30% faster for 5 seconds.

Name: Gathered Pace
Description: Every few tiles you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Scent Snap
Description: Snaps a scale at the first enemy it meets, dealing 5 damage with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Quarry Marker
Description: A crushing blow that deals 34 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Fall In Behind
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Run-Down Resolve
Description: Against afflicted enemies, your damage rises by 12% and your armour by 6%.

Name: Anvil Drop
Description: A crushing overhead blow that deals 36 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Clang Sweep
Description: Sweeps your plates around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 30% chance of [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

Name: Wall of Plate
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 30 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 15% while it holds.

Name: Tempered Hide
Description: Your armour rises by 15%, and you have 10% physical resistance.

Name: Seam Cut
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Slips a scale-edge between its plates for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Probing Edge
Description: A quick cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Find the Seam
Description: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Long Wait Edge
Description: After several hits without a critical hit, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Your armour is 6% higher at all times. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Tail Whip
Description: Whips a scaled tail into the target, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Basking Spit
Description: Spits a glob that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and hinders its attacks for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

Name: Regrown Scale
Description: Regrows damaged plates, restoring 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Basking Hide
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Gnawing Swarm
Description: Looses a cone of gnawing slivers 4 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to every enemy caught in it.

Name: Famine Ball
Description: Hurls a curled ball of scales that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts for 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Swarm Shell
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds. For 12 seconds a swarm fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4s.

Name: Stripped Field
Description: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times.

Name: Glimmer Bolt
Description: Sends a raw bolt of arcana into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

Name: Unshaped Burst
Description: Releases raw arcana from under your plates, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Bare Current
Description: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Spent Spark
Description: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Your armour is 8% higher at all times. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Final Syllable
Description: A spoken word that strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 38 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Muttered Jab
Description: A quick tail jab that deals 5 damage with a 40% chance of [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Spoken Reversal
Description: Each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 10 seconds.

Name: Last Breath of Mana
Description: When your mana runs empty, you regain 15 mana. Your armour is 10% higher at all times. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Gentle Nudge
Description: Leans your whole weight into the target, dealing 12 damage, knocking it back 2 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Tide Slap
Description: Slaps a tail along the water at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 7 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

Name: Calm Pulse
Description: A slow pulse from under your plates restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Slow Tide
Description: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second permanently.

Name: Marginalia
Description: Flicks an annotated slip into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It deals 15% more damage for each affliction on the target, up to 60% more.

Name: Struck Through
Description: Strikes the target, dealing 18 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Recite From Memory
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Well-Thumbed Manual
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.

Name: Drawn Off
Description: Sends a blotting sheet into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Soiled Blotters
Description: Scatters used blotting sheets across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in it and leaving each [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Apothecary's Script
Description: Writes out a remedy that removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 10 health.

Name: Return to Sender
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

Name: Slammed Tome
Description: Brings a bound volume down two-handed for 16 damage, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3 tiles.

Name: Flung Folio
Description: Hurls a heavy folio overarm for 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its maximum range of 7 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Chest-Thumped Decree
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

Name: Cracked Spine
Description: Each time you kill something, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Binder's Awl
Description: Drives a binding awl through the layers of the target's plating for 8 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Writ Absolute
Description: Reads a writ aloud that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The damage ignores armour.

Name: Pasted Plate
Description: Pastes sheet over sheet into a plate that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Riveted Boards
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 8% slashing resistance.

Name: Sentence Carried Out
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Brings the edge down for 24 damage, using up every affliction on the target and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Guillotine Cut
Description: Drops a trimming blade through a narrow cone 4 tiles long, dealing 15 damage to every enemy in it and stunning each for 1 second. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

Name: Headsman's Commission
Description: Your damage rises by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: The Condemned Roll
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Inkwing Flutter
Description: Looses a small folded flier into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Unheard Shriek
Description: Shrieks at a pitch too high to hear, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. The damage ignores resistances, and each enemy hit is left [Muddled] for 6 seconds, slowing its casting.

Name: Colony Between Covers
Description: Calls a colony of folded fliers. For 12 seconds it harries an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

Name: Night Edition
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.

Name: Pressed Flat
Description: You charge up to 6 tiles to the target and crush it, dealing 18 damage. The target is [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Tear a Ream
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Tears a ream from your own body and scatters it, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Shelved Until Spring
Description: You regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Hidebound Volume
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Barbed Postscript
Description: Flicks a barbed slip into the first enemy it meets for 3 damage, leaving the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Swarm Circular
Description: Sends a circular through the swarm, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy hit are copied to every other enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Piecework
Description: Your attack speed rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Tireless Scriveners
Description: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Skimmed Dart
Description: Throws a folded dart for 7 damage, rising to 2 times that at its maximum range of 7 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Kite Stoop
Description: You glide up to 7 tiles to the target and land on it, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Thousand-Fold Crane
Description: Folds a crane and lets it fly for 10 seconds. It pecks an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each peck with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Airmail
Description: Every few paces you cover, a leaflet dives at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Arrow-Borne Challenge
Description: Shoots an arrow with a written challenge tied to the shaft for 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its maximum range of 8 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to open [Karma] against the target for 6 seconds: your blows on it land harder and its blows land softer.

Name: Loosed Quire
Description: After a 1.2 second draw, looses 5 arrows fletched with torn pages at once, spread apart, each dealing 12 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Unrolled to Length
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Bodkin Nib
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Ruled Lines
Description: Draws a ring of ink bars around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 0.8 seconds. Every enemy hit is then [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Closed Case
Description: Sends a closed file into the first enemy it meets, dealing 16 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Barred Passage
Description: Draws a wall of ink bars 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing can cross it.

Name: Docket Entry
Description: Each time you afflict something, you regain 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Inked Pawprint
Description: A quick swipe that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Clawed to Confetti
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Claws through the target for 22 damage and tears up every affliction you have on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Quiet in the Stacks
Description: Hides you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Ninth Draft
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Pasteboard Stampede
Description: Drives a herd of folded oxen ahead of you across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: The Sealed Bull
Description: Brings a sealed edict down on the target, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Vellum Coat
Description: Your armour rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Branded Tally
Description: Every hit you land brands a tally mark on that enemy, up to 10. At 10 marks they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per mark (272% at full). Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Pass It On
Description: Sends a letter into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage. It then copies itself to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each copy dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Lien Placed
Description: Binds the target in linked pages, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. The target is 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Hindered] for 5 seconds, slowing its attacks.

Name: Joint Signatories
Description: Links every ally within 5 tiles under one contract: each strikes 15% harder for 9 seconds and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: No Escape Clause
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them.

Name: Red Tape
Description: Lashes a length of filing ribbon into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds, slowing its attacks.

Name: Unspooled Chronicle
Description: Unrolls a woven scroll across a cone 6 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in it. The damage ignores resistances, and each enemy hit is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Field Dressing
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Its healing rises 1% for each 1% of cast speed you have.

Name: Rag-Stock Cushion
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Pulp Spur
