Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws a spur of hardened pulp for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its maximum range of 6 tiles. The target is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Accreted Stacks
Description: Raises a reef of hardened pages around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

Name: Living Watermark
Description: Grows a field of wet pulp 3 tiles across where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Layer Upon Layer
Description: Every time you use an ability, a layer of pulp sets on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per layer (56% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Indenture
Description: You lunge up to 5 tiles to the target and clamp down on it, dealing 16 damage. The target is 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Snapped Cover
Description: Slams a great book shut around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. The damage ignores armour.

Name: The Fine Print
Description: Hides a clause at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

Name: Overdue Notice
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Hasty Foolscap
Description: Flicks a loose leaf into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Scattered Sheaf
Description: Startles a sheaf of pages into flight around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Quick Exit
Description: You spring 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

Name: Errata Slip
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Rolled Gazette
Description: Throws a rolled gazette into the first enemy it meets for 8 damage. Holds 3 charges, and each kill fetches one back.

Name: Charter of the Pack
Description: Howls a signed charter aloud, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. On a hit, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Note in the Jaws
Description: Sends a hound with a written remedy in its jaws to the ally who needs it most, restoring 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Faithful Copy
Description: Calls a bonded hound folded from your own pages that fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Printed Canard
Description: Floats a printed rumour into the first enemy it meets for 3 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 5 seconds, lowering the damage it deals.

Name: Bill Come Due
Description: Skims an itemised bill at the target for 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its maximum range of 6 tiles. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Waxed Sleeve
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Little Boat Afloat
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Fault Line
Description: Heaves up strata in sheets across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 15 damage to every enemy in it and stunning each for 0.8 seconds. Every enemy hit is [Exposed] for 6 seconds, stripping its resistance to the elements.

Name: Shattered Tablet
Description: Hurls an inscribed clay tablet into the first enemy it meets for 34 damage. It shatters there, dealing 80% of that damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Set in Stone
Description: The damage you take is reduced by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Milestone Script
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Close Reading
Description: A glance that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its maximum range of 8 tiles. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Censor's Sweep
Description: Sweeps a censor's gaze across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in it. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy hit is [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Between the Lines
Description: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Double-Take
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Next Course Served
Description: Serves the next course on the written menu into the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Eat Your Words
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Devours every affliction you have written on the target, dealing 18 damage plus 1.8 times their remaining damage.

Name: Grace Said Aloud
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. It grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Food for Thought
Description: Each time you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Matchbook Flick
Description: Strikes a match from the book and flicks it into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, setting the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Burnt Offerings
Description: After a 0.8 second cast, burns 4 written offerings and sends them out at once, spread apart, each dealing 14 damage plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

Name: Tinder Jacket
Description: Wraps you in flash sheets for 8 seconds. 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Catching Scraps
Description: Each time you kill something, a burning scrap leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Gyotaku Print
Description: Slaps an inked sheet onto the first enemy it meets that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target are printed onto every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Silver Run
Description: Looses a shoal of 5 folded fish at once, spread apart; each deals 8 damage and slips past the target's armour entirely.

Name: Oiled Vellum
Description: Coats you in slick waxed pages that raise your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Slick Margins
Description: Every blow you slip past adds a line to your margins, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per line (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a line fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Ink Speck
Description: Flicks a leaping speck of ink into the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Infested Shelf
Description: Shakes a swarm of booklice off your pages that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each one [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit hop to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Flip-Book Hop
Description: Flicks you through the pages to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Skipped Page
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled again, and the second roll stands.

Name: Courier's Dispatch
Description: Throws a weighted dispatch that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have travelled, up to 30%.

Name: Postmark Stomp
Description: Stamps down on the target, which deals 13 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Wrapped Puttees
Description: Wraps your legs in layered pages that absorb up to 18 damage for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

Name: Annotated Mile
Description: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you note it down: your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Branching Clause
Description: Sends a folded clause into the first enemy it meets that deals 7 damage, then branches to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Either-Or Tines
Description: Looses 2 pronged slips at once along diverging paths; each deals 10 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Rewritten Chapter
Description: Rewrites the story so far: clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Path Not Taken
Description: Once every 180 seconds, a blow that would kill you is rolled again, and the second roll stands.

Name: Forged Notes
Description: Looses 3 forged notes at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage and has a 15% chance to turn its target against its own allies for 2 seconds.

Name: Called-In Debt
Description: Serves the target a forged notice of debt that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Fine Print
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Cooked Books
Description: Each critical hit skims 6 mana back to you. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Jumping Fold
Description: Flicks a folded jumper that springs into the first enemy it meets and deals 7 damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Pulp Spit
Description: Spits wet pulp in a narrow cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Sprung Crease
Description: Springs you 5 tiles forward off a folded crease. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Lily-Pad Leaves
Description: Your pages hold you up: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.

Name: Rotted Through
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A strike that deals 16 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Riffled Spores
Description: Riffles open a mildewed volume, releasing spores in a cone 5 tiles ahead that deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignores resistances and leaves each target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

Name: Mouldering Stack
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to set down a mouldering stack of books beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds spores on enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Spotted Endpapers
Description: Every hit you land leaves a spot of mould on that enemy, up to 8. At 8 they all burst at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per spot (218% at full). Unfed, a spot fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Chewed-Up Terms
Description: A bite that needs one of your afflictions on the target and eats it, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Bleated Proclamation
Description: Bellows a proclamation that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each one 3 tiles back.

Name: Paperweight Stance
Description: Weighs you down as a paperweight: the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Grudge List
Description: Every time you take damage, you add the offence to your list, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per entry (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, an entry fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Herdbook Entry
Description: Hurls a heavy herdbook that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. On a hit, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Shredded Bedding
Description: Kicks up shredded paper bedding that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Byre Roll
Description: Calls the roll of your herd: you and every ally regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Quilted Lining
Description: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Rolled Cartridge
Description: Fires a ball from a paper cartridge into the first enemy it meets that deals 32 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Burning Wadding
Description: Fires 3 scraps of burning wadding at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage.

Name: Firing Table
Description: Consults a printed firing table: for 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

Name: Filed Report
Description: Each critical hit sends a bolt to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles that deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Fine-Line Cut
Description: A slicing page edge that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Sewn Into the Spine
Description: Lashes binding thread around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Strand-Laid Sheets
Description: Laces your pages with strands that raise your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Calligrapher's Brush
Description: Conjures a calligrapher's brush with an edge. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Gavel Ruling
Description: A gavel blow that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Flatbed Descent
Description: Brings a printing press down around you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles that ignores armour, and leaves each one [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Case Dismissed
Description: Strikes the charges from the record: removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally.

Name: Pressman's Arms
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.

Name: Dealt Five Cards
Description: Flicks 5 cards out in a fan; each deals 2 damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Signed Off
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Stamps a signed order on the target that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Raised Ballot
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Steady Penmanship
Description: When your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Hoofprint Seal
Description: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and stamp a seal on it that deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Relay Post
Description: Sends a sealed letter into the first enemy it meets that deals 7 damage. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Stage Ticket
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Remount Chit
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Snagging Clip
Description: Flicks a barbed clip into the first enemy it meets that deals 6 damage, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Cliffhanger Line
Description: Strings a 6-tile line of barbed pages ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Catching Clasp
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Caught Reader
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Stampeding Broadsheets
Description: Sends a charge of folded broadsheets 5 tiles ahead in a cone that deals 13 damage to everything in it and knocks each target 3 tiles back.

Name: Galloping Effigy
Description: Hurls a folded effigy that deals 26 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles, and always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Offering Steed
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to fold a steed that fights beside you for 12 seconds, trampling an enemy within 2 tiles for 5 damage every second.

Name: Turnpike Charter
Description: On paved ground, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Wanted Poster
Description: Pins a wanted poster to the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Bounty Collected
Description: A finishing blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Hunting Blind
Description: Hides you behind a paper screen for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Against enemies low on health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Gall-Ink Blot
Description: Flicks a blot of corrosive ink that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Clasped Codex
Description: Hurls a clasped codex into the first enemy it meets that deals 30 damage and ignores resistances.

Name: Unyielding Covers
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Cold Binding
Description: When anything but fire hurts you, your covers close: you gain a ward of 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Letter Opener
Description: Slides a hidden blade from the spine that deals 28 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Razor Fan
Description: Fans out razor-edged pages in a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Sharp Rebuttal
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Keen Deckle
Description: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Torn-Off Tail
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Tears off a slip of yourself and flings it into the first enemy it meets, which deals 9 damage.

Name: Stilling Page
Description: Holds up a cold page that chills a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, stunning each target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Shed Pages
Description: Sheds your outer pages: removes up to 3 conditions from you.

Name: Second Draft
Description: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Gnawed Edges
Description: A strike that needs one of your afflictions on the target and devours it, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Plague Scroll
Description: Unrolls a plague scroll whose swarm deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

Name: Chewing Cloud
Description: Releases a cloud of chewing paper locusts for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Famine Edition
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Inscribed Charge
Description: Writes a raw glyph into the target with a strike that deals 28 damage, ignores resistances and leaves it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Glyph Line
Description: Writes a 6-tile line of burning glyphs ahead of you for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Read the Scroll
Description: Reads a scroll aloud and restores 20 mana.

Name: Candlelit Study
Description: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Full Stop
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Sends a full stop into the first enemy it meets that deals 22 damage.

Name: Spoken Edict
Description: Reads out 3 edicts at once, spread apart; each deals 12 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Counter-Script
Description: For 6 seconds, your counter-script returns 30% of the elemental damage you take to whoever dealt it.

Name: Corrected Spelling
Description: Each time you spend mana, 4 mana is returned to you. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Tidewrack Sheet
Description: Sends a page drifting into the target that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Waterlogged Ream
Description: Swings a waterlogged ream around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks each one 2 tiles back and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Bookmarked Moment
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to mark the page: holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Blotting Calm
Description: Every time you take damage, it soaks in like ink into a blotter, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal 5% of your maximum health per blot (30% at full). Unfed, a blot fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Trellis Tangle
Description: Lashes one enemy within 6 tiles with a vine for 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. The target moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Deadheading
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. Cuts it for 18 damage, consumes every affliction on it and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the cut.

Name: Second Flush
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds and restores 10 health.

Name: Perennial Habit
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Draw the Venom
Description: Strikes one enemy for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Wormwood Mist
Description: Releases a wormwood mist over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 3 damage and leaving each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. Half of the damage the poison deals heals you.

Name: Plantain Poultice
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Mithridatism
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You gain 10% poison resistance.

Name: Strangler Grip
Description: Seizes one enemy in a vine-wrapped grip for 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Buttress Slam
Description: Roots break the surface under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

Name: Liana Swing
Description: Swings you on a vine to a spot up to 7 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

Name: Burled Knuckle
Description: When you land a weapon strike, you restore 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Heartwood Wedge
Description: Drives a wedge of heartwood into one enemy for 28 damage that ignores armour, then leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Shedding Bark
Description: Sheds a layer of bark in every direction, dealing 4 damage to each enemy within 2.5 tiles. You move 12% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Gorse Hauberk
Description: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it lasts restores 6 health.

Name: Annual Layers
Description: Every time you take damage, a layer of bark builds on you, up to 6. At 6 layers they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per layer (42% in all). A layer fades every 10 seconds if none is added. You also regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Felling Cut
Description: Chops one enemy for 14 damage, knocking it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Timber Fall
Description: Fells a trunk across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy under it and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Coppice
Description: Restores 14 health to you. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Sugaring Off
Description: When you land a critical hit, you gain 20% lifedrain for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Moonflower Sip
Description: Darts a barbed petal into one enemy for 4 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Mandrake Shriek
Description: Pulls up a mandrake that shrieks, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Nectar Draught
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Night-Blooming
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. You regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Bramble Paw
Description: Swipes a bramble-clawed paw across a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 9 damage with a 60% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

Name: Rootbound Hug
Description: Crushes one enemy for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Roots hold it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and it is 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Dormant Season
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Berry Fat
Description: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Foraging Flight
Description: Looses 3 stingers in a spread, each dealing 2 damage. 30% of the damage they deal comes back to you as healing over the next 6 seconds.

Name: Pollen Courier
Description: Bursts a pollen sac on one enemy for 12 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target are carried to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Honey Ration
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. The amount rises with your cast speed.

Name: Hive Tenant
Description: A swarm nesting in your hollow fights beside you, stinging an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second and leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.

Name: Samara Spiral
Description: Spins a winged seed into one enemy for 4 damage. It then glides on to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage.

Name: Leafwing Gust
Description: A wingbeat drives sharp leaves down a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Thistledown Drift
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

Name: Seed on the Wind
Description: Every few paces you travel, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Pegging Shaft
Description: Looses a thorn-headed shaft at one enemy within 10 tiles for 28 damage that ignores armour, rising to 2 times that at full reach. The shaft takes root and holds the target [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Quiver of Thorns
Description: Looses 3 thorns in a spread, each dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; a kill restores one.

Name: Fletcher's Sapling
Description: Roots a sapling where you stand for 20 seconds. It shoots thorns at enemies within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Bodkin Tip
Description: Your plant damage cannot be resisted, and you regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Bindweed Bars
Description: Closes a cage of thorned vine on one enemy, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. The thorns leave it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Flytrap Clasp
Description: Snaps shut on one enemy for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. The target is [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Hedgerow
Description: Raises a hedge 6.5 tiles long ahead of you that nothing crosses for 6 seconds. Enemies it strikes move 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Wicker Ribs
Description: When you are hurt by anything but fire, woven branches close around you as a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Hawthorn Pounce
Description: You spring up to 6 tiles to one enemy and rake it for 13 damage. Thorned claws leave it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Nepeta Haze
Description: Shakes out a haze of pollen that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

Name: Tallgrass Prowl
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 8 health. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Ninth Regrowth
Description: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Turned Furrow
Description: Lowers your horns and ploughs a furrow 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles. Roots turned up by the furrow leave them [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Close Cropping
Description: Crops one enemy for 4 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Chew the Cud
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and restores 8 health at once.

Name: Fallow Strength
Description: When your stamina is full, you deal 25% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Linked Runners
Description: Sends a runner vine into one enemy for 7 damage. It then links on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that damage. Holds 4 charges; a kill restores one.

Name: Grapnel Tendril
Description: Hooks one enemy with a tendril and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it, dealing 13 damage. The target is left [Hindered] for 4 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Reeling Creeper
Description: Knots a creeper at a spot ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Enemies it strikes move 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Bound and Fed
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Flaxen Lash
Description: Whips a length of woven flax across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Winding Sheet
Description: Wraps one enemy in wet linen for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Muddled] for 8 seconds.

Name: Linen Dressing
Description: Binds the wounds of the ally who needs it most in linen, restoring 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Burr-Sewn Gambeson
Description: Conjures a gambeson that lowers every hit you take by 2 and raises your armour by 8%. 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Budded Spur
Description: Snaps a budded spur off in one enemy for 8 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, one for each bud; a kill restores one.

Name: Spore Spawning
Description: Releases a cloud of spawn that deals 26 damage, ignoring resistances, to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 8 seconds. The poison spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 5.5 tiles.

Name: Symbiont Shallows
Description: Raises a reef of weed and polyp where you stand for 10 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. Each ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4 allies.

Name: Algal Plating
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Mangrove Roll
Description: Clamps onto one enemy and rolls it under for 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Mangrove roots hold it [Caged] for 3 seconds.

Name: Surfacing Snap
Description: You burst from cover up to 6 tiles to your target and snap across a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Mudbank Rest
Description: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

Name: Log in the Reeds
Description: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. You also regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Shed Tine
Description: Breaks a branching tine from your own antlers, costing 4% of your maximum health, and hurls it at one enemy within 7 tiles for 9 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach.

Name: Startled Thicket
Description: Brambles burst from the ground around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Browse Line
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 30% for 9 seconds and restores 8 health.

Name: Game Trail
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you gain 10% plant resistance.

Name: Burr Bite
Description: Bites one enemy for 26 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Marked] by clinging burrs for 10 seconds. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Raised Hackles
Description: Bristles with thorns, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

Name: Faithful Canopy
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds. You restore 8 health.

Name: Briar Hound
Description: A hound grown from briar fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. What it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Dewdrop Shot
Description: Rolls a bead of water off your leaves into one enemy for 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Pondweed Mat
Description: Spreads a mat of floating weed under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 7 damage with a 60% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

Name: Lotus Sheen
Description: For 10 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to roll off and land on whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Lily Pad Footing
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.

Name: Buckling Ground
Description: Roots heave the ground under every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Geode Pod
Description: Throws a stone-shelled seed pod that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Tilled Ground
Description: Turns the ground where you stand into a growing bed for 10 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Dug In
Description: When your stamina runs out, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Ocellus Flare
Description: Flares open across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Heliotrope Lance
Description: A flower turns to face one enemy and looses a thorn for 28 damage that always lands as a critical hit. The target is [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Watchtower Stalk
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far. You restore 8 health.

Name: Chitted Tuber
Description: Every critical hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 stacks they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% in all). A stack fades every 10 seconds if none is added.

Name: Ripe Picking
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Plucks it for 9 damage, heals you for 35% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Laden Bough
Description: Shakes down 5 heavy fruit in a spread, each dealing 6 damage. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Compost Banquet
Description: Needs at least 1 body within 9 tiles. Your roots drain every body in reach, up to 5, and each restores 7% of your health.

Name: Gleaner's Appetite
Description: Each kill restores 4 health. When you kill an enemy, you also receive 40% more healing for 8 seconds, once every 10 seconds.

Name: Resin Brand
Description: Burns 5% of your maximum health as fuel to throw a brand of resin at one enemy, dealing 9 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Backburn Front
Description: Sends fire through dry brush across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage and leaving every enemy hit [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Charcoal Hide
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and attackers are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Ashfall Mulch
Description: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Shoaling Seeds
Description: Looses 3 seeds that swim out in a spread, each one that hits dealing 6 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Kelp Undertow
Description: You slip up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it for 13 damage, wrapping it in stinging kelp that leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and 25% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Mucilage Coat
Description: Coats you in slick plant slime for 12 seconds, raising your dodge chance by 25%. You restore 10 health.

Name: Eelgrass Bed
Description: Every attack you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 stacks they all spend at once and heal you for 6% of your maximum health per stack (24% in all). A stack fades every 8 seconds if none is added.

Name: Hitchhiker Bite
Description: Flicks a hooked seed that leaps onto the first enemy it meets and deals 4 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Mistletoe Latch
Description: A parasitic shoot latches onto one enemy and deals 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on it; each one used up adds 60% more damage. The target is left 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Sprung Pod
Description: A seed pod bursts beneath you and flings you to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds afterwards.

Name: Host Hopping
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Trodden Path
Description: Stamps the ground, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Creeping Runner
Description: Sends a runner along the ground to one enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and grows to as much as 2 times its damage at maximum range.

Name: Wayside Plantain
Description: Chews a roadside leaf that restores 12 health and raises your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds.

Name: Mile Grass
Description: Every 6 tiles you walk, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Offshoot Thorn
Description: Throws a thorn that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each taking 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Ramifying Thicket
Description: Grows a branching briar across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage and leaving every enemy hit [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Shared Graft
Description: Splits your sap between you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, restoring 14 health to each, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Sideshoot
Description: When you land a critical hit, a thorn branches off toward the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Bewildering Pollen
Description: Blows pollen over up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning it for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 4 seconds.

Name: Lure Blossom
Description: Tosses a sweet-scented blossom at one enemy at or below 30% health; it deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Turned Nettles
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.

Name: Sundew Tally
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 stacks they all spend at once and heal you for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% in all). A stack fades every 5 seconds if none is added.

Name: Sticky Tendril
Description: Flicks a sticky tendril at one enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, more the further it reaches, up to 1.5 times. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Bulrush Spring
Description: You spring up and land in the reeds, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 3 tiles and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Algal Jelly
Description: Wraps you in a jelly of algae that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

Name: Coiled Stem
Description: When your stamina becomes full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Draw
Description: Sends a thread of mycelium into one enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using that affliction up; it deals 9 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Rot in the Roots
Description: Exhales a cloud of spores across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances and leaving every enemy hit [Poisoned] for 4 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Mycorrhizal Share
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally near you, and restores 10 health to you.

Name: Hyphal Mat
Description: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 stacks they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% in all). A stack fades every 10 seconds if none is added.

Name: Butting Burl
Description: A knotted, wood-hard blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] from splinters for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Taproot Stamp
Description: Stamps down through your roots, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Stand Fast
Description: Sinks roots into the ground beneath you, reducing the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds. You restore 10 health.

Name: Saxifrage Hold
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Herd Trample
Description: The herd crosses the meadow around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds. You restore 12 health.

Name: Clover Bolus
Description: Lobs a chewed wad of clover that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Hayloft Warmth
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You restore 10 health.

Name: Winter Fodder
Description: When your health falls below 35%, you regain 5 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Sandbox Pod
Description: Fires a ripe seed pod that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 34 damage, and 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Seed Buckshot
Description: Fires 3 hard seeds at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 3 seconds.

Name: Pod Battery
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to grow a seed-spitting pod beside you for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage.

Name: Swelling Seedcase
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Capillary Snare
Description: Casts ten thousand fine root hairs over one enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, more the further they reach, up to 1.4 times, with a 60% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Tangled Filaments
Description: Throws a mesh of filaments over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, stripping 6% armour for 3 seconds and slowing each by 15%.

Name: Bast Wrapping
Description: Binds you in strips of bark fibre, raising your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Felted Root Mat
Description: When you take damage from anything but fire, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Buckled Ground
Description: Roots heave the ground flat around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Deadfall Bough
Description: Brings a felled bough down on one enemy, dealing 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Tamped Earth
Description: Packs the earth into a slab around you that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Flattened Thicket
Description: When you strike an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Creeper's Clasp
Description: Throws a grasping tendril that closes on the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Uprooting Wrench
Description: Grips one enemy at or below 25% health and wrenches it up by the roots, dealing 26 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Green Thumb
Description: Tends your own wounds, restoring 18 health to you with a 10% chance to heal critically.

Name: Thornwood Haft
Description: Grows a briar weapon into your grip. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Hoofbeat Charge
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes it for 12 damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Thistle Kick
Description: Kicks up thistles around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Trail Oats
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds and 10 health at once.

Name: Understory Reserve
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Catchbriar Line
Description: Strings a 5-tile line of hooked briars ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Reeling Thorn
Description: Hooks a thorn into one enemy up to 6 tiles away and deals 16 damage, using up every affliction you have on it; each one used up adds 60% more damage.

Name: Burdock Snag
Description: Scatters clinging burs that pull up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Barbed Tithe
Description: When you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Tumbleweed Stampede
Description: Sends a rolling stampede of tumbleweed across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Rolling Seedhead
Description: Bowls a spiny seedhead at one enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 7 damage, more the further it rolls, up to 1.6 times. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Wild Oat Run
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

Name: Burr Wake
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, a spiny seed flies at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Scent Bead
Description: Flicks a bead of scented sap that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Closing Snare
Description: Snaps a noose of vine shut on one enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit and grows to as much as 1.5 times its damage at maximum range.

Name: Scent on the Wind
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds. You restore 10 health.

Name: Wilting Quarry
Description: You deal 15% more damage to enemies at low health.

Name: Lignum Vitae
Description: A blow with dense, iron-hard wood that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Rustleaf Spray
Description: Shakes rust-coloured spores across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Petrified Bark
Description: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you; transcendent damage still lands. You restore 12 health.

Name: Slow-Grown Grain
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, every ability you have comes round 5% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Sawgrass Ring
Description: Whips razor-edged grass around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Pruning Cut
Description: A clean cut at one enemy at or below 25% health (the threshold rises with rank) that deals 24 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage. You have 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet bled.

Name: Undergrowth Lurk
Description: Veils you in leaves for 6 seconds, moving 10% faster; enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You restore 8 health.

Name: Thorn in the Wound
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying an affliction.

Name: Sun-Still Snap
Description: Snaps at one enemy from stillness, dealing 13 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Frill Flare
Description: Spends 4% of your maximum health to flare a frill of sun-warmed petals across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage and setting every enemy hit [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Shed and Regrow
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: Noon Basking
Description: During the day, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Chaff Cloud
Description: Looses 4 husks at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Stripped Stalk
Description: Fires a stalk stripped bare that deals 18 damage to one enemy, using up every affliction you have on it; each one used up adds 50% more damage.

Name: Threshing Swarm
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm of seed-eaters for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 5 health.

Name: Grain Gorge
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (20% at full) for 6 seconds. A stack fades every 10 seconds if none is added.

Name: Ley Spore Burst
Description: Looses 5 spores of raw mana at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances.

Name: Mana Thorn
Description: Flicks a thorn of mana at one enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, more the further it flies, up to 1.5 times, with a 30% chance to leave it [Dimmed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Forced Bloom
Description: Forces one of your other abilities into early flower, clearing its cooldown; it is chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Ley-Fed Roots
Description: Each time you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Hushing Bramble
Description: Brambles close over the mouth of one enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 10 damage and taking its next action away for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Ogham Stave
Description: A strike with a stave cut with tree-letters that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Leafbound Recital
Description: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. You restore 8 health.

Name: Pressed Verse
Description: Each time your mana becomes full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Seagrass Drift
Description: Drifts a mat of seagrass over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 12% armour for 6 seconds, slowing each by 25% and pushing it back 2 tiles.

Name: Bladderwrack Lob
Description: Lobs a heavy frond of bladderwrack at one enemy, dealing 26 damage. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Tidal Pasture
Description: Grows a meadow of seagrass where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Unhurried Graze
Description: When you are healed, you restore 5 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Thousandth Kick
Description: A practised kick that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Flawless Roundhouse
Description: A spinning kick that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

Name: Reset Stance
Description: Hops you 2 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Muscle Memory
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Bitterleaf Nibble
Description: A quick nibble that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Dregs Flick
Description: Flicks a bitter pellet that deals 16 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Run It Off
Description: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Sweat It Out
Description: Every stretch of ground you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Drop-Kicked Boulder
Description: Heaves up a boulder and kicks it at a target. It deals 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, ignores armour and throws the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Grip and Kick
Description: Grabs the target and kicks it with both hind feet, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Cornered Fury
Description: For 6 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Weave Then Wallop
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Barge Past
Description: A shoulder barge that deals 13 damage, throws the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Cast-Off Weight
Description: Sheds your plating in a blast that deals 28 damage, ignoring armour, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds afterward.

Name: Pared-Down Guard
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Moving Target
Description: Every stretch of ground you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Run-Up Chop
Description: An overhead chop that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Hamstring Notch
Description: A darting cut at the legs that deals 7 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spring-Loaded Edge
Description: Hops you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your slashing damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Culling Spree
Description: Each time you kill an enemy, your next strike has 30% more critical hit chance, once every 12 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Snared Shriek
Description: Looses a piercing scream 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Skipping Pulse
Description: Sends out a pulse of sound that deals 4 resonating damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Erratic Flit
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds, and flits you 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Crepuscular Habit
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Heavyweight Hindkick
Description: A two-footed kick with your whole weight behind it. It deals 30 damage, throws the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Bluff Charge
Description: Rushes you at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and rears up, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

Name: Denning Leap
Description: You spring 2 tiles aside, then restore 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Winter Fat
Description: The moment your stamina runs out, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Needle Fan
Description: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Booted Hive
Description: Kicks a hive that deals 28 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Nectar Run
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Scout Drone
Description: Calls a bonded drone that flies beside you, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Stooping Kick
Description: Glides you up to 8 tiles onto a target and lands a kick for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

Name: Moulting Scatter
Description: Looses 3 quills at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Gliding Bound
Description: Carries you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Hollow Bones
Description: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 8% faster.

Name: Loosed Mid-Stride
Description: Looses an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Parting Shot
Description: A heavy arrow that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles. It throws the target back 3 tiles and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Breathing Room
Description: Hops you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Strung by Stride
Description: Every stretch of ground you cover, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Hutch Kick
Description: A hind kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Bars Behind
Description: Drops a line of bars 5 tiles long for 4 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Slipped Latch
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Close Shave
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Raking Hindlegs
Description: Rakes the target with both hind feet for 4 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Mad Half-Minute
Description: Tears around clawing every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Soft-Footed Slink
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Lucky Ninth
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Gathering Stampede
Description: Barrels through everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 13 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Both Barrels
Description: A two-footed hind kick that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Clover Pasture
Description: Raises a patch of clover where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Rested Legs
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Link Skip
Description: Flicks a weighted link that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Run Rings
Description: Runs a loop of links round everything near you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Tripline
Description: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 25% for 3 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Slack Taken Up
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Pulled Thread
Description: Hooks a loose thread and runs with it, dealing 20 damage and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Flashed Scut
Description: Snaps a white cloth out in a flash, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 0.8 seconds. Each has a 40% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

Name: Out of the Hat
Description: After a 1 second cast, pulls a hare out from under a cloth. It fights beside you for 18 seconds, kicking an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Empty Sleeve
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Snap the Growth
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: a bite snaps it off for 8 damage, using it up and adding half its remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Mass Spawning
Description: Releases a cloud of sharp spawn, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each of them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Sunken Burrow
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Tide-Skipper
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, from silver your dodge chance rises by 8% on it, and from gold your stamina recovers 25% faster on it.

Name: Snapped Shut
Description: Clamps onto an enemy at or below 30% health for 20 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Death Roll
Description: Thrashes violently, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing them back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Held Breath
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Long Wait
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Springing Jab
Description: A bounding jab that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

Name: Flagged Alarm
Description: Stamps the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Startle Reflex
Description: Leaps you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Spooked
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Scent Lunge
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away for a bite that deals 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: End of the Chase
Description: Seizes an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Decoy Run
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. While it lasts, a hound runs beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Lurcher at Heel
Description: Calls a bonded lurcher that runs beside you, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites is slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Churned Wake
Description: Kicks up a wake of water 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 water damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Skimmed Sheet
Description: Kicks a sheet of water that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, throws it back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Rolls Right Off
Description: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Paddling Underneath
Description: You move 8% faster, and you have 10% water resistance.

Name: Seismic Thump
Description: Thumps a hind foot on the ground, dealing 3 earth damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Erupting Burrow
Description: Tunnels you to a target up to 6 tiles away and bursts up beneath it, dealing 15 earth damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Gone to Ground
Description: You drop into the ground and come up 3 tiles away. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Bolt-Hole
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Frozen in the Gaze
Description: Fixes a stare on the first enemy in its path, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Seen Faltering
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You bolt up to 7 tiles onto it and strike for 20 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and adding 1.3 times their remaining damage.

Name: Sentinel's Signal
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Second Look
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Stolen Mouthful
Description: A quick bite that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Mow the Rows
Description: Crops everything within 3 tiles ahead of you for 7 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Warren Supper
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Fuel for Running
Description: Whenever you are healed, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Hotfoot
Description: A kick with a burning foot that deals 9 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It burns you too, taking 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Friction Flashover
Description: Flame bursts from your tracks, dealing 30 fire damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Scorched Trail
Description: Raises a line of flame 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sparks at the Heels
Description: Every stretch of ground you cover, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Silverside Scatter
Description: Flicks 3 darting water bolts in a spread as you run; each deals 4 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Slick Rebound
Description: A kick that skids off the target, deals 14 water damage, drives it 3 tiles back and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It hits harder the farther away the target is, up to 1.6 times at 6 tiles.

Name: Wriggle Loose
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 30% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Never Quite Caught
Description: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 23% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Moonshot Drop
Description: Leaps onto a target up to 8 tiles away and deals 30 damage, up to 2 times that at the far end of the leap. It also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Ricochet Hop
Description: Pings a pellet that deals 7 damage, then hops to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles for 60% of that. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Across the Table
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Landing Bite
Description: Every stretch of ground you cover makes your next ability deal 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Trodden Toes
Description: A raking stamp that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows its movement by 15% for 2 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Last Mile
Description: A heel strike that deals 32 damage, always crits and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Marching Lungs
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Shorter Roads
Description: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 10%.

Name: Zigzag Dart
Description: Flings a pebble that deals 4 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

Name: Branching Scrape
Description: Scrapes dirt out in a cone 5 tiles long that deals 12 earth damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Sudden Jink
Description: Darts you 4 tiles in the direction you choose, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Either Way
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Doubling Back
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: you loop back on it and deal 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that from 6 tiles away.

Name: Scattered Musk
Description: Kicks up a ring of musk that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them 2.5 tiles back. Each has a 30% chance to turn on its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Briar Hideaway

Name: Damp Springs
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and you carry 8% water resistance.

Name: Grazing Lull

Name: Autumn Stores
