Description: Flings a tine that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

Name: Two Ways at Once
Description: Looses 2 tines at once, spread wide apart, each dealing 13 damage and knocking its target back 3 tiles.

Name: Crossed Prongs
Description: Crosses the tines before you, raising your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

Name: Splintered Haft
Description: Each time you strike, a splinter of the tines flies to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 4 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Sleight Toss
Description: Tosses a pocketed pebble that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to confuse it for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Baited Leavings
Description: Primes up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds. Each bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Under the Leaf Pile
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10%. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Skimmed Off the Top
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 6 mana. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Tongue's Length
Description: Snaps out at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Dredged Muck
Description: Flings a cone of pond muck 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Mud Coat
Description: Rakes a coat of mud over you: a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 5%. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Coiled to Spring
Description: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Turned Leaf Mould
Description: Turns the mould around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Spent Caps
Description: A finishing blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Mouldering Heap
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to rake up a mouldering heap beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds spores on enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Grows Overnight
Description: Against an enemy carrying a condition, your damage rises by 10%.

Name: Planted Shove
Description: Drives the butt of the haft into the target, dealing 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3 tiles.

Name: Crag Reach
Description: Reaches up to 7 tiles to a target and deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Unmoved
Description: Sets the haft and your feet: for 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Sure Footing
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, permanently.

Name: Bringing In the Hay
Description: Sweeps the haft round, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Herding Prod
Description: Prods a target up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

Name: Haystack Warmth
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 5 tiles, for 10 seconds.

Name: Winter Stores
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Loaded With Grit
Description: Blasts a cone of gathered grit 3.5 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it.

Name: Ramrod Shot
Description: Fires a packed slug that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Sighted Down the Haft
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to sight along the haft, then increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Ricochet
Description: When you land a critical hit, a stray pellet deals 6 damage to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Snarled Tight
Description: Whips a tangle of strands around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Pulled by the Roots
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Combs hard through the target, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Woven Hedge
Description: Weaves a hedge of strands 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Tangle Guard
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Tamped Down
Description: Brings the head down flat, dealing 15 damage and consuming every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Grade the Ground
Description: Drags the head level across a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to everything in it.

Name: Packed-Earth Stance
Description: Tamps the ground under you: the damage you take falls by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Level Every Plate
Description: Your blunt attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.

Name: Gathering Grasp
Description: Sweeps a 5-tile line ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Long Arm
Description: Reaches a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Easy Grip
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 7 seconds.

Name: Sure Hold
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.

Name: Kicked-Up Clods
Description: Looses 3 clods from the turned soil at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Harrow's Weight
Description: Drags the tines through the target with your full weight behind them, dealing 28 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Up the Rows
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with +5% dodge chance for it.

Name: Fallow Breath
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Barbed Fan
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Looses 3 barbs at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 40% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Rip It Free
Description: Tears the barbs back out of the target, dealing 22 damage and making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Snag and Reel
Description: Catches the tines on a point up to 6 tiles away and puts you there instantly.

Name: Barb Sets Deep
Description: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Thundering Sweep
Description: Sweeps the haft through a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Full-Tilt Thrust
Description: Levels the haft and drives it home, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Ride Abreast
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Hayfield Gallop
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.

Name: Beat the Brush
Description: Beats a cone of brush 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Hurls a bolt that deals 17 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Widening Search
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to cast. For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

Name: Scent on the Wind
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your critical hit chance by 15% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Breach the Guard
Description: Drives a tine through the target's guard, dealing 13 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunning it for 1 second.

Name: Burst Spokes
Description: Looses 3 tines at once, spread apart, each dealing 24 damage and bursting on impact to hit everything within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Anchored Plate
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Blackened Temper
Description: Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Tine in the Straw
Description: A quick jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Blind-Side Thrust
Description: A thrust from where it was not looking that deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Blades in the Leaves
Description: Takes 1 second to bury a blade under raked leaves at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Edge Kept Keen
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Shed Tail
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A lash that deals 8 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Strike From Stillness
Description: Lunges at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances.

Name: Basking on the Heap
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Midday Reach
Description: By day, your damage rises by 10%.

Name: Stripped Rows
Description: Strips every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 3 damage, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Swarm Off the Tines
Description: Flings a knot of the swarm that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts to hit everything within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Cloud Over the Field
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Nothing Left Standing
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Arcane Chaff
Description: Flicks a scrap of loose arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets.

Name: Gathered Static
Description: Releases the arcana gathered on the tines, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances.

Name: Glean the Leylines
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Residue of Spells
Description: Each time you spend mana, 4 mana comes back to you. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Correcting Stroke
Description: Strikes a target carrying one of your afflictions and uses it up, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Recited Furrow
Description: After a 0.8 second recital, drags a cone of arcana 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 damage to everything in it. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Repeat Recital
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Practiced Gathering
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Slow Reach
Description: Reaches a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Heavy Wallow
Description: Rolls your bulk around, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Mending
Description: Increases the healing you receive by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Drifting Bulk
Description: Your maximum health rises by 10%.

Name: Same Spot Again
Description: Bites the spot the last bite opened, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Rehearsed Frenzy
Description: Rats fan out in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Second Run-Through
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Maze-Bred
Description: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold your abilities come round 5% sooner.

Name: Venom Sippers
Description: Three rats dart ahead of you, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each bite deals 10% more for every affliction on its target (max 30%).

Name: Siphoned Sickness
Description: Bites out every affliction you have on the target: it deals 16 damage, with 60% more for each affliction used up, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. The target is left 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Cough It Up
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 10 health.

Name: Outlived the Dose
Description: As one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 8% poison resistance.

Name: Pile On
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and slams it for 15 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

Name: Hurled Packmate
Description: Throws a rat at the first enemy in its path. It bites for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Draw the Brute Off
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Knuckle Tally
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Inside the Breastplate
Description: A bite delivered from inside the target's plate: it deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Gnawed Buckles
Description: Bites at straps and buckles in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Loose-Fit Mail
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds.

Name: Scrap Harness
Description: Conjures armour pieced from gnawed scrap: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Hamstring Run
Description: Rats hack at ankles in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Timberfall
Description: A heavy chop at an enemy up to 3 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, then rats burst from the wound and bite every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Honed on the Handle
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Chips Fly
Description: Each time you land a critical hit, a rat bites the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Shriek on the Wing
Description: A winged rat stoops on the first enemy in its path with a shriek, biting for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Falling Roost
Description: The colony drops from above onto every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

Name: Rafters Cry as One
Description: The whole colony screeches at once, holding every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Night Shift
Description: At night, you deal 10% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Buried Under Fur
Description: The pack piles its whole weight onto every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each of them for 1 second.

Name: Lean Season Lunge
Description: A mauling bite that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 36%).

Name: Sleep Off the Winter
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

Name: Nowhere Left to Run
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Both Nests Empty
Description: Sends rats and bees out in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Barbed Parting Gift
Description: A weapon strike that leaves a barb in the target: it deals 9 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Verminous Hive
Description: Calls a mixed swarm of rats and bees that fights for 12 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1 second, each strike with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: One Stings, All Bite
Description: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Startled Flock
Description: Flushes a flock that hits every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and knocking them back 2 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Carrion Call
Description: Scavengers from the ground and the sky fall on a dying enemy for 26 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Hop, Flap, Gone
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds, and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Glide Into the Bite
Description: Every few paces you cover, your crit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Scurry Shot
Description: Looses 3 short arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. You move 12% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Peephole Shot
Description: An arrow loosed from hiding at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and ignores armour. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

Name: Covering Swarm
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 32% further. For the first 6 seconds, an escort of rats strikes your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Pincushion
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Snap of the Trap
Description: Sprung jaws close on the target for 14 damage, stun it for 1.2 seconds and leave it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Hunger Let Out
Description: Opens a cage of rats: 5 leap out at once, spread apart, each biting for 8 damage. Every bite is a critical hit.

Name: Chewed-Through Bars
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Sprung but Empty
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Pounce From the Skirting
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away for a raking weapon strike that deals 14 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Done Playing
Description: A killing bite that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Feet First
Description: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Waiting at the Hole
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Heel-Nip Drive
Description: Nips at the target's heels for 13 damage, drives it back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Murrain
Description: Rats foul the ground around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 6 seconds. The disease spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Byre Warmth
Description: Lays a nest of warm straw where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Fat on Feed Corn
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regain 0.5 health a second.

Name: Link by Link
Description: A line of rats tied tail to tail lashes the first enemy in its path for 8 damage, then whips on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Shackle Gang
Description: Rats tied tail to tail wind around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Tangle of Tails
Description: Throws a knot of rats ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: King of Knots
Description: A knot of rats bound by their tails runs with you as a familiar, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Pulled Thread
Description: Gnaws a thread loose from the target, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Moth-Eaten Wards
Description: The swarm chews through every woven protection in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. It ignores resistances.

Name: Thrown Dust Sheet
Description: Throws a sheet over you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the sheet comes off the moment you attack.

Name: Lined Burrow
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Festering Scrape
Description: A scrape against an enemy up to 2.5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Spur in the Gap
Description: Drives a spur of reef into a gap the rats have gnawed, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Warren Outcrop
Description: Raises a coral outcrop riddled with rat holes that stands for 15 seconds. Rats dart out of it to bite an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Wharf Runner
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.

Name: Clamp and Gnaw
Description: Lunges at an enemy up to 3 tiles away and clamps on for 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stunning it for 1.2 seconds. The gnawing leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Culvert Ambush
Description: Lunges up out of cover at every enemy within 3 tiles for 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Eyes Above the Waterline
Description: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later and you move 22% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Teeth That Keep Growing
Description: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and you regain 0.4 health a second.

Name: Lowered Tines
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and gores it for 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Alarm Drumming
Description: A shrill alarm and a stamped hoof hit every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Bound for the Treeline
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and bounds you 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Startle Reflex
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Shake It Dead
Description: Seizes an enemy up to 3 tiles away and shakes it for 22 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

Name: Rally the Kennel
Description: Rats and hounds surge out together in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Terrier Off the Leash
Description: Looses a terrier that hunts alongside your rats for 18 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Pack Closes Ranks
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, the pack closes around you as a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Surfacing Bite
Description: Comes up under an enemy up to 4 tiles away and bites for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, leaving it [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Ditchwater Flick
Description: Flicks foul water off your coat at every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

Name: Bob Up Elsewhere
Description: You dive and come up at a point up to 5 tiles away, and have 8% more dodge chance.

Name: Off the Oiled Coat
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. You have 8% water resistance.

Name: Tunnelled Lunge
Description: A rat burrows ahead of you in a line up to 6 tiles long and comes up under the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: The Hollowed Ground
Description: The undermined ground collapses under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Spoil Heap
Description: Throws up a ridge of dug earth 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Bolt-Hole
Description: Once your health falls below 30%, you go to ground behind a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Whisper Network
Description: Sends 3 scout rats out spread apart, each dealing 7 damage and leaving its target [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Set Upon the Seen
Description: The swarm falls on an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 18 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Wainscot Sentry
Description: Sets a watching rat in place for 10 seconds. It bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Never Caught Napping
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Snatched Morsel
Description: Darts at an enemy up to 3 tiles away and tears off a mouthful for 8 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Banquet Raid
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, where the swarm strips every enemy within 2 tiles of you for 12 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Pick the Bones
Description: The swarm strips every body within 6 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

Name: Whetted Appetite
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Scorched Litter
Description: Lights 3 rats and lets them run, spread apart, each dealing 3 fire damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Burning] for 4 seconds. The burning spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Tinder Nest
Description: Hurls a burning nest that deals 30 fire damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. It leaves the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Burning Straw Behind
Description: Lays a line of burning straw 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Cinder Whiskers
Description: A smouldering rat runs with you as a familiar, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Darting School
Description: Looses 5 rats at once in a tight fan, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Slipped Grip

Name: Puddle to Puddle

Name: Crouched in the Reeds
Description: After 6 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Spore-Dusted Rush
