Description: Sends a snapping set of jaws at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Whale Fall
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Heel-Swimmer
Description: A spurhound pup swims at your heel, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.

Name: Dabbling Snap
Description: Sends a bite at an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage and leaves it [Soaked] for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Underside Strike
Description: You strike from beneath at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 30 water damage that ignores resistance, up to 1.5 times as much at full range, and leave it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Slick Dive
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Skimming Cruise
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster on it, from silver your dodge chance rises 8%, and from gold your mana recovers 25% faster.

Name: Fin Through Bedrock
Description: Sends a tremor through the ground to an enemy up to 6 tiles away that erupts under it for 13 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full range, knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Fossil Spray
Description: Throws 3 stone teeth in a spread, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Seabed Rest
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 8 health.

Name: Flint Jaws
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Singled Out
Description: A strike that reaches an enemy up to 5 tiles away. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full range.

Name: Lidless Sweep
Description: Sweeps your gaze across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 9 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds and [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Tonic Stillness
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, then leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Nothing Unseen
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.

Name: Second Helpings
Description: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Everyone Eats
Description: You tear into every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

Name: Bone Gleaning
Description: Feeds on every body within 8 tiles, up to 5. Each one gives back 7% of your health.

Name: Fed and Fierce
Description: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Scalding Edge
Description: A weapon strike that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Rolling Boil
Description: Scalds every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 10 fire damage and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Warm-Blooded Surge
Description: Raises your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Blood Heat
Description: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Silver Scatter
Description: Looses 4 darting slivers of water at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

Name: Cut From the School
Description: A bite that deals 24 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It can only strike a target that low. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Through the Fingers
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +12% dodge chance for it.

Name: Wriggled Free
Description: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Sudden Landing
Description: Leaps you up to 7 tiles onto the target, then deals 13 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Pinprick Draught
Description: Flicks a barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Gorged Hop
Description: You spring 2 tiles and regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

Name: Next Host
Description: When you kill an enemy, a strike leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Miles of Hunger
Description: A thrown strike that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Stamping Wake
Description: A stamping turn that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Ceaseless Stride
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed by 15% for the first 5 seconds.

Name: Road-Fed
Description: Each time you cover enough ground, your damage heals you for 12% of what it deals for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Split Feed
Description: Sends a snap of water that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Two Currents
Description: A raking pass that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of you and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Other Flank
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a circling double that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

Name: Second Prong
Description: When you land a critical hit, a strike forks to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Flicker of Teeth
Description: Snaps a bolt of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet and a 20% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds.

Name: Grin Before the Lunge
Description: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit. It leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 6 seconds.

Name: Doubled-Back Trail
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Bait Taken
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Up From the Reeds
Description: A springing bite that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Belly Splash
Description: Lands with a slam that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1 second and restores 4 health to you.

Name: Bounding Lunge
Description: Springs you 4 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Still Before the Spring
Description: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Mouldered Wound
Description: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Bloom of Rot
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you takes a burst of spores that deals 26 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and is [Diseased], so healing does less for it, for 8 seconds. [Diseased] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles. You restore 8 health.

Name: Digesting Rot
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

Name: Threaded Through
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Snout First
Description: A ramming blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Over the Edge
Description: A weapon strike that deals 22 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It can only strike a target that low.

Name: Unmoved Hide
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Stood Ground
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Straggler Nip
Description: A darting nip at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Circling the Herd
Description: A full circuit that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for each ally near you (max 24%).

Name: Warm Flank
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 8 seconds. A circling escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Well-Fed Calm
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: First Report
Description: Fires a shot that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a target that has not been hurt yet, its critical chance is 50% higher.

Name: Scattershot Snap
Description: Blasts a short cone of shot ahead of you that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%).

Name: Cocked and Waiting
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 6 health.

Name: Hangfire
Description: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Thousand Fine Cuts
Description: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Snarl Line
Description: Strings a 5-tile tangle of strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Bristling Hide
Description: For 6 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Snagged Filaments
Description: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Pinned to the Floor
Description: A sweeping head-blow that deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Levelling Plunge
Description: Hurls a crushing column of water that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, and every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it takes 80% of that.

Name: Wide-Set Senses
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

Name: Ramming Skull
Description: When you strike an enemy, your physical damage rises by 33% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Wrung Dry
Description: A crushing grip that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Snatching Reach
Description: Grabs at a target up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, slows it by 20% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Locked Grip
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds and restores 6 health.

Name: Hold Fast and Feed
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Long-Ridden Charge
Description: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds after.

Name: Dust-Cloud Trample
Description: Tramples through a short cone ahead of you, dealing 6 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Warm From the Ride
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds and 6 health at once. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Never Unsaddled
Description: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Gaff Bite
Description: Casts a barbed line that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Reel It In
Description: Snags a target up to 6 tiles away at or below 25% health and deals 20 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. It can only strike a target that low.

Name: Line and Lure
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A circling escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Barbs Torn Loose
Description: Every hit you land sets a barb in that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it tears them all out: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per barb (20% at full). Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Gallop to the Kill
Description: Rushes you up to 8 tiles to the target and deals 13 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Stampede Wake
Description: A thundering circuit that deals 26 damage, ignoring armour, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you, and you move 25% faster for 5 seconds after.

Name: Full Gallop
Description: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +6% dodge chance for it.

Name: Gathered Momentum
Description: Each time you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Closing Distance
Description: Looses a bolt that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and draws out every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Tracking Nip
Description: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Quarry in Sight
Description: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Marked for the Chase
Description: Every hit you land marks that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Unrelenting Jaws
Description: A grinding bite that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Grinding Circle
Description: A grinding turn that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Cold Plating
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Last Plate
Description: When your health falls low, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health covers you for 7 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Out of Nowhere
Description: A sudden cut that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Quick Nick
Description: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Honed in the Dark
Description: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Drawn Red
Description: When you land a critical hit, your damage heals you for 15% of what it deals for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Tail Lash
Description: A whipping turn that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of you and knocks them back 3 tiles.

Name: Cold Snap Bite
Description: Snaps out at the first enemy ahead of you at or below 30% health, which deals 22 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. It can only strike a target that low.

Name: Basking Stillness
Description: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Shed and Regrow
Description: When your health falls low, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Gnawing Cloud
Description: Looses 5 biting specks at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Stripped to the Stalk
Description: A tearing bite that deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Ravening Swarm
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

Name: Field Picked Clean
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Arcing Nibble
Description: Looses a short cone of raw arcana ahead of you that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%).

Name: Arcane Undertow
Description: Lashes a target up to 6 tiles away with raw arcana that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Shocked], so nothing it has refills, for 5 seconds.

Name: Drink the Current
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 6 seconds and 6 health at once.

Name: Mana Into Flesh
Description: When you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Recited Mouthful
Description: Takes a mouthful from every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 6 damage and restores 3 health to you. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Practised Final Word
Description: Speaks a strike at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and ignores its resistances. Its damage rises 7% for every tenth of your own health already lost (max 35%).

Name: Another Lap
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Circling Recital
Description: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You also regenerate 0.4 health a second, permanently.

Name: Lazy Mouthful
Description: Lobs a slow bubble that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. 25% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Heavy Drift
Description: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles, slows it by 25% for 3 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Mending
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: Thick Blubber
Description: When something other than fire hurts you, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health covers you for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Read the Opening
Description: Bashes with the shield's boss, which deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of its health the target still has, up to 30%.

Name: Kata's End
Description: Turns a full circle on the shield's rim, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Second Nature
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Practice Pays
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Draw It Out
Description: Sends a bolt that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Dregs
Description: Upends the shield, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 2 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Bitter Return
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, for 7 seconds.

Name: Mithridate Lining
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 15% poison resistance.

Name: Both Fists Down
Description: Pounds the shield flat into the ground with both fists, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Overhand Wreck
Description: Brings the shield down two-handed, which deals 34 damage that ignores armour, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Chest Thunder
Description: Drums the shield against your chest: up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles are pulled onto you for 6 seconds, and your blunt damage rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: It Grips Back
Description: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Peel a Layer
Description: Hooks the shield's rim under the target's plates, which deals 4 damage and strips 6% of its armour for 5 seconds.

Name: Breastplate Toll
Description: Slams the shield against your own breastplate. The ring deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

Name: Plate on Plate
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Lamellar Coat
Description: Conjures a harness of plates behind the shield: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. The harness adds a further 5% armour.

Name: Hew the Front Row
Description: Chops the shield's honed rim through an arc 3 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Headsman's Drop
Description: Drops the shield's edge on a failing enemy, which deals 22 damage and splits its armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Notched Boss
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each attacker is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Weighted Edge
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Gong Shriek
Description: Strikes the shield's face. The sound deals 11 damage to everything in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Sounding Ping
Description: Bounces a pulse of sound off the shield's face that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then echoes to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Roost in Shadow
Description: Hides you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice all of you 60% later, and the veil breaks for anyone who attacks.

Name: Dusk Sentry
Description: At night, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Den Roar
Description: Roars over the shield's rim in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

Name: Whole Weight Behind
Description: Throws your full bulk behind the shield at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Full Height
Description: Rears to full height behind the shield: your maximum health rises by 20% for 12 seconds, and it restores 10 health.

Name: Winter Den
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Barb Left In
Description: Sends a guard bee from behind the shield that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slow Learner] for 6 seconds.

Name: Comb Rampart
Description: Raises a wall of comb 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on that enemy spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Sentries at the Entrance
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. A swarm of guard bees fights beside you for 9 seconds, stinging for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Hive Answers
Description: 12% of the damage you take is stung back into whoever dealt it. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Stoop
Description: Dives up to 7 tiles onto the target and lands shield-first, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles.

Name: Discus
Description: Sends the shield gliding at a failing enemy, dealing 18 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Alight and Brace
Description: Moves you 3 tiles from where you stood, raises your armour by 15% for 8 seconds and makes you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Carried on the Wind
Description: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Over the Rim
Description: Looses an arrow over the shield's rim that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Through the Slit
Description: Draws for 1 second behind the shield, then looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage that ignores armour.

Name: Pavise Battery
Description: Spends 1 second planting a standing shield with an arrow slit. It holds for 15 seconds and looses an arrow at an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.5 seconds, each dealing 5 damage.

Name: Drawn by Every Blow
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Lockdown
Description: Slams the shield's rim into the ground, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: The Bars Close
Description: Crushes a cornered enemy against the shield, which deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. The target is left [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

Name: Portcullis
Description: Drops a line of bars 6 tiles long across the ground ahead for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Double-Locked
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Off the Ledge
Description: Bats the target away with the shield's face, which deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Flurry of Swats
Description: Swipes the shield's edge across an arc 2 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Catch Me, Then
Description: Taunts up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds, and your dodge chance rises by 20% for 9 seconds.

Name: Whisker's Width
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Horns Down
Description: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and rams it shield-first, which deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 25%.

Name: Herd Surge
Description: Surges forward shoulder to shoulder and tramples every enemy within 3.5 tiles, which deals 28 damage that ignores armour. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

Name: Close Ranks
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Plods On
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Hurl and Haul
Description: Throws the shield out on its tether, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Running Links
Description: Casts a length of chain that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, then runs on to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that damage each. Each enemy hit is left [Hindered] for 4 seconds, and your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Shackled to Me
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

Name: Slack Taken Up
Description: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Billow
Description: Snaps your mantle out from behind the shield across an arc 2.5 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Colours to the Fore
Description: Hurls your woven standard to stand in the target, dealing 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Mirror Weave
Description: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Stitch in Time
Description: When a condition on you wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Reefshard
Description: Breaks a branch off the reef grown over the shield, at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, and throws it. It deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 60% chance to leave it [Slow Learner] for 6 seconds.

Name: Wave-Breaker
Description: Braces the reef-crusted shield and breaks forward through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or elite it adds 5% of the target's maximum health.

Name: Sheltering Reef
Description: Raises a living reef around the shield where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

Name: Slow Accretion
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Bank Lunge
Description: Lunges from stillness with the shield's edge and holds the target under it, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and stunning it for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Death Roll
Description: Holds still behind the shield for 1.5 seconds, then clamps it shut and rolls, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Against a boss or elite it adds 6% of the target's maximum health.

Name: Lure and Hide
Description: Lies still behind the shield: up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles are drawn onto you for 5 seconds, and the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Waiting Jaw
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Upsweep
Description: Scoops everything in an arc 3 tiles ahead on the shield's upturned edge and throws it, dealing 12 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles.

Name: Sidestep Jab
Description: Jabs with the shield's rim, which deals 7 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Bolt Under Cover
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: First to Flinch
Description: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You gain +5% dodge chance.

Name: Warning Snap
Description: Snaps at the target from behind the shield, which deals 4 damage and leaves it 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

Name: Call the Pack
Description: Barks from behind the shield in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Hackles Up
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A guard hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Shared Spoils
Description: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Spray Off
Description: Shakes the water off the shield as 4 droplets at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage and leaving what it hits [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Skip Across
Description: Skims the shield low across the ground, dealing 11 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Unruffled
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You regain 6 health.

Name: Rolls Right Off
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. You have 10% water resistance.

Name: Ridgeline
Description: Raises a ridge of jagged stone 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Slab Hurl
Description: Breaks a slab off the shield's stone face and throws it. It deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Ground Holds Fast
Description: Plants the shield for 0.5 seconds, then the ground seizes every foot near it: every creature within 4 tiles is held in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Flagstone Footing
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Sightline
Description: Fixes on the first enemy in its line and looses a bolt that deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries, up to 40%.

Name: Stripped by a Look
Description: Turns the shield's painted eye on everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistance and leaving each enemy [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Nothing Unnoticed
Description: Raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds, and you gain +8% dodge chance.

Name: Seen Once Already
Description: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike within 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Second Helping
Description: Bashes the target and takes a bite of what breaks off: it deals 7 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

Name: Board Is Laid
Description: Slams the shield down flat as a table between your allies, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You regain 10 health, and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Rations Behind the Line
Description: Passes food back from behind the shield: restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Fat of the Table
Description: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Furnace Door
Description: Swings the heated shield open and lets the heat out in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 2 tiles and setting it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

Name: Flashover
Description: Presses the red-hot boss into a failing enemy, which deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Ember Palisade
Description: Raises a palisade of flame 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Too Hot to Strike
Description: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, a bolt leaps from the shield to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 6 damage, and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Skipping Rim
Description: Skims your shield at the first enemy in its path, dealing 7 damage, and it slips off to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Bow Wave
Description: Sweeps your shield round through a wave of water, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2.5 tiles back. Each enemy hit is [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Slick Face
Description: Coats your shield in slick water: you take 15% less damage and gain 25% dodge chance for 8 seconds.

Name: Silver Scatter
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 2% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher.

Name: Vaulting Bash
Description: Leaps up to 7 tiles onto the target and brings your shield down on it, dealing 13 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Skyfall Landing
Description: Springs impossibly high and lands shield-first, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. A boss or elite hit also loses 5% of its maximum health.

Name: Hop to Cover
Description: Hops 3 tiles and raises your guard as you land, increasing your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and freeing you of every root, freeze and slow.

Name: Soft Landings
Description: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Forced March
Description: Marches your shield forward, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead and driving it 3 tiles back.

Name: Heel Stamp
Description: Stamps the rim of your shield down on the target's foot, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Column Drill
Description: Raises your armour by 15% for 15 seconds and your movement speed by 15% for 8 seconds, and breaks 1 root, freeze or slow on you.

Name: Well-Trodden
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Two-Way Rebound
Description: Throws your shield at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, and it rebounds to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the original damage.

Name: Tine Catch
Description: Catches the target's weapon in the forked edge of your guard and wrenches it, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It is [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Split the Blow
Description: Raises a forked guard that absorbs the next 20 damage across up to 2 blows, holding for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% while it holds.

Name: Either Way
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: False Opening
Description: Drops your guard, then slams it back up, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Each has a 40% chance to be confused for 3 seconds and attack its own side.

Name: Sucker Punch
Description: A hidden blow from behind your shield that deals 26 damage to a target at or below 25% health, and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

Name: Decoy Challenge
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A fox decoy fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Feint Ledger
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Spring Into Guard
Description: Springs up to 6 tiles at the target behind your shield, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.4 times as much from the far end of its reach.

Name: Splashdown
Description: Hops and lands on the edge of your shield, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Spring Clear
Description: Springs 3 tiles behind your raised shield, and for 2 seconds blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. It breaks 1 root, freeze or slow on you.

Name: Coiled Retreat
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have +6% dodge chance.

Name: Puffball Slam
Description: Slams your shield down in a burst of spores, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Mould on the Rim
Description: A strike with the mould-grown rim of your shield that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Mat
Description: Roots a bed of spores around your shield for 8 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

Name: Slow Fruiting
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Ram the Gap
Description: Butts the target with your shield, dealing 13 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Crag Slide
Description: Drives your planted shield through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to everything in it.

Name: Dig In
Description: Plants your feet behind your shield, reducing the damage you take by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Crag Stance
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% rock resistance.

Name: Turn the Herd
Description: Turns your shield across a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage and pushing enemies 2.5 tiles back. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4.

Name: Bellwether Blow
Description: Strikes one enemy within 5 tiles with your shield, dealing 30 damage. When it lands, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Barn Warmth
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally near you for 8 seconds.

Name: Winter Coat
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Scatter from Cover
Description: Fires 4 pellets through a port in your shield, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage and knocking what it hits 3 tiles back.

Name: Breach Round
Description: Fires one round from behind your shield at an enemy up to 9 tiles away, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour and leaving it [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

Name: Recoil Drive
Description: Fires a round into your braced shield and the recoil carries you 4 tiles forward.

Name: Return Fire
Description: When a blow from anything but fire lands on you, you fire back at the nearest enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Snare Line
Description: Casts a line of strands from your shield's rim at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 11 damage, binding it for 1 second, and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Bristling Flurry
Description: Shakes your shield and looses 5 stiffened strands, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Curtain of Locks
Description: Draws a curtain of strands around you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Woven Layers
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. When you reach 10, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pinned Flat
Description: Hammers your shield into the target at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Level the Ground
Description: Brings your shield down flat, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy hit is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Anvil Stance
Description: Sets your shield as an anvil that absorbs the next 24 damage across up to 4 blows and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Beaten Back
Description: When a blow from anything but fire lands on you, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Fling and Catch
Description: Flings your shield at an enemy up to 6 tiles away and catches it on the return, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Final Grip
Description: Grips a target at or below 25% health behind your shield and wrenches it, dealing 26 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

Name: Pull Clear
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you and from every ally near you.

Name: Steady Gauntlet
Description: Conjures a gauntlet for your shield hand: your maximum health rises by 12, your armour by 6% and your critical chance by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.

Name: Couched Charge
Description: Rushes up to 7 tiles at the target behind your lowered shield, dealing 32 damage. It always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Wheel and Bash
Description: Wheels about, dealing 4 damage with the rim of your shield to every enemy within 2 tiles.

Name: Hard Ride
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 6 seconds. It frees you of every root, freeze and slow.

Name: Endless Muster
Description: When you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Barbed Catch
Description: Snags the target on the barbed rim of your shield, dealing 10 damage, stunning it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Haul to the Rim
Description: Casts a hooked line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it in toward your shield and dealing 26 damage to each. A boss or elite caught also loses 4% of its maximum health.

Name: Snag the Bolt
Description: For 6 seconds, your shield catches elemental attacks: 30% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Caught and Covered
Description: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Thunder In
Description: Gallops up to 8 tiles to the target and rears behind your shield, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Run Them Down
Description: Rides down a target at or below 30% health with your shield, dealing 24 damage and consuming every affliction on it for 60% more damage each.

Name: Lead the Charge
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Gathered Speed
Description: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher.

Name: Bring to Bay
Description: Throws your shield at the first enemy in its path, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Flush the Covert
Description: Sweeps your shield through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 8 damage to everything in it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Stalking Cover
Description: Veils you behind your shield for 5 seconds: enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Quarry at Bay
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions. Your armour is 5% higher.

Name: Hex-Breaking Disc
Description: Hurls your shield at the first enemy in its path, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances.

Name: Clanging Front
Description: Strikes your shield through a cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Unbending Rampart
Description: Raises a wall of cold iron 6 tiles long for 8 seconds that blocks enemies and their missiles.

Name: Warding Chill
Description: 15% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it. You have 10% arcane resistance.

Name: Knives from Cover
Description: Looses 3 knives from behind your shield, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Counterstab
Description: Stabs past the edge of your shield, dealing 28 damage as a critical hit and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Hidden Edges
Description: For 8 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and blades behind your shield leave them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Finishing Edge
Description: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below half health. Your armour is 5% higher.

Name: Still, Then Strike
Description: Throws your shield at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 28 damage.

Name: Sunflash
Description: Turns the sun off the face of your shield through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage, stunning everything in it for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Name: Sun Ledge
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds and lifts 1 condition from you. You have 10% fire resistance while it lasts.

Name: Sunlit Bulwark
Description: By day, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Swarm Front
Description: Pushes your shield into a cone 3 tiles ahead under a cloud of locusts, dealing 10 damage with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Stripped Bare
Description: Grinds your shield into the target under a cloud of locusts, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Living Screen
Description: Calls a cloud of locusts around you for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Gleanings
Description: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher.

Name: Rebuking Word
Description: Speaks a word through your shield that strikes the first enemy in its path, dealing 9 damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Circle of Refusal
Description: Speaks a ward outward from your shield, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Spoken Ward
Description: Raises a spoken barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

Name: Rote Warding
Description: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Lazy Shove
Description: Nudges an enemy up to 3 tiles away with your shield, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Slow Swell
Description: Rolls your shield outward in a heavy swell, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. When it lands, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Becalmed
Description: Spends 1 second settling behind your shield, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 4 seconds. Afterwards they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Drifting Reserve
Description: When you run out of stamina, you recover 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Bulldozing Advance
Description: Drives your shield into an enemy up to 4 tiles away, dealing 14 damage and knocking it 3.5 tiles back.

Name: Hurled Bulwark
Description: Hurls your shield with everything you have, dealing 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Brute Summons
Description: Slams your shield down and draws up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Pent Force
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Drilled Broadside
Description: Looses 4 bolts at once, spread apart out to 8 tiles, each dealing 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Stolen Wind
Description: A cut that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

Name: Ready About
Description: Puts you about 3 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Sea Legs
Description: After you cover enough ground, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Scupper Wash
Description: Pumps a jet through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 2.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Damped] for 5 seconds.

Name: Heave It Overboard
Description: Throws the poison back at the first enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 16 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each. For 4 seconds after, you move 15% faster.

Name: Pump the Bilges
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies and restores 10 health. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Clean Bill of Health
Description: Your movement speed is permanently 8% higher, and you carry 12% poison resistance.

Name: Swing Aboard
Description: You swing up to 7 tiles onto the target and bring both fists down for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Belaying Pin Fling
Description: Throws a belaying pin for 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: Moves you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Topman's Grip
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 4% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 6% faster.

Name: Beaked Prow
Description: Rams the target for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Shields Along the Rail
Description: Slams a wall of shields through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and stunning each enemy for 1 second.

Name: Double Hull
Description: Absorbs the next 26 damage you take, for up to 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds, and you move 12% faster for the first 4 seconds.

Name: Copper Sheathing
Description: Every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, you move 4% faster, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Chop and Bear Away
Description: A chop that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 12% faster.

Name: Bring Down the Rigging
Description: Cuts the rigging down across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Cut the Cable
Description: Frees you from up to 2 conditions that hold or stun you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Boarder's Hatchet
Description: Conjures a boarding hatchet. Your weapon damage rises by 10% and you move 4% faster, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Echo Sounding
Description: Sends a pulse into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, then on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave its target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Colony Sortie
Description: Looses 3 bats in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 6 damage. 25% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Running Dark
Description: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Feeding on Passage
Description: After you cover enough ground, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Full Weight Under Way
Description: Shoulders into the target for 15 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Slamming Off the Swell
Description: Slams the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health to a boss or elite. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Winter Berth
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Slow to Gather Way
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Straight-Line Sting
