Name: Undermine
Description: You drop into the ground and come up at a spot up to 6 tiles away. You gain +8% dodge chance.

Name: Gravedigger's Hours
Description: At night, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Grub Raker
Description: Rakes the blade through the ground in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and throwing each enemy back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Deadfall
Description: Drops your whole weight behind the blade for 32 damage and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Winter Den
Description: You dig in and rest, regaining 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

Name: Dig In Deeper
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Burst Comb
Description: Flings a spadeful of broken comb as 3 shots spread apart, each dealing 4 poison damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Honey Mark
Description: You dash up to 6 tiles to the target and strike with the honey-smeared blade for 10 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Overturned Nest
Description: Turns over a ground nest. The swarm fights for 12 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

Name: Dawn to Dusk Digging
Description: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Haft Vault
Description: You plant the haft and vault up to 7 tiles to the target, landing blade-first for 15 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Winnowing Toss
Description: Tosses a spadeful of chaff to the wind in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 wind damage with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Robin at the Spade
Description: Turns a patch of soil, and a robin comes to it for 10 seconds, pecking an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Run-Up
Description: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Full Draw
Description: Draws the spade back to the shoulder and drives it out to full extension for 26 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

Name: Sprung Haft
Description: Bends the haft back against the ground and lets it snap, flinging its load as 3 shots spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Archer's Stakes
Description: Digs in a row of sharpened stakes 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Range Found
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 12. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (326% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Through the Bars
Description: Jabs the blade out at arm's length for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

Name: Oubliette
Description: Opens the ground under every enemy within 3 tiles and shuts it over them, dealing 14 earth damage and stunning them for 1.4 seconds.

Name: Buried to the Neck
Description: Packs earth around every creature within 3 tiles, holding them in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Bolt-Hole
Description: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you drop behind a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Scratch It Under
Description: Finishes weakened prey and scrapes earth over it for 20 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Gravel Spray
Description: Kicks loose dirt back in a ring, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each one [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Covered Tracks
Description: You scrape earth over your trail and are veiled for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Clawed Back Out
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Turned Furrow
Description: Drives the blade through the ground, cutting a furrow 4 tiles long that deals 7 earth damage to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Ox-Goad
Description: Prods with the full length of the haft for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3.5 tiles, and drives the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Plough Team
Description: Puts every ally within 5 tiles in harness with you: they strike 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fight with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Long Furrow
Description: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Flail Head
Description: Whirls the spade-head out on its tether for 13 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Picket Pin
Description: Throws a tethering stake that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Dragline
Description: Drags a chained scoop along a 6-tile line ahead of you for 5 seconds, hauling nearby enemies toward it and slowing those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Work-Song Cadence
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Ballast Sack
Description: Swings a sack of packed earth on the end of the haft for 14 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Tarp Crack
Description: Whips a dirt-laden groundsheet around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each one [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Sandbag Parapet
Description: Stacks filled sacks in front of you as a barrier that absorbs 24 damage for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

Name: Mud and Lint
Description: Once your health falls below 30%, you pack the wound with clay and bind it, regaining 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Barnacled Edge
Description: A strike with the reef-crusted blade that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Silt Cast
Description: Hurls a spadeful of dredged seabed that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Dug Tidepool
Description: Digs a pool where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Causeway
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, from silver your health recovers 12% faster on it, and from gold your dodge chance is 8% higher on it.

Name: Boggy Thrash
Description: Thrashes with the blade dug in and churns the ground to mud, dealing 28 earth damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each one [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Mudbank Roll
Description: Clamps the blade shut on the target and rolls it under the mud, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Waiting Pit
Description: Digs a covered pit at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 24 damage.

Name: Sunk to the Eyes
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Startle Shove
Description: Shoves with the flat of the blade for 12 damage, throwing the target back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Buck's Scrape
Description: Scrapes a ring of turned earth around you, dealing 4 earth damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

Name: Bolt from the Hollow
Description: You spring 3 tiles, then move 35% faster with +8% dodge chance for 6 seconds.

Name: Minded Distance
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Thrown and Fetched
Description: Hurls the spade for 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Flushed Quarry
Description: Drives the blade into the ground and breaks open what is hiding under it, dealing 26 earth damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Buried for Later
Description: Digs up what you buried and restores 16 health to you. The healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

Name: Terrier at Heel
Description: Calls a terrier familiar that digs and fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Skipping Clod
Description: Skims a flat clod that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each skip dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Burst Dyke
Description: Cuts through the bank and floods a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 water damage that ignores resistances to everything in it and leaving each enemy [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Heads Down
Description: You drop into a dug hole: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Runs Off Downhill
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

Name: Landslip
Description: Levers a boulder loose and sends it rolling. It deals 30 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Spall
Description: Strikes stone with the blade's edge, spraying chips in a cone 2.5 tiles long for 4 rock damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Tumbling Cairn
Description: Piles a cairn that stands for 10 seconds and sheds rocks on an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second, each hit with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Dug to Bedrock
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Dig at the Mark
Description: Drives the blade in where you marked for 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Survey Pegs
Description: Throws 3 survey pegs at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Sighted Line
Description: Raises the reach of your attacks and spells by 30% for 20 seconds.

Name: Staked Claim
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Heaped Mouthful
Description: Scoops a bite out of the target with the blade's edge, dealing 4 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and healing you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Pit Roast
Description: Uncovers a pit oven under your feet, dealing 26 fire damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Root Harvest
Description: Digs up a crop and shares it. It restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, more the faster you cast.

Name: Fed Labourer
Description: Whenever you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Cinder Fling
Description: Flings a spadeful of live coals in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 fire damage with a 50% chance to set each enemy [Burning] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Match
Description: Plunges the glowing blade into the target, dealing 12 damage and setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Coal Trench
Description: Digs a trench 5 tiles long and fills it with coals for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Bellows Work
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Wriggling Clod
Description: Hurls a clod of wet silt that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Sluice Cut
Description: Cuts a sluice that floods a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 14 damage to everything in it, throws each enemy back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Slip the Mire
Description: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Silt Scales
Description: Conjures a coat of dried silt scales: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.

Name: Leap the Cutting
Description: Vaults on the haft up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

Name: Lousy Spadeful
Description: Flings 3 clods of flea-ridden dirt at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

Name: Scrape to Scrape
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Spoil Heap Lodgers
Description: A bonded swarm of fleas from the spoil heap fights beside you, biting for 3 damage every 1 second. Each bite leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Mile After Mile
Description: A thrust that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Its damage rises 3% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

Name: Heel to the Tread
Description: Stamps the blade into the ground with your boot, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Marching Camp
Description: Digs a camp ditch where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Metalled Way
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Both Prongs
Description: Two thrusts of the tines, each dealing 4 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Parted Rows
Description: Rakes rows out from your feet, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Diversion Ditch
Description: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Between the Stones
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Under the Henhouse Wire
Description: A low strike that deals 30 damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Dirt in the Eyes
Description: Flings a spadeful of dirt in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Decoy Den
Description: Digs a false den at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles set it off: it deals 20 damage in a blast 2.5 tiles across.

Name: Always a Back Door
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Mud Gob
Description: Spits a gob of mud that deals 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Flycatcher's Reach
Description: A lash at full stretch that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and stuns the target for 0.8 seconds. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Sprung from the Bank
Description: Carries you 4 tiles forward and raises your movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

Name: Spadefoot's Burrow
Description: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Leaf-Mould Fling
Description: Flings a spadeful of spore-thick leaf mould in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Morning Flush
Description: A cut that deals 15 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Shallow Grave
Description: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles sprouts where it lies for 8 seconds, and gives every enemy within 4 tiles of it Rot for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Turned Compost
Description: When one of your afflictions runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Horns First
Description: A butt with the haft that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

Name: King of the Mound
Description: Clears the ground around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing each back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Heels Dug In
Description: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Won't Be Shifted
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pitched Turf
Description: Pitches a clod of turf that deals 6 damage. 25% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Break New Pasture
Description: Breaks the ground open around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Winter Fodder
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

Name: Deep Litter
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Fire in the Hole
Description: Lobs a blasting charge that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Loaded with Grit
Description: Fires 4 loads of grit at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage and throwing its target back 2 tiles.

Name: Rifle Pit
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to dig a pit beside you and set a loaded piece in it for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage.

Name: Parapet Rest
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8% and your armour by 6%.

Name: Root Ball
Description: Throws a root-bound clod that deals 6 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Knotted Runners
Description: Knots the roots under up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 5 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Wattle Hurdle
Description: Weaves a wattle fence 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Strands in the Daub
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Tamping Blow
Description: Brings the flat of the blade down for 18 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Levelled Ground
Description: Slams the ground flat, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and ignoring armour.

Name: Rammed Earth
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Post-Driver's Count
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Arm's Length
Description: A thrust that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: White-Knuckle Drive
Description: Drives the blade in with both hands for 32 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Spade Down the Line
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Worn Handle
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Ridden to a Standstill
Description: Runs a tiring target down with a blow that deals 18 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Lunge Ring
Description: Churns a ring of earth around you, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Long Haul Breath
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Dray Beast Alongside
Description: A bonded heidel hauls spoil beside you and fights, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. You can ride it.

Name: Dig the Barb Out
Description: A gouging thrust that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Snare Ditch
Description: Digs a 6-tile ditch lined with barbs ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Flukes Set Fast
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Gaff-Backed Blade
Description: Conjures a digging blade with a gaff on its back. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Tent-Peg Pass
Description: A thrust at the gallop that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 3% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

Name: Trampled Tilth
Description: Stamps the ground to churned earth, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Steeplechase Stride
Description: Carries you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.

Name: Sparks off the Flints
Description: Every few paces you cover, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 lightning damage. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Flush from Cover
Description: Throws a clod that deals 4 damage with a 35% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 16 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

Name: Sunk Hide
Description: Veils you for 10 seconds in a hide dug into the ground. Enemies notice you far later and you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Stopped Earths
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Cold Spike, Driven Home
Description: Drives a cold spike through the target into the ground. It deals 32 damage, ignoring the target's resistances, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Bog Ore Scatter
Description: Flings 3 lumps of bog ore at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Mortsafe
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it lasts.

Name: Shod in Grey
Description: Your armour rises by 12%, and you have 10% arcane resistance.

Name: Spinning Entrencher
Description: Throws the sharpened blade, which deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Put Under the Sod
Description: A finishing cut that deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

Name: Whetted Edge
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Sharp on Both Sides
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Sand-Swimmer
Description: Burrows up to 5 tiles to the target and strikes for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Shade-Cold Subsoil
Description: Flings a spadeful of cold subsoil in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Buried Clutch
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to bury a clutch beside you that hatches at once. The hatchling fights for 12 seconds: every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage.

Name: Sun-Baked Clay
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Eaten to Stubble
Description: A stripping cut that deals 26 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Hopper Trench
Description: Digs a 4-tile trench full of hoppers ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 7 damage to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Nothing Left to Bury
Description: Strips every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

Name: Gorged on Gleanings
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Strip the Overburden
Description: A scraping cut that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Down to the Ley
Description: Cuts into a ley line under the target for 34 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and ignoring the target's resistances.

Name: Dowsed Well
Description: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: The Lower Lode
Description: When your mana runs out, you restore 15 mana. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Mouthful of Loam
Description: Hurls a clod at the mouth of the first enemy it meets. It deals 10 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Circle Scored in Turf
Description: Scores a circle into the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

Name: Read from the Headstone
Description: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles rises and fights at your side for 30 seconds. It deals 5 damage a hit.

Name: Said Over the Dead
Description: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Broad-Backed Shove
Description: A long push with the flat of the blade that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and throws the target back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Grazed Seabed
Description: Stirs up the silt around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each [Stalled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Warm Wallow
Description: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

Name: Tomorrow Will Do
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Counted Strokes
Description: Strikes the target for 8 damage, leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Flawless Swath
Description: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Fresh Edge
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Gleaner's Second Pass
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Lance the Swelling
Description: A cut that deals 16 poison damage, draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn, then leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Carried Bitterness
Description: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long that deals 3 poison damage to everything in it and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Pare Away the Rot
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies and restores 12 health.

Name: Drawn Into the Blade
Description: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 8% poison resistance.

Name: Whirl by the Handle

Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Sweeps a full circle that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Repeated Clause
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Fresh-Cut Reagent
Description: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Lob
Description: Lobs a slow crescent of water that deals 5 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow Wake
Description: After a 1.5 second cast, rolls a wave 5 tiles ahead that deals 30 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Slowed] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

Name: Calm Shallows
Description: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Buoyant Reserves
Description: When you are healed, a shield worth 8% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Second Coat
Description: Sprays musk at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 15% for each affliction the target already carries (max 45%).

Name: Tight Grouping
Description: Looses 3 jets of musk in a tight spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 10 damage, knocking its target back 2 tiles and leaving it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Glands Primed
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Nothing Wasted
Description: When you inflict a condition, you regain 6 mana. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Draw the Venom
Description: Strikes an enemy at or below 30% health for 18 damage and draws out every affliction you have on it: 1.5 times their remaining damage is added to the blow and they are used up.

Name: No Known Remedy
Description: Sprays a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Snake-Eater's Blood
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Better Out Than In
Description: When you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Flung Handful
Description: Throws a handful of filth at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, with a 30% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drumming Threat
Description: Beats your chest and stamps both feet, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

Name: Handstand Bluff
Description: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Three Warnings Given
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Greased Vambrace
Description: A backhand with musk-smeared plate that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Seeps Through Steel
Description: Vents musk through every joint of your plate, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Musk-Lined Mail
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Wide Berth
Description: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Tainted Bit
Description: A chop with a musk-wet blade that deals 4 damage and leaves the cut [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Warned Once, Felled
Description: Holds the blade raised for 1.5 seconds, then swings a full circle, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Scored in the Dirt
Description: Chops a line 5 tiles long into the ground and fills it with musk for 8 seconds. Anything that crosses it is [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Spatter from the Cut
Description: When you land a critical hit, musk spatters from the cut onto the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Nose and Echo
Description: Sends a click and a whiff of musk into the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. It then echoes on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

Name: Nightfall Flyby
Description: Swoops to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and sprays as you pass, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Roost Mate
Description: Looses a roost-mate for 10 seconds that swoops on an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each pass with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Dusk Riser
Description: At night, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Swat on the Snout
Description: Swats musk into the target's face, dealing 15 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Blunted] and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Big Things Back Off
Description: Sprays a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it [Poisoned] for 8 seconds.

Name: Shared Winter Den
Description: Digs a den where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Fat and Foul
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.

Name: Snapped at the Entrance
Description: Snaps up the first enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage, then the next 2 within 3 tiles for 60% of that. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Smoke the Hive
Description: Blows a cone of musk-smoke 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Hindered] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Scratch at the Comb
Description: Scratches a hive open. For 12 seconds its swarm stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, and each kill restores 4 health to you.

Name: Steady Industry
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Overhead Drop
Description: Drops musk on an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 11 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Wingbeat Waft
Description: A wingbeat drives 3 gusts of musk in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Fanned Plume
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Owl-Wary
Description: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Held at Full Draw
Description: Holds the draw for 1.2 seconds, then looses a musk-dipped arrow at the first enemy within 10 tiles for 30 damage. It is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Rank Quiver
Description: Looses 3 musk-dipped arrows in a spread out to 8 tiles, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each kill gives one back.

Name: Downwind Reach
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Stamp, Stamp, Loose
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Closed Quarters
Description: Bars close on the first enemy within 6 tiles and musk fills them, dealing 26 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. The target is [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Reeking Bars
Description: Raises a row of bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that deals 12 damage to each enemy crossing it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Sprung Box
Description: Sets a box trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 20 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: Cornered Animal
Description: When your health falls below 35%, a jet of musk hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 15 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Stiff-Legged Pounce
Description: Springs onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and rakes it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: Arched and Hissing
Description: Arches and hisses across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave each target [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hackles Up
Description: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 15% for 10 seconds.

Name: Soft Step, Sour Strike
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Last Straw
Description: A horn-first shove that deals 26 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound and [Poisoned] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Warning Stamp
Description: Stamps a forefoot, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Stands in the Road
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Slow to Rile
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Bucket Brigade
Description: Sprays the first enemy within 6 tiles for 10 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Hobbling Blow
Description: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

Name: Leashed to the Smell
Description: Lays a musk-soaked tether 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it, slows those it catches by 20% for 3 seconds and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Pass It On
Description: When you inflict a condition, a jet of musk flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Gagging Wrap
Description: Throws a musk-soaked wrap over the face of the first enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Washing Line
Description: Strings a musk-soaked line 6 tiles long for 8 seconds that deals 11 damage to each enemy crossing it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Cover Scent
Description: Draws a musk-soaked shroud over you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the shroud breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Into the Weave
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Cast-Off Frond
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A strike with a frond broken from your own growth that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Spawning Cloud
Description: Releases a cloud of stinging spawn, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Bright Outcrop
Description: Plants an outcrop in warning colours that stands for 15 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds, each sting with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: What the Sting Leaves
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: The Long Wait
Description: A single bite that deals 34 damage, is always a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target already carries (max 40%).

Name: Snap at the Scent
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Snaps across a cone 3 tiles long for 9 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Water-Dance Bellow
Description: Bellows a warning that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

Name: Strikes as It Lifts
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Parting Spray
Description: Sprays the first enemy within 5 tiles for 11 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

Name: Herd-Wide Alarm
Description: Stamps the alarm, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Marked] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Caught Mid-Step
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, and you bound 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Flag and Bolt
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 18% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Follows the reek to an enemy at or below 30% health and bites for 20 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target already carries (max 40%).

Name: Coat Shudder
Description: Bounds to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and shakes the musk out of your coat, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. The poison spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Whole Pack Reeks
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Doused Hound
Description: A bonded hound fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving its target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Preen-Gland Stroke
Description: A weapon strike slicked with tail-gland oil that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each kill gives one back.

Name: Slick Underfoot
Description: Sprays oily musk across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Oilskin
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Rolls Off, Sticks On
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Digs Where It Smells
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Digging claws rake it for 9 damage and leave it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Dust-Up
Description: Kicks grit and musk across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Name: Only the Tail Showing
Description: Raises a barrier of packed dirt that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 6%.

Name: Deepest Tunnel
Description: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Blinked First
Description: A jet of musk into the eyes of an enemy at or below 25% health and up to 7 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaving it [Blunted] for 8 seconds.

Name: Every Lid Streaming
Description: Sprays a cone 4 tiles long at face height, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to everything in it and leaving it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Sighted Down the Stripe
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Sharp Focus
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Gorge on the Spoiled
Description: Bites the first enemy within 3 tiles for 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Clears the Table
Description: Lets go a reek that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

Name: Roadside Leavings
Description: Eats from every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

Name: Belch After Supper
Description: Each time you gain health, a belch of musk hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Flashpoint
Description: Lights a jet of musk that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Burns Its Own Oil
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. The musk in your coat catches, dealing 8 fire damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Smudge Pot
Description: Sets down a smouldering pot of musk for 10 seconds that burns an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each time with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Scorched Hide
Description: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You also have 15% fire resistance.

Name: Week-Old Catch
Description: Throws a spoiled fish that deals 26 damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles and leaves it [Diseased] for 8 seconds, then bursts over every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that damage.

Name: Spatter School
Description: Flicks 4 darts of musk in a spread out to 6 tiles, each of which deals 2 damage with a 25% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. The poison passes on its own to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Oiled Scales
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: The Bite That Missed
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a jet of musk strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Across the Table
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A musk-fed flea leaps from your coat to an enemy up to 8 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at maximum range, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Lands Reeking
Description: Leaps up to 7 tiles to your target and lands in a burst of musk and fleas that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Over Their Heads
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and leaps you 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Feeds Where It Itches
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Scuffed Line
Description: Scuffs a line of musk 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you that lasts 6 seconds. It deals 6 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Every Mile of Muck
Description: A kick with a road-fouled boot that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Plod On Regardless
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Right of Way
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 15%. Your other abilities come round 5% sooner.

Name: Jet That Divides
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Sends a jet of musk that deals 8 damage, then forks to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Twin Streams
Description: Fires 2 jets of musk, one from each gland, in a wide spread out to 6 tiles. Each jet deals 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Cuts Both Ways
Description: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Spare Nozzle
Description: When you land a critical hit, your other gland fires at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage, then the jet forks to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Somebody Else's Stink
Description: Flicks a dab of your musk onto an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It always crits and leaves the target [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Counted Your Coins
Description: Looses 3 jets of musk in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each jet deals 5 damage, and 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Rolled in It
Description: Masks your own scent under musk for 7 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Can't See for Crying
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Swallowed Whole
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Your tongue snaps out at the first enemy within 4 tiles and deals 20 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%).

Name: Weeping Skin
Description: Sweats toxin through your skin that deals 24 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and leaves each [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

Name: Gone at a Glance
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Toxin on the Tongue
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Ripe Puffballs
Description: Seeds up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles with puffballs for 30 seconds. Each one bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Settling Spores
Description: Puffs a cloud of stinkhorn spores at the first enemy within 6 tiles that deals 3 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Stink-Cap Stand
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a stand of stinkhorns beside you for 12 seconds. They shed spores on an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds, each time with a 35% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Fruiting Body
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, a puff of spores hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Off My Ledge
Description: A head-down butt, rank with billy musk, that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 9 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Eats Anything
Description: Bites the first enemy within 3 tiles and deals 16 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Butted Right Back
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hooves Dug In
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Every Head Comes Up
Description: Stamps a warning in time with the herd that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1 second. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 40%).

Name: Chewed Cud
Description: Spits a wad of sour cud at the first enemy within 6 tiles that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

Name: Barn-Warm Fug
Description: Lets a warm fug settle where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. A grazen from the herd fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Warmth Kept In
Description: When you gain health, the healing you receive is 30% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Five Good Shots
Description: Fires a jet of musk at the first enemy within 10 tiles that deals 9 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Both Barrels
Description: Discharges both glands with a bang across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 14 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

Name: Smoke Bank
Description: Lays a bank of foul powder smoke 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Bore and Choke
Description: Your poison damage cannot be resisted.

Name: Wet-Brush Lash
Description: A weapon strike wound in musk-soaked strands of your tail hair that deals 4 damage, tangles the target to slow it by 20% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Ten Thousand Snags
Description: Whips 6 musk-soaked strands out in a spread to 6 tiles. Each strand deals 4 damage, stuns its target for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Matted Mantle
Description: Raises a barrier of matted, musk-stiff fur that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Thickening Coat
Description: When you gain health, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Flattened Gland
Description: Hammers a full musk gland flat against the target, which deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Count of Three
Description: A hammering stamp of warning that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Baited Deadfall
Description: Takes 1 second to rig a musk-baited deadfall at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles drops it: it deals 20 damage in a blast around it and leaves each enemy hit [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: While They Gag
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Palmed Dose
Description: A weapon strike with musk smeared across your palm that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Wafted Their Way
Description: Fans musk with an open hand across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hold Your Nose
Description: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 8 health to you.

Name: Grip That Won't Wash
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Tail Up, Hooves Out
Description: A kick from both hind hooves with your tail raised that deals 11 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 6 seconds.

Name: Team Leans In
Description: Sprays a ring of musk that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies pull together and deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Nosebag Rest
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Rank in the Traces
Description: A bonded heidel fights beside you, kicking enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.8 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. You can ride it.

Name: Snagged on the Scent
Description: Casts a musk-baited hook at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Torn Free
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike that rips the barb back out, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Led by the Nose
Description: A baited reek pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Barb Stays In
Description: 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Ridden Down
Description: Gallops you to a target up to 8 tiles away for a weapon strike that deals 15 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Dust Still Hanging
Description: Leaves a trail of musk and hoof-dust 7 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. It deals 24 damage, ignoring resistances, to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Upwind at a Gallop
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

Name: Hoofbeat Pace
Description: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Scent-Trail Finish
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A finishing blow that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Tagged for the Pack
Description: Sends a jet of musk at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Slipped the Leash
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a hound on the scent for 15 seconds. It bites an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Quarry Worn Down
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.

Name: Cold Rebuke
Description: A blow with cold iron that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Tarnishing Wave
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A wave of sulphurous musk deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to tarnish its armour and leave it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Stood Its Ground
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds, and you have 20% more poison resistance while it holds.

Name: Seasoned Like a Skillet
Description: Your armour rises by 14%, and you have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Edge From Behind
Description: A weapon strike from the blind side that deals 32 damage, always crits and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Unannounced
Description: Throws a musk-wet sliver at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, it has 50% more crit chance.

Name: There Before They Turn
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Fair Warning Expired
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 50% more crit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Bitten, Then Followed
Description: A foul-mouthed bite that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 10 seconds.

Name: Shed and Thrashing
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sheds the tip of your tail, which thrashes musk across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Long Noon Basking
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds, and you have 20% more poison resistance while it lasts.

Name: Left the Tail Behind
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 5 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Stripped to the Stalk
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A swarm strips everything in a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 9 damage with a 40% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Plague Hop
Description: Throws a clot of musk-fed locusts at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 14 damage. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Chewing Haze
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of locusts and musk for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Next Field Over
Description: When you kill an enemy, the swarm moves on to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage, slowing it by 25% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Unfiltered
Description: Hurls a bolt of musk and raw arcana at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 30 damage, ignores resistances and leaves the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Sympathetic Reek
Description: Looses 3 bolts of musk-laced arcana in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each bolt deals 6 damage, and your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Carries Further
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 65% further.

Name: Residue as Reagent
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Words Choked Off
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sends a jet of musk into the mouth of the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 6 damage and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Silenced Mid-Word
Description: A burst of musk deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

Name: Practiced Cadence
Description: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. A haze of musk fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Rote Habit
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Slow Roll of Musk
Description: Rolls out a slow-drifting glob of musk that deals 12 damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles and knocks it back 2.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Lazy Cloud
Description: Breathes out a cone of musk 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Slowed] for 8 seconds.

Name: Nothing Urgent
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to hold every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leave each enemy caught [Damped] for 6 seconds.

Name: Gentle Recovery
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Remedial Lesson
Description: A rap that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it a [Slow Learner] for 8 seconds: your thorns bite it deeper, and barriers it strikes grow stronger. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Marginal Notes
Description: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances, and its damage rises 15% for each of your afflictions on the target (max 60%).

Name: Economy of Motion
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds.

Name: Another Pass
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Bitter Vapour
Description: Breathes a vapour across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 poison damage to everything in it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Drawn in Good Time
Description: Consumes every affliction you have on the target: deals 16 damage and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Bland Diet
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 12 health.

Name: What the Dose Leaves
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Deadweight Hug
Description: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and goes on crushing it for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Bough Breaker
Description: Slams down with your full weight, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores their armour. Everything hit is [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Chest Drum
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow to Anger
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (48% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Dead Stop
Description: A weapon strike that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaves it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 40% for 4 seconds.

Name: Struck Breastplate
Description: Rings your breastplate in a blow that deals 7 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Also costs 3% of your maximum health.

Name: Plates at Rest
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 15 seconds.

Name: Mossback Harness
Description: Equips armour that lowers every hit you take by 2, raises your armour by 10% and raises your maximum health by 12.

Name: Canopy Drop
Description: Drops you onto a target up to 6 tiles away, then the falling axe deals 16 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 7 seconds.

Name: Hobbling Toss
Description: Throws the axe at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slows the target by 40% for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Whetstone Hour
Description: After a 2-second pause to whet the edge, increases your damage by 35% for 20 seconds.

Name: Stump Sitter
Description: Each time you kill an enemy, you recover 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Lullaby Shriek
Description: Lets out a low shriek across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 resonating damage, stuns everything in it for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

Name: Quiet Nip
Description: A bite that deals 4 dark damage to the first enemy it meets, heals you for 25% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Daylight Roost
Description: Veils you and every ally near you for 10 seconds and restores 12 health. Enemies notice you 65% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Nocturnal Habit
Description: At night, your armour rises by 12%. You have +5% dodge chance at all times.

Name: Roused Too Early
Description: A sweep that deals 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Winter Reserves
Description: A weapon strike that deals 10 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds and slows it by 30% for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Short Hibernation
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

Name: Waking Hunger
Description: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Drowsy Drones
Description: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each of which deals 2 poison damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds. [Hindered] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Honeyed Barb
Description: A weapon strike that deals 6 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Let the Hive Work
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. A swarm of bees fights beside you for 9 seconds, stinging for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Idle Hands, Busy Wings
Description: The moment your stamina is full, a bee flies to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Downdraft
Description: Sends a downdraft across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 wind damage, knocks everything in it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Circling Wait
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Stoops on a target up to 8 tiles away and deals 20 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: Easy Descent
Description: Moves you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

Name: Soft Landing
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Loose When Ready
Description: An arrow loosed at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and slows the target by 20% for 3 seconds.

Name: The Long Hold
Description: After a 2-second draw, fires an arrow that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour.

Name: No Need to Walk
Description: After a 1.5-second cast, your attacks and spells reach 40% further for 30 seconds.

Name: Tension Kept
Description: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Bar by Bar
Description: Sends an iron bar that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Muzzled Menagerie
Description: Locks every enemy within 4 tiles in bars, which deals 26 damage and leaves them [Suppressed] for 5 seconds, their auras smothered and their abilities out of reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

Name: Everything Stays Put
Description: After a 1-second cast, holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Lock and Lean
Description: Each time you afflict something, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Pounce From Stillness
Description: Springs you onto a target up to 7 tiles away and rakes it, which deals 15 damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Full-Length Stretch
Description: A stretch with every claw out that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Nine-Tenths Asleep
Description: Restores 12 health and increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Do Not Disturb
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Plodding Tread
Description: A plodding stamp that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Gore
Description: Gores a target, which deals 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Grazing Ground
Description: Raises a patch of pasture where you stand, reaching 3.5 tiles. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Draught Strength
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 10% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your mana recovers 15% faster.

Name: Dragging Links
Description: Casts a weighted chain that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: Hauls you along a chain to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Sea Anchor
Description: Drops an anchor ahead of you on 6 tiles of chain. For 7 seconds it drags every enemy near it inward, and anything it catches moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: No Link Slips
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Swaddle
Description: Throws cloth that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Smothering Drape
Description: Drops a heavy drape over every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 12 damage and leaves them [Damped] for 8 seconds, their damage lowered. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Tuck In
Description: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

Name: Cocoon Reflex
Description: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health wraps you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Seal the Growth
Description: A stroke that deals 10 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Leaden] for 8 seconds, its Speed drained. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Polyp Bloom
Description: Stings every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 3 poison damage and leaves them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Breakwater by Inches
Description: Grows a reef 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 9 seconds, and restores 10 health.

Name: Accretion
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Roll Them Under
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Clamps on and rolls, which deals 26 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Surfacing Snap
Description: Lunges across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 28 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Log in the Shallows
Description: Veils you for 15 seconds: enemies notice you 75% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Waits for the Weak
Description: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises 14%.

Name: Caught in the Open
Description: A shot at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, with a 20% chance to leave it [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Hooves Planted
