Description: A stamp that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Stock Still
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Saw It Coming
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would have hit you is rolled a second time against your dodge, and the second roll stands.

Name: Locked Jaw
Description: Bites down and holds on, which deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.3 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Porch Howl
Description: A long, low howl across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 resonating damage and leaves everything in it [Weakened] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Let It Lie
Description: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hearthside Hound
Description: A bonded old hound keeps beside you. Every 2.2 seconds it bites an enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 7 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Slack Water
Description: Sends a slow ripple that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Enervated] for 8 seconds, so its health, mana and stamina return slower.

Name: Flat Water
Description: Sends a wave out from you that deals 28 water damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances and leaves them [Soaked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Off the Back
Description: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Drift Paddle
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank your health regenerates 15% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Creeping Scree
Description: After a 2-second rumble, a slide of scree crosses a cone 5 tiles long and deals 30 earth damage to everything in it. It ignores armour and leaves everything hit [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Weathering Blow
Description: A grinding blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 12 seconds.

Name: Older Than Hills
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Silt Settles
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Heavy Lids
Description: Fixes a gaze on the first enemy in its line, which deals 11 arcane damage, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Leaden] for 6 seconds, its dodge lowered.

Name: The Slow Blink
Description: One slow blink across a cone 4 tiles long deals 7 arcane damage to everything in it and leaves it [Stalled] for 6 seconds, so its abilities return slower. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Fixed Regard
Description: After a 1.5-second look, increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 20 seconds.

Name: Stared Down
Description: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Month-Long Meal
Description: Takes a bite that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. 50% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 8 seconds.

Name: Food Coma
Description: Sends out a wave that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1.2 seconds and leaves them [Fatigued] for 8 seconds.

Name: Second Stomach
Description: Healing you receive rises by 40% for 20 seconds.

Name: Larder for Later
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Banked Coal
Description: A weapon strike that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 15 seconds.

Name: Stir the Cinders
Description: Breathes a bolt that deals 16 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 60% more damage for each one used up.

Name: Raked Ember Line
Description: Lays a line of fire 5 tiles long in front of you for 10 seconds. It deals 4 fire damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Not Quite Out
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, a bolt of fire strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 7 damage. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Silver Needles
Description: Looses a shoal of 3 silver needles, spread apart, and each one deals 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Played Out
Description: Casts a line at an enemy within 7 tiles that is at or below 25% health and deals 26 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at the end of its reach.

Name: Let It Slide
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to slide off and land on whoever laid it instead.

Name: Slick Hide
Description: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield of 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Hop Along
Description: Flicks a biting speck that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

Name: Long Way Down
Description: You spring up to 7 tiles onto the target and land with your whole weight, dealing 16 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Itch and Jink
Description: You hop 3 tiles from where you stood and settle there, with your dodge chance raised by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Fur Tenants
Description: A colony living in your fur leaps out at enemies within 4 tiles, biting for 3 damage every second. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Every Step Counted
Description: Stamps down, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each stretch you have walked, up to 50%.

Name: Unhurried Kick
Description: A kick that deals 12 damage, knocks the target 2.5 tiles back and leaves it [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. It moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Steady Lungs
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Rest Stop
Description: When you have walked a long way, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Split Decision
Description: Throws a bolt that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on the first target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Tine After Tine
Description: Two quick prongs, each of which deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Crook of the Bough
Description: You wedge yourself in place: your armour rises by 20% and your dodge chance by 10% for 12 seconds.

Name: Second Tine
Description: When you kill an enemy, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Opened One Eye
Description: A strike that deals 22 damage to a target at or below 25% health, leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Drowsy Ruse
Description: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes a blow that deals 10 damage and is stunned for 0.8 seconds. Each has a 40% chance to turn against its allies for 3 seconds.

Name: Dead to the World
Description: You go limp and vanish from notice for 8 seconds, regaining 12 health at once. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Never Quite There
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Sticky Tongue
Description: Flicks your tongue at the first enemy in reach and deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Heavy Landing
Description: You drop your full weight onto the ground, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. Each has a 50% chance to be [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

Name: Buried in Mud
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Coiled Haunches
Description: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Shed Spores
Description: Shakes spores loose on every enemy within 2.5 tiles: each one takes a puff that deals 3 damage and is [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 12 seconds.

Name: Fruiting Body
Description: A blow that deals 18 damage and bursts every affliction you have on the target, uses them up, and deals 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Moss Takes Over
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

Name: Grows on Anything
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 8% poison resistance.

Name: Brow Shove
Description: Leans your forehead into the target, dealing 14 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Pinned to the Rock
Description: A horned strike that deals 32 damage, ignoring armour, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Won't Budge
Description: You plant yourself: the damage you take falls by 30% for 12 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

Name: Dig In
Description: When your health falls low, you gain a shield of 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Shoulder to Shoulder
Description: A shove that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Closed Ranks
Description: Raises a 5-tile wall ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and each enemy it catches takes a blow that deals 12 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

Name: Circle the Calves
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Winter Coat
Description: Your maximum health rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Took My Time
Description: Takes 2 seconds to aim, then fires a shot that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Muzzle Flash
Description: A blast of smoke and sparks that deals 10 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, stuns each one for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Long Fuse
Description: Takes 1 second to set a charge at the nearest enemy. It arms after 3 seconds and waits up to 12 seconds; the first enemy within 2 tiles sets it off, and it deals 24 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Waited for the Shot
Description: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Snarled Line
Description: Strings a 5-tile tangle of strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. Each one it catches takes a lash that deals 10 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

Name: Garrote
Description: Whips a cord of strands around an enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Matted Fleece
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

Name: Grown Over
Description: When a condition on you wears off, you gain a shield of 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Overdue Blow
Description: A long-delayed blow that deals 40 damage plus 6% of a boss or elite's maximum health, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

Name: Tamping Down
Description: A short pounding that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Anvil Hide
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Beaten Level
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once in one more blow on it for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Wring Out
Description: Squeezes the target, using up one of your afflictions on it to deal 8 damage and leave it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Never Let Go
Description: Reaches out up to 4 tiles to an enemy at or below 30% health and deals 26 damage. It moves 40% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Hang and Rest
Description: You hang by your grip and rest, restoring 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds.

Name: Tightening Grip
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Thrown Shoe
Description: Hurls a worn shoe that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Stampede at a Walk
Description: Drives a plodding herd through a cone 6 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage to everything in it plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaving each one [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Pack Beast
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a tireless beast that fights beside you for 20 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each strike has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Bottomless Wind
Description: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Caught on the Barb
Description: Casts a barb at an enemy within 6 tiles that deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

Name: Raking Sweep
Description: Rakes your claws through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 3 seconds.

Name: Snag Line
Description: Strings a 6-tile line of snags ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Nothing Gets Loose
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Long Run-Up
Description: A hoof-driven blow within 8 tiles that deals 10 damage, up to 2 times as much at its farthest reach. It knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Thunder Underfoot
Description: Pounds a 4-tile track of hoofbeats ahead of you for 4 seconds. It deals 4 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Barded Plod
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after you use it.

Name: Built-Up Stride
Description: When you have walked a long way, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Cold Trail
Description: A thrown jab at an enemy within 7 tiles that deals 5 damage and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Strikes a target at or below 25% health for 20 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Lying in Wait
Description: You hold still and watch: your critical chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Scent Taken
Description: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Ballast Blow
Description: A weighted strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Final Rivet
Description: A blow against a target at or below 25% health that deals 24 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Unbinding Chill
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you.

Name: Dead Weight
Description: Your armour rises by 12%, and you have 8% physical resistance.

Name: Behind the Knee
Description: A low cut that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Slowed] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Tucked Blades
Description: Flicks a hidden blade at an enemy within 6 tiles that deals 6 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Whetted in Idle Hours
Description: Your critical hits deal 30% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Retracted Claws
Description: Conjures a set of long claws. They increase your weapon damage by 12% and your maximum health by 10, and every strike with them leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Torpid Hiss
Description: A cold hiss that deals 3 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

Name: Bite and Wait
Description: A venomous bite that deals 25 damage, ignoring resistance, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 12 seconds.

Name: Regrown Tail
Description: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Torpor Sets In
Description: When your health falls low, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Lingering Cloud
Description: A cloud settles over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage and gnawing at each for 1 damage a second for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Strip to the Stalk
Description: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, using up one of your afflictions on it to deal 8 damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Settling Plague
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 15 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each bite has a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

Name: Gorge by Degrees
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Thickened Air
Description: Breathes thick arcana in a cone 4 tiles ahead, using up one of your afflictions on each target to deal 7 damage. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Spell Left Simmering
Description: Lays a spell on an enemy within 7 tiles that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistance, 6 seconds later. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries by then, up to 50%.

Name: Everything Waits
Description: Takes 1 second to cast, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Afterwards each one is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Steady Trickle
Description: When you spend mana, you restore 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Hush
Description: Speaks a word at the first enemy in reach that deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Droning Lecture
Description: A monotone recitation that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Recited at Leisure
Description: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Spoken Ward
Description: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and you gain a shield of 6% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Undertow
Description: Lays a 4-tile current ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 6 damage to each one it catches and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Lazy Bubble
Description: Blows a drifting bubble that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Warm Shallows
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and your party for 10 seconds.

Name: Buoyant Bulk
Description: You float and paddle across water and swamp as easily as solid ground.

Name: Refined Dosage
Description: Spits venom that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

Name: Once, Correctly
Description: A single practised bite that deals 32 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Return to the Coil
Description: You recoil 2 tiles from where you stood, and the cooldown clears on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Economy of Motion
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.

Name: Lanced and Drawn
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. The venom is drawn back out as a bolt that deals 8 poison damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Spoiled Remedy
Description: Breathes a bitter mist 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 poison damage to everything in it and ignores resistances. Each target is left [Diseased] for 10 seconds, so healing does less for it.

Name: Milked for Serum
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health to you.

Name: Hardened by Trace Amounts
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Strangler's Heave
Description: A crushing hold that deals 14 damage, throws the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Flung Viper
Description: Throws a live viper at an enemy up to 6 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Bough Drop
Description: Swings you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Anchored Mass
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Between the Plates
Description: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Spalled Scales
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A burst of hardened scales that deals 8 slashing damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Venomous Rebuke
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Overlapping Hide
Description: Overlapping scales harden you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.

Name: Rearing Verdict
Description: A downward blow that deals 28 slashing damage to everything in the 3 tiles ahead of you and ignores armour. Each target is left [Poisoned] for 8 seconds.

Name: Seeping Gash
Description: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and has a 35% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Poised Above the Neck
Description: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Severed, Still Biting
Description: Each time you kill something, a bolt leaps from the body to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Thinned Blood
Description: Spits thinning venom that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Hollow Echo
Description: A hiss that carries 4 tiles ahead of you and deals 11 resonating damage to everything in it. It stuns each target for 1 second.

Name: Heat-Pit Sense
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Taking the Warmth
Description: When you land a critical hit, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Autumn Gorging
Description: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Rolling Maul
Description: A crushing roll that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks each back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Brumation
Description: You go still and restore 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Full-Bellied Fury
Description: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Many Small Doses
Description: Looses 4 small fangs in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each deals 3 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: The Full Measure
Description: Fires one long fang that deals 15 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Knot of Hatchlings
Description: Turns loose a swarm of hatchling vipers for 14 seconds. It bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Immunity Is a Rumour
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Canopy Glide
Description: You glide onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and bite. The bite deals 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 7 tiles, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Egg-Tooth Crack
Description: A sharp bite that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Flattened Ribs
Description: You flatten your body and glide 4 tiles forward, then move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Stalker's Pace
Description: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Held at Full Draw
Description: Looses one strike at an enemy up to 8 tiles away. It deals 27 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, is always a critical hit, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Gall-Tipped Shafts
Description: Looses a fang-tipped arrow that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spitter's Reach
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: Straight to the Blood
Description: Your poison damage cannot be resisted.

Name: Final Exhale
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The squeeze deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Pit of Many
Description: A ring of vipers that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Living Palisade
Description: Raises a wall of coils 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Each Breath Tighter
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Crouch Then Spring
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and bite. The bite deals 13 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Borrowed Hiss
Description: A hiss carries 3 tiles ahead of you. It deals 4 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Still in Long Grass
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 11% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Flinch Before the Strike
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again, and the second roll stands.

Name: Rattle Through the Herd
Description: A rattled warning deals 26 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Lowered Head
Description: A headbutt that deals 5 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

Name: Chewing It Over
Description: You restore 10 health at once and 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow to Anger
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Link to Link
Description: Sends a bite into the first enemy it meets that deals 11 poison damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles for 60% of that, and your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: End of the Tether
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. A lash at up to 6 tiles deals 9 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and wraps the target so it moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Dragging Loops
Description: Lays a line of loops 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Whispered Onward
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Pulled Thread
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. The strike deals 9 damage and unravels the target's guard, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Cast-Off Slough
Description: Throws your shed skin across the 3 tiles ahead of you. It deals 4 damage to everything it lands on and leaves each target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Empty Skin
Description: You leave your shed skin behind and slip 2 tiles from where you stood. For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Wound Dressing
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health wraps you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Bloom of Barbs
Description: Fires a stinging cell that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 2 tiles for 60% of that.

Name: Spawning Night
Description: A burst of stored venom that deals 28 poison damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and is always a critical hit. Each target is left [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Crevice Lurker
Description: Raises a reef head where you stand for 14 seconds. A sea krait strikes from its crevices at an enemy within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Krait's Crossing
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Drowning Roll
Description: A clamping roll that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Mud-Bank Lunge
Description: You rush up to 5 tiles to the target. The weapon strike deals 14 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Eyes at the Waterline
Description: Veils you for 9 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 6% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Longer the Wait
Description: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 40% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Glancing Nip
Description: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You spring away 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

Name: Frozen at the Rustle
Description: A sudden strike that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each of them for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Flight Response
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and springs you 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

Name: Stepped On
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Trailing the Bitten
Description: Strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away. The strike deals 16 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Locked Jaw
Description: A bite that holds on: it deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

Name: Threat Display
Description: You pull up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Viper-Mouthed Hound
Description: A bonded hound with a viper's bite fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Wake Across the Pond
Description: You cut across the surface and send a wake 4 tiles ahead of you. It deals 11 water damage to everything in it, knocks each target back 2 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Taken From Below
Description: A weapon strike from underneath that deals 19 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 70% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Returned to Sender
Description: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Unrippled Surface
Description: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Fang of Bedrock
Description: Hurls a fang of stone that deals 28 rock damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds, then shatters, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Ground-In Grit
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Under the Flat Rock
Description: Sets a flat stone with a viper under it at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the viper deals 18 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: Felt Through Flagstones
Description: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Lidless Stare
Description: Your stare fixes on the first enemy in its path: it deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.4 seconds.

Name: Unbroken Regard
Description: A look held on an enemy up to 8 tiles away deals 26 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and ignores resistances. The target is left [Marked] for 10 seconds.

Name: Slow Sway
Description: Your swaying gaze holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds. When it lets go, they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Never Looks Away
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again, and the second roll stands.

Name: Swallowed Whole
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The bite deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Passed Around the Table
Description: Serves venom to the 4 tiles ahead of you: it deals 12 poison damage to everything in the cone and leaves each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Nothing Left Over
Description: You swallow every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

Name: Fourth Course
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Venom Set Alight
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. You spit venom through flame across the 3 tiles ahead of you: it deals 9 fire damage to everything in the cone and sets each target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

Name: Fever Breaks
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The bite deals 20 fire damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Basking by the Coals
Description: You regain 8 health at once, and your attack speed rises by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Heat Signature
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Needles in the Shoal
Description: Spits 3 venom needles in a spread; each deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Silver Dart
Description: Looses a darting fang that deals 8 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

Name: Shed and Slip Away
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Venom in Every Miss
Description: Every blow you avoid builds a stack of venom on you, up to 5. Your next ability spends them all: a venom strike hits the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.

Name: From Across the Room
Description: You leap up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and bite, dealing 15 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

Name: Bites Everywhere at Once
Description: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you takes 3 poison damage and has a 35% chance to become [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 30%.

Name: Coiled Spring
Description: Springs you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with 15% more dodge chance, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

Name: Strike on Landing
Description: After you cover ground, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Every Step Stings
Description: A bite that deals 7 poison damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and lays [Cursed Step] on it for 6 seconds, so every step it takes costs it blood. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

Name: Followed for Miles
Description: Spits a long venom shot that deals 28 poison damage and ignores armour. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

Name: Shed the Road Dust
Description: You shed your worn outer skin: you regain 10 health at once and restore 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Warm Road Basking
Description: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Split Tongue
Description: Spits venom that deals 5 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that, with a 25% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Venom Takes Both Roads
Description: Every enemy within 3 tiles of you takes 12 poison damage and becomes [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Both Ways at Once
Description: For 8 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Second Prong
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Dead Until It Isn't
Description: From a feigned stillness you bite, dealing 16 poison damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Misdirected Fangs
Description: Spits 3 fangs in a spread; each deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 15% chance to turn it against its own side for 2 seconds.

Name: Feigned Stillness
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Pocketed the Change
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you restore 6 mana. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Sprung From Still Water
Description: You spring a venom-laced bolt that deals 14 water damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Slick Skin Spray
Description: Sprays toxic slime across the 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 poison damage to everything in the cone, with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Toxic Skin
