Description: For 6 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Blooded Points
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Throat Hold
Description: A weapon strike that bites and locks on. It deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Flanking Jabs
Description: A flurry of jabs deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. The damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

Name: Stand Over the Fallen
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Mastiff at Heel
Description: A bonded mastiff fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.2 seconds. Each bite deals 4 damage and holds on, slowing the target by 25% for 2 seconds.

Name: Sitting Target
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. A thrown quill deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets within 6 tiles and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds, so blows are harder for it to slip.

Name: Muddied Water
Description: Churns the ground around you: it deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, strips 12% armour for 6 seconds, slows each by 20% and knocks each back 2 tiles.

Name: Preening Bill
Description: You pick up to 2 conditions off yourself and move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Returned to Sender
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Falling Stalactite
Description: Drops a stalactite on the first enemy it meets within 8 tiles. It deals 30 damage, then shatters and hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Row of Fangs
Description: A row of stone tines erupts in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead. The eruption deals 13 damage to everything in it and stuns each target for 1 second.

Name: Jagged Rampart
Description: Raises a wall of stone tines 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Rock Bottom
Description: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Dead Centre
Description: Throws a dart at a spot you have picked out, up to 8 tiles away. It deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit. The damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

Name: Picking the Spot
Description: A hard stare across a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Pinned by a Stare
Description: Your stare holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds. When it lets go, they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Second Look
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Carve for the Table
Description: Carves around you with a two-tined fork. The cut deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and restores 8 health to you. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Last Morsel
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A thrown skewer deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets within 5 tiles, and you heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

Name: Turning Spit
Description: Plants a spit of roasting meat where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Loaded Skewer
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you eat what is on the skewer and are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Poker from the Coals
Description: A weapon thrust with a red-hot iron deals 12 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Forest of Hot Iron
Description: Tines of white-hot iron erupt around you. The eruption deals 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Tempered in Embers
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. You have 15% fire resistance.

Name: While the Iron Glows
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Silverside Scatter
Description: Flicks 3 spines from your skin in a spread, each one dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets within 6 tiles. You dart 10% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

Name: Venom in the Fin
Description: A strike with a venomous spine deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Scales Over Spines
Description: For 10 seconds, your armour rises by 15% and your dodge chance by 10%.

Name: Barbed Pilot
Description: A bonded needlenose swims at your side, darting at an enemy within 4 tiles every second. Each dart deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Skewering Leap
Description: You leap onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and drive a spike into it, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times as much the further you leapt.

Name: Springing Thorn
Description: Flicks a barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets within 8 tiles, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hop dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Hard to Swat
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Itch Under the Hide
Description: Every time you land a hit, a barb lodges in that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a barb works loose every 4 seconds.

Name: Hobnail Stamp
Description: Stamps a studded heel into the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Miles in the Kick
Description: A kick from a spiked sole deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +50%).

Name: Strewn Caltrops
Description: Scatters caltrops in a line 4 tiles long in front of you for 8 seconds. The line deals 5 damage to any enemy that crosses it and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

Name: Kicked-Up Points
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, a spike kicked up from your heel flies at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Two Tines Deep
Description: A two-pronged jab that strikes twice, each strike dealing 4 damage, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.

Name: Branching Bolt
Description: Hurls a forked spike that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets within 9 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite. It then splits to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

Name: Sent the Other Way
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Second Prong
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Misleading Prick
Description: Flicks a spine that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles, with a 15% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds.

Name: Set Them Snapping
Description: Jabs up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

Name: Doubled Back
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 15% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Short-Changed
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Tongue Lash
Description: Lashes out a barbed tongue at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Sprung from the Reeds
Description: You spring onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and burst spines out where you land, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 50% chance of being [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Bitter Hide
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Coiled Legs
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Spore-Tipped Stab
Description: A stab that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Fruiting Eruption
Description: Fungal spines burst from the ground around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. The disease is catching: it finds up to 2 more enemies within 5 tiles on its own, 30% of the time.

Name: Bracket Shelf
Description: For 12 seconds, your armour rises by 20% and your poison resistance by 15%.

Name: Mycelial Spear
Description: Conjures a spear of hardened fungus. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Horn-First
Description: A head-down gore that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Cliffside Buck
Description: Bucks spiked horns up through a cone ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores armour.

Name: Sure Purchase
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Butt Back
Description: When you take damage from anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Stand for the Herd
Description: A spike thrust that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it lands, your allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds.

Name: Huddled Quills
Description: Bristles every quill on your body, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max +40%).

Name: Between Them and Us
Description: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Quilled Calf
Description: A bonded grazen calf with a back of quills fights beside you, butting an enemy within 3 tiles every 1.4 seconds. Each butt deals 3 damage and slows the target by 15% for 2 seconds.

Name: Bursting Round
Description: Fires a spike from your palm with a crack that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets within 11 tiles, then bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Scattershot
Description: Blasts a spray of quills through a narrow cone, dealing 4 damage to everything within 4 tiles in it.

Name: Rifled Bore
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Armour-Piercing Load
Description: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Shaken Loose
Description: Shakes loose 5 quills in a wide spread, each dealing 10 damage to the first enemy it meets within 6 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Finest Needle
Description: A hair-fine needle deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Strand Snare
Description: Lays a snare of quilled strands at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it closes and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Coat of Bristles
Description: Conjures a coat of stiff quills: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 8%, 15% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 10.

Name: Driven to the Head
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A hammering blow drives a spike into the target, dealing 24 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Level the Ground
Description: Slams a ring of spikes into the ground around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Tempered Edge
Description: Takes 1 second to hammer your spines to an edge, then increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Nailed Down
Description: When you kill an enemy, a ward absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Clutching Jab
Description: A gripping jab with spiked fingers that deals 5 damage, slows the target by 15% for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.

Name: Closed Fist
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. You close a spiked fist around it, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Catch the Blow
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 20 damage for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds.

Name: Knuckle Thorns
Description: Conjures a gauntlet with spined knuckles: you attack 6% faster, your critical chance rises by 3%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.

Name: Couched Charge
Description: You rush up to 7 tiles to an enemy with a spike couched low, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Spurred Hooves
Description: Kicks out with spurred hooves, dealing 7 damage to everything within 3 tiles in a cone ahead of you. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Barded in Thorns
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Long Ride
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you have 8% physical resistance.

Name: Twist the Barb
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A barbed strike deals 9 damage, slows the target by 25% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Snagging Cast
Description: Casts a fan of barbed lines through a cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Dragline
Description: Casts a barbed line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Snagged Close
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Full-Tilt Thrust
Description: Hurls a lance-length spike at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times as much at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Stampede
Description: Tramples through a cone ahead of you on spiked hooves, dealing 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Lance Raised
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 18 damage for 6 seconds. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Gathered Momentum
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your physical damage by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Run Down
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. A finishing thrust deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage.

Name: Brought to Ground
Description: Hurls a spike at the first enemy it meets within 9 tiles, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Quarry in Sight
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Wounded Prey
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Cold Nail
Description: Drives a nail of cold metal into the first enemy it meets within 10 tiles, dealing 28 damage that ignores its resistances.

Name: Maiden's Embrace
Description: Spikes close in around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. It strips 15% of their armour for 6 seconds and slows each by 20%.

Name: Spellproof Bristle
Description: For 8 seconds, 35% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Unyielding Grain
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% arcane resistance.

Name: Hidden Point
Description: A hidden spike slides out and deals 28 damage, always as a critical hit, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Palmed Darts
Description: Throws 3 spines from your palm in a tight spread, each dealing 6 damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Already in Reach
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Edge Kept Sheathed
Description: Your critical hit chance rises by 10%.

Name: Hide Gone Sharp
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Spines burst out of your hide, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Still, Then Strike
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A spike shot from stillness deals 22 damage to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, rising to 1.3 times as much at full reach.

Name: Shed Skin
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Afternoon Basking
Description: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Gnawing Cloud
Description: Whirls a cloud of spines around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stripping 12% of their armour for 6 seconds and slowing each by 15%. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Strip to the Stalk
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Flicks a barb that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Needle Plague
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of spined insects for 12 seconds. It deals 3 damage to an enemy within 6 tiles every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Gorged on the Field
Description: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Unmaking Shard
Description: Launches a shard of raw arcana at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times as much at full reach, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

Name: Conjured Thicket
Description: Conjures 4 spikes of force and looses them in a spread, each dealing 25 damage to the first enemy it meets within 8 tiles. They ignore armour.

Name: Held on the Points
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to cast, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Spilt Needles
Description: Each time you spend mana, a needle of force flies at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Countered Incantation
Description: Pins one enemy within 7 tiles with a spoken spike that deals 10 damage, knocks it back 2 tiles and silences it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

Name: Recited Lance
Description: Takes 1.5 seconds to recite, then launches a lance of force that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets within 10 tiles, always as a critical hit.

Name: Glyph of Thorns
Description: Takes 1 second to write a glyph beside you for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires a spike at an enemy within 6 tiles that deals 5 damage.

Name: Drilled Forms
Description: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your arcane resistance rises by 8%.

Name: Drifting Spine
Description: Sends a barb drifting at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Settling Weight
Description: Settles your spined bulk onto everything within 3.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, stripping 12% of their armour for 8 seconds and slowing each by 30%.

Name: Long Float
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Layered Bristles
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.

Name: Thousandth Repetition
Description: A drilled strike with the butt of the staff that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Form Without Flaw
Description: Runs a complete staff form through every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It deals 28 damage and ignores their resistances.

Name: Back to First Stance
Description: You step 2 tiles from where you stood, back to the staff's full length, and the cooldown clears on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Other End Follows
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again with the other end of the staff, and the second roll stands.

Name: Lancing Thrust
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and draws one of them out through the staff, using it up. The thrust reaches a target up to 4 tiles away and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

Name: Wormwood Arc
Description: Sweeps the staff through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 11 damage to everything in it and leaves each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

Name: Drawn Through the Grain
Description: You spin the staff in a guard for 9 seconds. Each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: Bracing Draught
Description: When one of your afflictions lifts, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Grown to a Pillar
Description: The staff lengthens to hit the first enemy in its path up to 8 tiles away and deals 30 damage. It then swells to a pillar and lands on every enemy within 3.5 tiles of the target for 80% of that.

Name: Swing Round the Upright
Description: You plant the staff and swing your whole body round it. It deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles.

Name: Hand Over Hand
Description: You climb the planted staff and swing off its top to a point up to 5 tiles away, then move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Brute Leverage
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.

Name: Shod Ram
Description: Rams the steel-capped butt of the staff into the target. It deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Rattle Their Plate
Description: A sweep of the banded staff that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Hoops of Steel
Description: You hold the staff crosswise and its steel bands close into a barrier. It absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 6 blows, and holds for 10 seconds.

Name: Parry Rings True
Description: 12% of the damage you take is turned back off the staff into whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Cleave the Rank
Description: Swings the head at the full length of the haft through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignores armour and leaves each target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

Name: Hooked Beard
Description: A weapon strike with the beard of the axe head that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Foot of the Haft
Description: You slide both hands to the foot of the haft. Your critical damage rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Swing Carries On
Description: When you kill an enemy, the head keeps its arc and your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Tapped Echo
Description: Taps the staff on the ground. The sound deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Shriek Down the Bore
Description: Sends a shriek down the hollow staff at the first enemy within 8 tiles. It deals 26 damage and ignores armour, then echoes to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each echo at 60% of that.

Name: Roosting Post
Description: Plants the staff upright for 12 seconds as a roost. Bats drop from it onto an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Answering Rap
Description: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: the staff strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Deadfall Slam
Description: You rear up on the staff and drop your full weight down it. It deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Ragged Stubs
Description: A weapon strike with a limb left rough with broken branch stubs. It deals 8 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Winter Lean
Description: You settle your weight on the staff. It restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: Bulk Behind the Bough
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Shaken Skep
Description: Shakes the hive hung from the staff and looses 3 bees in a spread out to 5 tiles. Each deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Alarm Scent
Description: A weapon strike that smears the hive's alarm scent on the target. It deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Dripping Comb
Description: Plants the staff with its comb dripping honey. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Forager's Miles
Description: Every few paces you cover on foot restores 5 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Vaulting Stoop
Description: You vault on the staff up to 7 tiles onto a target and strike down on it. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

Name: Whirled Overhead
Description: Whirls the staff overhead. It deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and the lift moves you 10% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: Flown From the Perch
Description: Casts a hawk off the head of the staff for 10 seconds. It swoops on an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Walker's Tailwind
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.

Name: Long Loose
Description: Strings the staff and looses a shaft at a target up to 8 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: Loosed Fan
Description: Slips the string and looses 4 shafts in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each deals 5 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles.

Name: Full Draw
Description: You brace the staff and string it. For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: Bent Back
Description: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Catchpole
Description: Thrusts a closing collar on the end of the staff at a target up to 4 tiles away. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Last Bar Set
Description: Drives the staff into the ground beside the target as the last bar. It deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one, then leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Driven Palings
Description: Drives a row of staves into the ground as a wall 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: No Gap Between
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Batted About
Description: Bats the target from one end of the staff to the other. It deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Unseen Sweep
Description: A low sweep of the staff through a cone 3.5 tiles long. It deals 26 damage to everything in it, and every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Fence-Top Walk
Description: You carry the staff crosswise for balance. Your movement speed rises by 30% for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

Name: Lands on Three Feet
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Stampede Down the Lane
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to a target, then drive the levelled staff through a cone 3.5 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it.

Name: Lean Into the Traces
Description: Sets the staff across your shoulders and walks it through the target. It deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Rumination
Description: You rest your weight on the staff. It restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Drove Road
Description: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Flung Third
Description: Whips the end section of the staff out on its links at the first enemy within 5 tiles. It deals 4 damage, then swings on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

Name: Snaking Lash
Description: Lets the linked sections unfold through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each target for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Reeling Line
Description: Lays the unfolded sections in a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Link by Link
Description: Every hit you land wraps a link of the staff's chain round that enemy as a stack, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Flag in the Face
Description: Snaps the pennant tied to the staff through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

Name: Planted Standard
Description: Drives the banner staff into a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Draped Awning
Description: Drapes cloth over the raised staff and veils you and your allies for 9 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 6% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Wound on the Distaff
Description: Every ability you use winds a stack of thread onto the staff, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Poling Off
Description: Sets the staff against a target up to 4 tiles away and shoves off. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

Name: Snapped Branches
Description: Snaps 3 branches off the growth on the staff and throws them in a spread out to 5 tiles. Each deals 3 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Reef on the Piling
Description: Drives the staff in where you stand for 14 seconds and a reef head grows over it. Its polyps sting an enemy within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Barnacled Haft
Description: Whenever you strike an enemy, the reef on the staff feeds you: you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Roll Under
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. You pin its neck under the staff and roll: it deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Wedged Jaw
Description: Jams the staff upright between the target's jaws. It deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Stick-Propped Snare
Description: Sets a pair of jaws at the nearest enemy, propped open on a length of staff. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles knocks the prop out: the jaws deal 18 damage and leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Log at the Waterline
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Lowered Tines
Description: You level the forked head of the staff and rush a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 12 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Sudden Crack
Description: Cracks the staff on the ground. It deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 25% chance to be startled into turning on its neighbours for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Stot Over
Description: You vault 4 tiles forward on the staff, then move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Guard Already Up
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again as a parry with the staff, and the second roll stands.

Name: Sent After It
Description: Throws the staff at the first enemy within 6 tiles with a hound after it. It deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second, and the hound then worries 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that.

Name: Low at the Hocks
Description: Sweeps the crook low through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, and its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

Name: Gate Held Shut
Description: You bar the way with the staff and pull up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Works to the Crook
Description: A bonded herding dog works to the signals of your staff. It bites enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds, and anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Shallows Slap
Description: Slaps the flat of the staff down on standing water and throws it through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 11 damage to everything in it, knocks each target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Level Prod
Description: A level prod at a target up to 3.5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Off the Spinning Shaft
Description: You spin the staff overhead for 3 seconds. Blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Paddling Beneath
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Butt to Bedrock
Description: Drives the foot of the staff into the ground. The shock deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1 second.

Name: Pry the Fault
Description: Sets the foot of the staff into a crack in the target's guard and levers it wide. It deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Rooted Menhir
Description: Stone closes around the grounded staff and your legs. Your armour rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Wayside Cairn
Description: Every time you take damage, a stone is set at the foot of the staff and a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Struck Where Sighted
Description: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: True Bearing
Description: Sights along the staff and fixes a stare on the first enemy in line within 8 tiles. It deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Plumb Line
Description: You sight along the staff before each blow. Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Watch Kept Long
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Second Helping
Description: Runs the staff through the first enemy within 4 tiles. It deals 8 damage, and 40% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Dinner Gong
Description: Beats the staff on the ground. It deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you regain 10 health. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Bread From the Bindle
Description: Unslings the bundle from the end of the staff and shares it out. It restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Provisioned
Description: When you are healed, 6 stamina comes back to you. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Both Ends Alight
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Spins the staff with both ends burning: it deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Rake Out the Coals
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. Rakes the burning end of the staff through the target: it deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Line in the Ash
Description: Drags the burning end of the staff across the ground to draw a line 5 tiles long that burns for 10 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Torchbearer
Description: At night, with the head of the staff lit, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Slid Through the Palms
Description: You let the staff run through your hands to jab an enemy up to 5 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach.

Name: Silver Darts
Description: You flick the wet tip of the staff three times, sending 3 darts of water in a fan out to 6 tiles. Each deals 10 damage, knocks the enemy 2.5 tiles back and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Wet Grip Turn
Description: You spin the staff in a slick blur. For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 40% chance to slide off the haft and land on whoever laid it instead.

Name: Slithers Down the Haft
Description: Your guard with the staff gives you +5% dodge chance. When a blow that is not fire lands on you, it slides down the haft and you restore 8 stamina, once every 8 seconds.

Name: Bound and Land
Description: You plant the staff and vault onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away. The landing deals 13 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Pogo Spin
Description: You bounce on the planted staff and spin, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, then move 10% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Across the Table
Description: You plant the staff and spring to a point up to 9 tiles away in an instant, then move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Spring in the Stride
Description: Each stretch of ground you cover on the staff stores a spring: your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Stamp and Plant
Description: You stamp down and drive the butt of the staff into the ground, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

Name: Every Mile in It
Description: A long overhand swing at an enemy within 3 tiles that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Leaning Rest
Description: You lean your weight on the staff and restore 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Road Legs
Description: Raises your Speed by 1 and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze you move 5% faster, from silver the staff gives you 4% dodge chance, and from gold you attack 6% faster.

Name: Two Ways at Once
Description: You thrust the forked head of the staff so both tines strike at once, sending 2 jabs out to 4 tiles, spread apart. Each deals 3 damage.

Name: Tines Astride
Description: You drive the fork down over an enemy within 3 tiles at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage. It is [Pinned] for 2 seconds and left 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Split Palisade
Description: You plant the staff and a forked palisade branches out from it, a wall 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 6 seconds.

Name: Other Tine Follows
Description: When you land a critical hit, the second tine jabs the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Through the Gap
Description: You slip the staff through an opening in an enemy's guard within 3 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Showman's Twirl
Description: You twirl the staff in a showy circle, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each has a 15% chance to turn on its neighbours for 2 seconds.

Name: Doubled Back
Description: You vault 2 tiles aside on the staff, then move 30% faster with +10% dodge chance for 6 seconds.

Name: Feint Before the Blow
Description: When a run of your staff blows has gone without a critical hit, you feint and your critical hit chance rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Springboard Crash
Description: You spring high off the bent staff and crash down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Damp Flick
Description: You snap the wet end of the staff to fling a gob of water at the first enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Lily-Pad Hop
Description: You pole-hop 5 tiles forward on the staff, then move 20% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: Coiled Crouch
Description: When your stamina fills, you crouch low on the staff and your physical damage rises 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Spore-Packed Head
Description: You rap an enemy with the spore-caked head of the staff, dealing 10 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Ripe for Picking
Description: You jab the staff into a spore-ridden enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. It deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, each one adding 60% more damage.

Name: Ring of Caps
Description: You plant the staff and a ring of mushrooms springs up round it for 8 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3 tiles.

Name: Grows on Anything
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Butting Thrust
Description: You ram the end of the staff into an enemy, dealing 14 damage, knocking it 3.5 tiles back and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Crag Scrape
Description: From planted feet, you sweep the staff low through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 20% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Wedged on the Crag
Description: You wedge the staff against the ground and brace on it, raising your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Gives No Ground
Description: Each time you take damage while braced on the staff, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Herding Sweep
Description: You swing the staff wide through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Crook for Stragglers
Description: You reach the staff out to rap an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, and 8% more for each ally near you, up to 32%. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Gathered Close
Description: You thump the staff to call your allies in, restoring 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Barn-Warm Company
Description: Every hit you land with the staff builds a stack of shared warmth on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Down the Length
Description: You sight along the staff and fire a ball of shot at the first enemy within 12 tiles, dealing 32 damage. It bursts on impact, and every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that.

Name: Muzzle Kick
Description: A blast of smoke and shot leaves the end of the staff through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy 3 tiles back.

Name: Long Barrel
Description: You sight down the staff's length: for 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Powder Still Hot
Description: When you land a critical hit, the staff stays primed: your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Braided Lash
Description: You snap the strands braided round the staff's head across an enemy, dealing 7 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Ten Thousand Tangles
Description: You whirl the staff and its strands unspool, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each has a 50% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Strung Between
Description: You pay out strands from the staff in a line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward, and anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Loose Strand
Description: When you strike, a loose strand whips from the staff to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Peg Driven Home
Description: You bring the staff down two-handed on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank, dealing 28 damage and using up every affliction on it to add their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Levelling Blow
Description: You slam the staff flat against the ground, dealing 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each 2.5 tiles back. Each has a 30% chance to be [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Weighted Head
Description: You choke down to the end of the staff and swing it as a maul: your blunt damage rises 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Flattened Guard
Description: Your blunt damage, staff blows among them, cannot be resisted, and ignores 12% of the target's armour.

Name: Choked to the Ferrule
Description: You slide your grip to the very end of the staff for a thrust at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Knuckle Rap
Description: A short-gripped rap at an enemy within 2 tiles that deals 5 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Settled Grip
Description: You settle your grip on the staff, raising your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Never Lets Go
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused: you catch yourself on the staff and are left at 1 health.

Name: Couched at the Gallop
Description: You couch the staff and rush an enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that the further the blow travels.

Name: Trampling Arc
Description: You sweep the staff low at hoof height through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Steady Trot
Description: You lean on the staff as a walking pole and settle into a trot, moving 25% faster for 12 seconds.

Name: Leans and Keeps Going
Description: When your stamina runs out, you lean on the staff and regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Behind the Knee
Description: You catch an enemy behind the knee with the staff's crook, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Reaping Crook
Description: You sweep the crook of the staff through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Hauled Into Reach
Description: You snag up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles on the crook and pull them onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Already Snagged
Description: Your damage rises by 12% against an enemy already caught by one of your conditions.

Name: Full-Tilt Line
Description: You level the staff and drive through a narrow cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Hoofbeat Tap
Description: A quick rap with the staff in time with your stride that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Then you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: Charge Sounded
Description: You beat the staff on the ground for the charge: your damage rises 25% for 12 seconds and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Quickening Gait
Description: Every hit you land with the staff builds a hoofbeat stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Pointing the Quarry
Description: You jab a dart of force from the staff's tip at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: You lunge the full length of the staff at an enemy within 4 tiles at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Halloo the Pack
Description: You raise the staff to signal the chase: every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more power.

Name: Closing In
Description: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health, once the staff has run them down that far.

Name: Cold-Shod Blow
Description: A blow with the staff's shod end that deals 30 damage ignoring resistances and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Spellbreaker Arc
Description: You sweep the cold grey length of the staff through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 5 damage with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Unbending
Description: You set the staff and stand behind it: for 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage, transcendent ones included, and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Grey Turns Spells
Description: The cold iron worked into the staff turns magic: 15% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.

Name: Ferrule Blade
Description: You flick out the blade hidden in the foot of the staff at an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using it up. It deals 8 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Fan From the Hollow
Description: You shake 3 blades out of the hollow staff in a fan out to 7 tiles. Each deals 26 damage, ignoring armour.

Name: Only a Walking Stick
Description: You lean on the staff and pass for a harmless traveller. For 6 seconds you are veiled and move 10% faster; enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Edge Out Unseen
Description: When you lay a condition on an enemy, the staff's hidden edge is out: your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: From Dead Stillness
Description: A sudden full-length thrust of the staff at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Shed Length
Description: Spends 4% of your maximum health to strike with the staff, dealing 8 damage and chilling the target for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Sunning on the Post
Description: You lean motionless on the staff and restore 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Tail Regrows
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you brace on the staff and regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Swarm off the Spin
Description: You whirl the staff and fling 4 buzzing bolts in a wide spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Gnawing Jab
Description: You jab a biting spray of insects from the staff's tip at the first enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 7 damage and healing you for 20% of it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

Name: Stirred From the Stubble
Description: You beat the stubble with the staff and stir up a swarm of locusts for 10 seconds. It bites enemies within 4 tiles of it for 3 damage every second.

Name: Strips the Field
Description: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Lengthwise Bolt
Description: You gather power down the length of the staff and loose it as a bolt at the first enemy within 12 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances.

Name: Sparking Ferrule
Description: You rap the butt of the staff on the ground and sparks fly in a ring, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 15% chance to leave each [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drawn Up the Wood
Description: You plant the staff and draw raw power up through it, restoring 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Overspill
Description: When you spend mana, a spark leaps from the head of the staff to the nearest enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Word of Halting
Description: You point the staff and speak the halting word. A bolt strikes the first enemy within 9 tiles, deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Recited Over
Description: On the closing word of a recitation you thrust the staff at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, using that affliction up. It deals 8 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Measured Cadence
Description: You beat time on the staff as you cast, raising your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Practised Phrasing
Description: When your mana fills, the words line up along the staff and your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Swing
Description: After a 1.5-second wind-up, you swing the staff through a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to everything in it.

Name: Drifting Prod
Description: A slow, wet prod with the staff that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Soaked] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Drift Guard
Description: You turn the staff slowly before you, raising a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises 5% while it holds.

Name: Nothing Urgent
Description: Your maximum health rises 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Thousandth Repetition
Description: Fires a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Form at Double Time
Description: A burst around you that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores their armour. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

Name: No Wasted Motion
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Drilled Past Thinking
Description: Your ability cooldowns are 7% shorter. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Drawn in One Pull
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A strike that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Dose After Dose
Description: Flicks a dart that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Run It Off
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sweated Clean
Description: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Canopy Drop
Description: You swing up to 6 tiles to the target and land on it. The landing deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Feinting Backhand
Description: A blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Chest-Beat Tempo
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 3 seconds.

Name: Long-Armed Stride
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you attack 6% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Flung Gauntlet
Description: Throws a gauntlet at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 11 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Gap in the Lames
Description: A thrust that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterwards.

Name: Glancing Angle
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 9 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

Name: Turned Blows
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: End Over End
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Throws a hatchet at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: Chopping Reel
Description: A spin that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Juggled Hatchets
Description: Increases your slashing damage by 20% for 10 seconds. For the first 6 seconds, an escort of hatchets strikes for 3 every 0.8 seconds.

Name: Woodcutter's Cadence
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.

Name: Doppler Shriek
Description: A shriek through a cone 5 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Swoop and Sip
Description: You dart up to 7 tiles to the target and bite it. The bite deals 12 damage, heals you for 30% of it and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Jinking Flutter
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

Name: Heard It Coming
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Whole Weight Arriving
Description: A blow that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Bowled Over
Description: A charge that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, knocks them back 2 tiles and leaves them [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Wintered Hide
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Rolling Bulk
