Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Draw the Dose
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A pump-needle that deals 8 damage, draws your afflictions out of the target and adds 0.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Final Draught
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Fires a hollow needle that deals 20 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Belt Syrette
Description: Spring-loaded injectors remove up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restore 12 health.

Name: Backflow Valve
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Cable Swing
Description: A winch cable swings you onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away, where a blow deals 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

Name: Longer Lever
Description: Jams a pry bar into the target's guard and hauls on it, which deals 32 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Chest-Plate Drumming
Description: Your attack speed rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Ratchet Grip
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Rivet Popper
Description: Punches a fastening out of the target's guard, which deals 4 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Bulwark Ram
Description: Rams a plate forward on its pistons across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Ablative Layers
Description: Bolts on a stack of sacrificial plates that absorbs the next 26 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6% while it holds.

Name: Powered Cuirass
Description: Conjures a powered harness: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Ripsaw Sweep
Description: Sweeps a pull-cord saw through a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Falling Weight
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A weapon strike that releases a weighted blade, which deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Spinning Picket Line
Description: Stakes a row of spinning blades 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Anything that crosses it is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Treadle Whetwheel
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 4% sooner.

Name: Sonar Ping
Description: An emitter sends a locating pulse across a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

Name: Ultrasonic Lance
Description: Fires an ultrasonic bolt that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Dark Rangefinder
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

Name: Answering Echo
Description: Each time you spend mana, a pulse leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Hydraulic Maul
Description: Swings a hydraulic maul across a cone 2.5 tiles long, which deals 13 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Trap-Spring Bite
Description: A weapon strike that closes sprung iron teeth on the target, which deals 30 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Winter Maintenance
Description: You power down and run repairs, restoring 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Needle in the Red
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Relay Sting
Description: Sends a stinger drone that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then flies on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each for 40% of that damage.

Name: Emptied Racks
Description: Launches a rack of drones outward, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Hive Fabricator
Description: Sets down a fabricator that builds drones for 12 seconds. The swarm deals 3 damage every second to an enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Shift Rotation
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Rotor Wash
Description: Spins up a rotor that throws 3 gusts in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each deals 9 damage and knocks its target back 3 tiles.

Name: Finned Plummet
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Releases a finned dart from overhead that deals 20 damage and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Catapult Launch
Description: A launch rail throws you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Clockwork Kestrel
Description: A bonded ornithopter flies beside you. It deals 4 damage every 1.3 seconds to an enemy within 5 tiles and slows what it strikes by 15% for 2 seconds.

Name: Repeater Latch
Description: A lever-fed crossbow looses a bolt at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

Name: Cranked Battery
Description: After a 1.5 second crank, releases 4 heavy quarrels in a spread out to 8 tiles, each of which deals 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Windlass Sentry
Description: Sets up a ballista for 15 seconds. It deals 5 damage to an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Fully Wound
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Throw the Bolt
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one up. Slams a lock bolt home on it, which deals 9 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Portcullis Drop
Description: Releases a ring of counterweighted bars around you, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Shutter Gate
Description: Rolls down a barred shutter 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Grounded Mesh
Description: A wire mesh around you sends 12% of the elemental damage you take back to whoever dealt it. Your lightning resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Switchblade Cuff
Description: A weapon strike with spring blades that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Sprung on the Limping
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A pounce that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Padded Servos
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Ninth Backup
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Cowcatcher
Description: Drives through with a plough frame, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Millstone Turn
Description: Drops a millstone on one enemy, which deals 32 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Yoked Team
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Low Gearing
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 12% faster, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Linked Discharge
Description: Empties a capacitor into the first enemy it meets, which deals 7 damage, then arcs to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each for 60% of that damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Coupling Harpoon
Description: Fires a harpoon on a reel at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Capstan Drag
Description: Stakes a powered capstan whose line runs 6 tiles for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 3 seconds.

Name: Cascade Relay
Description: Each time you kill something, an arc leaps from the body to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Flying Shuttles
Description: A loom arm flings 3 threaded shuttles in a spread out to 6 tiles, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Seam Ripper
Description: Runs a motor-driven hook along the target's seams, which deals 18 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Lockstitch Suture
Description: A stitching arm closes your wounds and restores 16 health to you. The healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

Name: Ballistic Weave
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Budded Blade
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A weapon strike with a blade grown from your own plating, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Layered Breakwater
Description: Lays down a reef wall 5 tiles long that stands for 6 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy crossing it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Seeded Spire
Description: Seeds a spire that stands for 12 seconds. It deals 3 damage every second to an enemy within 4 tiles, each time with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Accreting Hull
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 1 health a second.

Name: Toothed Vise
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Shuts a toothed vise on it, which deals 24 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Death-Roll Flywheel
Description: A flywheel spins you through a full roll, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Waiting Jaws
Description: Sets a sprung iron trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 50 seconds, and deals 16 damage in a blast around it to each of the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles.

Name: Coiled Mainspring
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Startle Flare
Description: Pops a flare that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Launched Tines
Description: A spring rack shoots tines at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Headlamp Glare
Description: Throws a lamp beam that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

Name: Panic Button
Description: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. You also have +6% dodge chance.

Name: Fetch Disc
Description: Throws a bladed disc at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill brings one back to your hand.

Name: Lockjaw Actuator
Description: A weapon strike that locks a geared jaw on the target, which deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Brass Mastiff
Description: Winds up a brass hound that fights beside you for 15 seconds. It deals 5 damage to an enemy within 4 tiles every 1.2 seconds, each bite with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Scent Tracker
Description: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.

Name: Bilge Spray
Description: A hand pump sprays a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Wind-Up Decoy
Description: Sends a clockwork decoy forward. It deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Sealant Coat
Description: Sprays you with sealant. For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Pontoon Feet
Description: Floats under your feet let you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 12% faster, from silver your mana recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Jackhammer Bit
Description: Drives a hammering bit into the target, which deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Seismic Charge
Description: Detonates a charge sunk in the ground under you, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Borehole Transit
Description: A boring head cuts a shaft under you and brings you up at a spot up to 6 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Metalled Road
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Designator Beam
Description: Fires a lens-focused beam that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Failure Analysis
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, up to 8 tiles away. Fires a shot that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

Name: Spotter Drone
Description: Launches a spotter that calls your shots. Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds, and for 8 seconds the spotter fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Firing Solution
Description: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Carving Slicer
Description: A crank slicer takes a cut from the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Lid Off the Cooker
Description: Opens the valve on a pressure cooker, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Mess Stove
Description: Sets down a field stove where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Sealed Preserves
Description: The moment you are back at full health, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Exhaust Vent
Description: Vents engine exhaust around you, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Burning] for 4 seconds. The thrust moves you 12% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: Incendiary Canister
Description: Lobs a pressurised canister that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Afterburner
Description: A burner kicks you 3 tiles from where you stood, then your movement speed rises by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

Name: Kept at Forge Heat
Description: Conjures a tool held at forge heat by its own burner. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Homing Torpedo
Description: Launches a finned torpedo that steers itself into the first enemy it meets, which deals 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Minnow Salvo
Description: A spring tube fires 5 darts that scatter in a spread, and each one deals 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Greased Coupling
Description: Vents a slick of oil over your joints that removes up to 3 control conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Wind-Up Pike
Description: A clockwork pike swims at your side and strikes an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Spring-Heel Drop
Description: A coiled spring in your heels launches you onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away, and the landing deals 15 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Recoil Bounce
Description: A piston in your boots bounces you in place, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Pogo Greaves
Description: Snaps out sprung stilts that hop you 3 tiles from where you stood, then raise your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

Name: Tension Coil
Description: Every blow you dodge winds a coil on you, up to 8. At 8 they all release at once: you move and attack 3% faster per coil (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a coil unwinds every 6 seconds.

Name: Odometer Kick
Description: A piston-driven kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

Name: Stamping Mill
Description: Drives a geared iron boot into the ground, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Folded Mile
Description: A geared stride shortens the road and steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after.

Name: Pedometer Ratchet
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover clicks a ratchet that restores 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Split Circuit
Description: Fires a spark that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Twin-Prong Discharge
Description: Arcs current between two prongs across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 13 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1 second.

Name: Junction Switch
Description: Throws a switch that clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

Name: Bifurcated Feed
Description: Each critical hit splits off a bolt that leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Feint Flare
Description: Flicks a dazzling trick flare that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted], its aim thrown off, for 3 seconds.

Name: Jack-in-the-Box
Description: Tosses a sprung box at an enemy up to 5 tiles away; it bursts open and deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's armour.

Name: Mirror Cabinet
Description: Folding mirrors hide you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Loaded Dice Gear
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Grapple Tongue
Description: Fires a sprung tongue at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Bellows Croak
Description: Pumps a croak through a brass bellows across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Coiled Haunches
Description: Spring-loaded legs fling you 5 tiles forward, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Primed Pads
Description: While your stamina sits full, your springs stay primed: your next strike has 30% more critical chance. Once every 9 seconds.

Name: Spore Canister
Description: Lobs a sealed canister of spores that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Inoculating Needle
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike through a culture needle that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Humidor Vent
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to set down a humming spore vent for 15 seconds. It mists an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Fruiting Timer
Description: Every hit you land sets a spore timer on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the spores fruit at once and strike it for 24% of your weapon damage per timer (143% at full). Unfed, a timer fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Ram Piston
Description: Drives a piston ram into the target, which deals 16 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Landslide Charge
Description: Plants your braces and sets off a blasting charge in the rock underfoot, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Locked Stance
Description: Locks your leg braces into the ground: for 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Gyro Ballast
Description: A spinning gyroscope keeps you planted: your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Bell Clapper
Description: Swings a weighted herd-bell clapper at an enemy up to 4 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

Name: Boiler Blast
Description: Opens a boiler valve across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 13 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Barn Radiator
Description: Sets up a portable radiator that warms every ally within 5 tiles: they strike 15% harder and fight with 1 more power for 12 seconds.

Name: Slow-Burn Regulator
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Breech Shot
Description: Fires a heavy round from a breech-loader that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour.

Name: Buckshot Spread
Description: Fires 6 pellets in a wide spread; each one deals 4 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Rifled Barrel
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Chambered Round
Description: Each kill chambers a fresh round: your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Filament Garrote
Description: A weapon strike that loops a fine wire around the target, which deals 7 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spun Snare
Description: Flings out a net of spun filaments, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Wire Rampart
Description: Strings a fence of taut wire 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Watch-Spring Charm
Description: Coils a thousand fine strands into a watch-spring charm: your critical chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 15% more, each kill restores 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 12.

Name: Drop Forge
Description: Releases a drop-forge weight onto the target, which deals 30 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Shockwave Anvil
Description: Slams a steam hammer onto a portable anvil, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Beaten Scrap Plate
Description: Beats a plate of scrap flat across your chest that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Counterweight Swing
Description: Each critical hit drops a counterweight: your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Crushing Vise
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A weapon strike from a geared gauntlet that clamps shut, which deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Telescoping Reach
Description: A telescoping arm punches out at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and deals 8 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spare Arms
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to assemble a pair of clockwork arms that fight beside you for 15 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Fitted Haft
Description: Conjures a tooled weapon whose grip fits your palm: your weapon damage rises by 12%, you attack 6% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 2 ticks.

Name: Hauling Stamp
Description: A hydraulic hoof stamps the target, which deals 7 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Steam Trample
Description: Drives a steam-powered trample across a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Draught Harness
Description: Straps on a braced draught harness that reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Tireless Gearing
Description: When your stamina runs out, a reserve flywheel restores 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Snag Line
Description: A weapon strike trailing a barbed line that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Gaff Winch
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Fires a winched gaff at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 24 damage.

Name: Haul-In Lines
Description: Fires barbed lines that reel up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and hold their attention for 6 seconds.

Name: Barbed Pawl
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Flat-Out Lance
Description: A steam-driven lance thrust at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.8 times at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Camshaft Charge
Description: Pistoned hooves hammer the ground around you, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

Name: Throttle Open
Description: Opens the throttle wide: your movement speed rises by 35% for 8 seconds.

Name: Hoofbeat Governor
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover spins up a governor: your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Tracker Dart
Description: Fires a homing tracker dart that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Closing Jaws
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A spring-jaw strike that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Target Scope
Description: Snaps a ranging scope over your eye that raises your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Pursuit Algorithm
Description: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Hardened Stud
Description: Fires a hardened stud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Grounding Spike
Description: Drives a grounding spike into the earth, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances.

Name: Bolted Plates
Description: Bolts heavy plates over you, raising your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Riveted Layers
Description: Every time you take damage, another plate is riveted on, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per plate (56% at full). Unfed, a plate falls away every 10 seconds.

Name: Hidden Spur
Description: A weapon strike that snaps a hidden spur from the hilt, which deals 30 damage, always crits, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Pinwheel Cutters
Description: A sprung fan throws 3 blades that each deal 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Stropping Spindle
Description: Runs your edges over a spinning strop, raising your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Spring-Loaded Edge
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, a concealed edge springs out: your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Burning Glass
Description: Focuses sunlight through a lens onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 4 damage and leaves it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Banked Noon
Description: Releases the heat a solar battery has stored across a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignoring their resistances.

Name: Regrowth Pump
Description: Starts a regrowth pump that restores 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Solar Collector
Description: During the day, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Chewing Rotors
Description: Spins a ring of chewing rotors that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Stripping Drone
Description: Launches a stripping drone that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Clockwork Cloud
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to release a cloud of clockwork insects for 12 seconds that chews an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Harvest Counter
Description: Every kill ticks a counter on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per tick (15% at full). Unfed, a tick fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Mana Slug
Description: An arcane coil fires a slug of condensed mana at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 14 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Raw Venting
Description: Vents unrefined mana through an open valve across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 8 damage to everything in it. Each use costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Vapour Still
Description: Condenses loose arcana into 20 mana for you.

Name: Overflow Arc
Description: Each time you spend mana, the excess arcs to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Recited Formula
Description: A brass cylinder recites a formula as a bolt that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Punch-Card Barrage
Description: Feeds a punch card through a casting engine that looses 3 bolts, and each one deals 2 damage to the enemy it strikes.

Name: Rehearsal Metronome
Description: Sets a metronome ticking at your practised tempo, raising your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Memorised Sequence
Description: Every ability you use adds a step to the sequence on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per step (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a step fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Ballast Drop
Description: Lets a ballast weight settle onto the target, which deals 18 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Sluice Tide
Description: Opens a sluice around you, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Becalming Engine
Description: Takes 1 second to wind a becalming engine, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Padded Hull
Description: When non-fire damage reaches you, a padded hull swells around you: a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: One Clean Pass
Description: Throws a needle on a line at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range. It is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Seam Ripper
Description: Runs a strand through a gap in the target's armour. It deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Pattern Shared
Description: Ties a strand to every ally within 5 tiles. Each of them strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds.

Name: Backstitch
Description: When you land a critical hit, the strand whips on to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Draw It Out
Description: Pulls a drawing strand out through the target that deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Bitter Wick
Description: Casts a soaked strand that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Common Ligature
Description: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and out of each of your allies, and restores 8 health.

Name: Dose Returned
Description: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Garrote Haymaker
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A blow with a looped line that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Troop's Bolas
Description: After a 0.4 second cast, hurls 3 weighted cords at once, spread apart. Each cord deals 16 damage, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves its target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Swing Hand Over Hand
Description: Swings you 4 tiles forward on a strand. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

Name: Wrap and Wrench
Description: Every hit you land winds a loop round that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per loop. Unfed, a loop fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Cinch the Straps
Description: Loops a cord through the harness of a target up to 5 tiles away and cinches it. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Unlaced
Description: Cuts the cords that hold the target's plates together. It deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Reel Them In
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds and hauls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you, holding their attention for 4 seconds.

Name: Corded Lamellar
Description: Conjures armour of plates laced on cord: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Sever the Tie
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A chop through that strand that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Lanyard Whirl
Description: Whirls a hatchet around you on a cord. It deals 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, knocks them back 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Pendant Blade
Description: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. A hatchet on a cord swings beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Carried On the Cord
Description: When you kill an enemy, the hatchet swings on its cord to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Subsonic Chord
Description: Plucks the strands strung around you, sending a note that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Latched Feeder
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Latches a strand onto the first enemy it meets that deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Echo Along the Wire
Description: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back along the strand to whoever dealt it.

Name: Every Tremor Counted
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Hauled Up Short
Description: Casts a loop over the first enemy it meets and pulls it up short. It deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Deadweight Maul
Description: Brings a maul down that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Wintering Cocoon
Description: Spins a cocoon around you that restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: Stakebound Cub
Description: A bonded cub on a tether swats enemies within 3 tiles for 7 damage every 2.4 seconds.

Name: Sewing Swarm
Description: Looses 3 stingers at once, spread apart. Each stinger deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Barb Left In
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that deals 8 damage and leaves a barb on a strand in the wound: the target is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and moves 20% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Trailing Hive
Description: After a 0.3 second cast, looses a swarm for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Nectar Run
Description: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and draw back to you, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per strand. Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Kite-String Hoist
Description: Hooks a strand into the first enemy it meets. It deals 11 damage, carries the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Three on Creances
Description: Looses 3 hawks on lines at once, spread apart. Each hawk deals 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Woven Nest
Description: Weaves a nest of strands reaching 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Line Paid Out
Description: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Towline Arrow
Description: Looses an arrow trailing a line that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hauls you up to 7 tiles along the line to the target.

Name: Cobweb Barrage
Description: After a 0.6 second cast, looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, with a strand strung between them. Each arrow deals 12 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves its target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. [Slowed] is catching: it passes along the strand to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Second String
Description: Fits the spare string: clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Settled Sights
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Tightening Noose
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Drops a loop over a target up to 5 tiles away and draws it shut. It deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Wire Bars Closing
Description: Draws a ring of wire bars shut around you. It deals 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Cradle of Strands
Description: After a 0.5 second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Last Lattice
Description: When your health falls below 35%, strands close around you as a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Pounce Along the Yarn
Description: You pounce up to 5 tiles down a strand onto the target. The pounce deals 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles.

Name: Dangled Lure
Description: Whips a dangled strand around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to turn each against its allies for 2.5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Ropewalker's Poise
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds, and carries you 2 tiles along a strand from where you stood.

Name: Hanging by a Filament
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Draught Charge
Description: Rushes you to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, where the charge deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

Name: Not to Be Hurried
Description: Flicks a rein at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Grazing on One Tether
Description: Restores 2 health a second to you and every ally for 8 seconds.

Name: Herd in Harness
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Lockstitch Throw
Description: Throws a looped strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each leap dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Fettered Together
Description: Shackles every enemy within 3 tiles to its neighbours. It deals 11 damage and leaves each [Slowed] for 4 seconds, and your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Mail Weave
Description: Weaves links into a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it.

Name: Each Loop Locks
Description: Every ability you use adds a link to the one before, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per link (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a link fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Pull the Loose End
Description: Hooks a loose end on the first enemy it meets and pulls. It deals 15 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Winding Sheet
Description: Winds a sheet around every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 28 damage that ignores resistances and leaves each [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Whipstitch
Description: Stitches a wound shut and binds it. It restores 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically.

Name: Shared Selvedge
Description: Conjures a cloak woven of strands: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, your maximum health rises by 10 and each kill returns 2 health. Its effect increases by 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Reef on a Rope
Description: Strings a rope 6 tiles long ahead of you and a jagged reef grows along it for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Holdfast Snag
Description: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and snags it on anchoring strands, slowing it by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Anchored Colony
Description: After a 1 second cast, anchors a colony on a strand where you stand for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Byssus Footing
Description: Anchoring strands hold you to the surface: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Spooled Under
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. You clamp on and roll, winding the line round the target. The roll deals 22 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Sunken Tripwire
Description: Snaps a hidden line taut across a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Snare That Waits
Description: Takes 1 second to set a snare line at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles is caught: the snare deals 22 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Snap Shut
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Alarm Snap
Description: Snaps every strand strung around you. It deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Trailed Behind
Description: Whips the strand you have trailed at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: First Twitch
Description: Your dodge chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Tripline Warning
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 15%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.

Name: Lead Runner
Description: Looses a hound down a long lead. It deals 28 damage to the first enemy it reaches and leaves it [Marked] for 12 seconds. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Brought to Bay
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A weapon strike at the end of the lead that deals 22 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

Name: Fetched to Heel
Description: Hauls up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you on taut leashes and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Never Off the Leash
Description: A bonded hound on a leash fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.

Name: Bobbing Decoys
Description: Skims 3 decoys out on lines at once, spread apart. Each decoy deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn its target against its allies for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Dabbler's Hook
Description: Hooks the first enemy it meets on a float line and dunks it. It deals 11 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Backwash
Description: For 7 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to pass back to whoever laid it instead.

Name: Little Ones in Tow
Description: A bonded hatchling follows you on a strand, pecking enemies within 3 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Full-Length Sling
Description: Whirls a sling on a long cord and looses a jagged rock at a target up to 8 tiles away. It deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, and ignores armour.

Name: Unstitched Ground
Description: Rips the ground open in a cone 2.5 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Mason's Line
Description: Strings a mason's line 6 tiles long ahead of you and a stone wall rises along it for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Pendulum Weight
Description: Every time you take damage, a rock on a cord is drawn back a notch, up to 8. At 8 it swings: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per notch (163% at full). Unfed, a notch fades every 10 seconds.

Name: First Glance
Description: Sends a strand down your line of sight that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your critical chance is 30% higher against an enemy that has not yet been hurt.

Name: Field of Regard
Description: Ties everything in your field of view to your gaze, in a cone 5 tiles long. It deals 12 damage, stuns each target for 1 second and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Long Sightline
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

Name: Knot for Every Look
Description: Every hit you land on an enemy ties a knot on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per knot (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a knot fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Course After Course
Description: Skewers the first enemy it meets on a strand. It deals 8 damage, and 20% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Strung for the Spit
Description: Runs a strand through every enemy within 3 tiles and trusses them. It deals 28 damage, and when it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Round the Table
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Gleaner's Share
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Short Fuse
Description: Throws a lit fuse that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that damage.

Name: Slow Match
Description: Sweeps a smouldering cord through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it and sets each target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

Name: Slag Shackles
Description: Burns through up to 3 conditions that hold or stun you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Spark at the End
Description: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, the fuse has burnt down and a spark jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. The spark deals 8 damage and sets that enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Silvered Skein
Description: Sends a strand into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Cast and Reel
Description: A thrown line that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Slip the Knot
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you and increases your movement speed by 25% for 6 seconds.

Name: Cut Loose
Description: When your health falls below 35%, the cords around you slacken into a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Stitch Bites
Description: Three quick strikes, each dealing 6 damage and making the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Spring on the Line
Description: You rush to the target along a tether and strike it for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Anchored Leap
Description: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away and gives you +15% dodge chance.

Name: Slack Taken Up
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Long Haul Lash
Description: Throws a weighted cord that deals 8 damage. Its damage rises +5% per tile you have travelled (max +40%). Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

Name: Drag the Column
Description: Hauls a wide cone of cord ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

Name: Forced Stride
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Second Wind
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Split Line
Description: Looses 2 strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage.

Name: Double Pin
Description: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 60% of their remaining damage to this blow for each one, which deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

Name: Branch Back
Description: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

Name: Second Draw
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Crossed Strands
Description: Throws a net of crossing strands in a cone, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Blunted], lowering the target's critical chance for 6 seconds.

Name: Palmed Purse
Description: A sly cast that deals 30 damage and strips 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Veiled Tie
Description: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Marked Cards
Description: After a run of strikes without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 50% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Tongue-Tied
Description: Flicks a sticky strand that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Slowed], moving 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Startle Ring
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 14 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

Name: Springboard Knot
Description: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sudden Spring
Description: When you spend stamina, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Sporing Lines
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 6 damage and is [Diseased], so healing does less for them, for 6 seconds. Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

Name: Root Stitch
Description: A strike that deals 14 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Underlying Mat
Description: Spreads a mat of strands where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Fruiting Body
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, healing you receive is 30% stronger for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Butting Round
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 16 damage and is knocked back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Short Jab
Description: A quick jab that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Staked Footing
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Planted Hooves
Description: Every time you take damage, a stake is driven in, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per stake (30% at full). Unfed, a stake fades every 8 seconds.

Name: Pasture Tug
Description: Hauls on a strand that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Slowed], moving 25% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Herd Rally
Description: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 28 damage. Each ally takes the hit with you: allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds.

Name: Shared Warmth
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Settling In
Description: When you gain health, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Plumb Shot
Description: Fires a weighted line that deals 9 damage. Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

Name: Scattershot Web
Description: Looses a burst of strands in a cone, dealing 30 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Tripwire Charge
Description: Conjures a trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles takes 30 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Reload
Description: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 50% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Fine Barrage
Description: Looses 4 fine strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Matted Web
Description: A lashing strike that deals 14 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Combed Out
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

Name: Lashing Locks
Description: When you strike, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Peened Rivet
Description: A flattening blow that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Drive Every Stake
Description: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Hammered Home
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

Name: Settled Seam
Description: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Reaching Hold
Description: A thrown grasp that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

Name: Lent Grip
Description: Two strikes, each dealing 12 damage and making the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Pass It Along
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Spare Pair
Description: Calls a bonded familiar of force that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds within 5 tiles.

Name: Lead Rope
Description: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 4 damage. Its damage rises +10% per ally nearby (max +40%).

Name: Hauled Weight
Description: A hauling blow that deals 36 damage, ignoring the target's armour.

Name: Second Stretch
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 7 seconds.

Name: Never Winded
Description: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Grapple Line
Description: Sends a barbed line that deals 12 damage, then hauls you to the target.

Name: Barbed Flick
Description: A flicked barb that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Haul In
Description: Calls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Caught Fast
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 15% more damage.

Name: Running Out the Line
Description: A thrown strand that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises +5% per tile you have travelled (max +40%).

Name: Ride Down
Description: You gallop to the target along a line and strike it for 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Full Gallop
Description: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Hoofbeat Tempo
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Casts a line that deals 9 damage. Its damage rises +8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%). Each kill returns a charge, up to 3.

Name: Quarry's Mark
Description: A long cast that deals 40 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, and strips 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Paid-Out Reach
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Closing In

Name: Basking Snare

Name: Warm Reserve

Name: Swarming Strands

Name: Muttered Clause

Description: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Follow-Up Drill
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, your next 2 abilities deal 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.

Description: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Sharpened Barbs
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Stampede Front
Description: A thundering cone that deals 16 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Cadence Strike
Description: A strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Cavalry Call
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Gallop Primer
Description: When you cover a long stretch of ground, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Run Down
Description: A thrown jaw that deals 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It only strikes a target at or below 25% of its health.

Name: Set Scent
Description: Sends a bolt that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds, so your abilities bite deeper. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Lie in Wait
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Trapline Hound
Description: Calls a bonded hound that fights beside you, striking for 5 damage. It also makes its target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Press-Tooth Slam
Description: A crushing blow that deals 36 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Blood Rivet
Description: Fires a rivet that deals 9 damage. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Cold Clasp
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds, hardening your armour by 10% while it lasts.

Name: Hardened Hinge
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Palmed Edge
Description: A quick cut that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Sheathed Verdict
Description: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow for 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% of its health.

Name: Hush
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Dry Spell Edge
Description: After a run of strikes without a critical hit, you gain 30% critical chance for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Dead Still Shot
Description: A shot that deals 32 damage and freezes the target [Frozen] for 1.5 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Chill Sweep
Description: Sweeps a ring of cold that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Hold Still
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sunlit Reset
Description: When your stamina runs out, you restore 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Gnaw Swarm
Description: Looses 5 small jaws at once, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Famine Burst
Description: Hurls a mass of jaws that deals 28 damage and bursts for 80% of it on every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Gnashing Cloud
Description: Conjures a swarm of snapping jaws that fights for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

Name: Crumbs Gathered
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Tacked Sigil
Description: Tacks a sigil to the target that deals 5 damage and has a 30% chance of leaving it [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Unbinding Burst
Description: Bursts arcana that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances.

Name: Held Moment
Description: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Primed Rune
Description: When you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: First Syllable
Description: A spoken blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Binding Verse
Description: Speaks a verse that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss or elite enemy's maximum health, and leaves each [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Reach of the Word
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

Name: Final Clause
Description: When your mana runs out, you restore 12 mana. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Drift Net
Description: Sweeps a cone that deals 4 damage to everything in it and has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Tidal Shove
Description: A surge that deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 2 tiles. It leaves the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Calm Water
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Lazy Current
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. You also regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.

Name: Heave
Description: A shove of force that deals 18 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Deadfall
Description: A dropped weight that deals 40 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, ignoring the target's resistances.

Name: Surge of Force
Description: Increases your damage by 35% for 12 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort strikes beside you for 4 every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Unyielding Jaws
Description: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner.

Name: Longstaff Drill
Description: Thrusts a long branch that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

Name: Grain-True Form
Description: A blow that deals 28 damage and always lands as a critical hit. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Rooted Stance
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Rings of Practice
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. When you reach 10, they all spend at once: you gain a shield of bark that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Taproot Draw
Description: Drives a root into the target that deals 8 damage, leaves it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Bitter Leaf-Fall
Description: Sheds poisonous leaves in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you. It deals 10 poison damage to every enemy caught in it and leaves each one [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Inner-Bark Poultice
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Tannin Core
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.

Name: Deadwood Club
Description: Swings a torn-off limb as a club that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Pelted from Above
Description: Throws 3 hard green fruits pulled from your crown in a spread out to 7 tiles; each one deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Hand over Hand
Description: Swings you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Gnarled Grip
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your armour rises by 5%, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold you attack 5% faster.

Name: Shed Layer
Description: Bursts a layer of bark plate off your body 3 tiles ahead of you; it deals 8 piercing damage to everything caught in it. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Pavise Slam
Description: Slams a plank shield into the target that deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Cambium Plate
Description: Grows a fresh layer of bark under your plate that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Cork Hide
Description: Conjures a cuirass of cork bark: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Felled Across Them
Description: Cuts a trunk loose so that it falls along a narrow line 5 tiles ahead of you. It deals 14 damage to everything under it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: The Last Notch
Description: A felling cut that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It deals 15% more damage for each of your afflictions on the target (max 45%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Coppice Shoots
Description: New shoots close over your cuts and restore 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Living Haft
Description: Conjures a blade on a living haft. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your maximum health by 12, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Shriek from the Hollow
Description: A shriek rings through your hollow trunk and deals 7 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, leaving them [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Roost Drop
Description: Lets go of a high branch and falls on a target up to 7 tiles away. The blow deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and always lands as a critical hit.

Name: Dusk Emergence
Description: Looses the colony that roosts inside your trunk for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage. Each kill made while it flies restores 2 health to you.

Name: Hangs by Night
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.

Name: Heartwood Maul
Description: A two-pawed blow that deals 34 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Stripped to Sapwood
Description: A raking weapon strike that deals 4 damage, strips 5% of the target's armour for 3 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Lie Dormant
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You also restore 15 health.

Name: Winter Girth
Description: Your maximum health rises by 15, and your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Nectar Run
Description: Sends 3 foragers out from your blossom in a spread out to 6 tiles; each one deals 3 poison damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

Name: Wax-Sap Clot
Description: Throws a clot of sap and comb that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Blossom Flush
Description: Brings you into flower where you stand. For 8 seconds the blossom restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles. A swarm escort drawn to it fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Honey Tithe
Description: Each time you gain health, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Maple Key
Description: Throws a winged seed that glides to its target and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles.

Name: Covey Rising
Description: A flock bursts out of your crown and deals 11 wind damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocking them back 3 tiles.

Name: High Perch
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: Windborne Seed
Description: Every few paces you cover, you take root in new ground and regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Green Shaft
Description: Looses a green shaft that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to take root in it and leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Yew at Full Draw
Description: Bends a yew stave to its limit and looses a shaft that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 8 tiles. It ignores armour.

Name: Spring-Pole Snare
Description: Rigs a spring snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds; when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it springs, deals 20 damage to everything within 2 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Creaking Strain
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Shut the Wicker Door
Description: Closes woven roots on a weakened target: the blow deals 22 damage, leaves it [Caged] for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Hedgerow
Description: Raises a 5-tile line of root bars ahead of you for 3 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Overgrown Bars
Description: Roots rise as bars around every creature within 4 tiles and hold it in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Living Ribcage
Description: When your health falls below 50%, roots close round you as bars: you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Limb-Leap Ambush
Description: Leaps you from a high limb onto a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Silvervine Dust
Description: Shakes silvervine pollen over every enemy within 3 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn each one on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

Name: Up the Trunk
Description: Scrambles you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Ninth Life
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you standing at 1 health instead.

Name: Fence-Post Butt
Description: A level shove from planted feet that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

Name: Muster at the Oak
Description: Stamps the ground under your boughs and deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Noon Shade
Description: Spreads your canopy where you stand. For 10 seconds its shade restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. It grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Slow Chew
Description: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Rhizome Runner
Description: Sends a root runner along the ground that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then links on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Liana Haul
Description: Throws a thorned liana round a target up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it, then deals 12 damage, leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 30% for 4 seconds.

Name: Graft-Bound Stand
Description: Grafts your roots to every ally within 5 tiles: each one strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Links Underground
Description: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, linked roots wrap you in a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.

Name: Bast Winding
Description: Throws a length of bark fibre that winds round the first enemy it meets and deals 11 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

Name: Kapok Burst
Description: Splits a seed pod and looses its floss 4 tiles ahead of you; it deals 7 damage to everything caught in it and leaves it [Blunted] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Draped Canopy
Description: Veils you and your allies in hanging moss for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking ends it.

Name: Fibre Bandage
Description: When anything but fire hurts you, healing you receive is 30% stronger for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Staghorn Shard
Description: Snaps a branch off your own body and throws it; it deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Prop-Root Reef
