Description: Raises a 5-tile line of encrusted stilt roots ahead of you for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to anything that crosses it, leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Drinking the Tide
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and 10 health at once.

Name: Mangrove Stilts
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank your health regenerates 15% faster, from silver you move 10% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Cached under the Snag
Description: A weapon strike that deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Log Roll
Description: Rolls your whole trunk over on the spot and deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Mistaken for Driftwood
Description: You veil yourself for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking ends it.

Name: Stillwater Wait
Description: When your stamina fills, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.

Name: Velvet Rub
Description: Rakes branching tines down the target and deals 5 damage, stripping 8% of its armour for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Rack Sweep
Description: Sweeps your branching rack in a full circle and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Understory Dash
Description: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance.

Name: Second Spring
Description: When your stamina runs out, you restore 15 stamina at once. Once every 30 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Fetched Stick
Description: Throws a stick that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill brings one back.

Name: Held at Bay
Description: Rushes every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Kennel in the Buttress
Description: Raises a barrier of buttress roots that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds. A hound escort guards you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Buried Bones
Description: Every kill you make buries a stack at your roots, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Drip Line
Description: Sheds water from your leaves onto every enemy within 3 tiles; it deals 3 water damage and leaves them [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Lands on Someone Else
Description: Flicks a bead of shed water that deals 15 water damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Waxed-Leaf Sheen
Description: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to run off your leaves and land on whoever inflicted it instead.

Name: What Drips Down
Description: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, it drains down to your roots: you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Upheaval
Description: Your roots heave the ground 4 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 rock damage to everything standing on it and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Splitting Wedge
Description: Drives a root into the target and splits it open: the blow deals 30 rock damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Silica Sheath
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Anchored in Bedrock
Description: Your rock attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Knothole Glance
Description: A stare from a knot in your bark that deals 4 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

Name: Lenticel Stare
Description: Opens every pore in your bark: it deals 26 arcane damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignores resistances and leaves each one [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Watch-Sapling
Description: Plants a sapling that watches for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Nothing Unwitnessed
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Fed through the Soil
Description: Your roots feed on every enemy within 2.5 tiles: the draw deals 3 damage to each, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Ripe for Picking
Description: A harvesting blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

Name: Laden Bough
Description: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Harvest Garland
Description: Conjures a garland of fruiting branches: your maximum health rises by 15, each kill returns 4 health, your critical chance rises by 4% and your critical hits deal 12% more damage.

Name: Pitch-Pine Brand
Description: A weapon strike with one of your own limbs lit as a brand: it deals 8 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Serotinous Cone
Description: Throws a resin-sealed cone that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then bursts open in the heat, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Charred Rind
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Spotting Embers
Description: When you kill an enemy, an ember leaps from it to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. It sets that enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Silverleaf Shoal
Description: Sheds 3 slick willow leaves that swim out in a loose shoal, each dealing 3 damage.

Name: Under the Bank
Description: Bank roots close on a target at or below 25% of its health and drag it under, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Riverworn Rind
Description: Your bark runs slick with river water: your armour rises by 15% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

Name: Slip and Settle
Description: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and harden into a bark shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.

Name: Bough Spring
Description: You bend a bough and let it fling you up to 7 tiles onto the target, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that from the full distance.

Name: Gall Spatter
Description: Kicks a cone of hopping gall seeds ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Too Small to Fell
Description: You hop 2 tiles and set your bark: damage you take is reduced by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Wayfarer's Ward
Description: Each time you have covered enough ground, your bark closes into a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Mile-Worn Stamp
Description: Brings a rooted heel down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Kicked Burr
Description: Kicks a seed burr that deals 4 damage and catches on the target's feet, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Walking Saplings
Description: Uproots 2 saplings that march beside you for 20 seconds, each striking enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Milestone Oak
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Bifurcate
Description: Throws a twig that deals 7 damage, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Root Delta
Description: Roots branch out under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour, then fork on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 50% of the damage.

Name: Crown Splits Wide
Description: Your crown forks outward: for 15 seconds your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

Name: Offshoot
Description: When you land a critical hit, a splinter forks off to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Rustling Thicket
Description: The undergrowth around you lashes out, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Low-Branch Feint
Description: A switch of a low branch that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Leaf-Litter Den
Description: You sink into the leaf litter and are veiled for 6 seconds, moving 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

Name: Moonlit Cover
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.

Name: Canopy Tongue
Description: A sticky lash from high in your branches that deals 4 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and reaches 30% further. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Shaken Rain
Description: Shakes the rain out of your canopy, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Rain-Rinsed Leaves
Description: Rinses up to 2 conditions off you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Lodger in the Crook
Description: A bonded familiar lives in the crook of your branches and leaps at enemies within 5 tiles, striking for 3 damage and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a tick for 4 ticks.

Name: Heartrot
Description: Bores into the core of a target at or below 30% of its health, dealing 15 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Mycelial Bloom
Description: Spores rise through the soil from your roots, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Sap Commons
Description: Pushes sap through the threads beneath you, restoring 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Fed on Rot
Description: When you inflict a condition, its rot feeds your roots: you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Unbudged Gore
Description: A lowered-crown butt that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% per tenth of your health already lost (max 30%).

Name: Steady Hooves
Description: Stamps your footing, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 15% chance to leave each [Pinned] by roots for 1 second.

Name: Will Not Be Moved
Description: Plant yourself and challenge up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles, pulling them onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Clinging to the Crag
Description: When your health falls below 50%, your roots lock into the rock and you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.

Name: Ripened Windfall
Description: After a 1.5-second wait, drops a heavy ripe fruit that deals 32 damage and bursts for 80% of that on enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Hedgerow Browse
Description: Crops the hedge around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Shelterbelt
Description: Spreads your branches over the ally who needs it most, restoring 3 health a second to them for 8 seconds.

Name: Slow-Grazed Rings
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Capsule Crack
Description: A seed capsule bursts open and fires a seed that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets.

Name: Splinter Report
Description: Your bark bursts outward in a cone of splinters, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Seasoned Stock
Description: Your grain dries and hardens to a gunstock's: your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Primed Resin
Description: When your stamina is full, resin primes in your bark and your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Filament Binding
Description: A strike wound with fine root filaments that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Needle Strands
Description: Combs out 4 strands of pine needles at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

Name: Moss Mantle
Description: Mats moss and fibre into a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Fine Draught
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.

Name: Timber Falls
Description: You topple your own trunk along a narrow line 6 tiles long, dealing 32 damage to everything under it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Knotted Mallet
Description: Pays 5% of your maximum health to swing a knot of your own wood, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Driven Stakes
Description: Hammers a row of sharpened stakes 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you, blocking enemies for 8 seconds.

Name: Driven Deep
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.

Name: Reaching Limb
Description: A limb reaches out to grab the first enemy in its path, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Uprooting Grip
Description: Grips a target at or below 25% of its health and wrenches it out, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Linked Branches
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles takes hold of your branches and strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Steady Limbs
Description: When you strike, your grip settles: your next strike has 12% more critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Ridden Down
Description: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] by roots for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Kicked-Up Mould
Description: Kicks leaf mould ahead of you in a cone, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

Name: Long-Haul Sap
Description: Sap runs through your legs: your stamina recovery rises by 40% for 20 seconds.

Name: Deep Reserves
Description: When your stamina runs out, your roots draw it back: you regain 4 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Barbed Twist
Description: Twists a thorn into a target already carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage and leave the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Bramble Snag
Description: Throws a line of briars 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags enemies inward, dealing 12 damage and stunning each it catches for 1 second.

Name: Barbed Reprisal
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and the barbs leave them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Burrs Gather
Description: Every hit you land hooks a burr into the target, up to 4. At 4 they all tear free at once, striking that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per burr (136% at full). Unfed, the burrs fall away.

Name: Hoofbeat Tremor
Description: Hoofbeats gallop out through the ground in a cone, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Drumming Hardwood
Description: Hurls a hardwood stave that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Steady Canter
Description: Your movement speed rises by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 5% more dodge chance.

Name: Long Stride
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%. You carry 6% earth resistance.

Name: Spotter's Spike
Description: From high in your crown you loose a thrown spike that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, reaching 50% further (up to 1.2 times the damage at full reach), and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Brought to Ground
Description: Strikes a target at or below 30% of its health, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds as roots catch it.

Name: Trunk to Trunk
Description: Steps you through the trees to a point up to 8 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after.

Name: Scent Through the Soil
Description: Against a target at low health, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Lignum Ram
Description: A ram of dense, cold wood that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Heartwood Spike
Description: Drives a spike of cold, dense heartwood into a target at or below 20% of its health, dealing 25 damage.

Name: Ashen Heartwood
Description: Your wood goes grey and cold: your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Cold-Core Bole
Description: Your armour rises by 10%. You carry 6% frost resistance.

Name: Splinter to the Heart
Description: Slides a hidden splinter into a target at or below 25% of its health, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Peeling Edges
Description: Pays 5% of your maximum health to shed edged slivers of bark around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Honed Limb
Description: You strop your limbs to an edge: your damage rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Sap on the Edge
Description: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Held-Breath Lunge
Description: After holding still, you lunge at a target at or below 25% of its health, dealing 22 damage, up to 1.3 times that from further away. Its reach is 30% longer.

Name: Stored Sunlight
Description: Releases the sunlight your leaves have stored, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Sun-Drawn Sap
Description: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Leaves Turned Sunward
Description: By day, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Defoliate
Description: Pays 5% of your maximum health to shed your leaves in a devouring cone, dealing 8 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

Name: Grub-Eaten Pinecone
Description: Throws a pinecone hollowed by grubs that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Leaf Swarm
Description: Looses a swarm of chewing leaves for 12 seconds that strikes enemies within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second.

Name: Regrowth After Ruin
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Ley Lance
Description: Draws raw arcana up through your roots and fires it as a lance that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistances.

Name: Glittering Pollen
Description: Breathes a cone of charged pollen, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drawn Through the Xylem
Description: Draws mana up through your wood: you regain 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Surge Sheath
Description: When you spend mana, the spillover hardens your bark into a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Carved Sigil
Description: Carves a glyph into a target already carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 9 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Twin Glyph-Seeds
Description: After a 1-second recitation, looses 2 rune-cut seeds at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Runic Backlash
Description: Runes open across your trunk: for 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is sent back at whoever cast it.

Name: Annual Recitation
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Drifting Seed Pods
Description: Sets seed pods drifting out around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drift of Timber
Description: Sets a waterlogged mangrove log drifting at the first enemy in its path, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Seagrass Meadow
Description: Grows a meadow of seagrass where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it, within 4 tiles.

Name: Unhurried Mending
Description: When you take damage that is not fire, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Reading the Cracks
Description: Jabs the target for a hit that deals 4 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. The hit does 10% more damage for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

Name: Plumb and Level
Description: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It always strikes critically.

Name: Journeyman's Hand
Description: After a 0.5-second cast, calls an apprentice for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Course by Course
Description: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 5% of your maximum health per stack (29% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Rake Out
Description: Strikes an enemy and uses up one of your afflictions on it. The strike deals 9 damage and leaves the enemy 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions.

Name: Bitter Slurry
Description: A burst that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it, and you restore 8 health.

Name: Lime Poultice
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Tight Pointing
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and your poison resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Cornerstone Toss
Description: Throws a stone block that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Tamping Fists
Description: Slams the ground, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. It costs 4% of your maximum health, and its damage rises 6% for each tenth of your health you have lost (max 30%).

Name: Roughcast Grip
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hod-Carrier's Shoulders
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your armour rises by 5%, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold you attack 5% faster.

Name: Resounding Slab
Description: Slams a slab across the front, which deals 12 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Seam Driver
Description: A thrust between the layers that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 10 seconds.

Name: Buttress
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

Name: Banded Ashlar
Description: Conjures stone armour: every hit you take deals 2 less damage, your armour rises by 10%, and your maximum health rises by 12.

Name: Split on the Score
Description: A chop that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Chips Off the Block
Description: A chop across the front that deals 11 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you, knocks each enemy back 2 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

Name: Broken-Glass Coping
Description: Raises a wall 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 8 seconds. Enemies that touch it are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Bedding Plane
Description: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Sounding Tap
Description: Raps the ground, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Belfry Burst
Description: Sends bats at the first enemy it meets, which deals 28 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. It ignores resistances.

Name: Whispering Gallery
Description: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is reflected back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Roofline Grotesque
Description: A bonded grotesque fights beside you. Every 1.3 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4.5 tiles and deals 4 damage.

Name: Wallbreaker
Description: Shoulders into everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, which deals 16 damage and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

Name: Undermine
Description: Strikes the target, which deals 30 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 10 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Warm Den
Description: Sets up a healing field where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

Name: Girth of a Pier
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Brood Cells
Description: Stings every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 7 damage. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Mud-Dauber's Errand
Description: Sends a bee at the first enemy it meets, which deals 11 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It then carries your afflictions on that enemy to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Swarm Lodge
Description: After a 0.4-second cast, builds a hive for 12 seconds. Every second its swarm stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Industry of the Comb
Description: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.

Name: Stoop From the Spire
Description: Drops a stone from height onto a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Swallow's Pellets
Description: Flings 3 mud pellets at once in a spread, and each deals 2 damage. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Mud-Cup Nest
Description: Surrounds you with a shield that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Beakful of Mud
Description: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Line Pin Shot
Description: Shoots a pin at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Drawn Until It Snaps
Description: Releases a taut line in a ring, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Long Sight
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

Name: True to the Bob
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Grille Throw
Description: Throws an iron grille at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1.5 seconds, and the target moves 30% slower for 4 seconds.

Name: Portcullis Drop
Description: Drops a gate across the front, which deals 30 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Standstill
Description: After a 1-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 4 seconds, then leaves each of them moving 30% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Warden's Side
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour is 10% higher.

Name: Taut-Cord Prowl
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then strikes, which deals 13 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Ledge Lob
Description: Lobs a loose brick at the first enemy it meets that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 3% for each 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Quiet Footing
Description: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 65% later, you move 17% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Bolt-Hole
Description: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Treading the Clay
Description: Stomps the ground, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Yoked Heave
Description: A heavy blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Steady Labour
Description: After a 1.5-second cast, your damage rises 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Hair in the Mix
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Running Bond
Description: Throws a link on a chain that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Unlinking
Description: A wrenching blow that deals 16 damage and tears out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one torn out. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Come Along
Description: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Through-Stone Tally
Description: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Plaster Cast
Description: Throws a plaster strip that wraps the first enemy it meets, which deals 11 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Chalk Snap
Description: Snaps a chalked cord at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 3 seconds.

Name: Under One Tarpaulin
Description: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Linen Gambeson
Description: Conjures a linen coat: every hit you take deals 1 less damage, your armour rises by 6%, and your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Living Spur
Description: Breaks a spur off your own body and throws it, which deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Breakwater
Description: Strikes every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 12 damage and knocks them back 3 tiles. You restore 6 health.

Name: Accretion
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Reef Causeway
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Footing Bite
Description: Clamps onto the target, which deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.6 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Moat Lunge
Description: Lunges at a target up to 5 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores armour.

Name: Flagstone Snare
Description: After a 1-second cast, sets a trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage and leaves the enemy [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: The Long Set
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Antler Pick
Description: Strikes the target, which deals 8 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Over the Ha-Ha
Description: Bounds you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then lands, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Park Paling
Description: Raises a wall 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: A Brick Per Miss
Description: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Thrown and Fetched
Description: Throws your trowel, which deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill fetches one back.

Name: Pack at the Gate
Description: A shove outward that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

Name: Hold the Threshold
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Porter's Mastiff
Description: A bonded mastiff guards you. Every 1.2 seconds it bites an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Sluice Gate
Description: Releases a torrent ahead of you, which deals 28 damage to everything within 4.5 tiles in front and leaves each enemy [Soaked] for 8 seconds. It ignores resistances.

Name: Slate Skip
Description: Skims a slate at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

Name: Waterproof Render
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Drip Mould
Description: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Knocking Off Spalls
Description: Knocks 4 jagged spalls off a block in a spread, and each deals 2 damage.

Name: Backfill
Description: Buries the target, which deals 24 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Waymark Cairn
Description: After a 0.5-second cast, stacks a cairn for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it throws a stone at an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage.

Name: Bedrock Beneath Paving
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Oculus Glare
Description: Fires a beam of light that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, its critical hit chance is 50% higher.

Name: Chisel to the Mark
Description: Throws a chisel at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Carved Watcher
Description: After a 0.5-second cast, sets up a stone watcher for 12 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it fires on an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Measured Twice
Description: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 30% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Clear the Board
Description: Flings a blade that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Carving Round
Description: Cuts a full circle, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and makes them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Topping-Out Supper
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Stocked Larder
Description: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Stokehole Blast
Description: Blasts everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 damage and leaves each enemy [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Bursting Clinker
Description: Throws a brick that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Hard Glaze
Description: Raises your armour by 30% and your fire resistance by 15% for 12 seconds.

Name: Kiln-Hot Float
Description: Conjures a float still hot from the kiln. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You have 8% fire resistance.

Name: Shoal of Slurry
Description: Flicks 3 gobs of wet mortar in a spread; each deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slipped Load
Description: Skims a slick load of mortar off the trowel at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Slick Render
Description: Coats you in wet render that raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 12% for 10 seconds.

Name: Skim-Coat Slip
Description: After you move a set distance, a skin of wet mortar wards you, absorbing damage equal to 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Scaffold Pounce
Description: Leaps 7 tiles to the target and slams the trowel flat, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Hopping Grit
Description: Flicks a pinch of quick-setting grit that deals 4 damage, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Spring and Brace
Description: Springs you 3 tiles away and braces you: the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 8 seconds.

Name: Crusted Hopper
Description: Binds a mortar-crusted flea familiar to you that strikes for 4 damage; anything it hits moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Thrown Milestone
Description: Heaves a milestone that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

Name: Tramp the Bedding
Description: Stamps the mortar bed flat around you, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Hobnailed Stance
Description: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Mile of Setts
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Split Bat
Description: Flings half a brick that deals 7 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Both Ways Out
Description: Swings the trowel both ways, sending 2 clods of spoil out spread wide; each deals 11 damage and knocks the enemy it hits back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Diverted Blow
Description: For 8 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Either Side of It
Description: Once every 12 seconds, a blow aimed at you that would have landed is rolled for dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Lime in the Eyes
Description: Throws a fistful of lime dust around you, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to confuse each one for 3 seconds.

Name: Pulled Keystone
Description: Pulls a keystone loose at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Blunted] for 6 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Loose Paver
Description: After a 0.5-second cast, lays a loose paving stone at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 18 damage and leaves the enemy [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Mischief in the Mix
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Lick of Lime
Description: Flicks a lick of wet mortar at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Trench Spring
Description: Springs 6 tiles out of the footing trench onto the target and strikes it, which deals 15 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Damp Plaster Skin
Description: A coat of damp plaster absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Wet-Set Hop
Description: When you spend stamina, you gain a ward that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum health for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Rot in the Joints
Description: A strike into the mortar joints that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Dry Rot Bloom
Description: Bursts the rot through the stonework around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring armour, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Damp Pillar
Description: After a 0.5-second cast, sets up a mould-furred pillar for 12 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it fires spores at an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

Name: Mycelial Footing
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Butting Heel
Description: A drive with the trowel's heel that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Coping Stone Kick
Description: Kicks a loose coping stone down at the target that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

Name: Plant Your Feet
Description: You become immune to blows and conditions for 6 seconds.

Name: Won't Be Budged
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Penning Sweep
Description: Sweeps the trowel round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

Name: Raising the Byre
Description: Drives a beam end at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Winter Fold
Description: Marks out a fold 4 tiles across for 10 seconds; you and your allies inside it regain 3 health a second.

Name: Barn-Warm Walls
Description: Your abilities' cooldowns are 6% shorter, your armour is 6% higher, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Finishing Report
Description: Fires a charge of packed grit at a target up to 7 tiles away that is at or below 25% of its health; it deals 24 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

Name: Quarry Face Blast
Description: Sets off a blasting charge that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit and has a 50% chance to leave the enemy [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Truing the Shot
Description: Raises your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Down the Bed Course
Description: Your piercing damage ignores 12% of armour, and your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.

Name: Fibred Spatter
Description: Flicks horsehair plaster ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles in front, with a 15% chance to leave each one [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Drawn Taut
Description: A strike that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Bristled Render
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Lath and Lime
Description: Conjures a coat of lime plaster: your armour rises by 10% and then by a further 4%, every hit on you is reduced by 2, and 8% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Tamping Block
Description: Hurls a tamping block at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 14 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Bedded Flat
Description: A flattening blow that deals 32 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Settled Swing
Description: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Compacted Blows
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.

Name: Passed Along
Description: Lobs a brick to a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Steady Round
Description: Sweeps the trowel round in one steady stroke, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Lifting Together
Description: Removes up to 2 control effects from you and your allies.

Name: Mason's Mitts
Description: Conjures a mason's gloves: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical damage by 15% and your maximum health by 12, and each kill restores 3 health.

Name: Unflagging Strokes
Description: A strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Trampled Footings
Description: Tramples through the footings ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles in front, knocking them back 3 tiles and leaving them [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Hauling Team
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and fights with 1 more power for 12 seconds.

Name: Second Haul
Description: When your stamina runs out, you restore 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Raking Barb
Description: A raking pull of the trowel point that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to make it [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

Name: Wall-Tie Snag
Description: Casts a barbed wall-tie at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

Name: Snag and Haul
Description: Hauls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Caught Fast
Description: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Ridden Down
Description: Gallops 8 tiles to a target and strikes it, which deals 16 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles.

Name: Tamped Seam
Description: A tamping strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

Name: Hoofbeat Run
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 8 seconds.

Name: Paced Gallop
Description: Your movement speed is permanently 10% higher, and you have 8% earth resistance.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: Rushes 8 tiles to a target and strikes it, which deals 16 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. The strike does 10% more damage for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

Name: Chalk-Line Mark
Description: Snaps a chalk line at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

Name: Sight Down the String
Description: Your reach rises by 30% for 15 seconds.

Name: Next Quarry
Description: When you kill an enemy, you restore 15 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Cramp Bolt
Description: Flings an iron cramp that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

Name: Cold Filing Spray
Description: Sprays cold iron filings ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles in front, ignoring resistances, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Banded Course
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

Name: Unyielding Bond
Description: When your health falls below 35%, you gain a ward that absorbs damage equal to 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Concealed Edge
Description: A cut with the trowel's edge at a target at or below 30% of its health that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Slate Slivers
Description: Flicks 3 slivers of slate in a spread; each deals 3 damage, rising 10% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

Name: Behind the Scaffold
Description: You fade from sight for 6 seconds: enemies pay you 60% less attention, and you move 10% faster.

Name: Honed Again
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Sun-Warmed Lash
Description: Lashes the trowel at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Chill Pat
Description: Slaps cold mortar round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Basking Wall
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds, and you have 10% frost resistance.

Name: Warm Stone Sitter
Description: During the day, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Grit Swarm
Description: Looses 4 chips of grit at once, spread apart; each deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Picked Clean
Description: A strike that deals 18 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Cloud Over the Yard
Description: Looses a swarm for 10 seconds. Every second it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage.

Name: Rubble-Fed
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Arcane Capstone
Description: Hurls a keystone charged with raw mana that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistances.

Name: Resonant Course
Description: Sets the mortar joints around you humming, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to confuse each one for 2 seconds.

Name: Relaid Foundations
Description: Resets the cooldown of 1 of your other abilities.

Name: Charged Bedding
Description: Your abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter, and you have 8% arcane resistance.

Name: Recited Courses
Description: Recites a line ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles in front, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Muddled] for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

Name: Last Letter Struck
Description: A strike at a target at or below 25% of its health that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Corrected Script
Description: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Rehearsed Lines
Description: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Settle
Description: A press of the trowel that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Lazy Wake
Description: Rolls a wave of slurry at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Drifting Mend
Description: Heals you and every ally within 4 tiles for 14 health, plus 1% more for each 1% of your cast speed.

Name: Slow to Bruise
Description: When you take non-fire damage, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Same Lesson Twice
Description: Strikes the target with your shell, which deals 4 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it a [Slow Learner] for 8 seconds: your thorns hurt it more and barriers it strikes grow stronger.

Name: Learned the Hard Way
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. The blow deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Testudo Drill
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Practised Routine
Description: Your ability cooldowns are 6% shorter and your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Draw the Bitterness
Description: Draws one of your afflictions out of an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Lobbed Purge
Description: Spits a glob of poison that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. The target is left [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Taken Into Yourself
Description: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and your allies and into your shell, and restores 10 health.

Name: Nothing Takes Hold
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Cracked on the Anvil
Description: Seizes the target and slams it into your shell, which deals 30 damage that ignores armour, leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Swung by the Rim
Description: Swings a plate of your shell through a cone 3 tiles ahead, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Brute Resolve
Description: Your blunt damage rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you restore 12 health.

Name: Knapped Scute
Description: Shapes a scute from your shell into a weapon. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Riveted Shove
Description: Drives your shell into the target, which deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 14% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The target is [Damped], its damage lowered, for 5 seconds.

Name: Shed Lames
Description: Blasts the outer plates off your shell, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores their armour.

Name: Second Skin of Steel
Description: Closes a second layer of plate over you that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

Name: Layer on Layer
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Fall
Description: After a 1.5-second wind-up, chops down through a cone 3 tiles ahead, which deals 34 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Splitting Wedge
Description: A chop usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. It deals 20 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Blades Along the Keel
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Knows Where Shells Split
Description: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Hollow Ping
Description: Sends out a ping that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds: your abilities hurt it more and it shows on the map.

Name: Struck Bell
Description: Rings your shell, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. Each has a 30% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

Name: Brumation
Description: Veils you in the dark for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and the veil breaks the moment you attack. It also restores 14 health.

Name: Hibernaculum
Description: At night, your armour rises by 14%. Your dodge chance is 4% higher at all times.

Name: Whole Weight Down
Description: Lunges up to 3.5 tiles and falls on the target, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and moves 30% slower for 4 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Wounded Shrug
Description: Throws your weight through a cone 2 tiles ahead, which deals 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Laid-Up Stores
Description: Your maximum health rises by 20% for 10 seconds, and you restore 12 health.

Name: Denned Up
Description: Once your health falls below 50%, healing you receive is 40% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.

Name: Foragers Out
Description: Sends 3 foragers out from the hive in your shell in a spread out to 6 tiles; each one deals 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

Name: Barb Left Behind
Description: Fires a barbed sting that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and stays in the wound, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Open Comb
Description: Opens a honeycomb field within 3 tiles of where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. For 7 seconds a swarm fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Colony Aboard
Description: A bonded swarm fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 2 health.

Name: Plummet
Description: Lifts you to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and drops you on it, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Clutch of Four
Description: Throws an egg from your clutch that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Updraft
Description: Lifts you 4 tiles from where you stood. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you; transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Long Migration
Description: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Held at Full Draw
Description: Holds the string at full draw for 2 seconds, then looses an arrow that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour.

Name: Loophole Shot
Description: Looses an arrow through a gap in your shell at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. The target moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Planted Pavise
Description: Stands a plate of your shell 4 tiles long in front of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Loaded Silence
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Shelled In
Description: Closes a cage of shell plates around the first enemy it meets, which deals 10 damage and stuns it for 1.6 seconds. The target is [Suppressed] for 5 seconds: its auras are smothered and its abilities are out of reach.

Name: Ribs Sprung Wide
Description: Springs the ribs of your shell outward as bars, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

Name: Portcullis
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Anything it holds moves 25% slower for 4 seconds.

Name: Turn the Key
Description: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying one of your afflictions. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: End of the Stalk
Description: A pounce at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away, usable only on one at or below 30% health. It deals 20 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: Pebble-Still Ambush
Description: Lashes a paw out at the first enemy in its path, which deals 4 damage. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Bask on the Sill
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and restores 10 health.

Name: Lands Right Side Up
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Gathering Plod
Description: Shoves into the target, which deals 14 damage, knocks it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 25%).

Name: At Your Own Pace
Description: Stamps the ground, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered], its attacks slowed, for 4 seconds.

Name: Will Not Be Driven
Description: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you and restores 8 health.

Name: Plough Until Dusk
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.

Name: Link After Link
Description: Throws your anchor chain, which deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second, then links to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Each enemy struck is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Flail on a Tether
Description: Swings a shell plate on a length of chain at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Shackled to You
Description: Chains up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles to your shell: they are pulled onto you and held there for 6 seconds.

Name: Mail of Linked Scutes
Description: Conjures mail of linked scutes: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Winding Sheet
Description: Wraps an enemy up to 5 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, which deals 20 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Smothering Fold
Description: Throws a fold of padding over a cone 2.5 tiles ahead, which deals 3 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped], its damage lowered, for 5 seconds.

Name: Dressing Station
Description: Binds the wounds of the ally who needs it most, restoring 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Self-Binding Wraps
Description: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health wraps you for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Polyp Touch
Description: Lashes stinging polyps at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target is left [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Fringing Reef
Description: Grows a reef 5 tiles long out from your shell for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Calcify
Description: Your armour rises by 30% for 12 seconds, and your water resistance rises by 15%.

Name: Slow Accretion
Description: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal for 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Drag Under
Description: Clamps your beak on an enemy at or below 30% health and rolls, which deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The target is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Log That Wasn't
Description: Erupts around you, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles as a critical hit and leaves each [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

Name: Wriggling Lure
Description: Up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles are pulled onto you for 5 seconds, and your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

Name: Longer the Wait
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Shed and Regrown
Description: Throws a tine at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, which deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. 40% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

Name: Startle Stamp
Description: Stamps the ground, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 0.8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds afterward.

Name: Leap into Cover
Description: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood and pulls you into your shell: your armour rises by 25% for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Spooked Stride
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 4% faster per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Sent After It
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away to bite and hold on, which deals 13 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

Name: Circle the Wards
Description: Slams the ground around you, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Stand Over Them
Description: The damage you take is reduced by 25% for 10 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Barded Mastiff
Description: A bonded mastiff in shell barding fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Belly to the Sky
Description: Flips the target onto its back, which deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Skipped Across the Pond
Description: Skims a flat scute that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Rolls Off the Back
Description: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 70% chance to run off your shell and back to whoever inflicted it.

Name: Bobbing Driftwood
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Shrugged Landslide
Description: Shrugs the stone off your back in a spread of 3 boulders out to 6 tiles; each one deals 8 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

Name: Spalled Plate
Description: Breaks a stone plate off your shell over the target at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, which deals 10 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Nest in the Scree
Description: Buries a clutch of stone eggs at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off, which deals 24 damage.

Name: Fault Under Strain
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Slit Glance
Description: Fires a glance at the first enemy in line, which deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Exposed], its resistance to the elements stripped, for 8 seconds.

Name: Sweep of the Gaze
Description: Sweeps a cone 5 tiles ahead with your gaze, which deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores resistance. Each target has [Karma] opened against it for 10 seconds: your blows on it land harder and its blows land softer.

Name: Periscope Neck
Description: Extends your neck from the shell: for 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Nictitating Blink
Description: When you land a critical hit, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Mouthful
Description: Takes a mouthful out of the target, which deals 8 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Overturned Cauldron
Description: Tips out a pot of boiling stew, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores resistance. You restore 10 health.

Name: Everyone Eats
Description: Serves a meal off the back of your shell: restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Full Larder
Description: The moment you are back at full health, the surplus is stored as a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Banked Ember
Description: Throws an ember banked under your shell that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Vent the Kiln
Description: Vents the heat stored in your shell, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hearth Within
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Cold Blood Warmed
Description: Each time you afflict something, the heat warms your blood and you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Fry From the Underside
Description: Looses 3 silver fry from the shelter under your shell, spread apart, each one dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage they deal comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

Name: Slick Glide
Description: You glide shell-first along a slick of scales to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and it deals 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slips the Net
Description: Raises a slick shell barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Slip, Then Settle
Description: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and you settle into a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Sprung Snap
Description: Springs your jaws out at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: Fall From a Height
Description: You leap high and come down shell-first where you stood, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Infested Challenge
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. Fleas pour out of your shell and fight beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 3 every 1 second.

Name: Bite Back Harder
Description: When your health falls below 50%, 25% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Road's-End Stamp
Description: A stamp that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +40%).

Name: Overtaken at Last
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A blow that deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Rest at the Milestone
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and heals you for 10 health when you use it.

Name: Every League Hardens
Description: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, your shell hardens into a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Split Tine
Description: Flicks a two-pronged barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. You heal for 10% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Branching Rot
Description: A strike with your weapon that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Glanced Both Ways
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage that reaches your shell is turned back on whoever dealt it.

Name: The Other Road
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.

Name: Out of the Shell
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Darts your head out of your shell for a bite that deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit. It has 50% more critical chance against anything not yet wounded.

Name: Spun Upside Down
Description: You spin on the dome of your shell, which deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

Name: Empty-Shell Ruse
Description: Veils you for 5 seconds and heals you for 10 health. Enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: After Lamplight
Description: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 6% at all times.

Name: Snatched From the Bank
Description: Springs at an enemy up to 4 tiles away and snaps it in your jaws, which deals 22 damage and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It only lands on a target at or below 25% health.

Name: Belly-First Splash
Description: You spring up and land in a splash, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Plop and Pull In
Description: You spring 3 tiles and pull into your shell, raising your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Cool Mud Skin
Description: When something other than fire hurts you, your damp skin draws it off and you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Shake Loose the Moss
Description: Shakes the spore-moss off your shell, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you heal for 10 health.

Name: Ripe for Picking
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A blow that deals 16 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 2 times their remaining damage to the hit.

Name: Spore-Crusted Back
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Larger Each Morning
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.6 health a second.

Name: Ram With the Rim
Description: Lowers your head behind the rim of your shell and rams, which deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Scree Down the Slope
Description: Kicks loose a slide of scree down the cone ahead of you, which deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores armour. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +30%).

Name: Plant All Four Feet
Description: You take 25% less damage for 12 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Purchase on Stone
Description: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Herd at Your Back
Description: Leads a shove into the cone ahead of you, which deals 10 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max +32%).

Name: Lead Beast's Blow
