Description: A slow, heavy blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds after it lands.

Name: Huddle for Warmth
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Chewing the Cud
Description: When you regain health, you also restore 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Aim From Cover
Description: Settles in behind your shell for 2 seconds, then fires a shot that deals 38 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour.

Name: Point-Blank Recoil
Description: A blast into the cone ahead of you that deals 11 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 7% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +35%).

Name: Held Breath
Description: Hunker still for 1.5 seconds, then your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

Name: Powder Kept Dry
Description: When a long run of your hits fails to crit, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Snarl of Strands
Description: Casts a snarl of strands 4 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Enemies it catches take 10 damage and are stunned for 1 second.

Name: Lashing Fringe
Description: Lashes a fringe of strands at an enemy up to 4 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Combed Clean
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and heals you for 12 health.

Name: Counted Strand by Strand
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once and you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pressed Into the Ground
Description: Drops your full weight onto the ground, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores armour.

Name: Patient Peening
Description: A short tap that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Anvil Back
Description: Raises your armour by 35% for 12 seconds, and your blunt resistance by 15%.

Name: Struck Back Level
Description: Every blow you take builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Snapping Hold
Description: Clamps your jaws onto the target: it deals 10 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Wrench the Wound
Description: Wrenches at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, which deals 9 damage and uses up that affliction.

Name: Every Collar Seized
Description: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Braced Grip
Description: When you spend stamina, you brace inside your shell and gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Kicked-Up Clods
Description: Kicks clods of earth into the cone ahead of you, which deals 7 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Hoofbeat Rush
Description: Thunders at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds, and heals you for 10 health.

Name: Plodding but Endless
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 6%, and your earth resistance by 8%.

Name: Snagged and Reeled
Description: Casts a barbed line at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Barb Torn Free
Description: A tearing strike with your weapon that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Worm on the Tongue
Description: Sets a lure on the ground near the nearest enemy. It waits up to 12 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage in a snap around it.

Name: Line Held Taut
Description: Against afflicted enemies, your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Shell-First Gallop
Description: Gallops to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and strikes shell-first, which deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Trampling Thunder
Description: Rears and brings your whole armoured weight down, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health to a boss or elite.

Name: Barded Charger
Description: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Momentum Under the Shell
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 4% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.

Name: Marking Snap
Description: Snaps at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground
Description: A strike with your weapon that deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It only lands on a target at or below 30% health.

Name: Stalker's Vigil
Description: For 28 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

Name: Closing Distance
Description: Against enemies below 50% health, your damage rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.

Name: Unyielding Shove
Description: A strike with your weapon that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3 seconds.

Name: Cold Grey Breath
Description: Breathes the cold off your shell into the cone ahead of you, which deals 28 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances.

Name: Cold and Unmoved
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

Name: Grey Carapace
Description: Conjures cold iron over your shell: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.

Name: Edge Under the Rim
Description: Draws an edge from under the rim of your shell for a strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: From Inside the Shell
Description: Flicks a blade from inside your shell that deals 24 damage to the first enemy it meets. It only lands on a target at or below 25% health.

Name: Bait the Lunge
Description: Your critical damage rises by 40% for 15 seconds, and up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles are drawn onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Edge Kept Sheathed
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Basking Ambush
Description: Strikes an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Chill That Settles
Description: Lets the cold in your blood settle over the ground, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. They are [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Sun-Warmed Mending
Description: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

Name: Sunned Shell
Description: By day, your armour rises by 12%.

Name: Swarm Spat Back
Description: Spits a knot of locusts that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Strip the Field
Description: Looses a devouring cloud into the cone ahead of you, which deals 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of its maximum health to a boss or elite.

Name: Cloud Kept Close
Description: Calls a swarm that circles you for 10 seconds, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second.

Name: Gorged and Mended
Description: When you kill an enemy, healing you receive rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Discharge the Shell
Description: Releases the arcana soaked into your shell, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores resistances.

Name: Muddling Mote
Description: Throws a mote of raw arcana that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Spell-Turning Dome
Description: For 8 seconds, your shell turns 40% of the elemental damage you take back on whoever dealt it.

Name: Ward Woven In
Description: Your armour rises by 8%, and your arcane resistance by 10%.

Name: Word of Halting
Description: Speaks a halting word into the cone ahead of you, which deals 11 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Closing Syllable
Description: Sends a single spoken syllable that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Recited Ward
Description: Recites a ward over your shell that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Learned by Rote
Description: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Gentle Wake
Description: Pushes a slow wake into the cone ahead of you, which deals 3 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Unhurried Blow
Description: A slow, heavy blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Warm Shallows
Description: Warms the water where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Drift Until Rested
Description: When your stamina runs out, you drift and restore 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Lap After Lap
Description: Strikes a target up to 5 tiles away as you pass. It deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Perfected Line
Description: Carries you through a turn that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Second Nature
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Miles of Practice
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Bitter Cargo
Description: Draws the poison back out of a target up to 6 tiles away as you pass. It deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

Name: Urgent Dispatch
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and vents the poison you have drawn across a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 12 damage and leaves each enemy [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: House Call
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and from each ally, and restores 10 health to you. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Clean Getaway
Description: When a condition on you ends, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Swinging Arrival
Description: Swings you to a target up to 6 tiles away and brings both fists down on it. The blow deals 16 damage, leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second and makes it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Fist-Fall Tread
Description: Each knuckled stride pounds the ground and deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Running Board
Description: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 4 health.

Name: Knuckle Gallop
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you attack 5% faster, and from gold your maximum health rises by 10.

Name: Ram Prow
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and rams it with a steel prow. The ram deals 30 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Trading Paint
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sideswipes everything in a cone 2.5 tiles long: it deals 8 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hatches Down
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Coachwork Plate
Description: Conjures plating built to travel in: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and you move 4% faster.

Name: Headsman's Run
Description: Runs you to a target up to 6 tiles away and chops it. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. The chop deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Chariot Blades
Description: Blades on your axles sweep every enemy within 3 tiles. The sweep deals 14 damage, knocks each enemy back 2 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Felled Across the Road
Description: Fells a trunk 5 tiles long across the ground in front of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Outrider's Hatchet
Description: Conjures a hatchet made to be swung from the saddle: your weapon damage rises by 12%, you move 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Flyby Nip
Description: A bite taken in passing that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. You move 8% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Shrieking Descent
Description: Swoops you to a target up to 6 tiles away and shrieks. The shriek deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance to turn each one on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

Name: Lamps Out
Description: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Sounding Ahead
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, a shriek finds the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Roadkill
Description: Rolls over the target with your full weight. The blow deals 34 damage that ignores resistance, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Bulk Through
Description: Shoulders your weight through everything in a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 16 damage and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

Name: Too Heavy to Stop
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

Name: Gathering Tonnage
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health settles over you for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Forager Sortie
Description: Looses 3 foragers at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage. They carry 20% of the damage dealt back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Hive Aboard
Description: Sends a hive off your tailboard into the first enemy in its path. It deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Tireless Rounds
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. For 8 seconds a swarm rides escort beside you, stinging for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Combs Aboard
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.

Name: Quill Overboard
Description: Drops a quill from overhead onto the first enemy in its path. It deals 4 damage, and its reach is 40% longer.

Name: Stoop From Height
Description: Carries you down onto a target up to 8 tiles away. The stoop deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, and it is always a critical hit.

Name: Updraft Hop
Description: Lifts you over the ground and sets you down at a point up to 8 tiles away. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Coasting Glide
Description: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Shot Over the Tailboard
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. An arrow loosed as you pull away deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds.

Name: Running Quiver
Description: Looses 3 arrows at once from the moving bed, spread apart; each deals 2 damage, with a 20% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Loosed From the String
Description: Draws you back and releases you 5 tiles forward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Level Firing Bed
Description: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Tumbril Ride
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Locks it aboard: deals 20 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Boxed In
Description: Swings out the barred sides of your wagon and deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Roll Bars
Description: Closes bars around you that absorb the next 22 damage and hold for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Menagerie Car
Description: A bonded beast travels in your barred wagon and fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Footboard Pounce
Description: Springs you from your seat onto a target up to 6 tiles away. The pounce deals 14 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Passing Rake
Description: Rakes claws across a cone 2 tiles long as you go by. It deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

Name: Righting Reflex
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance.

Name: Weaving Traffic
Description: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack faster for each stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.

Name: The Long Drive
Description: Drives team and wagon through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 28 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Horns First
Description: Gores the target with the full load behind the horns. The shunt deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hitch and Haul
Description: Hitches up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Yoked Ox
Description: A bonded draught ox walks in your traces and fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 2 seconds. You can ride it.

Name: Tow Hook Cast
Description: Throws a tow hook that deals 7 damage to the first enemy in its path, then links on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Dragged Behind
Description: Hooks the target and drags it behind you. It deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage each, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and 40% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Winch In
Description: Anchors a winch point ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Convoy Coupling
Description: Conjures a coupling that links you to your convoy: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, each kill returns 3 health, and you move 4% faster. The effect grows 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Trailing Pennant
Description: Lashes a target up to 4 tiles away with a streamer as you go by. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at maximum range, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Canvas Over All
Description: Runs you under full sail to a target up to 7 tiles away and drops the canvas over every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 28 damage that ignores armour and leaves each enemy [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Under the Awning
Description: Pitches your wagon's awning where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally under it.

Name: Spare Sail Aloft
Description: You move 8% faster and have 10% wind resistance.

Name: Run Aground
Description: Drives the target onto a spur of reef. The grounding deals 14 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and makes it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Scraped Keel
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Grinds past every enemy within 2.5 tiles: it deals 8 damage and leaves each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Hulk at Anchor
Description: Sinks a reef-grown hulk where you stand. It stays for 15 seconds, and every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage.

Name: Barnacle Skin
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield for each stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Hauled Under
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Clamps on and tows it down: deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Death Roll
Description: Clamps on and rolls the target over. The roll deals 30 damage, plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Low in the Water
Description: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you drift 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Held at Idle
Description: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Glancing Tine
Description: Clips the target with an antler as you bound past. It deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Scatter and Bolt
Description: You bolt through the press and startle it: the rush deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Out of the Snare
Description: Removes up to 3 control conditions from you. You move 30% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Sudden Swerve
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

Name: Harnessed Fangs
Description: Your lead hound bites from the traces. The bite deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%). It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Cut the Traces
Description: Slips the whole sled team at once: 4 hounds run out, spread apart, and each deals 8 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Whole Team Pulling
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Carriage Hound
Description: A bonded hound runs beside your wheels and fights with you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill returns 3 health.

Name: Thrown Wake
Description: Throws your wake across a cone 2.5 tiles long. It deals 3 damage and leaves each enemy [Soaked] for 2 seconds.

Name: Line Astern
Description: Sends a brood out in single file. It deals 12 damage to the first enemy in its path, then follows on to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Rolls Right Off
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Shallow Draught
Description: You cross water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Quarry Dump
Description: Tips a load of quarry stone onto the first enemy in its path. It deals 30 damage, and 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles of where it lands.

Name: Spun Gravel
Description: Your wheels throw up 4 stones at once, spread apart; each deals 2 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Bogged to the Hubs
Description: Churns the ground to mud under every creature within 4 tiles, holding each in place for 3 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Ballast
Description: When your health falls below 50%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health settles over you for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds. You have 10% earth resistance.

Name: Full Lamps
Description: Turns both carriage lamps on everything in a cone 4 tiles long. The glare deals 26 damage that ignores resistance and leaves each enemy [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Bearing Down
Description: Fixes on a target up to 7 tiles away and rushes you to it. The blow deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Lookout's Perch
Description: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

Name: Watched Approach
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Bolted Down
Description: A bite eaten on the move that deals 8 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Rolling Banquet
Description: Tips your laden cart over every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It deals 28 damage and restores 10 health to you. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Meals Brought Round
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Fuel From the Table
Description: Each time you regain health, you also regain 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Stoke the Box
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Opens your firebox on everything in a cone 3 tiles long: it deals 8 damage and sets each enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Heaped Coals
Description: Dumps the coals your run has heaped up onto the first enemy in their path. It deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage each. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 40%).

Name: Burning Tracks
Description: Lays a line of fire 5 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Head of Steam
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blast strikes the nearest enemy for each stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Live Bait Lob
Description: Lobs a live fish off the side of your ride at the first enemy in its path. It deals 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Bow Wave
Description: Ploughs your hull forward through a cone 4 tiles long, throwing up a wave of water and darting fish. It deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

Name: Wriggle Loose
Description: Removes 2 conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Riding Carp
Description: A bonded barge carp swims beside you and fights for you, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. You can ride it.

Name: Long Hop Landing
Description: Bounds your ride onto a target up to 7 tiles away. It deals 12 damage, up to 2 times that at the far end of its reach, and stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Biting Hitchhiker
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Your passenger bites the target: it deals 7 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Gap Jump
Description: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

Name: Sprung Seat
Description: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Running-Board Kick
Description: A kick from the running board that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Stamping Halt
Description: You brake hard and stamp down. It deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

Name: Forced March
Description: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

Name: Shorter Every Mile
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.

Name: Branch Line
Description: Sends a spark down the line into the first enemy in its path; it deals 7 damage, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Both Lanes
Description: Sends 2 runaway carts down diverging lanes at once; each deals 11 damage and stuns what it hits for 1 second.

Name: Change of Route
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and moves you 2 tiles.

Name: Switch Points
Description: Each time you land a critical hit, a fork of lightning hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Decoy Cart
Description: Rolls an empty decoy cart into the first enemy in its path. It deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and has a 50% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

Name: Dust in Their Eyes
Description: Spins your wheels to throw dust through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 7 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Blunted] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: False Trail
Description: Veils you for 6 seconds and moves you 25% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Already Down the Road
Description: Once every 12 seconds, an attack that would hit you rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.

Name: Bellyflop Landing
Description: Springs your ride into the air and brings it down on every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 13 damage, knocks them back 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Tongue From the Cab
Description: Lashes a sticky tongue from your seat at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Clutch Spring
Description: Increases your movement speed by 25% for 6 seconds. You spring 3 tiles from where you stood as it starts.

Name: Next Lily Pad
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 4 seconds. You also gain +5% dodge chance.

Name: Rotting Cargo
Description: Tosses a crate of spores off your tailgate at the first enemy in its path. It deals 7 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 8 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Toadstool Circuit

Name: Mycelium Rest Stop

Name: Spore Trail

Name: Uphill Charge

Name: Over the Edge

Name: Roadblock
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

Name: Keeps Climbing

Name: Drover's Pebble

Name: Barn on Wheels

Name: Circle the Wagons
Description: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.

Name: Turret Round

Name: Drive-By Spray
Description: Sprays 3 shots at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

Name: Limbered Cannon

Name: Backfiring Exhaust

Name: Tangled Reins

Name: Paved Over

Name: Hauled Brake Spin

Name: Pulled Aboard

Name: Holding On

Name: Never Winded

Name: Long-Ridden Steed

Name: Kedge Line

Name: Gaff in Passing

Name: Grapple Swing
Description: Snags a hold ahead and swings you 7 tiles forward.

Name: Caught in the Spokes

Name: Runaway Coach

Name: Full Gallop
Description: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +5% dodge chance.

Name: Hoofbeat Heart
Description: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1.

Name: Run to Ground

Name: Ride Alongside

Name: Scent in the Slipstream
Description: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds, and you move 20% faster for the first 5 seconds.

Name: Gaining Ground

Name: Cowcatcher

Name: Bolted Plating

Name: Cold Chassis
Description: Your armour rises by 12% at all times.

Name: Thrown From the Seat

Name: Running Cut

Name: Edge in the Lap
Description: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 15 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

Name: Drawn on the Move
Description: Each time you have travelled far enough, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Idle in the Sun

Name: Sun-Warmed Engine

Name: Crop for Fuel

Name: Surge Vents

Name: Unspent Fuel
Description: Fires the arcana left in your tank into the first enemy in its path. It deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

Name: Topping the Tank
Description: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Mana-Fed Engine
Description: Each time you spend mana, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Word to Halt
Description: After a 0.8 second incantation, speaks a command into the first enemy in its path. It deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Recited Route
Description: You recite a route and your ride drives it through a narrow cone 5 tiles long. It deals 30 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances.

Name: Carried Word
Description: Your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

Name: Practised Rounds
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.

Name: Barge Into
Description: Drifts the whole weight of your ride into a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 26 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and slows the target by 30% for 4 seconds.

Name: Lazy Wake
Description: Drifts a heavy wake over every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 6 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Becalmed
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Slow Water Living
Description: Your maximum health rises by 15. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.

Name: Same Puncture Twice
Description: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%).

Name: Finishing Form
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A sting that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: Primed Again
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Fourth Clean Strike

Name: Draw It Back Out
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A sting that deals 8 damage, draws your afflictions back out of the target and adds 0.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

Name: No Known Cure
Description: Stings every enemy within 3 tiles. Each sting deals 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaves its target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Returned Dose
Description: Raises a ward for 10 seconds: each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

Name: Immune to Its Own
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 12% poison resistance.

Name: Overarm Nest
Description: Hurls a nest that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. The enemy it strikes is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Ham-Fisted Jab
Description: A heavy backhand that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Stung to Frenzy
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

Name: Riled Beyond Reason
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Under the Gorget
Description: A sting that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Every Joint Found
Description: Stings everything in a cone 4 tiles long. Each sting deals 26 damage that ignores armour, with a 40% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Curled in the Shell
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Answered in Kind
Description: Every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Downstroke
Description: A chop that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Hew the Swollen
Description: A swing through a cone 2.5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%). It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Hollow Trunk Felled
Description: Fells a trunk 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Spiked Poll
Description: Conjures an axe: your weapon damage rises by 12%, you attack 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Lap What Was Opened
Description: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A bite that deals 8 damage, uses up one of those afflictions and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Out of the Eaves
Description: Looses 3 stingers at once, in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each one deals 10 damage and is always a critical hit, with a 50% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Roost Empties at Dusk
Description: Sends a swarm for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage. Each kill made while it flies restores 2 health to you.

Name: Drinks at the Wound
Description: When you put a condition on an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Pelt Shaken Out
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. It deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

Name: Full Weight Behind It

Name: Hide Too Thick

Name: Slow to Rouse

Name: Robbing the Comb
Description: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. 25% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds.

Name: Left-Behind Barb
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A sting that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Rally Scent
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

Name: Never Idle Wings
Description: Each time you kill an enemy, 3 stamina a second comes back to you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Culling Stoop
Description: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away: it deals 18 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Mobbing Flight
Description: A pass that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

Name: Hover and Dart
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance.

Name: Strafing Pass
Description: Every few paces you cover, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Quiver That Hums

Name: Nailed to the Spot

Name: Held Breath

Description: Stings every enemy within 3 tiles. Each sting deals 10 damage, stuns its target for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Egg Laid Last

Name: Stilled for the Egg
Description: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds and leaves each one [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Hatching Day

Description: The moment you are back at full health, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Buffalo Ford
Description: You charge up to 6 tiles to the target. It deals 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 6 tiles, and is left [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Herd Crossing
Description: Drives a wash of mud through a cone 3 tiles deep. It deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 2 seconds, and its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

Name: Evening Trough
Description: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

Name: Millrace
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Link to Link
Description: Sends a bolt of water into the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage. It then runs on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy hit [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Kedge Haul
Description: Sinks an anchor into a target up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it along the cable: it deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 7 tiles, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

Name: Bucket Brigade
Description: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally for 6 seconds.

Name: Thrown Lifeline
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Sodden Snap
Description: Snaps a soaked cloth at an enemy up to 3 tiles away. It deals 6 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and the target moves 25% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Damp Shroud
Description: Throws a soaked sheet over the first enemy it meets. It deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Damped] for 6 seconds.

Name: Cold Compress
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Wicking Weave
Description: When you regain health, you also regain 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Spawning Tide
Description: Releases a cloud of spawn that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Overgrown
Description: A weapon strike that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target with 50% more damage for each one used, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Fringing Reef
Description: Raises a reef 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that nothing crosses, and restores 8 health to you.

Name: A Grain a Year
Description: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Thrashed Shallows
Description: A sweeping strike that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Undertow
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A clamping strike that deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Enervated] for 5 seconds.

Name: Mudbank
Description: Your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Basking Count
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Sip and Start
Description: Flicks water at the first enemy it meets: it deals 4 damage, you heal for 20% of the damage dealt, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

Name: Brookside Bolt
Description: A spray from a leap that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks each back 2 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Lifted Head
Description: Restores 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Drinks Between Alarms
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Beater's Surge
Description: Sends a surge of water at the first enemy it meets that deals 26 damage, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Lapping Nip
Description: A weapon strike that deals 5 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Rescue Swim
Description: Restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds to the ally who needs it most.

Name: Marsh Retriever
Description: A bonded Marsh Retriever fights beside you. Every 1.2 seconds it deals 3 damage to an enemy within 4 tiles, and each kill it makes restores 5 health to you.

Name: The Dunking Stool
Description: Dunks the target under: it deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second, and leaves it [Soaked] for 8 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Spreading Wake
Description: A wake spreads from you and deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Beading Runoff
Description: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back onto whoever inflicted it.

Name: Paddling Underneath
Description: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on it, from bronze rank your health recovers 20% faster, from silver you move 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.

Name: Slurry Slide
Description: Sends a slide of mud through a cone 4 tiles deep. It deals 13 damage, carries enemies back 2 tiles and has a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

Name: Grit in the Current
Description: Sends a stream of grit at the target in front of you that deals 4 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Struck Spring
Description: Cracks the ground at your feet and a spring wells up. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Alluvium
Description: Every time you take damage, a layer of silt settles on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per layer (28% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Pellucid
Description: Strikes the target from up to 7 tiles away: it deals 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and ignores resistances. The target is left [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Brine in the Lashes
Description: Flicks 3 drops of brine at once, spread apart. Each one deals 2 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

Name: Mirror Pond
Description: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Droplet Lens
Description: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and you carry 10% water resistance.

Name: Lees
Description: Pulls a surge of water at the first enemy it meets that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 60% more damage for each one used. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

Name: Stockpot
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sends out a ring of broth that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 30%).

Name: Toast All Round
Description: You restore 8 health, and every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Salt Thirst
Description: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Boiler Burst
Description: Hurls a ball of boiling water that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It then bursts and hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Thermal Shock
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. It deals 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Scalding Mantle
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Head of Steam
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack of pressure builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blast of steam strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Schooling Darts
Description: Looses a school of 3 darting jets of water, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Slick Recoil
Description: Your weapon runs slick with water for one strike that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Drowning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Eel Skin
Description: Your dodge chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you restore 10 health.

Name: Never Netted
Description: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Plunging Leap
Description: Leaps you to a target up to 7 tiles away and lands in a crushing splash that deals 16 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Far-Flung Droplet
Description: Flicks a bead of water at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at full reach.

Name: Springing Film
Description: Wraps you in a skin of water that absorbs the next 14 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Landing Spatter
Description: Each time you spend stamina, a droplet springs to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Wading Kick
Description: A kick carried by river water that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Boot Full of River
Description: Kicks a cone of cold, muddy water 4 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Cool Footbath
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Mile by Mile
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Branching Jet
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A jet of water deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that damage.

Name: Distributary
Description: Floods out from you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

Name: Backwash
Description: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

Name: Tributary
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, the healing you receive rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Sly Undercut
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A low feint with a water-slicked weapon that deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Drowning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, then you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Mirage Shimmer
Description: A shimmer of false reflections spreads from you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 15% chance to turn each against its allies for 2 seconds.

Name: False Reflection
Description: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back at whoever dealt it.

Name: Puddle Vixen
Description: Calls a bonded vixen of water that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds; anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: Lunge from the Reeds
Description: Springs you at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 14 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

Name: Croaking Ripple
Description: Sends a croaking ripple out from you that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

Name: Dampened Leap
Description: Springs you 2 tiles away, and the healing you receive rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Coiled Spring
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Soft Rot
Description: Your weapon carries damp spores for one strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Mildew Burst
Description: Bursts a cloud of wet spores around you that deals 26 damage, plus 4% of the maximum health of a boss or elite, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Damp Bed
Description: Spreads a bed of wet moss where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Slow Seep
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Ram the Rapids
Description: A ramming charge carried by a surge of water that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Crag Spill
Description: Tips a torrent down from the heights onto a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 2 times at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Anchor the Shore
Description: Your armour rises by 25% and your water resistance by 15% for 12 seconds.

Name: Sure Footing
Description: When your health falls below 40%, a film of water shields you for 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Herd Surge
Description: A stampede of water rolls out from you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Spattered Cud
Description: Spits a wad of wet cud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drinking Circle
Description: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

Name: Second Stomach
Description: Each time you regain health, you restore 4 stamina. Once every 5 seconds. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Burst Main
Description: Fires a high-pressure slug of water that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Hydrostatic Round
Description: Fires a crushing round of compressed water at a target up to 10 tiles away that deals 32 damage, ignores its armour and hits harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at full reach.

Name: Recoil Jet
Description: Fires a jet of water behind you that throws you 4 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

Name: Building Pressure
Description: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Drowning Tangle
Description: Hurls a sodden mass of strands that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and has a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: Wet Lash
Description: Whips a fan of wet strands 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Kelp Curtain
Description: Hangs a curtain of dripping strands 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

Name: Matted Undertow
Description: Every hit you land knots a stack onto that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Fathom Press
Description: Brings the weight of deep water down on the target, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Pounding Surf
Description: Slams the ground and sends out a wave that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Struck Anvil
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each kill you make while it holds restores 6 health.

Name: Leveller
Description: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Hold Under
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A grip of water holds the target under and deals 20 damage, using up every affliction you have on it, adding their remaining damage and dealing 60% more damage for each.

Name: Grasping Splash
Description: Throws a grasping splash of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

Name: Cupped Palms
Description: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

Name: Wringing Grip
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Tidal Trample
Description: Rushes you up to 6 tiles at a target, then a spate of water rolls 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it.

Name: Hoof Splash
Description: Kicks a spray of water at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.6 times at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Ride the Current
Description: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance.

Name: Slackened Tide
Description: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.

Name: Barbed Eddy
Description: Twists a hooked eddy 4 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward, dealing 10 damage and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Snagged Silt
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A barbed strike with a wet edge deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Reel In
Description: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds. A current of water fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Caught Fast
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your conditions, your damage rises by 10%.

Name: Wild Combers
Description: Drives a gallop of breaking waves 6 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage to everything caught in it and ignoring their resistances.

Name: Galloping Breaker
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away on a breaking wave, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Surf Steeds
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a steed of surf that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Bow Wave
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, a wave of water shields you for 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Closing Tide
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Sends a closing tide at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 24 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.4 times at full reach.

Name: Trail Through Silt
Description: Sends a thread of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Silent Wading
Description: Your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

Name: Spoils of the Chase
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Rust Through
Description: Your weapon runs with rusting water for one strike that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's armour, leaves it [Corroding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

Name: Corroding Spray
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Sprays a cone of rust-laden water 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

Name: Quenched Bulwark
Description: Raises a barrier of quenched iron that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

Name: Cold Ballast
Description: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% water resistance.

Name: Silt-Hidden Edge
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A blade of pressed water deals 20 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet bled.

Name: Thrown Slivers
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws 3 slivers of pressed water, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

Name: Murk
Description: Veils you in murky water for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Bloodied Rill
Description: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Basker's Ambush
Description: Takes 1 second of stillness, then spits a cold jet that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

Name: Chill Spit
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Spits cold water at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

Name: Shed and Regrow
Description: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

Name: Riverbank Sunning
Description: During the day, your damage rises by 10%. You carry 8% water resistance.

Name: Plague Rain
Description: Looses a cloud of 6 driving raindrops, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and ignoring resistances. 15% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

Name: Strip the Stalk
Description: A jet of water deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets, using up every affliction you have on it and dealing 60% more damage for each.

Name: Devouring Squall
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a stinging squall for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

Name: Stripped Fields
Description: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Wellspring Lance
Description: Hurls a lance of mana-charged water that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts and hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Leyline Swell
Description: Sends a ripple of raw mana through the water around you that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

Name: Drawn from the Well
Description: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Overflow
Description: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Drowned Syllable
Description: Speaks a word that drops a weight of water on a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.3 times at full reach, and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Recited Bead
Description: Speaks a bead of water into being that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Stilled Surface
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to speak a stilling word that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

Name: Quick Study
Description: Each time you inflict a condition, you restore 4 mana. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Nudging Bump
Description: A slow shove of water that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

Name: Wallowing Roll
Description: Rolls over in a slow heave of water that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and has a 60% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

Name: Drift Off
Description: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

Name: Unbothered
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Rote Verse
Description: Sings a drilled phrase that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it ringing with [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds.

Name: Coda
Description: A closing note that deals 18 damage to an enemy up to 8 tiles away and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Taught by Ear
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Refrain
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

Name: Spat Dregs
Description: Spits the strained-out dregs in a cone 5 tiles ahead, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Backwash
Description: Draws one of your afflictions back out of an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

Name: Baleen Sieve
Description: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 8 health.

Name: Ambergris
Description: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Driftwood Heave
Description: Hurls driftwood at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Grip and Plunge
Description: Grips the target and drops on it with your full weight, which deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Booming Challenge
Description: Booms a challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

Name: Slow to Rouse
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Ramming Brow
Description: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and rams it head-first, which deals 14 damage and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Broadside
Description: Slams down broadside, which deals 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Barnacle Crust
Description: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Fathom Plate
Description: Conjures plate built for the deep: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 12, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Final Cut
Description: Cuts down through a weakened enemy, which deals 26 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Flensing Arc
Description: A wide stripping cut that deals 7 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead, with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Flukes Up
Description: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 12 seconds.

Name: Scrimshaw Cleaver

Name: Sounding Ping
Description: Sends out a ping that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Stunning Click
Description: Fires a focused click that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

Name: Lightless Dive
Description: Veils you and your allies for 9 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Blackwater Hunter
Description: At night, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.

Name: Fattening Bite
Description: Snaps at the first enemy in front of you, which deals 4 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Toppling Bulk
Description: Rears up and falls flat, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of maximum health to a boss or elite.

Name: Burn the Reserve
Description: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

Name: Winter Layer
Description: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your ice resistance rises by 10%.

Name: Droning Round
Description: Hums 3 notes at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

Name: Stray Sting

Description: Coils the lash round an enemy up to 7 tiles away and swings you to it, which deals 13 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach.

Name: Thrashing Bough
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Thrashes the lash around you with both arms, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Stunned] for 1 second.

Name: Troop Rally
Description: Cracks a challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

Name: Working Up a Temper
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Buckle Cutter
Description: Flicks the tip under a strap on an enemy within 3.5 tiles, which deals 4 damage and lowers its armour by 6% for 5 seconds.

Name: Unbuckling Sweep
Description: Rakes the lash through a cone that deals 27 damage to everything within 4.5 tiles and ignores armour. Each enemy hit is left [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

Name: Lamellar Windings
Description: Winds the lash around you as a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

Name: Plate Seams
Description: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.

Name: Headsman's Reach
Description: Drops a bladed tip on an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away, which deals 24 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach.

Name: Felling Arc
Description: Swings the bladed tip in a full circle that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to the enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

Name: Honed Edge
Description: Edges the tip of your lash: your critical hits deal 30% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Rope-Dart Bit

Name: Clap in the Rafters
Description: Cracks the lash overhead with a report that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and stuns each for 1 second.

Name: Nightfeeder's Flick
Description: Flicks the tip into the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Name: Belfry Swing
Description: Lashes a spot up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it at once. You also gain 10% dodge chance.

Name: Echo Off the Walls
Description: When you strike with your weapon, a bolt hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Heavy Hand
Description: A weapon strike that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Downstroke

Name: Baiting Answered

Name: Tethered Bruin

Name: Angry Flight
Description: Snaps 3 stingers off the tip in a spread out to 6 tiles; each deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.
