Description: A running bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Hoofbeats in Time
Description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. A packmate runs beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Long-Legged Stride
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.

Name: End of the Chase
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A closing bite that deals 24 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Run It Down
Description: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target first, then strike for 14 damage and leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

Name: Scent Found
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Quarry After Quarry
Description: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 15 seconds.

Name: Clamped Shut
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health. A locking bite that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

Name: Grey Wall Closes
Description: The pack closes a ring of teeth around you, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores armour.

Name: Sprung for Them
Description: Sets a set of jaws on the nearest enemy. It waits 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles takes 20 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Bites Through Mail
Description: Your piercing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.

Name: Unseen First Cut
Description: A snap that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Flank Opened
Description: A slash from the side that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Teeth Bared Late
Description: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

Name: Waiting Edge
Description: When you go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Flick and Snap
Description: A darting snap that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, with a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

Name: From Utter Stillness
Description: A lunge that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores resistances, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

Name: Licked and Regrown
Description: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

Name: Sunned on the Rocks
Description: By day, you deal 10% more damage.

Name: Stripping the Field
Description: Bites into everything close, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Descending Cloud
Description: A bounding leap that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Famine Follows
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a devouring cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

Name: Marrow Meal
Description: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Conjured Loper
Description: Sends a loping shape of arcane force that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It stays beside you for 3 seconds, striking for 2 every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Light-Bending Howl
Description: A howl that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles of you and ignores resistances.

Name: Called From Candlelight
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a packmate of arcane light that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Arc to the Nearest
Description: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Final Syllable
Description: A spoken bolt that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each.

Name: Two-Word Command
Description: Looses 2 bolts of arcane force at once, spread apart out to 6 tiles, each dealing 7 damage. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

Name: Drilled Cadence
Description: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds. A packmate fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Learned by Rote
Description: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.

Name: Unhurried Gnaw
Description: A slow bite that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Rolling Swell
Description: A wave rolls through a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocks them back 3 tiles. Each has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Warm Pool Rest
Description: Raises a still pool where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Slow Salve
Description: Your maximum health rises by 6%. You also regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.

Name: Exact Ignition
Description: Throws a bead of flame that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, always as a critical hit, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Rehearsed Singe
Description: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Juggler's Coals
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds. For the first 8 seconds, burning coals strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Muscle Memory
Description: Your ability cooldowns are 8% shorter, and you have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Caustic Spark
Description: Flicks a spark of flame that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It has a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

Name: Bitter Fumes
Description: Burns a reagent in a ring around you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each has a 50% chance to be [Damped], its damage lowered, for 6 seconds.

Name: Burn It Off
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. For 6 seconds afterwards, they burn off as flames that strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Sweated Out
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 12% poison resistance.

Name: Lobbed Bough
Description: Throws a burning branch at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Knuckles Aflame
Description: Pounds the ground with burning fists, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

Name: Brandished Torch
Description: Increases your fire damage by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

Name: Kindled Cudgel
Description: Conjures a burning branch to wield as a club. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Melt Through
Description: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Struck Sparks
Description: Throws sparks in a cone that deals 4 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Sundered], its armour softened, for 5 seconds.

Name: Annealed Barrier
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds. For the first 5 seconds, it burns your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Tempered Mail
Description: Conjures a suit of armour: every hit you take deals 2 less damage, your armour rises by 10%, and 12% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

Name: Heartwood Split
Description: A falling chop at an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Windmill Cut
Description: Swings a burning axe head in a full circle, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Honed Edge
Description: Increases your critical hit damage by 35% for 12 seconds. For the first 8 seconds, sparks off the blade strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Flying Splinters
Description: When you strike with your weapon, a burning splinter flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, deals 6 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Scorched Echo
Description: Screeches a tongue of flame that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then echoes to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

Name: Fevered Colony
Description: Looses 3 bats in a spread, each of which deals 3 damage with a 25% chance to set its target [Burning] for 5 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Smoke Roost
Description: Veils you in smoke for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Wingbeat Embers
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, an ember drops on the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 5 damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Furnace Maul
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then mauls it, which deals 14 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 6 seconds.

Name: Cornered Roar
Description: Roars a cone of flame that deals 28 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and ignores resistances. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

Name: Winter Den
Description: Lights a fire where you stand that reaches 3 tiles. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Slow to Rouse
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a burst of flame strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Roasting Cluster
Description: Sends the swarm to cluster around an enemy at or below 25% health: the swarm deals 18 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Needle Swarm
Description: Looses 4 burning stingers in a spread, each of which deals 2 damage. Their damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

Name: Keeper's Hush
Description: Holds every creature within 3.5 tiles in place for 4 seconds and leaves each [Hindered], its attacks slowed, for 6 seconds.

Name: Candlewax Drone
Description: A bonded ember-bee flies with you. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 3 damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Stoop of Cinders
Description: A burning dive on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Shed Plumage
Description: Sheds 4 of your feathers in a spread, each of which deals 3 damage. Each use costs 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Soaring Pyre
Description: Looses a firebird for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it dives on an enemy within 5 tiles, which deals 4 damage with a 35% chance to set the target [Burning] for 6 seconds.

Name: Out of the Ashes
Description: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.

Name: Pitch Arrow
Description: Looses a pitch-soaked arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Burning Rain
Description: Looses 5 lit arrows in a wide spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 5 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Tracer Shafts
Description: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far. For the first 8 seconds, lit arrows strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Tinder String
Description: Conjures a bow with a burning string. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 6%, and every arrow from it sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Red-Hot Gibbet
Description: Drops a cage of red-hot bars over a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It holds the target stunned for 1.2 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Closing Brazier
Description: Closes a ring of burning bars around you that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, always as a critical hit, and leaves each [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

Name: Bars of Flame
Description: Raises a row of red-hot bars 5 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it, sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds.

Name: Portcullis
Description: When your health falls below 30%, bars of flame close around you: you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds, and for the first 5 seconds the bars burn your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.

Name: Scorching Pounce
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes it with your weapon, which deals 12 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

Name: Tipped Lamp
Description: Swats a lit lamp at the first enemy it meets, which deals 26 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. The lamp then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Unsinged
Description: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it. You have 15% fire resistance.

Name: Toying Distance
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.

Name: Branding Iron
Description: Presses a hot brand into the target, which deals 8 damage, sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Bellows Breath
Description: Bellows a cone of flame that deals 27 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and sets each target [Burning] for 10 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

Name: Cured Hide
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds. You have 15% fire resistance.

Name: Stoked by Blows
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds.

Name: Leaping Lash
Description: Whips a red-hot length that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

Name: Heated Manacle
Description: A lash of heated links with your weapon that deals 4 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Glowing Tether
Description: Stretches a red-hot length 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

Name: One Catches the Next
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage, then to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Smouldering Shroud
Description: Throws a burning shroud over an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It leaves the target [Suppressed], its abilities put out of reach, for 5 seconds.

Name: Whirled Sash
Description: Whirls a burning sash that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to set each [Burning] for 5 seconds. [Burning] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles.

Name: Sooty Drapes
Description: Draws a curtain of smoke over you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Slow Match
Description: When one of your afflictions burns down to its end, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Scalding Vent
Description: Vents a cone of scalding steam that deals 12 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and pushes each target back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Burning] for 5 seconds.

Name: Stinging Polyp
Description: A raking weapon strike edged with stinging growth that deals 8 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each use costs 3% of your maximum health.

Name: Touch and Burn
Description: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Vent Bloom
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.

Name: Banked Lunge
Description: A lunge out of stillness that deals 34 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

Name: Death Roll
Description: Thrashes in a ring of flame, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Sleeping Cinder
Description: Buries a banked coal at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it bursts and deals 22 damage.

Name: Basking Heat
Description: In daylight, your damage rises by 12%. You have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Tines Alight
Description: Tosses the target on burning antlers with your weapon, which deals 12 damage, throws it back 3 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Startle Flash
Description: A sudden flash of flame that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds after you use it.

Name: Transfixed
Description: A glare of firelight holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after you use it.

Name: Quick Hooves
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and you have 12% fire resistance.

Name: Hellhound's Bay
Description: Bays a ring of flame that deals 27 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

Name: Singeing Fang
Description: A bite with your weapon that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

Name: Faithful Flame
Description: Sets a hound of flame on your enemies for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it bites an enemy within 5 tiles, which deals 5 damage with a 25% chance to set the target [Burning] for 4 seconds.

Name: Hot on the Trail
Description: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.

Name: Oil Slick
Description: Sprays burning oil that deals 8 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and leaves each target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Skipping Coal
Description: Skips a hot coal low across the ground that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles, then skips on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

Name: Preened Feathers
Description: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. You have 12% fire resistance.

Name: Sparks Roll Off
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.

Name: Caldera
Description: Splits the ground around you with molten rock, which deals 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignores armour and sets each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Magma Knuckle
Description: A blow with a fist of half-molten rock that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to set it [Burning] for 6 seconds.

Name: Basalt Ridge
Description: Raises a ridge of lava rock 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 6 seconds. Anything that touches it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Cooling Crust
Description: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Burning Glass
Description: Focuses a beam through a lens onto a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 15 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It burns away every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

Name: Dazzle
Description: A flare of white flame that deals 11 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, stuns each target for 1 second and leaves it [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 6 seconds.

Name: Watchtower Beacon
Description: Lights a beacon where you stand for 14 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds its beam burns an enemy within 7 tiles, which deals 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Held Focus
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a beam of focused heat strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Searing Mouthful
Description: Spits a gobbet of flame that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Last Course
Description: A searing bite that deals 16 damage and devours every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

Name: Spit-Roast
Description: Roasts every body within 8 tiles, up to 5, and eats them: each gives back 7% of your health.

Name: Gorging Blaze
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Flashover
Description: Looses 4 fireballs in a wide spread, each of which deals 10 damage, ignores resistances and sets its target [Burning] for 6 seconds. [Burning] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

Name: Backdraft
Description: Throws a gout of flame that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 80% of that. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Fanned Higher
Description: Increases your fire damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Nothing Left Unlit
Description: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 15% fire resistance.

Name: Spark Shoal
Description: Looses a shoal of 3 sparks that spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to set the target [Burning] for 3 seconds.

Name: Scatter the School
Description: Hurls a flame that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. It then darts to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

Name: Through the Boil
Description: You slip 2 tiles, and for 3 seconds blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You have 15% fire resistance.

Name: Gleam Off the Scales
Description: Every time you avoid a blow, a spark builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Hopping Cinder
Description: Flicks a cinder that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Failing Host
Description: A biting strike that deals 20 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

Name: Sudden Bound
Description: You leap 3 tiles and your dodge chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds. A cloud of burning sparks fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 3 every 1 second.

Name: New Host
Description: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Mile-End Kick
Description: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, sets it [Burning] for 5 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

Name: Smouldering Tread
Description: Stamps a 4-tile trail of burning ground ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 6 damage to each enemy that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Coalwalk
Description: Raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 25% for 10 seconds, freeing you of every root, freeze and slow. You have 25% fire resistance.

Name: Kicked-Up Embers
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover flings an ember at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.

Name: Cleft Flare
Description: Throws a brand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 80% of the original damage. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

Name: Two-Pronged Gout
Description: Looses 2 gouts of flame that split apart, each dealing 12 damage and setting the target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Parted Flames
Description: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is split off and sent back to whoever dealt it. You have 15% fire resistance.

Name: Second Prong
Description: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 2. When you reach 2, they all spend at once: a second blow of flame strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (41% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.

Name: Marsh Light
Description: Sends a flickering light that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds. Each hit has a 15% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

Name: Led Astray
Description: Lights false fires around up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles, which deals 26 damage to each, ignoring their resistances, and sets them [Burning] for 6 seconds. They turn against each other for 5 seconds.

Name: Flickering Double
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to call up a flickering copy of yourself that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each strike has a 35% chance to set the target [Burning] for 5 seconds.

Name: Flustered Prey
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Flicked Lash
Description: Lashes out up to 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full reach, and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Splashdown
Description: You spring onto a target up to 7 tiles away and land in a burst of flame that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Swamp Gas Bubble
Description: Takes 1 second to sink a bubble of swamp gas at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles ignites it: it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

Name: Coiled Spring
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Puffball Burst
Description: Bursts a cloud of smouldering spores that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

Name: Punkwood Finish
Description: A blow that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction you have on the target, adding their remaining damage to the hit and 60% more damage for each one.

Name: Smoking Mound
Description: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a smoking mound of caps beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds embers on enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds, and each hit has a 30% chance to set the target [Burning] for 4 seconds. It taunts your last target.

Name: Takes Root Anywhere
Description: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You have 8% fire resistance.

Name: Butting Blaze
Description: A butting strike that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Will Not Be Quenched
Description: Hurls a flame that deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's resistances, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

Name: Planted on the Crag
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 15%. You have 20% fire resistance.

Name: Shrugged Off
Description: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Trampling Heat
Description: Drives a wide wave of flame ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles, knocks each back 2.5 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

Name: Warmth Passed Around
Description: A strike that deals 26 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. When it lands, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Banked Hearth
Description: Banks a low fire where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

Name: Ember Calf
Description: Calls a bonded calf of fire that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and setting what it hits [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Powder Charge
Description: Fires a ball of packed powder that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it hits and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Muzzle Flash
Description: A flash of flame bursts from you in a narrow cone, dealing 12 damage to everything within 3 tiles, stunning each for 0.8 seconds and setting it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

Name: Powder Smoke
Description: Veils you in powder smoke for 5 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

Name: Ricochet
Description: When you land a critical hit, a spark ricochets to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.

Name: Lit Strand
Description: A whip of burning strands that deals 4 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 10% for 1 second.

Name: Flash Singe
Description: Flings out a fan of flaring strands that deals 26 damage to everything within 4 tiles ahead of you and sets each [Burning] for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Snaring Strands
Description: Strings a 5-tile web of smouldering strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. Anything caught moves 25% slower for 2 seconds and is set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Through the Weave
Description: Your fire damage cannot be resisted.

Name: While It's Hot

Name: Forge Quake

Name: Sparks off the Anvil
Description: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Rhythm of the Forge

Name: Scalding Clasp
Description: Seizes the target in a burning grip that deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Steady Pour

Name: Cauterizing Touch
Description: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

Name: Held Flame
Description: Each time you afflict an enemy, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Trampled Scorch
Description: A trampling strike that deals 8 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 3 seconds and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Sun-Baked Circuit
Description: Circles in a ring of desert heat that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

Name: Stoked Stride
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds. A running blaze fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

Name: Desert-Hardened Pace
Description: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%. You have 10% fire resistance.

Name: Hauled Onto the Coals
Description: Casts a 5-tile line of red-hot barbs ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Barb Left In
Description: A barbed strike that deals 7 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

Name: Reel In
Description: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds. A ring of flame fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

Name: Lingering Snag
Description: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Galloping Blaze

Name: Ridden Down

Name: Blazing Mare

Name: Built-Up Momentum
Description: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.

Name: Run to Ground

Name: Wintering Waters

Name: Nothing Takes Hold

Name: Spent Dose
Description: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.

Name: Concussive Screech

Name: Talons Close
Description: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Seizes it with a grip that deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Standing Takeoff

Name: Gathered Airspeed
Description: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Staggering Flight
Description: Draws for 1 second, then looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart. Each deals 5 damage and stuns its target for 0.8 seconds.

Name: Taut String
Description: After a 1-second draw, your attacks and spells reach 40% further for 20 seconds.

Name: Bodkin Weight
Description: Your piercing attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.

Name: Bars of Your Own

Name: Coiled Spring

Name: One of Nine

Name: Chewing the Cud
Description: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

Name: Draught Strength

Name: Never Lets Go

Name: Set Up the Patsy
Description: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Tongue Crack
Description: Snaps your tongue out to 5 tiles, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

Name: Belly-Flop
Description: You spring onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and land on it, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

Name: Crouched Spring
Description: Crouch for 1 second, then your damage rises 30% for 10 seconds.

Name: Pent-Up Leap
Description: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.

Name: Burst the Cap
Description: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. The blow deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

Name: Rot Through
Description: A rotting blow that deals 16 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 10 seconds. Your afflictions on it then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

Name: Swell Overnight
Description: Your maximum health rises 25% for 20 seconds.

Name: Creeping Mass
Description: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.

Name: Lowered Horns
Description: Butts the target with your full weight, which deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Off the Ledge
Description: Kicks out in a cone 3.5 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Unbudging
Description: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

Name: Stubborn Footing
Description: Your armour rises by 12% at all times.

Name: Shoulder to Shoulder
Description: Shoulders outward, which deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4.

Name: Lead Bull's Blow
Description: A blow that deals 30 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left. When it lands, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

Name: Herd's Edge
Description: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

Name: Thick Winter Coat
Description: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 6%.

Name: Point-Blank Report
Description: Fires a slug of packed force that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour.

Name: Buckshot Flick
Description: Flicks 3 pellets of force in a spread; each deals 3 damage.

Name: Snap Reload
Description: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Loaded Chamber
Description: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Bring Down the Pillars
Description: Heaves for 1.5 seconds, then deals 36 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour, and pins each of them for 2 seconds.

Name: Braided Lash
Description: Costs 4% of your maximum health. The lash deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

Name: Matted Mane
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Strand by Strand
Description: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (60% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.

Name: Collar and Hold
Description: Seizes the target and holds it fast, which deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

Name: Wrist Lock
Description: Wrenches the target's arm: the strike deals 4 damage and leaves it [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

Name: White Knuckles
Description: Your attacks come 25% faster for 12 seconds.

Name: Lifter's Chalk
Description: Conjures a pouch of grip chalk: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more, each kill returns 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.

Name: Ceaseless Kicking
Description: Kicks out in a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

Name: Rear and Trample
Description: Rears and stamps down on the target, which deals 15 damage, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Long-Ridden Lungs
Description: Your stamina recovers 50% faster for 18 seconds.

Name: Never Winded
Description: When your stamina runs out, you restore 5 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. Your armour rises by 8%.

Name: Barbed Haul
Description: Hurls a barbed line at a target at or below 25% health, which deals 24 damage to the first enemy it meets.

Name: Rip Through
Description: Drives a barb through armour: the strike deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Reel Them In
Description: Casts out a line of force 6 tiles long that lasts 4 seconds and drags every enemy near it inward.

Name: Heavy Bill
Description: Conjures a heavy billhook. Your weapon damage rises by 10%, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

Name: Full-Gallop Shoulder
Description: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and drive into it, which deals 16 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Stampede Line
Description: Thunders through a narrow cone 5 tiles long, which deals 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Barded Charger
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises 30% for 6 seconds.

Name: Momentum Carried
Description: When you have covered a stretch of ground, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Brought to Bay
Description: Hurls a blow at a target at or below 30% health up to 6 tiles away, which deals 26 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full range.

Name: Driving Blow
Description: Sends a bolt of force into the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

Name: Close for the Kill
Description: Your damage rises 25% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

Name: Quarry's Scent
Description: Against enemies carrying a condition, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Anvil Fist
Description: The strike deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it [Frostbite] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

Name: Dead-Weight Sweep
Description: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Leaden] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Stand Like a Post
Description: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

Name: Tempered by Blows
Description: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.

Name: Buried to the Hilt
Description: A blow that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit, uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

Name: Fanned Blades
Description: Throws 2 heavy blades at once in a spread; each deals 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Edge in Reserve
Description: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

Name: Edge Comes Out
Description: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your physical damage rises 40% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.

Name: Tail Lash
Description: Whips your weight around to hit a target up to 4 tiles away, which deals 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

Name: Slow Clamp
Description: A bite that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Sunned Hide
Description: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10%.

Name: Warm-Blooded Hours
Description: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage.

Name: Strip the Field
Description: Strips every enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 28 damage to each, ignoring resistances, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

Name: Skipping Swarm
Description: Sends a bolt of force into the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

Name: Gorge on the Crop
Description: Restores 20 health at once, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

Name: Never Sated
Description: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Unrefined Torrent
Description: Pours raw arcana through a narrow cone 5 tiles long, which deals 30 damage to everything in it, ignoring resistances.

Name: Overcharged Knuckles
Description: Costs 5% of your maximum health. The strike deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Unravelling] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

Name: Wring Out the Reserve
Description: Forces raw arcana back into you, restoring 25 mana at once.

Name: Mana Into Muscle
Description: When you spend mana, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.

Name: Word of Command
Description: Barks a word of force across a cone 3.5 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1 second.

Name: Final Syllable
Description: A blow that deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one.

Name: Called Cadence
Description: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

Name: Drilled Forms
Description: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.

Name: Full Weight Settles
Description: After 1.5 seconds your weight comes down, which deals 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour.

Name: Rolling Swell
Description: Pushes a slow swell of water into the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Unbothered
Description: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 15 seconds.

Name: Blubber Buffer
Description: When a non-fire blow hurts you, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.

Name: Everything at Once
Description: Hurls a blow with all of your surplus behind it at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 36 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range. Every hit is a critical hit.

Name: Excess Shockwave
Description: Releases the surplus, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3.5 tiles.

Name: Spill Over
Description: Increases your damage by 40% for 15 seconds.

Name: Twice the Frame
Description: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises 5%, from silver your attacks come 5% faster, and from gold your critical hits deal 10% more.

Name: Loosened Strap
Description: Works a strap loose mid-blow: the strike deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

Name: Thrown Crate
Description: Hurls the nearest heavy object; it deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

Name: Untied
Description: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

Name: Second Grab
Description: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
